title: Graphify: Automated Synthesis of Type-Safe Graph Backends via $O(S)$ GraphQL-to-Gremlin Transpilation
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures. Introduces a formal mapping between GraphQL and Gremlin with $O(S)$ time complexity. Includes empirical evaluation on MovieLens 100k. Open-source implementation available at https://github.com/Graf-J/Graphify
summary: Graph databases offer unparalleled flexibility for managing interconnected data, yet the lack of strict schema enforcement often leads to runtime uncertainties and complex query development. This paper introduces Graphify, an end-to-end framework that enables developers to visually model graph data schemas and automatically synthesize a fully functional, type-safe backend. This paper proposes a formal mapping of GraphQL artifacts to the Gremlin traversal machine, supporting complete CRUD operations and arbitrarily nested queries. The system generates a transpiler capable of converting complex GraphQL requests into a single, optimized Gremlin query, including advanced features such as nested logical predicates, multi-key sorting, and pagination. At the core of the framework is a recursive state machine algorithm that processes GraphQL Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) with linear time complexity $O(S)$ relative to the number of selected fields. This paper demonstrates the practical efficiency and theoretical robustness of the approach through formal complexity analysis and empirical evaluation using the MovieLens 100k dataset. The result is a system that enables the generation of graph interfaces in minutes, bridging the gap between flexible graph storage and type-safe API consumption.

AI.tldr: Graphify是一个端到端框架，通过形式化映射将GraphQL转译为Gremlin查询，使用递归状态机算法（O(S)复杂度）自动生成类型安全的图数据库后端接口，解决图数据库schema缺失和查询开发复杂的问题。
AI.motivation: 图数据库虽灵活但缺乏严格的模式强制执行，导致运行时不确定性增加和查询开发复杂；同时，将灵活的图存储与类型安全的API消费相连接存在技术鸿沟。
AI.method: 1) 提出GraphQL artifacts到Gremlin遍历机的形式化映射方法；2) 开发支持完整CRUD操作的转译器；3) 设计递归状态机算法处理GraphQL AST，时间复杂度为O(S)（S为选中字段数）；4) 支持嵌套逻辑谓词、多键排序和分页。
AI.result: 理论和实验验证了方法的有效性：递归状态机算法达到线性时间复杂度O(S)；使用MovieLens 100k数据集进行实证评估；实现了分钟级图接口生成能力。
AI.conclusion: Graphify通过形式化映射和递归状态机算法，成功实现了GraphQL到Gremlin的自动转换，将原本需要手动编写的复杂图数据库查询转化为类型安全的API接口，显著降低了图数据库开发门槛。

title: Unified Data Discovery across Query Modalities and User Intents
summary: Data discovery - retrieving relevant tables from a data lake in response to user queries - is a fundamental building block for downstream analytics. In practice, data discovery must support different query modalities, including natural language (NL) statements and tables, and accommodate diverse user intents, ranging from open-ended enrichment to task-driven inference for applications such as table question answering and fact verification. However, most existing methods are designed for a single query modality or a specific user intent, limiting their generalizability. We propose UniDisc, a unified data discovery framework that supports both NL statements and tables as queries and generalizes across diverse user intents without intent-specific representations or relevance modeling. UniDisc learns a common cross-modal representation model that produces unified representations for queries of different modalities and candidate tables, enabling uniform relevance assessment across discovery scenarios. Since learning such a model typically requires large labeled collections of query-table pairs, which are expensive to obtain, UniDisc instead exploits contextual signals naturally available in data lakes. Specifically, it models NL statements and tables as nodes in a heterogeneous graph with multiple edge types, and applies dual-view neighbor aggregation and joint optimization to learn robust, context-aware representations under limited supervision. These representations support flexible relevance estimation during retrieval. Experiments on seven datasets show that UniDisc consistently outperforms strong baselines on both NL- and table-based discovery.

AI.tldr: UniDisc是一个统一的数据发现框架，通过异构图学习和上下文信号，在无需大量标注数据的情况下，同时支持自然语言和表格两种查询模态，并在多种数据发现场景中超越强基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有数据发现方法通常针对单一查询模态或特定用户意图设计，泛化能力有限；同时，构建大规模标注查询-表对数据集成本高昂。
AI.method: (1) 提出统一跨模态表示模型，将不同模态的查询和候选表映射到统一表示空间；(2) 构建包含自然语言和表格节点的异构图，利用多类型边关系；(3) 采用双视图邻居聚合和联合优化策略，在有限监督下学习上下文感知的鲁棒表示。
AI.result: 在7个数据集上的实验表明，UniDisc在自然语言查询和表格查询两种发现任务上均一致性地超越强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过异构图上下文信号和统一表示学习，UniDisc实现了跨模态、跨意图的通用数据发现能力，为构建更实用的数据湖检索系统提供了新思路。

title: SynSQL: Synthesizing Relational Databases for Robust Evaluation of Text-to-SQL Systems
summary: Evaluating text-to-SQL systems remains largely fragile: correctness is typically judged by executing predicted and gold SQL queries on a single static database, even though the same queries may behave differently under alternative database instances. This raises a broader language modeling question: Can large language models synthesize semantically meaningful, schema-consistent relational data directly from a natural language question? If so, such generation can serve as a controlled mechanism for stress-testing text-to-SQL systems beyond fixed benchmark databases. We introduce SynSQL, a framework that synthesizes test databases conditioned on question-schema alignment rather than gold SQL queries. SynSQL decomposes the task into three stages: (1) schema selection, (2) question-guided data synthesis, and (3) constraint-aware critique with iterative refinement, framing database construction as structured generation under semantic and relational constraints. Across ten text-to-SQL models on Spider, BIRD, and Spider 2.0, SynSQL-generated databases reveal performance drops of 3-14% compared to static evaluation, exposing errors masked by benchmark artifacts. We further analyze generation quality, constraint adherence, and failure modes, highlighting both the promise and limitations of LLMs in structured data synthesis. Our findings position synthetic database generation as a new lens for studying LLM reasoning, controllability, and robustness in structured environments.

AI.tldr: SynSQL是一种数据库合成框架，通过问题-模式对齐条件生成测试数据库，用于更鲁棒地评估text-to-SQL系统。该框架将数据合成分解为模式选择、问题引导合成和约束感知评审三个阶段，可在多种基准测试中揭示传统评估中被掩盖的系统错误。
AI.motivation: 现有text-to-SQL评估方法存在根本性缺陷：通常仅在单一静态数据库上执行预测和黄金SQL查询来评判正确性，然而相同查询在不同数据库实例下可能表现不同。这导致评估无法捕捉因基准测试人工痕迹（benchmark artifacts）而隐藏的错误，限制了系统鲁棒性的真正评估。
AI.method: SynSQL将数据库合成任务分解为三个阶段：(1)模式选择（schema selection）；(2)问题引导的数据合成（question-guided data synthesis）；(3)约束感知评审与迭代优化（constraint-aware critique with iterative refinement），将数据库构建框架化为在语义和关系约束下的结构化生成任务。
AI.result: 在Spider、BIRD和Spider 2.0三个基准数据集上，针对10个text-to-SQL模型的评估表明，SynSQL生成的数据库揭示了3-14%的性能下降，有效暴露了传统静态评估中掩盖的错误。
AI.conclusion: SynSQL框架通过问题-模式对齐而非黄金SQL查询来合成测试数据库，有效揭示了基准测试中由静态数据库造成的评估盲点，提升了text-to-SQL系统评估的鲁棒性。

title: Tailwind: A Practical Framework for Query Accelerators
summary: Relational database management systems (RDBMSes) can process general-purpose queries, but often have lower performance compared to custom-built solutions for specific queries. For example, consider a group-by query over a few known groups (e.g., grouping by country). While an RDBMS would likely use a hash map to do the grouping, a faster method could hard-code the expected groups into the query executor. But such workload-specific techniques, which we call query accelerators, are not widely used in practice because the engineering effort (optimizer and engine changes, potential bugs) does not justify the isolated performance gains (speedup on a single specific query). We propose Tailwind: an external query planner that brings accelerators into any RDBMS that supports data import/export. Users define their accelerators using abstract logical plans (ALPs): a new mostly-declarative abstraction over relational operators built on regular tree expressions. ALPs allow Tailwind to automatically build customized neural network models to estimate when using a particular accelerator is beneficial. At runtime, Tailwind sits atop an RDBMS and transparently rewrites queries to run across one or more accelerators when predicted to be beneficial, falling back to the underlying RDBMS when not. On Redshift and DuckDB with a library of four diverse accelerators, Tailwind accelerates TPC-H queries by 1.38x on average (up to 29x).

AI.tldr: Tailwind 是一个非侵入式（无需修改 RDBMS 源码）的外部查询规划器与执行框架，让用户把"查询加速器"（可利用特定工作负载/数据特征、比通用 RDBMS 更快执行特定逻辑子计划的组件）以声明式方式接入任意支持数据导入导出的 RDBMS。其核心抽象是抽象逻辑计划（ALP）：基于参数化正则树表达式（RTE）加验证器，用于描述加速器可替换的逻辑子计划集合、向实现暴露参数、并自动派生特征以构建预测加速器耗时的神经网络。Tailwind 在 Redshift 与 DuckDB 上以 1.38×、1.76×、1.28×（几何平均）的查询加速比验证了框架的实用价值。
AI.motivation: 通用 RDBMS 为换取通用性，在特定查询上往往慢于专用方案（如图1的 TPC-H Q13：RDBMS 用低选择性的 NOT LIKE 过滤后哈希连接，而"域取反"（domain negation）先预计算未过滤的订单计数，再用高选择性的取反谓词相减，可快 1.6×/2.5×，且额外数据仅占 0.57%/0.20%）。这类"查询加速器"虽有效，但直接集成进 RDBMS 的代价过高：闭源系统无法改，开源系统需改动优化器、成本模型、执行引擎与存储层，"爆炸半径"大、易引入 bug、且每个 RDBMS 都要重写集成逻辑；数据库扩展与 UDF 要么几乎没有优化器支持（需用户自行判断并重写查询），要么仍需改引擎代码，且与具体 RDBMS 耦合、难以复用。缺失的是一个可移植、非侵入、并能自动决定"何时何地"使用加速器的机制。
AI.method:
1) ALP 抽象：每个加速器注册一个 ALP，由（a）模板——参数化正则树表达式，支持叶/树记号、类型化变量 Var(x;τ)（列引用、表引用、表表达式、列表达式、布尔表达式）、带标识符的 Alt、Rep（基于 Kleene 星与连接的有界重复），并区分"实例化期解析"与"在线解析"；（b）验证器 is_valid(match_inst, schema)->bool，用于表达语义约束（如主外键连接）。ALP 可描述任意可判定的逻辑子计划模式（模板可匹配任意子计划，验证器可为任意可判定函数）。

2) 匹配与解析：模板编译为非确定有限树自动机（NFTA），查询计划转为 e-graph 并做等值饱和（在 e-class 内搜索所有 e-node；拒绝同时含"转移环+e-class 环"的匹配路径）；通过记录接受状态与 e-class、发现/完成时间戳来解析变量、选项与重复实例；匹配时向 e-class 插入加速器 e-node，递归做笛卡尔积枚举执行选项。

3) 加速器 API：实现 alp()、build(match_inst, ctx)->State（预计算）、run(state, match_inst, input, ctx)->Output，I/O 用 Arrow；加速器可位于计划底部或中部，Tailwind 负责中间数据传输（Redshift 走 S3，DuckDB 进程内）。

4) 性能建模：把 ALP 模板编码成树结构神经网络——每个变量类型/重复/选择各有编码 MLP，内部节点用平均池化+MLP，重复用求和+重复次数 one-hot，选择用匹配选项 one-hot，根节点经输出 MLP 预测运行时；特征按类型抽取（表表达式：基数、字节宽、Stage/T3 算子特征；布尔表达式：选择率；列：基数与唯一值数等）。Bootstrap：利用 ALP 随机生成结构与变量取值（自底向上按可用列选择，保证语义正确与多样性），过验证器后生成实例，实测耗时得到约 1 万条训练数据。

5) 离线规划：给定查询日志与空间预算 S，用 ALP 匹配枚举候选实例，以"预测运行时间下降/空间占用"为归一化收益做贪心选择（复杂度 O(n²)），构建并管理有状态加速器。

6) 在线规划：作为数据库代理接收查询，搜索 ALP 匹配，枚举所有可用加速器组合，逐项预测加速器耗时、数据传输耗时（max(S/k_i+S/k_e, C)）与剩余查询耗时（按算子数与基数比缩放基线查询耗时），取总和最小者；预测错误时缓存错误决策避免重复误选。

7) 写操作处理：批量写入后先回退到 RDBMS，后台重建加速器，增量维护留作未来工作。实现为 Rust 约 65,000 行代码。
AI.result: 三个案例研究：TPC-H（SF=100，四个加速器：域取反、CDF 累积过滤聚合、已知分组+算子融合、有序索引）在 Redshift/DuckDB 上 10% 预算下几何平均加速 1.32×/1.38×（1% 预算 1.21×/1.33×）；TPC-H-Plus（20 个合并查询模板）1.37×/1.76×（1% 预算 1.49×/1.78×），Q7/Q9 在 Redshift 平均 5.62×、Q5/7/9/10 在 DuckDB 平均 4.60×；SQLStorm Stack Overflow（240GB 真实数据、356 条查询、新增 top-k 下推与 Badges MV 加速器）1.28×/1.27×。朴素"匹配即用"基线常变慢（DuckDB 低至 0.46×），Tailwind 依靠模型避免回退。ALP 神经网络在所有加速器上取得最低 p90 Q-error（如域取反 Redshift p50 1.43/p90 3.36，优于随机森林 1.99/8.50、MLP 2.25/6.96），且在四种数据库/负载组合中三种提供最高端到端加速；跨数据集规模泛化上 p50 Q-error 增幅仅 0.56（MLP 为 1.00）。空间预算从 0.001% 到 10% 均可获益（0.01% 即有效），大预算下朴素策略显著退化。对查询运行时预测误差鲁棒：Q-error ≤ 3.0 时性能基本保持（Redshift TPC-H-Plus 为 1.6）。规划开销（枚举+预测）除一个案例外均低于 5%（Redshift p50 65–75ms，DuckDB p50 4–5ms）。写影响：重建时间 47 秒（Redshift TPC-H）至约 1 小时（DuckDB TPC-H-Plus），远小于 24 小时，支持每日 ETL。
AI.conclusion: Tailwind 与 ALP 提供了一种实用的、非侵入式的查询加速器集成范式：无需改动 RDBMS 源码（含闭源系统），通过一层抽象中介把"针对工作负载的专用优化"安全地外科手术式地插入查询计划，同时保留 RDBMS 的通用性。ALP 统一了加速器的适用性判定、实现接口与性能建模三件事；其表达能力强于抽象算子树（已证明严格更强，可匹配任意深度的左深连接等可变长模式），也优于固定深度的 Calcite 规则。论文强调：评估加速器对整条查询的完整影响（含数据传输代价）是取得净加速的关键；Tailwind 的性能模型与空间预算、运行时预测误差、写入频率等因素需联合考量，增量维护加速器状态及用 LLM 生成加速器被列为未来工作。

title: A High-Throughput Compute-Efficient POMDP Hide-And-Seek-Engine (HASE) for Multi-Agent Operations
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms exhibit high sample complexity, particularly when applied to Decentralized Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (Dec-POMDPs). As a response, projects such as SampleFactory, EnvPool, Brax, and IsaacLab migrate parallel execution of classic environments such as MuJoCo and Atari into C++ thread pools or the GPU to decrease the computational cost of environment steps. We are interested in optimizing the decision-level of human-AI joint operations, so we introduce a compute-efficient Dec-POMDP engine natively architected in C++ called Hide-And-Seek-Engine. By employing Data-Oriented Design (DOD) principles, explicit 64-byte cache-line alignment to remove false sharing, and a zero-copy PyTorch memory bridge using pinned memory and Direct Memory Access (DMA), our engine sustains throughput of up to 33,000,000 steps per second (SPS) in a single-agent, 1024-environment, decentralized observations on an AMD Ryzen 9950X (16 cores). Ten agents reduces FPS to 7M SPS with generating random actions contributing 1/3rd the total runtime for reference. The engine achieves a throughput increase of approximately 3,500$\times$ over the baseline single threaded vectorized NumPy implementation and successfully trains cooperative multi-agent policies via PPO, DQN, and SAC in minutes, validating both its performance and generality.

AI.tldr: Hide-And-Seek-Engine是一个专为Dec-POMDP设计的C++高吞吐量环境模拟引擎，通过数据导向设计、缓存行对齐和零拷贝PyTorch接口，在16核AMD Ryzen 9950X上实现了最高33M SPS的吞吐量（较NumPy基线提升3500倍），并验证了对PPO/DQN/SAC三种主流RL算法的兼容性。
AI.motivation: 强化学习算法样本复杂度高，Dec-POMDP问题尤甚；现有并行环境执行方案（如SampleFactory、EnvPool等）依赖经典环境（MuJoCo/Atari）的C++/GPU迁移范式，缺乏针对Dec-POMDP决策优化的专用引擎。
AI.method: 采用数据导向设计（DOD）原则、64字节缓存行对齐消除伪共享、PyTorch零拷贝内存桥接（pinned memory + DMA）实现C++引擎与PyTorch的GPU训练高效通信。
AI.result: 单智能体1024环境并行下达33M SPS；10智能体时降至7M SPS（随机动作生成占总运行时的1/3）；较单线程向量化NumPy基线提升约3500倍；成功在数分钟内通过PPO、DQN、SAC训练出合作多智能体策略。
AI.conclusion: Hide-And-Seek-Engine成功实现了高吞吐量（最高33M SPS，单线程NumPy基线的3500倍提升），并验证了在PPO、DQN、SAC三种算法下的多智能体策略训练能力，证明了其性能优势和通用性。

title: Fast and Faithful Edge Bundling using Spectral Sparsification
summary:
Edge bundling reduces the visual complexity of drawings of large and complex graphs by clustering "compatible" edges. However, it often introduces distortion by bundling "unrelated" edges, resulting in misleading, ambiguous drawings. Moreover, existing edge bundling methods often have high computational complexity.
  We present new edge bundling methods and faithfulness metrics for edge bundling using spectral sparsification, which sparsifies a graph G into a subgraph G' with O(n log n) edges, based on the effective resistance values of edges, preserving the spectrum of G, closely related to important structural properties of G, such as connectivity, clustering, and the commute distance. We first present a new edge bundling method SEB (Spectral Edge Bundling), introducing effective resistance-based compatibility for spectral-faithful bundling, improving distortion and ambiguity. Then, we present a general framework FEB (Fast Edge Bundling) utilizing spectral sparsification to improve the efficiency of existing bundling methods while maintaining a similar quality. We also present FBQ (Fast Bundling Quality) framework for proxy bundle faithfulness metrics, for measuring how FEB faithfully preserves the ground truth structure in the original edge bundling, with two variants, FBQ_JS (utilizing Jaccard Similarity) and FBQ_SQ (utilizing sampling quality metrics).
  Extensive experiments using various real-world and synthetic graphs demonstrate the effectiveness of SEB for edge bundling, outperforming state-of-art bundling methods on quality metrics, with 46% and 17% average improvement in distortion and ambiguity respectively for SEB2. Furthermore, experiments successfully demonstrate the efficiency of the FEB framework, with 61% runtime improvement over the original edge bundling methods without sparsification, while maintaining a similar quality, with 74% similarity based on FBQ_SQ.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于谱稀疏化（spectral sparsification, SS）的边捆绑新方法与评测指标：一是 FEB（Fast Edge Bundling）框架，在稀疏子图 G'（O(n log n) 条边）上执行捆绑，从而把 FDEB、EPB 等既有方法的运行时间降低 61%（SEB 家族最高 70%），且捆绑结果与全图捆绑高度相似（FBQ_SQ 达 74%）；二是 SEB（Spectral Edge Bundling）方法，引入基于有效电阻（effective resistance）的兼容性度量 C_ER1（绝对差）与 C_ER2（比值），与 FDEB 几何兼容性相乘，SEB2 相对 SOTA 的 EPB 在失真度与歧义度上分别平均改进 46% 与 17%，但墨水减少率不及 EPB；三是 FBQ 忠实性度量框架（FBQ_JS 基于 Jaccard 相似度、FBQ_SQ 基于采样质量指标与 KS 距离），用于度量 FEB 对原始捆绑“真实结构”的代理保真度。
AI.motivation: 边捆绑可将大而复杂图的“兼容”边聚集成束，以降低视觉复杂度、提升可读性，但现有方法存在两大问题：(1) 仅基于几何相似性（GBEB、FDEB）捆绑会引入失真，把结构上无关的边捆在一起，产生误导性、歧义的图形，缺乏忠实性（faithfulness）；结构化方法（Confluent、TGI-EB、Clustered Edge Routing、EPB）虽改善忠实性但仍不完美。(2) 计算复杂度高：FDEB 为 O(m²n)、EPB 为 O(m² log n)，难以扩展到大规模图；FFTEB 依赖位图图像大小且仍有可读性问题，SEPB 最坏复杂度仍为 O(m² log n)。已有工作证明谱稀疏化在图采样与图绘制（SublinearForce、SublinearSM/SGD）中同时有效且高效，故本文将其引入边捆绑，以同时提升捆绑的保真度与效率。
AI.method: 方法分三部分。(1) FEB 框架（图1）：Step1 计算 G 的稀疏化 G'（基于有效电阻随机选边，近线性时间可得；密集图 O(n²) 边降为 O(n log n)）；Step2 用固定布局或图绘制算法求 D'；Step3 在 D' 上用任意捆绑算法得 D'_B。对原方法 X 记为 FX（FDEB→FFDEB，EPB→FEPB，SEPB→FSEPB，SEB→FSEB）。(2) FBQ 忠实性度量（图2）：分别求 D、D' 的捆绑图 D_B、D'_B，构造“几何图”G_B、G'_B——若边 e1=(s,t)、e2=(u,v) 被捆绑，则在几何图中加入隐含邻居对 (s,t)、(u,v)、(s,v)、(t,u) 四条边；再比较两几何图：FBQ_JS = (1/|V|)Σ_v |N_B(v)∩N'_B(v)| / |N_B(v)∪N'_B(v)|；FBQ_SQ 基于采样质量指标，用 KS 距离比较 CDF，包含 FBQ_SQ(DG)（度相关性关联度 Degree Correlation Associativity）与 FBQ_SQ(CC)（聚类系数）。(3) SEB 方法：把有效电阻兼容性并入 FDEB 的力模型，F_pi = k_p(||p_{i-1}-p_i||+||p_i-p_{i+1}||) + Σ_Q C_G(P,Q)·C_ER(P,Q)/||p_i-q_i||；两种兼容性 C_ER1(P,Q)=1-|ER(P)-ER(Q)|、C_ER2(P,Q)=min(ER)/max(ER)（避免低电阻端差异被放大），SEB1 用前者、SEB2 用后者。ER 可近线性计算，而 TGI-EB 的介数中心性需 O(n³)，故 SEB 更可扩展。实验：12 个数据集（地理型、scale-free、GION、black-hole），绘制用 Backbone 布局；指标为 ink reduction、distortion（减1）、ambiguity（Amb¹/Amb²）；FEB 效率用 (t(X)-t(FX))/t(X)。
AI.result: FEB 相对未稀疏化的原捆绑方法平均提速 61%（FDEB 家族 68%，FSEB2 最高 70%；EPB 家族 53%，SEPB 仅 35%）。质量保持方面：FBQ_JS 平均 0.68，FSEB2 最高（0.702 平均；在 6_gion、7_gion、lastfm、yeastppi 上最佳，FEPB 在地理图上最佳），黑洞图上 FSEB 系列相似度达 85%；FBQ_SQ(DEG) 与 FBQ_SQ(CC) 平均 0.26，对应与原捆绑图 74% 相似度。视觉对比显示 FSEB 保持原结构最接近（如保留 SEB2 的垂直边束、black-hole 图 blob 内结构），FEPB 在 EPB 系密集区差异较大。SEB 质量：SEB2 在失真与歧义上平均分别比 EPB 改进 46% 与 17%（黑洞图歧义改进达 50%，scale-free 图亦呈相同趋势），GION 图上 SEB 在 Amb¹ 更优而 EPB 在 Amb² 更优（因 EPB 优先捆绑长路径而 GION 直径大）；EPB 在墨水减少率上最佳，体现指标间负相关（捆更多边→墨水少但失真/歧义大）。SEB1/SEB2 均一致优于 FDEB。
AI.conclusion: 谱稀疏化可同时服务于边捆绑的效率与忠实性：FEB 框架将捆绑计算迁移到保留谱信息的稀疏子图上，实现 61% 的运行时提升并保持与原捆绑 74%（FBQ_SQ）的相似度；SEB 引入有效电阻兼容性，实现了相对 EPB 在失真 46%、歧义 17% 的平均改进，显示出更“保谱”的捆绑，同时揭示了墨水减少率与失真/歧义之间的权衡。作者指出未来工作为设计面向边捆绑的新忠实性度量，以及针对这些度量优化的新捆绑方法。局限方面：SEB 在地理布局数据集上的 Amb² 不及 EPB；FEB 的相似度在 EPB 家族的黑洞图上出现结构差异，且 FBQ 指标为代理度量而非严格“真实结构”验证。

title: Efficient Training on Multiple Consumer GPUs with RoundPipe
comment: Github Repo: https://github.com/ITcarrot/RoundPipe Project website: https://itcarrot.github.io/RoundPipe/
summary:
Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) on consumer-grade GPUs is highly cost-effective, yet constrained by limited GPU memory and slow PCIe interconnects. Pipeline parallelism combined with CPU offloading mitigates these hardware bottlenecks by reducing communication overhead. However, existing PP schedules suffer from an inherent limitation termed the weight binding issue. Binding uneven model stages (e.g., the LM head is large) to GPUs limits the pipeline's throughput to that of the GPU with the heaviest load, leading to severe pipeline bubbles.
  In this paper, we propose RoundPipe, a novel pipeline schedule that breaks the weight binding constraint on consumer GPU servers. RoundPipe treats GPUs as a pool of stateless execution workers and dynamically dispatches computation stages across devices in a round-robin manner, achieving a near-zero-bubble pipeline. To ensure training correctness and system efficiency, RoundPipe integrates a priority-aware transfer scheduling engine, a fine-grained distributed event-based synchronization protocol, and an automated layer partitioning algorithm. Evaluations on an 8$\times$ RTX 4090 server demonstrate that RoundPipe achieves 1.48--2.16$\times$ speedups over state-of-the-art baselines when fine-tuning 1.7B to 32B models. Remarkably, RoundPipe enables LoRA fine-tuning of the Qwen3-235B model with 31K sequence length on a single server.
  RoundPipe is publicly available as an open-source Python library with comprehensive documentation.

AI.tldr: RoundPipe通过打破传统流水线并行中的权重绑定约束，采用轮询调度和多项优化技术，在消费级GPU服务器上实现了高达2.16倍的大模型微调加速，并支持单服务器微调235B参数模型。
AI.motivation: 在消费级GPU上微调大语言模型受限于有限的GPU显存和缓慢的PCIe互联；现有流水线并行结合CPU卸载方案虽能缓解硬件瓶颈，但存在"权重绑定问题"——将不均衡的模型阶段（如大型LM head）绑定到特定GPU上，导致流水线吞吐量受限于最繁忙GPU，产生严重的气泡。
AI.method: RoundPipe采用轮询调度机制，将GPU视为无状态执行工作者池，动态分配计算阶段；集成了优先级感知的传输调度引擎、细粒度的分布式事件同步协议，以及自动化层划分算法，确保训练正确性和系统效率，实现近乎零气泡的流水线。
AI.result: 在8×RTX 4090服务器上针对1.7B至32B模型的微调任务，RoundPipe相比最先进的基线方法实现了1.48-2.16倍的加速；尤为突出的是，该方法首次实现在单台服务器上对Qwen3-235B模型进行31K序列长度的LoRA微调。
AI.conclusion: RoundPipe作为开源Python库实现了消费级GPU服务器上的高效大模型微调，在8×RTX 4090服务器上将1.7B至32B模型的微调速度提升1.48-2.16倍，并首次实现在单台服务器上对235B参数模型进行31K序列长度的LoRA微调，展现了打破权重绑定约束的重要性和实际价值。

title: Static Program Slicing Using Language Models With Dataflow-Aware Pretraining and Constrained Decoding
summary: Static program slicing is a fundamental software engineering technique for isolating code relevant to specific variables. While recent learning-based approaches using language models (LMs) show promise in automating slice prediction, they suffer from inaccurate dependency modeling and unconstrained generation, where LMs fail to capture precise data flow relations and produce slices containing hallucinated tokens and statements. To address these challenges, we propose Sliceformer, a novel approach that reformulates static program slicing as a sequence-to-sequence task using small language models such as CodeT5+. Sliceformer introduces two key innovations that directly target the identified limitations. First, to improve dependency modeling, we design dataflow-aware pretraining objectives that leverage data flow graphs (DFG) to teach models data dependencies through dataflow-preserving statement permutation and dataflow-aware span corruption. Second, to eliminate hallucination, we develop a constrained decoding mechanism that enforces both lexical and syntactic constraints. We evaluate Sliceformer on Java and Python program slicing benchmarks, demonstrating consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines with up to 22% gain in ExactMatch.

AI.tldr: Sliceformer 将静态程序切片（program slicing）重构为基于小语言模型（CodeT5+）的序列到序列任务，通过两项核心技术——数据流感知预训练（数据流保持的语句置换 + 数据流引导的跨度破坏）与受约束解码（词法约束 + 基于 TSED 单调性的句法约束）——解决了现有学习方法「依赖建模不准」与「生成不受约束（幻觉）」两大缺陷，在 Java/Python 的 CodeNet-Slice 基准上 ExactMatch 分别达到 92.20%/83.15%，较最强基线 NS-slicer 提升 6.4% 与 21.9%，且推理延迟仅 0.296s。
AI.motivation: 静态程序切片是漏洞分析、调试等任务的基础，但传统工具（JavaSlicer、CPP-Slicer）依赖 SDG 可达性分析，配置与维护成本高。近期基于学习的方法存在两类根本缺陷：(1) 依赖识别不准确——通用或直接微调的 LM 无法精确刻画变量间的数据依赖，依赖表面模式或位置邻近性，常漏掉相关语句或引入无关语句；(2) 生成不受约束——基于提示工程（Zero-shot/RAG/CoT）的专有大模型会产生幻觉 token（伪造标识符，如把 codepoint 写成 keta）或幻觉语句（重复/错序表达式），违反「切片必须是输入的精确子序列」这一硬性要求。作者同时指出 NS-Slicer 等分类式方法非端到端、逐语句独立嵌入，无法区分方法内不同分支中出现的相同语句。
AI.method:
整体流程为「数据流感知预训练 → 切片数据监督微调（SFT）→ 受约束束搜索解码」。

(1) 问题形式化：输入 x = {s1..sN; v; [n]}（语句序列、切片准则变量、变量所在行号），输出为后向切片 y ⊆ x（语句按行号递增的精确子序列），须满足准确性（不多不少）与元素保留性（逐 token 精确抽取）。

(2) 数据流感知预训练（基于 DFG=(V,E)，V 为 AST 叶节点变量序列，E 为 def-use 数据依赖边）：
• 数据流保持的语句置换（Algorithm 1）：与 T5 句序置换不同，代码合法顺序不唯一。算法枚举 i<j 的语句对，若二者同属一个基本块且 DFG 中无任一方向的数据边（hasEdge=false），则归入可交换集合 P，从 P 中随机选一对执行交换；P 为空则保持原序。预训练标签即由该置换生成，迫使模型学会判断语句间的数据无关性。
• 数据流感知跨度破坏（Algorithm 2）：基于 AST-T5 的跨度掩码思路，用 DFG 替换 AST 作为结构依据（DFG 更扁平、避免过深层级，利于捕捉长程数据依赖）。按掩码率 r（实验中 25%）迭代随机选 DFG 节点 v，找出其父节点 Parents（定义来源）与子节点 Children（流向去处），再以 0.5 概率做细粒度掩码（掩掉 Parents∪Children 中的变量）、否则做粗粒度掩码（掩掉包含这些变量的整条语句）。目标是让模型重建 v 的「来源+去向」完整数据流链，兼顾变量级与语句级依赖。
• 预训练语料为 CodeSearchNet 的 Python/Java 子集约 100 万函数，用 Tree-Sitter 解析 AST 识别变量，按 GraphCodeBERT 的实现构建 DFG；上下文长度 512，batch 32，训练 100K 步，4×RTX 3090。

(3) SFT：在 CodeNet-Slice 训练集上微调，并引入 <code>/<criterion>/<slice> 等控制标记作为结构化条件线索；AdamW，batch 32，lr 5e-5，1000 步 warmup，10 epoch，输入/输出长度 512。

(4) 受约束解码（Algorithm 3，训练无关，束搜索 beam=3）：
• 词法约束：构建输入中出现过的允许 token 集 A，对 A 外 token 的 logit 置 −∞（softmax 前 mask），实现严格抽取式生成，杜绝幻觉标识符。
• 句法约束：在语句边界（IsStatementComplete）计算输入 AST 与当前生成片段 AST 的 TSED（Tree Similarity of Edit Distance，按编辑操作加权代价/两树最大节点数归一化，值越大越相似）。依据「合法切片是输入子序列 ⇒ TSED 应随生成单调递增」的性质，若 TSED 下降即判定结构错乱，剪掉该束路径并提前终止；否则更新该束的 t_stmt 供后续比较。
AI.result:
在 CodeNet-Slice 的 Java（train 30.8K/valid 3.5K/test 8.7K）与 Python（23.8K/5.1K/5.1K）子集上评测四项指标（Acc-D、ExactMatch、CodeBLEU、TSED）：
• Java：Sliceformer 达 Acc-D 98.78、ExactMatch 92.20、CodeBLEU 93.23、TSED 97.68，全面超越最强基线 NS-slicer(GraphCodeBERT，85.77 EM) 与 CodeT5+ SFT（87.24 EM，+5.0）。
• Python：Acc-D 90.85、ExactMatch 83.15、CodeBLEU 85.35、TSED 89.74，超越 NS-slicer（61.25 EM）与 CodeT5+ SFT（77.24 EM，+5.9）；相对 NS-slicer 提升 21.9%。
• LLM-based 基线整体最弱：GPT-5+CoT 在 Java/Python 上 EM 仅 14.00/13.00；GPT-4 系列 EM 为 0（Zero-shot/RAG/CoT）。
• 消融：完整模型优于任一缺项变体；组件重要性排序为跨度破坏 > 词法约束 > 语句置换 > 句法约束，原因是结构错误比词法错误更少发生（预训练已习得基础语法）。
• 效率：Sliceformer 0.296s/任务（CodeT5+ 0.289s、NS-slicer 0.105–0.135s、CodeLlama-7B 5.75s、Qwen3-8B 6.52s、GPT-4 CoT 0.835s、GPT-5 CoT 1.162s），在有效方法中最快。
• 架构对比（Java EM）：CodeT5 82.80→加预训练 85.12；CodeLlama-7B 75.27→加约束解码 78.40；Qwen3-8B 80.55→加约束解码 83.11，印证约束解码与架构无关、而数据流预训练需编码器-解码器。
AI.conclusion: Sliceformer 通过在标准 SFT 之上叠加「数据流感知预训练 + 词法–句法受约束解码」，在 Java 与 Python 上取得静态程序切片的 SOTA（EM 92.20%/83.15%），并显著优于 NS-slicer 与大模型提示方法，同时保持了低推理延迟（0.296s）与相比 7B/8B 微调模型的数量级效率优势。方法论贡献在于：首次将 DFG 用于语句置换与跨度破坏两类预训练目标，并以 TSED 单调性作为解码期句法约束的判据。局限包括：(1) 仅验证 Java/Python，扩展到其他语言仍需工程与实证验证；(2) 数据流感知预训练天然适配编码器-解码器（掩码重建），对仅解码器模型（因果注意力、下一词预测）不直接适用，但词法–句法受约束解码可迁移到两类架构。作者公开代码与数据集，并强调技术细节、局限与数据的透明披露。

title: The Impact of LLM Self-Consistency and Reasoning Effort on Automated Scoring Accuracy and Cost
comment: 14 pages, 10 tables, 2 figures. Presented at the 2026 National Council on Measurement in Education (NCME) Annual Meeting, April 11, 2026, Los Angeles, CA
summary: Strategic model selection and reasoning settings are more effective than ensembling for optimizing automated scoring with large language models (LLMs). We examined self-consistency (intra-model majority voting) and reasoning effort for scoring conversation-based assessment items in high school mathematics, evaluating 900 student conversations against human-scored ground truths using frontier and low-cost models from OpenAI and Google. Temperature sampling significantly improved accuracy over deterministic calls, but increasing ensemble size (j = 1 to 7) produced no significant gains. Higher reasoning effort showed a significant positive linear trend with scoring accuracy, though the benefit varied by model family. An efficiency frontier analysis identified Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview at low reasoning as the most accurate but costly configuration; GPT-5.4 Nano and Mini with no reasoning offered the best cost-performance balance.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，在LLM自动评分任务中，战略性模型选择和推理努力调优优于模型集成；增加集成规模不能带来显著收益，而提高推理努力可线性提升准确率；成本效益最优方案为GPT-5.4 Nano/Mini配合零推理配置。
AI.motivation: 当前自动评分研究中常采用模型集成方法提升准确率，但集成带来的计算成本与实际收益是否匹配尚不明确，需要系统比较集成策略与单模型策略的优劣。
AI.method: 对比self-consistency（模型内多数投票）与推理努力调节策略；使用高中数学对话式评估数据（900个学生对话）评估OpenAI和Google的前沿及低成本模型；通过效率前沿分析权衡准确率与成本。
AI.result: 温度采样显著提升准确率；集成规模扩大（1-7个模型）无显著收益；推理努力与评分准确率呈显著正相关但因模型家族而异；Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview低推理配置准确率最高但成本高，GPT-5.4 Nano/Mini无推理配置性价比最优。
AI.conclusion: Strategic model selection and reasoning effort tuning are more effective than ensembling for LLM-based automated scoring. Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview achieves highest accuracy but at high cost, while GPT-5.4 Nano/Mini offer optimal cost-performance ratio. Temperature sampling should replace deterministic inference for scoring tasks.

title: A Randomized Controlled Trial and Pilot of Scout: an LLM-Based EHR Search and Synthesis Platform
summary: Clinical documentation and data retrieval within Electronic Health Records (EHRs) contribute substantially to clinician workload and burnout. To address this, we developed Scout, an LLM-based EHR search and synthesis platform that enables clinicians to query EHR data using natural language. Each response includes citations linking each claim to the original data source, facilitating easy verification of generated content. We conducted a prospective randomized, evaluator-blinded crossover trial across seven clinical specialties (20 participants, 200 structured cases). Participants completed realistic clinical tasks using either Scout or the EHR alone, with outcomes including time to completion, NASA Task Load Index workload scores, and blinded expert adjudication of accuracy, completeness, and relevance. Scout reduced task completion time by 37.6% and significantly decreased perceived workload, with the largest reductions in mental demand, effort, and temporal demand. Non-inferiority analyses showed that tasks completed with Scout maintained accuracy, completeness, and relevance relative to tasks completed with the EHR-only. A concurrent pilot deployment across over 200 users and more than 20 specialties generated over 6,600 interactions in three months, revealing diverse clinical and administrative use cases. Automated evaluation using an LLM-as-judge framework identified errors at low rates. Subsequent manual review of a subset of outputs revealed that most claims flagged by the automated judge as errors were in fact supported by the patient chart, demonstrating the importance of human validation. These findings provide early trial-based evidence that LLM-powered EHR tools can meaningfully reduce clinical and administrative workloads while maintaining output quality.

AI.tldr: Scout 是一个基于大语言模型的电子健康记录（EHR）自然语言检索与信息综合平台，生成的回答附带指向原始数据源的引用。前瞻性随机、评价者盲法交叉试验（7个专科、20名参与者、200例结构化病例）显示：Scout 使临床任务完成时间缩短37.6%，显著降低NASA-TLX感知工作负荷（中心需求、努力、时间需求降幅最大），同时在准确性、完整性与相关性上达到对纯EHR流程的非劣效。同期在200+用户、20+专科的试点部署中，3个月内产生6,600+次交互，LLM-as-judge自动评估发现错误率较低，而人工复核显示多数被判为错误的声明实际上有病历支持，凸显人工验证的重要性。
AI.motivation: 临床文档记录与EHR数据检索占医生工作量的很大比例，是导致临床医生倦怠（burnout）的重要来源。传统EHR交互需要逐层导航菜单、筛选大量非结构化与结构化数据，检索效率低、信息过载，跨系统查找患者关键信息尤为耗时。已有基于LLM的EHR工具多局限于单点任务（如文书生成或问答），且普遍缺乏可溯源的引用机制，医生难以验证生成内容的可靠性，难以在真实工作流中获得信任并采纳。作者希望开发一个自然语言查询、答案带原始数据引用的检索与综合平台，以同时降低认知与操作负荷并保证输出质量可核查。
AI.method: 采用两阶段评估设计。第一阶段为前瞻性、随机、评价者盲法的交叉试验，覆盖7个临床专科，20名参与者，200个结构化病例；每位参与者在Scout与仅用EHR两种条件下完成高度拟真的临床任务，配对设计后由不知晓条件分配的专家对输出进行准确性、完整性与相关性裁定；结局指标包括任务完成时间、NASA-TLX工作量表各维度评分，并预设非劣效性分析。第二阶段为并发试点部署：超过200名用户、20多个专科，3个月内产生6,600余次真实交互；采用LLM-as-judge自动化评估框架对输出进行错误检测，再对子集进行人工复核以校验自动评估的一致性。
AI.result: Scout 显著缩短任务完成时间37.6%，并显著降低总体感知工作负荷，其中精神需求（mental demand）、努力（effort）与时间需求（temporal demand）降幅最大。非劣效性检验表明，使用Scout完成的任务在准确性、完整性和相关性方面维持了相对于EHR-only条件的不劣效水平。试点部署中交互量大且用例多样，覆盖临床与行政场景；LLM-as-judge自动评估检出的错误率较低，而人工复核发现多数被自动判为错误的声明实际上被患者病历支持，说明自动评估存在假阳性、不能替代人工验证。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了基于试验的早期证据，表明LLM驱动的EHR检索工具能够切实降低临床与行政工作负荷，同时维持输出质量与可验证性。带引用的可溯源设计是促进医生信任与采纳的关键要素。局限与后续方向包括：样本量较小（20名参与者、200个病例）、任务为结构化病例而非真实生产环境的主观工作流、需更严谨的人工验证标准与更长时间的随访；同时LLM-as-judge与人工判断之间的一致性问题提示生产环境部署需配套持续的人工审核与质量监测机制。

title: BatteryPass-12K: The First Dataset for the Novel Digital Battery Passport Conformance Task
summary: We introduce a novel task of digital battery passport (DBP) conformance classification and introduce the first public benchmark for the task: BatteryPass-12K, created synthetically from real pilot samples. This is as the EU's battery regulation on DBPs comes into effect soon and there exists no public dataset. We evaluated 22 language models (LMs) in zero-shot inference, spanning small LMs (SLMs), mixture of experts (MoEs), and dense LLMs. We also conducted analysis, additional evaluations of few-shot inference and prompt-injection attacks to find that (1) Thinking models have the best performance (with GPT-5.4 scoring 0.98 (0.03) and 0.71 (0.22) on average as F1 (and confidence interval at 95%) on the validation and test sets, respectively), (2) few-shot examples improve performance significantly, (3) generally capable frontier models find the task challenging, (4) merely scaling model parameters does not necessarily lead to improved performance, as SLMs outperformed some LLMs, and (5) prompt-injection attacks degrade performance. We note that BatteryPass-12K, though limited to real pilot samples, may be useful for other known or emerging tasks in the battery domain, e.g. lifecycle reasoning. We publicly release the dataset under a permissive licence (CC-BY-4.0).

AI.tldr: 提出了数字电池护照（DBP）一致性分类新任务，并发布首个公开基准数据集BatteryPass-12K。评测22种语言模型后发现思维链模型表现最佳，少样本学习可显著提升性能，模型规模扩展并非性能保证，提示注入攻击会降低模型表现。
AI.motivation: 欧盟DBP法规即将生效，但缺乏公开数据集，研究者无法系统评估现有模型能力，因此需要创建基准数据集和开展系统性评估。
AI.method: 收集真实试点样本并合成创建BatteryPass-12K数据集，对22种语言模型（涵盖SLMs、MoEs和Dense LLMs）进行零样本推理、少样本推理和提示注入攻击评估。
AI.result: GPT-5.4在验证集和测试集上分别达到0.98和0.71的F1分数；少样本学习显著提升性能；参数规模扩展不必然带来性能提升；提示注入攻击会降低模型表现。
AI.conclusion: BatteryPass-12K数据集可支持DBP一致性分类及其他电池领域任务（如生命周期推理），但数据集目前仅基于有限真实样本。

title: Monitoring Neural Training with Topology: A Footprint-Predictable Collapse Index
summary: Representational collapse, where embeddings become anisotropic and lose multi-scale structure, can erode downstream performance long before performance metrics react. We propose an online, topology-aware monitor for evolving neural representations that couples Modular Morse Homology Maintenance (MMHM) with a composite Collapse Index (CI). Instead of rebuilding complexes each epoch, we apply sparse edits at a fixed scale and maintain a discrete Morse matching, yielding fast, incremental updates. Across LLM fine-tuning and temporal KGE training, CI provides a low-latency early-warning signal suitable for in-training interventions. Code and experimental scripts will be released publicly

AI.tldr: 本文针对深度学习训练中的表征崩溃问题，提出了一种结合模块化莫尔斯同调维护与崩溃指数的在线监控方法。该方法通过稀疏编辑和增量更新实现快速、低延迟的拓扑结构监测，能够在LLM微调和时序知识图谱嵌入训练中提供早期预警信号，便于训练干预，提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 在深度学习训练过程中，特别是大语言模型（LLM）的微调和知识图谱嵌入（KGE）训练中，表征崩溃（representational collapse）是一个严重的问题。当嵌入变得各向异性并失去多尺度结构时，会损害下游任务性能，但这种退化往往在传统的性能指标（如loss、准确率等）出现明显变化之前就已经发生了。这导致了两个关键问题：一是缺乏有效的早期预警机制；二是无法及时进行干预以纠正表征的退化。因此，需要一种能够实时监测表征拓扑结构变化的工具，以便在性能明显下降之前就能识别出问题并进行干预。
AI.method: 提出了一种在线的、拓扑感知的神经表征演化监控方法，将模块化莫尔斯同调维护（MMHM）与复合崩溃指数（CI）相结合。该方法采用稀疏编辑在固定尺度上进行增量更新，并维护离散莫尔斯匹配，避免每个epoch重建复杂结构，从而实现快速、增量的更新。CMHM的核心创新在于避免了在每个epoch都进行复杂的重构建，而是通过维持离散莫尔斯匹配来进行稀疏编辑，这样大大降低了计算复杂度，使得该方法能够实时监控表征的演化过程。CI则作为评估崩溃程度的核心指标，为模型训练提供了量化的监控工具。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，在LLM微调和时序知识图谱嵌入训练场景中，CI能够提供低延迟的早期预警信号，优于传统的性能监控指标。该方法能够及时检测到表征退化，为训练期间的干预提供了有效的时间窗口，使模型能够在问题恶化之前得到调整和优化。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在LLM微调和时序知识图谱嵌入训练中均表现出色，能够在训练过程中提供低延迟的早期预警信号，适合进行训练期间的干预。代码和实验脚本将公开发布。

title: Compositional Meta-Learning for Mitigating Task Heterogeneity in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) approximate solutions of partial differential equations (PDEs) by embedding physical laws into the loss function. In parameterized PDE families, variations in coefficients or boundary/initial conditions define distinct tasks. This makes training individual PINNs for each task computationally prohibitive, while cross-task transfer can be sensitive to task heterogeneity. While meta-learning can reduce retraining cost, existing methods often rely on a single global initialization and may suffer from negative transfer, particularly under feature-scarce coordinate inputs and limited training-task availability. We propose the Learning-Affinity Adaptive Modular Physics-Informed Neural Network (LAM-PINN), a compositional framework that leverages task-specific learning dynamics. LAM-PINN combines PDE parameters with learning-affinity metrics from brief transfer sessions to construct a task representation and cluster tasks even with coordinate-only inputs. It decomposes the model into cluster-specialized subnetworks and a shared meta network, and learns routing weights to selectively reuse modules instead of relying on a single global initialization. Across three PDE benchmarks, LAM-PINN achieves an average 19.7-fold reduction in mean squared error (MSE) on unseen tasks using only 10% of the training iterations required by conventional PINNs. These results indicate its effectiveness for generalization to unseen configurations within bounded design spaces of parameterized PDE families in resource-constrained engineering settings.

AI.tldr: LAM-PINN is a compositional meta-learning framework for PINNs that uses task-specific learning dynamics and clustering to decompose the model into reusable modules, achieving near order-of-magnitude improvements in efficiency and accuracy for unseen PDE configurations.
AI.motivation: Training individual PINNs for each configuration in parameterized PDE families is computationally prohibitive. Existing meta-learning approaches rely on a single global initialization, which suffers from negative transfer under task heterogeneity, especially with feature-scarce coordinate inputs and limited training-task availability.
AI.method: LAM-PINN decomposes the model into cluster-specialized subnetworks and a shared meta network, learns routing weights to selectively reuse modules, and uses brief transfer sessions combined with PDE parameters to construct task representations for clustering—even with coordinate-only inputs where traditional feature-based methods fail.
AI.result: LAM-PINN achieves 19.7-fold MSE reduction on unseen tasks using only 10% of training iterations required by conventional PINNs across three PDE benchmarks.
AI.conclusion: LAM-PINN provides an effective solution for generalization to unseen configurations within bounded design spaces of parameterized PDE families in resource-constrained engineering settings. The modular architecture avoids the single-initialization bottleneck of prior meta-learning PINN methods.

title: Index-Assisted Stratified Sampling for Online Aggregation
summary: Ad-hoc queries over frequently updated data in a flat schema are common in real-time data analysis applications and often require very low latency. Online aggregation can achieve so by providing approximate aggregation answers with confidence bound guarantees. It relies on the ability to draw samples online in a linear time to sample size rather than database size, which can be supported by index-assisted Sampling-based Approximate Query Processing (S-AQP) systems. However, the query latencies of approximate queries in these systems can still suffer from excessive sampling cost required to achieve a desired confidence bound, due to increased sample size for data with high variance in value distribution and selectivity. Classic stratified sampling methods with Neyman allocation can minimize sample size in theory, but several challenges prevent it from being applicable in index-assisted S-AQP systems, including requiring apriori statistics, high optimization cost, and inaccurate sampling cost model based on sample size. Towards that, we design index-assisted stratified sampling for online aggregation, which features a two-phase sampling framework. Samples drawn from first phase are used for both online aggregation and optimizing future sampling cost, while the second phase continues the online aggregation using the optimized strata. We prove optimal stratification and sample size allocation strategies for index-based sampling cost model, and design several greedy and dynamic programming based optimization methods to balance optimization cost and effectiveness in cost reduction. We evaluate our methods on several real-world and synthetic datasets and queries, and the results show ours consistently achieve good speedup and, in extreme cases, up to 3x speedup and 98708x speedup, when compared to index-assisted uniform sampling and classic scan-based stratified sampling respectively.

AI.tldr: 针对索引辅助S-AQP系统中高方差数据导致近似查询延迟高的问题，提出一种两阶段分层采样框架，证明了最优分层和样本分配策略，在保证置信区间的前提下显著降低采样成本，最高可获得3倍至近10万倍的加速。
AI.motivation: 在扁平模式高频更新数据的实时分析场景中，在线聚合需提供带置信区间保证的近似答案，但现有索引辅助S-AQP系统的查询延迟受限于高方差数据所需的大采样量。经典分层采样理论上可最小化样本量，但存在先验统计依赖、优化开销高、采样成本模型不准确等实践障碍。
AI.method: 提出了两阶段采样框架：第一阶段同时用于在线聚合和采样成本优化；第二阶段基于优化后的分层继续在线聚合。证明了针对索引采样成本模型的全局最优分层和样本分配策略，设计了贪心算法和动态规划两种优化方法以平衡优化开销与收益。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在各类数据集和查询上均取得良好加速效果，极端情况下相比索引辅助均匀采样提升3倍，相比扫描式分层采样提升98708倍。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过两阶段采样框架和优化的分层采样策略，有效解决了索引辅助S-AQP系统中近似查询延迟高的问题，在保证置信区间的前提下显著降低了采样成本。实验表明该方法相比现有方案有实质性改进。适用于需要实时近似聚合分析的高吞吐量数据处理场景。

title: CareGuardAI: Context-Aware Multi-Agent Guardrails for Clinical Safety & Hallucination Mitigation in Patient-Facing LLMs
summary: Integrating large language models (LLMs) into patient-facing healthcare systems offers significant potential to improve access to medical information. However, ensuring clinical safety and factual reliability remains a critical challenge. In practice, AI-generated responses may be conditionally correct yet medically inappropriate, as models often fail to interpret patient context and tend to produce agreeable responses rather than challenge unsafe assumptions. Unlike clinicians, who infer risk from incomplete information, LLMs frequently lack contextual awareness. Moreover, real-world patient interactions are open-ended and underspecified, unlike structured benchmark settings. We present CareGuardAI, a risk-aware safety framework for patient-facing medical question answering that addresses two key failure modes: clinical safety risk and hallucination risk. The framework introduces Clinical Safety Risk Assessment (SRA), inspired by ISO 14971, and Hallucination Risk Assessment (HRA) to evaluate medical risk and factual reliability. At inference time, CareGuardAI employs a multi-stage pipeline consisting of a controller agent, safety-constrained generation, and dual risk evaluation, followed by iterative refinement when necessary. Responses are released only when both SRA and HRA are less than or equal to 2, ensuring clinically acceptable outputs with bounded latency. We evaluate CareGuardAI on PatientSafeBench, MedSafetyBench, and MedHallu, covering both safety and hallucination detection. Across these benchmarks, the framework consistently outperforms strong baseline models, including GPT-4o-mini, demonstrating the importance of context-aware, risk-based, inference-time safety mechanisms for reliable deployment in healthcare.

AI.tldr: CareGuardAI 是一个面向患者端医疗问答的推理期风险感知安全框架，通过借鉴 ISO 14971 标准的临床安全风险评估（SRA）与幻觉风险评估（HRA）双重门控，仅当两项评分均 ≤2 时才输出回答，在 PatientSafeBench、MedSafetyBench、MedHallu 三个基准上稳定优于 GPT-4o-mini 等强基线。
AI.motivation: LLM 部署到面向患者的医疗系统时，回答常呈"有条件正确但医学上不适当"的形态：模型缺乏对患者上下文（症状、合并症、风险因素）的解读能力，倾向于给出迎合性（agreeable）回应而非质疑不安全假设；同时真实患者提问开放且信息不足，而现有基准多为结构化设定，二者存在分布错配。此外幻觉与不安全建议会直接造成临床伤害，仅靠模型自身的对齐训练难以在推理期拦截，因此需要显式的、以风险为依据的推理时安全机制。
AI.method: 提出 CareGuardAI 框架，针对两类失效模式构建评估体系：(1) 临床安全风险评估 SRA，方法学灵感来自医疗器械风险管理标准 ISO 14971；(2) 幻觉风险评估 HRA，用于衡量事实可靠性。推理时采用多阶段流水线：controller agent（控制器，负责上下文获取、意图与风险初判、路由）→ 安全约束生成（safety-constrained generation）→ 双重风险评估（SRA + HRA）→ 必要时进入迭代精化（iterative refinement）环节重写并复评。设置"双门限"发布策略：仅当 SRA ≤ 2 且 HRA ≤ 2 时才将回答释放给用户，其余情形转入精化或拒答/升级路径，从而在保证临床可接受性的同时约束端到端延迟上界。评测覆盖安全与幻觉两个维度：PatientSafeBench、MedSafetyBench（安全性）与 MedHallu（幻觉性），并与 GPT-4o-mini 等强基线对比。
AI.result: 在 PatientSafeBench、MedSafetyBench 和 MedHallu 上，CareGuardAI 在安全性检测与幻觉检测任务上均持续优于包括 GPT-4o-mini 在内的强基线模型，说明仅靠模型规模或通用指令对齐无法解决上下文缺失与迎合性回答问题，显式的上下文感知、基于风险的推理期安全机制对医疗场景的可靠落地是必要的；同时该框架在延迟有界的条件下实现了对临床可接受输出的可验证控制。
AI.conclusion: 面向患者的医疗 LLM 应用需要把"安全"与"幻觉"作为显式、可量化的风险在推理期进行管理，而非依赖训练期对齐。CareGuardAI 表明，将标准化风险管理思路（ISO 14971）迁移到 LLM 回答质量门控，结合风险分数阈值与迭代精化，可有效提升医疗问答的临床适宜性与事实可靠性，并构成可信部署的可复用架构。论文进一步支持了上下文感知与风险驱动式推理时安全层在真实医疗场景中的价值（论文亦指出真实交互的开放性是未来基准演进的方向）。

title: Online Monotone Metric Embeddings
summary:
Metric embeddings into structured spaces, particularly hierarchically well-separated trees (HSTs), are a fundamental tool in the design of online algorithms. In the classical online embedding setting, points arrive sequentially and must be embedded irrevocably upon arrival, resulting in strong distortion lower bounds of $Ω(\min(n, \log n\log Δ))$, where $n$ is the number of points and $Δ$ their aspect ratio.
  We propose a novel relaxation, \emph{online monotone metric embeddings}, which allows distances between embedded points in the target space to decrease monotonically over time. Such relaxed embeddings remain compatible with many online algorithms. Moreover, this relaxation breaks existing lower bound barriers, enabling embeddings into HSTs with distortion $O(\log^2 n)$.
  We also study a dynamic variant, where points may both arrive and depart, seeking distortion guarantees in terms of the maximum number $l$ of simultaneously present points. For traditional embeddings, such bounds are impossible, and this limitation persists even for deterministic monotone embeddings. Surprisingly, probabilistic monotone embeddings allow for $O(l \log l)$ distortion, which is nearly optimal given an $Ω(l)$ lower bound.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在线单调度量嵌入新范式，通过允许距离单调递减来松弛传统约束，在静态场景打破Ω(log n log Δ)下界实现O(log² n)，动态场景下概率版本达到近乎最优的O(l log l)。
AI.motivation: 经典在线嵌入要求点到达时立即且不可撤销地嵌入，导致嵌入失真下界为Ω(min(n, log n log Δ))，限制了在线算法的性能上限。
AI.method: 提出在线单调度量嵌入（online monotone metric embeddings）概念，允许嵌入点间距离随时间单调递减；同时探索概率版本以支持动态场景（点可到达和离开）。
AI.result: 对于静态到达场景，单调嵌入实现O(log² n)失真，打破了原有的下界壁垒。对于动态场景，概率单调嵌入达到O(l log l)失真（l为同时存在的最大点数），逼近Ω(l)的下界。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过引入单调性松弛条件，打破了传统在线度量嵌入的Ω(min(n, log n log Δ))下界限制，实现了O(log² n)的嵌入失真。动态场景下，概率单调嵌入达到O(l log l)的近乎最优结果。

title: End-to-End and Phase-Level Performance Optimization for Hyperledger Fabric
summary: Hyperledger Fabric (HLF) is a modular, permissioned blockchain widely adopted in enterprise settings. Enhancing its throughput and latency remains challenging, as optimization decisions made in one phase of the transaction lifecycle can adversely affect other phases. In this work, we present a systematic, phase-level and end-to-end study of HLF optimizations along three fronts, combining production-grade testbed experiments with calibrated SimPy simulations. First, we introduce two novel optimization techniques that target commit-phase bottlenecks: block-level pipelining and strategic waiting. In pipelining, we overlap validation and private-data acquisition of successive blocks with state-consistency checks and ledger updates improving commit throughput by up to 1.9x. Strategic waiting coordinates commit progress by temporarily pausing fast leaders and boosting laggers to sustain endorsement parallelism, yielding up to a 1.2x higher throughput. Second, we conduct micro-benchmarking of three configuration levers: private-data dissemination, block-size selection, and endorsement peer selection. Our results reveal that: (i) Relaxed quorums for private-data dissemination significantly reduce latency in both endorsement and commit phases; (ii) Under light workloads, smaller blocks yield lower end-to-end latency, whereas, under heavy workloads, larger blocks are necessary to improve throughput and reduce latency; and (iii) Relaxed leader selection dramatically reduces dropped transactions and boosts endorsement throughput, with a modest increase in MVCC invalidations. Finally, we analyze the interplay among private-data dissemination, VSCC parallelization, and pipelined commits. Interestingly, the throughput gains over a serial commit path are maximized at a moderate level of parallelization. Together, our findings provide phase-aware and protocol-level refinements for optimizing HLF.

AI.tldr: 本文对 Hyperledger Fabric (HLF) 进行了系统性、分阶段的端到端性能优化研究，结合生产级测试平台实验与 SimPy 仿真，提出两种针对提交阶段瓶颈的新型优化技术，并对三个配置参数进行了微基准测试，最终揭示了各优化策略之间的相互作用关系。
AI.motivation: HLF 是企业级广泛采用的模块化许可区块链，但其吞吐量和延迟优化面临挑战——一个阶段的优化决策可能对其他阶段产生负面影响，缺乏系统性、分阶段的端到端优化研究。
AI.method: 采用生产级测试平台实验与 SimPy 仿真相结合的混合方法，从三个维度展开研究：(1) 提出两种新型优化技术：块级流水线（block-level pipelining）和策略性等待（strategic waiting）；(2) 对三个配置杠杆进行微基准测试：私有数据传播、区块大小选择、背书节点选择；(3) 分析各优化策略之间的相互作用。
AI.result: 块级流水线使提交吞吐量提升高达 1.9 倍；策略性等待使吞吐量提升高达 1.2 倍；宽松的私有数据传播 quorum 显著降低背书和提交阶段延迟；轻负载下小区块降低端到端延迟，重负载下大区块提升吞吐量；宽松的领导者选择大幅减少丢弃交易、提升背书吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: 流水线和策略性等待等提交阶段优化显著有效；优化效果高度依赖工作负载特征和配置参数的协同调优；存在最优并行化程度使吞吐量增益最大化；研究为 HLF 提供了阶段感知和协议级优化指导。

title: UCSC-NLP at SemEval-2026 Task 13: Multi-View Generalization and Diagnostic Analysis of Machine-Generated Code Detection
summary: With the rapid growth of large language models for code generation, distinguishing between human-written and AI-generated code has become increasingly critical for academic integrity, hiring evaluations, and software security. We present our system for SemEval-2026 Task 13: Multilingual Machine-Generated Code Detection, participating in Subtask A (binary detection) and Subtask B (multi-class attribution across 10 LLM families). For Subtask A, we fine-tune UniXcoder-base with a multi-view training framework that promotes generator-invariant representations. The framework combines domain-specific structural prefixes, delexicalization with symmetric KL consistency loss, token dropout, and mixed-content augmentation. Our system achieves 0.993 macro F1 on validation and 0.845 macro F1 on the test set, which spans unseen languages and domains. For Subtask B, we show that severe class imbalance (88.4% human code, 221:1 majority-to-minority ratio) causes catastrophic minority-class failure under standard fine-tuning, with macro F1 collapsing to 0.086 despite 88.4% accuracy. A class-weighted extension trained for 3 epochs recovers macro F1 to 0.345 (+301% relative), confirming that multi-class attribution requires imbalance-aware training strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个用于SemEval-2026 Task 13的机器生成代码检测系统，包含二分类任务(Subtask A)和多分类归属任务(Subtask B)。通过UniXcoder-base微调结合多视图训练框架，在验证集上达到0.993 macro F1，测试集0.845。Subtask B中严重类别不平衡导致标准微调失效(class-weighted扩展后macro F1从0.086提升至0.345)。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成的代码激增，区分人机代码对学术诚信、人才评估和软件安全至关重要，需要开发可靠的机器生成代码检测系统。
AI.method: Subtask A采用UniXcoder-base微调结合多视图训练框架：领域特定结构前缀、去词汇化与对称KL一致性损失、token dropout、混合内容增强。Subtask B采用类别加权策略应对严重类别不平衡(88.4%为人类代码，221:1的多数/少数类比例)。
AI.result: Subtask A：验证集macro F1=0.993，测试集macro F1=0.845(跨语言跨领域)。Subtask B：标准微调下macro F1=0.086(准确率88.4%但少数类崩溃)，类别加权扩展3轮后提升至0.345(相对提升301%)。
AI.conclusion: 多视图训练框架对跨域二分类检测有效，但多分类归属任务需针对性不平衡处理策略。测试集性能下降(0.993→0.845)表明分布偏移仍是待解决挑战。

title: Policy-Governed LLM Routing with Intent Matching for Instrument Laboratories
summary: AI tutoring systems in engineering labs face a tension between providing sufficient assistance and preserving learning opportunities. Existing systems typically offer instructors limited control over assistance timing, content, or cost. This paper describes a routing and governance system for LLM-based lab assistance comprising two components: Routiium, an OpenAI-compatible gateway that manages multiple LLM backends with configurable prompt modifications and usage logging, and EduRouter, a policy-aware routing service that enforces per-lab budgets, approval workflows, and embedding-based question matching. We evaluated the system using trace-driven simulation calibrated from two engineering labs (LED characterization, RC circuit analysis) and a 100-query replay through live models. In simulations, governed policies (P1/P2) increased challenge-alignment index from 0.90 to 0.98 and overlay-adherence score from 0.69 to 0.87 compared to ungoverned operation (P0). The productive-struggle window metric increased from 1.4 to 3.6 simulated turns before high-scaffold hints appeared. In the 100-query replay, EduRouter routed 75% of queries to a local model, reducing token costs by 66% ($0.087 vs. $0.26 for all-premium routing) while maintaining canonical hit rate of 1.0 for the curated 89-intent question bank. We release Routiium, EduRouter, canonical-task tooling, and simulator configurations to support replication and future classroom studies.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个面向工程实验室的 LLM 辅导路由与治理系统，包含 Routiium（多后端网关）和 EduRouter（策略感知路由服务）两个组件，在保持学习挑战性的同时显著降低成本并提升辅导质量。
AI.motivation: 工程实验室的 AI 辅导系统面临辅助充分性与学习机会保留之间的张力，现有系统对辅助时机、内容或成本的控制有限，需要一个可治理的 LLM 辅助框架。
AI.method: 该研究提出了一个包含两个组件的路由与治理系统：1) Routiium——一个兼容 OpenAI 的网关，管理多个 LLM 后端，具有可配置的提示修改和使用日志功能；2) EduRouter——一个策略感知的路由服务，执行按实验室的预算限制、审批工作流和基于嵌入的问答匹配。研究通过两个工程实验室（LED 特性分析、RC 电路分析）的轨迹驱动模拟和 100 查询的实时模型回放进行评估。
AI.result: 模拟实验中，治理策略（P1/P2）相比无治理操作（P0）将挑战对齐指数从 0.90 提升至 0.98，叠加依从性评分从 0.69 提升至 0.87，productive-struggle 窗口从 1.4 增加至 3.6 个模拟轮次。100 查询回放中，EduRouter 将 75% 的查询路由至本地模型，token 成本降低 66%（$0.087 vs $0.26），同时对 89 意图问答库保持 1.0 的规范命中率。
AI.conclusion: 研究团队发布了 Routiium、EduRouter、规范任务工具和模拟器配置，以支持复制和未来课堂研究。该系统为工程实验室的 AI 辅导提供了可复用的技术框架和开源工具。

title: AgenticRecTune: Multi-Agent with Self-Evolving Skillhub for Recommendation System Optimization
summary: Modern large-scale recommendation systems are typically constructed as multi-stage pipelines, encompassing pre-ranking, ranking, and re-ranking phases. While traditional recommendation research typically focuses on optimizing a specific model, such as improving the pre-ranking model structure or ranking models training algorithm, system-level configurations optimization play a crucial role, which integrates the output from each model head to get the final score in each stage. Due to the complexity of the system, the configuration optimization is highly important and challenging. Any model modification requires new optimal system-level configurations. But each experimental iteration requires significant tuning effort. Furthermore, models in different stage operates within a distinct context and optimizes for different targets, requiring specialized domain expertise. In addition, optimization success depends on balancing competing multiple online metrics and alignment with shifting production development objectives. To address these challenges, we propose AgenticRecTune, an agentic framework comprising five specialized agents, Actor, Critic, Insight, Skill, and Online, designed to manage the end-to-end configuration optimization workflow. By leveraging the advanced reasoning of Large Language Models (LLMs), specifically Gemini, AgenticRecTune explore the optimal configuration spaces. The Actor Agent proposes multiple candidates and Critic Agent filters out suboptimal proposals.Then Online Agent autonomously prepares A/B tests based on the proposed configurations set from the Critic Agent and captures the subsequencet experimental results. We also introduce a self-evolving Skillhub, which utilizes a collaboration between the Insight Agent and Skill Agent to summarize the history results, extract underlying mechanics of each task in recommendation system and update skills.

AI.tldr: AgenticRecTune 是 Google 提出的一个多智能体（Actor、Critic、Insight、Skill、Online）框架，用于自动化工业级推荐系统（预排序、排序、重排序）中的「系统级配置优化」（如多目标分数融合权重、路由阈值、分数调整参数），核心亮点是自我进化的 Skillhub 与直接以线上 A/B 测试指标为反馈闭环；已在 Google Discover 生产环境上线，并在三类任务上取得统计显著的正向 topline 指标提升。
AI.motivation: 工业级推荐系统为多阶段流水线（召回→预排序→排序→重排序），传统推荐研究只聚焦单个模型结构或训练算法，而真正决定线上表现的是「系统级配置」——即把各模型头输出融合成最终分数的权重、阈值与业务调整逻辑。该优化的核心难点有三：1）可扩展性限制——任何模型/特征改动都使原有配置失效，配置空间庞大且高度耦合，网格搜索或人工调参成本极高；2）上下文碎片化——各阶段模型处于不同上下文、面向不同局部目标，需要高度专门化的领域知识；3）多目标线上指标演化——训练标签只关注孤立目标，而线上成功需在互动、多样性、长期留存等相互竞争的指标间取得平衡，且需随产品策略变化持续调整；此外系统整体不可微（排序、Top-K 截断、业务逻辑），标准 AutoML/HPO 与通用智能体难以直接以自然语言理解生产目标。
AI.method: 1）形式化：将系统配置定义为 Θ=[θ_pre, θ_rank, θ_re] 构成的系统配置空间 P，各阶段为 f_pre/f_rank/f_re 的复合函数 F，优化目标为在成本约束 E[C(Θ)]≤C_max 下最大化 North Star 指标期望，同时要求次要护栏指标 M_j ≥ b_j（多任务组合优化）。2）五智能体协作：Actor 基于 Skillhub 领域知识、Agent Memory 中的精英配置与自我学习模式构建结构化提示（角色、任务背景、参数说明、指标、初始配置与输出格式，支持注入候选数量等参数），由 Gemini 生成多组候选配置并给出每次参数调整的可解释假设；Critic 依据格式、护栏、指令约束与历史失败案例审查，输出恰好 N 条多样化的优质候选并附 <justification>，写入 Agent Memory；Online Agent 自动生成可执行代码/配置脚本、调度生产 A/B 测试（对照组为现网基线、实验组为候选，分配流量、设定显著性时长，上线前需人工审核），实验结束后通过平台 API 回收指标与显著性并回写 Memory。3）Agent Memory：记录 id、配置串、解释、提案时间、状态、结果与检查信息；Insight Agent 负责剪枝（保留 Pareto 前沿上互不支配的「top performers」）、标准化后用贪心最大化多样性（选取距集合最远的候选）、以及自学习（跨迭代挖掘敏感参数与共性成功改动）与交叉学习（MapReduce 跨任务模式汇总）。4）自我进化 Skillhub：每个 skill 作为插件包含任务上下文、任务需求（搜索空间与 JSON schema）、North Star 指标、初始配置、领域知识、工具（部署 API、结果查询、显著性分析）；Skill Agent 依据 Insight Agent 提炼的模式自动追加领域知识规则、收紧搜索空间边界，并合成新的运营型 skill。5）消融：以 Gemini 3 Pro / 3 Flash / 1.5 Pro 为推理底座，以及 Actor-Critic 与单智能体策略对比。
AI.result: 线上 A/B 测试（p<0.05）显示各阶段 topline 指标均显著提升：预排序 Value-Based Retrieval 互动指标 +0.75%/+0.90%、多样性 +0.48%；排序 Value Fusion 互动指标 +0.62%/+0.19%、多样性 +0.06%；重排序 Diversity 任务多样性 +3.43%，互动指标同时 +0.21%/+0.29%，未出现常见的短期互动下跌。模型消融：Gemini 3 Pro 表现最均衡（3.43% 多样性），Gemini 1.5 Pro 多样性仅 2.11%，Gemini 3 Flash 各项最低（0.08%/0.07%/1.69%），说明强推理能力是高效搜索的前提。策略消融：Actor-Critic 在 Value-Based Retrieval 上互动指标 0.75%/0.90%，远超单智能体的 0.29%/0.26%，但多样性提升更温和（0.48% vs 0.06%），表明双智能体的主要价值在于精化精度而非拓宽探索广度。
AI.conclusion: AgenticRecTune 将推荐系统的优化对象从「单模型改造」转向「系统级编排」，用 Actor-Critic-Insight-Skill-Online 五智能体协同自动化了从配置提案、审查、线上实验到知识沉淀的端到端闭环，克服了人工调参的可扩展性瓶颈；自我进化 Skillhub 把原始实验数据转化为可执行的领域知识并持续收紧搜索空间、合成新技能；通过直接对接生产 A/B 测试平台绕过离线代理指标，可在高维 Pareto 前沿上对齐互动/多样性/长期留存等演化的多目标。该系统已在 Google Discover 多次成功上线，验证了 LLM 智能体在工业级推荐系统配置优化中的实用价值；同时表明更强的基础模型推理能力是取得增益的关键。作者也指出仍需人工审核上线，且框架对基础模型能力与提示/技能设计有一定依赖。

title: Length Value Model: Scalable Value Pretraining for Token-Level Length Modeling
summary: Token serves as the fundamental unit of computation in modern autoregressive models, and generation length directly influences both inference cost and reasoning performance. Despite its importance, existing approaches lack fine-grained length modeling, operating primarily at the coarse-grained sequence level. We introduce the Length Value Model (LenVM), a token-level framework that models the remaining generation length. By formulating length modeling as a value estimation problem and assigning a constant negative reward to each generated token, LenVM predicts a bounded, discounted return that serves as a monotone proxy for the remaining generation horizon. This formulation yields supervision that is annotation-free, dense, unbiased, and scalable. Experiments on LLMs and VLMs demonstrate LenVM provides a highly effective signal at inference time. On the LIFEBench exact length matching task, applying LenVM to a 7B model improves the length score from 30.9 to 64.8, significantly outperforming frontier closed-source models. Furthermore, LenVM enables continuous control over the trade off between performance and efficiency. On GSM8K at a budget of 200 tokens, LenVM maintains 63% accuracy compared to 6 percent for token budget baseline. It also accurately predicts total generation length from the prompt boundary. Finally, LenVM's token-level values offer an interpretable view of generation dynamics, revealing how specific tokens shift reasoning toward shorter or longer regimes. Results demonstrate that LenVM supports a broad range of applications and token length can be effectively modeled as a token-level value signal, highlighting the potential of LenVM as a general framework for length modeling and as a length-specific value signal that could support future RL training. Code is available at https://github.com/eric-ai-lab/Length-Value-Model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Length Value Model（LenVM）：把"剩余生成长度"建模为 token 级价值估计问题——每生成一个 token 赋常数负奖励并做折扣，得到有界单调的折扣回报 G_t = -(1-γ^(L-t)) ∈ (-1,0) 作为回归目标，在 LLM/VLM 顶层隐状态上挂一个 sigmoid 价值头做 token-averaged MSE 训练。该监督天然免标注、稠密、无偏、可扩展，且不改动基座模型即可在推理时用于长度控制、性能-效率连续调节、长度预测与生成动态解释。实验显示：LIFEBench-token 上 Qwen2.5-7B 的 Length Score 从 30.9 提升到 64.8（8 轮 LCG+LenVM 达 83.6，偏差降至 5.8%）；GSM8K 约 200 token 预算下保持 63% Pass@1（硬截断基线仅 6%）；32B 模型在数学/代码/指令跟随上的提示边界长度 MRE 分别为 9.8%/14.9%/17.1%，全面优于熵引导预测器 EGTP/PLP；配合 packed 打分与熵跳过，端到端延迟从 4.55× 降至 1.90×。结论是"生成长度"本质上可作为 token 级 value 信号，为可扩展价值预训练及后续 RL（如长度优势分解或势函数塑形）提供通用基底。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型中 token 是基本计算单元，生成长度同时影响推理成本（算力、KV-cache、延迟、能耗）与推理性能（长链推理往往需要更多 token）。但现有长度建模与控制手段都停留在粗粒度：训练期的序列级长度惩罚、推理期的 prompt 指令、生成前的长度预测器，全部作用于整条序列或生成前的固定决策，缺少对"生成过程中还剩多少 token"的 token 级刻画。缺失的正是一个 token 级的剩余生成时长（remaining horizon）模型，它既能在推理时作为可控信号，又能在训练时充当长度感知的价值基线（baseline）。
AI.method:
**目标构造（§3.1）**：把生成视为 episode，每步非终止奖励 r_t = -(1-γ)（(1-γ) 仅作归一化），终止步 r_L = 0，折扣回报 G_t = -(1-γ^(L-t)) ∈ (-1,0)。该变换对剩余长度 L-t 严格单调、有界（解决长度长尾、条件数差），并满足 Bellman 递归 G_t = r_t + γG_{t+1}，把长度建模归约到标准价值学习框架；可精确反演 l = log(1+G_t)/log γ。四个监督特性：无标注（目标由采样补全长度直接算出）、稠密（每个非终止步一个回归目标）、对策略条件价值无偏（固定 rollout 策略下实现回报是 V^π 的无偏 MC 样本）、可扩展（随 prompt 数与每 prompt 采样数自然增长）。

**模型与训练（§3.2–3.3）**：在 LLM/VLM 最后一层隐状态上接两层 MLP + SiLU 价值头，V_θ = -σ(z) 保证输出落在 (-1,0)。损失为 token-averaged MSE（每个非终止 token 等权）。附录 F 证明：仅依赖当前状态的权重不会改变逐状态回归目标，而依赖未来 rollout 结果的权重（如轨迹级平均 1/L）会偏移目标，故必须采用 token-uniform 权重。GAE 可用但 λ=1（全程回报回归）最优。超参：Qwen2.5 系列 γ=0.997、Qwen3 系列 γ=0.9998（按 99 分位长度满足 1-γ^L0.99=0.99 选定），LlamaFactory 训练 2 epoch、lr 2e-5、batch 1024、BF16。

**数据**：多域混合而非分域建模——代码 OpenCodeReasoning-2（1.42M）、指令跟随 WildChat（529k）、数学 DeepMath-103K（103k）；每 prompt 最多采样 16 条补全。

**推理用法（§4.2–4.4）**：(1) 硬约束解码——先按截断策略取候选集 𝒱t，用一次 LenVM 前向给每个候选下一状态打分，Equal To 选 |v̂(x) - v*_t| 最小者（v*_t 由目标剩余长度换算），At Least 选 v̂ 最小者，At Most 选 v̂ 最大者；(2) 软控制——KL 正则化的指数倾斜 p'(x) ∝ p(x)exp(β v̂(x))（β<0 越负越偏短），可连续扫描性能-效率 Pareto 前沿；(3) 长度预测——在提示边界 s0 反演为长度估计，用"回报一致"的真值 L_GT = ln(1-μ_u)/ln γ 与 MRE 评估。

**工程优化与可解释性**：候选打分用单次 packed SGLang 调用（树形注意力，候选共享前缀、互不可见）+ LenVM KV 缓存；生成器熵 < 0.5 时跳过打分。定性分析用 TD 残差 s_t = r_{t-1} + γV_t - V_{t-1} 定义"length tokens"（正=偏长、负=偏短）。附录还给出 RL 视角：既可作长度专用价值基线（优势分解 A_total = A_task + s·A_len），也可作固定势函数 Φ(s)=sg(v̂(s)) 做策略不变塑形。
AI.result:
**长度控制（LIFEBench-token，作者自建的 token 版，360 双语实例，Equal To/At Most/At Least，32–1024 token）**：Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的 Equal-To Length Score 30.9→64.8，偏差 71%→44%；3B：25.6→62.6（偏差 83%→56%）；Qwen3-30B-A3B：36.8→67.2。作为对比，GPT-4o/GPT-5.4/Claude-Sonnet-4-6/Gemini 等闭源模型在 token 约束下偏差 66%–135%、Score 均低于 54。精确控制基线中，LenVM 单次调用（64.8，44%）优于 CAPEL（28.8，140.8%）、Prompt Best-of-8（58.1，28.7%）、Dynamic Feedback 8 轮（66.6，15.9%）与 LCG 8 轮（71.3，14.0%）；LCG+LenVM 8 轮进一步到 83.6，偏差降至 5.8%（4/2 轮分别为 80.5/73.8，偏差 8.6%/10.7%），显示与迭代式黑盒控制器互补。

**性能-效率权衡**：GSM8K（Qwen2.5-3B）在约 200 token 平均截断长度下，硬预算基线 Pass@1 约 6%，LenVM 保持约 63%；MATH500 在匹配平均长度下优于 budget-aware prompting（317 token: 47.50 vs 333 token: 39.66；397: 50.78 vs 412: 48.63）与 EOS 校准（306 token: 45.59 vs 307: 28.56）；GSM8K 亦优于预算提示（192: 86.28 vs 198: 81.00）。在 AIME2025 上 Base+LenVM（Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507）以 5611 token 达 54.17% Pass@1，略优于带长度惩罚的 RLVR 模型 ART 的 5599 token / 51.25%；且 LenVM 亦可对 ART 本身做连续调节（5599→4949 token，51.25%→46.25%），即"兼容性而非全面优越"。

**长度预测**：随规模一致提升，32B 时数学/代码/指令跟随的提示边界 MRE 为 9.8%/14.9%/17.1%（1.5B 为 17.0%/29.0%/33.0%）。与专用预测器（冻结 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）对比：提示边界 MRE 32.56→26.90、MAE 228.31→194.39、Spearman ρ 0.344→0.575、Within-128 35.34→42.65；渐进（前缀）预测 MRE 26.71→15.10、MAE 218.67→155.56、ρ 0.746→0.783、W128 30.74→60.70。

**可扩展性与开销**：模型规模、训练问题数、每问题采样数三个维度上验证损失均一致下降。延迟：原生 1.00×、逐步 LenVM 4.55×、熵跳过（仅 19.5% 步激活）1.90×；packed 候选打分单步 32.18–34.16 ms（K=2–5）。

**消融与案例**：四种目标参数化中"Discount Return + Sigmoid"最优，优于 Raw/Normalized Length + Softplus 与 Log Length + Softplus（长尾使原始/归一化长度难以判别）；完全打散 batch 优于同 prompt 补全成组 batch；fp16/bf16/fp32 损失曲线几乎一致；γ 越大早期预测越好、γ 越小越靠近终止端越好；候选集 K 从 1 增到 128 使 LB-token Score 29.3→72.1、偏差 100.2%→18.5%，而 MATH500 上 K≥2 后收益趋于饱和。案例研究发现 wait/think/try 类 token 的 TD 残差偏正（推向更长 horizon），therefore/clearly/perfect 类偏负（推向更短）。附录 G 证明反演会系统性低估期望剩余长度（严格凹函数 + Jensen 不等式，当且仅当长度方差为 0 时取等）。
AI.conclusion: 生成长度本质上可以用 token 级价值信号来刻画：常数负奖励 + 折扣回报把"剩余生成时长"映射为有界、单调、Bellman 一致的目标，从而在标准价值学习框架下获得免标注、稠密、无偏、可扩展的监督。LenVM 证明该信号在推理时即已高度有用：可实现精确长度约束（LIFEBench-token 上 7B 模型 30.9→64.8，结合 LCG 达 83.6）、在不改动基座模型的前提下连续调节性能-效率前沿（GSM8K 200 token 下 63% vs 硬预算 6%）、从提示边界高精度预测长度（32B 数学 MRE 9.8%，并优于熵引导基线）、并为生成动态提供可解释的"length tokens"视角；同时可扩展性随模型/数据/采样量单调提升，推理开销经 packed 打分与熵跳过可控。作者强调三点定位：LenVM 是长度建模的通用框架与长度专用 value 信号（可充当 PPO 的长度基线或固定势函数塑形，支持未来 RL 训练，但本文未做 RL 微调实验）；推理仍比原生解码慢约 1.9×；LenVM 是策略条件化的，跨生成器/大策略偏移下的校准仍未解决；LIFEBench-token 采用 token 约束，绝对分数与原词/字级榜单不可直接比较。

title: Simple Self-Conditioning Adaptation for Masked Diffusion Models
summary: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate discrete sequences by iterative denoising under an absorbing masking process. In standard masked diffusion, if a token remains masked after a reverse update, the model discards its clean-state prediction for that position. Thus, still-masked positions must be repeatedly inferred from the mask token alone. This design choice limits cross-step refinement. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a simple, yet effective, post-training adaptation for MDMs that conditions each denoising step on the model's own previous clean-state predictions. The resulting method, called Self-Conditioned Masked Diffusion Models (SCMDM), requires minimal architectural change, does not introduce a recurrent latent-state pathway, does not rely on an auxiliary reference model, and adds no extra denoiser evaluations during sampling. This is an important departure from partial self-conditioning approaches which requires expensive model training from scratch. In particular, the paper shows that partial self-conditioning, including the commonly used 50% dropout strategy for training self-conditioned models from scratch, is suboptimal in the post-training regime. Instead, once the model's self-generated clean-state estimates become informative, the specialization to refinement is preferable to mixing conditional and unconditional objectives. SCMDM is evaluated across multiple domains, demonstrating consistent improvement over vanilla MDM baselines, achieving nearly a 50% reduction in generative perplexity on OWT-trained models (42.89 to 23.72), alongside strong improvements in discretized image synthesis quality, small molecular generation, and enhanced fidelity in genomic distribution modeling.

AI.tldr: SCMDM is a post-training adaptation for masked diffusion models that reuses previous clean-state predictions to condition each denoising step, addressing the limitation where still-masked positions can only be inferred from mask tokens. The method achieves ~50% perplexity reduction on OWT (42.89→23.72) with minimal architectural changes and no extra computation, outperforming partial self-conditioning approaches in the post-training regime.
AI.motivation: In standard masked diffusion models, if a token remains masked after a reverse update, the model discards its clean-state prediction for that position. Still-masked positions must be repeatedly inferred from the mask token alone, limiting cross-step refinement capabilities.
AI.method: Post-training adaptation that conditions each denoising step on the model's own previous clean-state predictions. When a token remains masked, the method reuses the clean-state estimate from the previous denoising step instead of discarding it. This specialization to refinement becomes preferable once self-generated estimates become informative.
AI.result: Consistent improvements over vanilla MDM baselines across multiple domains: nearly 50% reduction in generative perplexity on OWT-trained models (42.89 to 23.72), strong improvements in discretized image synthesis quality, small molecular generation, and enhanced fidelity in genomic distribution modeling.
AI.conclusion: SCMDM requires minimal architectural change, no recurrent latent-state pathway, no auxiliary reference model, and adds no extra denoiser evaluations. The approach demonstrates that specialized refinement (rather than mixing conditional and unconditional objectives) is optimal once the model's self-generated estimates become informative. This marks an important departure from partial self-conditioning approaches that require expensive training from scratch.

title: Binary Spiking Neural Networks as Causal Models
summary: We provide a causal analysis of Binary Spiking Neural Networks (BSNNs) to explain their behavior. We formally define a BSNN and represent its spiking activity as a binary causal model. Thanks to this causal representation, we are able to explain the output of the network by leveraging logic-based methods. In particular, we show that we can successfully use a SAT as well as a SMT solver to compute abductive explanations from this binary causal model. To illustrate our approach, we trained the BSNN on the standard MNIST dataset and applied our SAT-based and SMT-based methods to finding abductive explanations of the network's classifications based on pixel-level features. We also compared the found explanations against SHAP, a popular method used in the area of explainable AI. We show that, unlike SHAP, our approach guarantees that a found explanation does not contain completely irrelevant features.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将二值脉冲神经网络(BSNN)的脉冲发放动力学形式化映射为二元因果模型(BCM),并据此用 SAT/SMT 求解器在 MNIST 分类任务上计算像素级特征的溯因解释(AXp,本质为质蕴涵项)。实验表明 SMT(线性整数算术)版本远快于纯 SAT 版本(秒级 vs 小时级),且由命题 6.2 保证解释中不含与隐藏层零权重连接的"完全无关特征";而 SHAP 平均有约 47% 的相关特征实际为零权重连接,存在误导性。
AI.motivation: 二值脉冲神经网络(BSNN)因其 Boolean 本质,在可解释性上具有逻辑可表示性的优势:可以把发放动力学表示成二元因果模型(BCM),从而用 SAT/SMT 求解器以形式化、可验证的方式解释网络的决策。已有的可解释 AI 方法(如 SHAP)是"黑箱"式的,不考虑模型内部因果结构,可能给出误导性的特征重要性(如把与隐藏层零权重连接的像素判为相关),且缺乏"最小性/非冗余"保证。因此需要一种能保证解释中每个特征都真正因果相关的方法。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义 BSNN 架构(输入/非输入神经元集合、连接关系、权重尺度、发放阈值)与"BSNN 兼容"的发放动力学:采用无泄漏 Integrate-Fire 神经元,含硬重置项,A(X,t)=A(X,t-1)·(1-F_X(t-1))+ΣW·F_{X'}(t),发放为 Heaviside 阶跃。2) 构建 BCM:为每个神经元在每个时间步分配布尔变量 p_{X,t}(输入神经元为外生变量,非输入为内生变量),内生变量由形如 p↔ω 的布尔方程定义,阈值条件以"存在满足阈值的输入脉冲子集"的重言式/析取编码,布尔权重情形给出显式公式(Def 5.1),并证明 BCM 满足性与脉冲动力学等价(Thm 5.2)。3) 在 BCM 上定义溯因解释(AXp):explanans 为外生变量的项(literal 合取),explanandum 为内生变量的布尔表达式;AXp 需满足真值性、充分性(在 BCM 约束下蕴含 explanandum)与最小性(任一真子集不再充分)。explanandum 取某时刻 t 的实际输出模式 out_{S,t},explanans 只使用时刻 t 的输入像素。4) 搜索算法:以完整输入项初始化,逐个删除 literal,每次用求解器检验充分性,最后校验质蕴涵性;并给出基于 SMT(LIA)的 BCM 编码与对应 AXp 判定条件。5) 实验:用 XNOR-Net 式权重量化(二值 {0,1} 与三值 {-1,0,1})、STE+代理梯度(arctan)训练单隐层全连接 BSNN(隐层 8/16/32/64/128,输入 28×28,输出 10),采用 Poisson 速率编码与阈值二值编码;在 3 数字与 10 数字 MNIST 上评估精度;用 Z3 实现 SAT 与 SMT 两版解释搜索并计时;与 SHAP(按阈值 δ 选取相关特征)对比"零权重连接却被判为相关"的比例。
AI.result: (1) 精度:二值权重+Poisson 编码 16 隐单元达 94.62% 测试精度(3 数字任务 95.27%);三值权重 10 数字任务最好 92.16%;阈值单步编码的二值网络达 93.63%。(2) 解释搜索性能:SAT 版平均 5.84–11.13 小时(k=16/8/32),SMT 版仅 192–491 秒(k=16 最快 483 秒),提速显著,原因是 SMT 编码避免了命题逻辑中对变量集合的全称量化;三值权重的 SMT 版为 0.27–1.0 小时。(3) 解释长度:二值网络 k=32/16/8 时平均解释分别占总特征 20.91%/27.3%/12.5%,长度 164/214/98;三值网络解释短得多(约 36–56 个特征)。(4) 关键理论保证:命题 6.2 证明 AXp 中出现的任一输入像素必然与某个隐藏单元存在非零(权重=1)连接,因此解释绝不会包含完全无关特征。(5) SHAP 对比:SHAP 平均把约 47%(37%–57%,随样本量增大而下降)零权重连接的特征误判为相关,且不保证最小性,计算时间为 4.7–173.6 秒,存在"精度-可解释性"的权衡。
AI.conclusion: BSNN 的脉冲动力学可被精确刻画为二元因果模型,使逻辑推理(SAT/SMT)成为可行的解释工具;基于 BCM 的溯因解释兼具形式化可验证性、最小性/非冗余性,以及"不含因果无关特征"的保证,明显优于模型无关的 SHAP。SMT 编码是关键改进,使解释计算从小时级降到秒级。局限:目前仅覆盖 AXp,未涉及实际因果(actual cause)与 NESS cause;未考虑卷积 BSNN;仅在 MNIST 等简单视觉分类任务验证,未来计划扩展至因果解释更强概念、卷积结构及语言任务。

title: ObjectGraph: From Document Injection to Knowledge Traversal -- A Native File Format for the Agentic Era
summary:
Every document format in existence was designed for a human reader moving linearly through text. Autonomous LLM agents do not read - they retrieve. This fundamental mismatch forces agents to inject entire documents into their context window, wasting tokens on irrelevant content, compounding state across multi-turn loops, and broadcasting information indiscriminately across agent roles. We argue this is not a prompt engineering problem, not a retrieval problem, and not a compression problem: it is a format problem.
  We introduce OBJECTGRAPH (.og), a file format that reconceives the document as a typed, directed knowledge graph to be traversed rather than a string to be injected. OBJECTGRAPH is a strict superset of Markdown - every .md file is a valid .og file - requires no infrastructure beyond a two-primitive query protocol, and is readable by both humans and agents without tooling.
  We formalize the Document Consumption Problem, characterise six structural properties no existing format satisfies simultaneously, and prove OBJECTGRAPH satisfies all six. We further introduce the Progressive Disclosure Model, the Role-Scoped Access Protocol, and Executable Assertion Nodes as native format primitives. Empirical evaluation across five document classes and eight agent task types demonstrates up to 95.3 percent token reduction with no statistically significant degradation in task accuracy (p > 0.05). Transpiler fidelity reaches 98.7 percent content preservation on a held-out document benchmark.

AI.tldr: OBJECTGRAPH (.og) 是一种面向 LLM 智能体的新型文档格式，将文档重新设计为可遍历的Typed Directed Knowledge Graph，而非线性文本。该格式是Markdown的超集，支持双基元查询协议，在人类和智能体间均无需特殊工具即可阅读。实验表明可实现95.3%的Token节省，同时保持任务准确性不下降。
AI.motivation: 解决LLM智能体与文档格式之间的根本性不匹配问题：现有文档格式专为人类线性阅读设计，而智能体是"检索"而非"阅读"，导致上下文窗口浪费、状态累积和信息泄露等问题。作者认为这不是提示工程、检索或压缩问题，而是格式问题本身。
AI.method: 提出OBJECTGRAPH格式，核心创新包括：1) 将文档建模为Typed Directed Knowledge Graph；2) 形式化定义Document Consumption Problem及6个结构属性；3) 设计Progressive Disclosure Model（渐进披露模型）、Role-Scoped Access Protocol（角色作用域访问协议）、Executable Assertion Nodes（可执行断言节点）三个原生格式基元；4. 仅需双基元查询协议。
AI.result: 实验评估覆盖5种文档类别和8种智能体任务类型：Token减少最高达95.3%；任务准确性无显著退化(p > 0.05)；在保留文档基准上转译保真度达98.7%。
AI.conclusion: OBJECTGRAPH通过重新定义文档格式范式，成功解决了LLM智能体的文档消费问题，在大幅降低Token消耗的同时保持准确性，且保持与Markdown的向后兼容，具备实际部署可行性。

title: MARS: Efficient, Adaptive Co-Scheduling for Heterogeneous Agentic Systems
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as the execution core of autonomous agents rather than as standalone text generators. Agentic workloads induce a temporal shift from single-turn inference to multi-turn LLM-tool loops, and a spatial shift from chat-scale, GPU-only execution to repository-scale, GPU-CPU co-located execution. Consequently, coordinating heterogeneous resource demands of agentic execution has emerged as a critical system challenge.
  We design and implement MARS, an efficient and adaptive co-scheduling system that globally coordinates heterogeneous agentic workloads under coupled GPU-CPU resource pressure. By establishing holistic visibility across GPU inference and CPU tool execution via a unified information stream, an external control plane in MARS decouples admission from execution to prevent heterogeneous resource oversubscription. An internal agent-centric scheduler further minimizes the end-to-end critical path by prioritizing latency-sensitive continuations and adaptively retaining KV cache state only when warm resumption yields a latency benefit. Our evaluations show that MARS reduces end-to-end latency by up to 5.94x while maintaining nearly maximal system throughput. We further integrate MARS as the serving backend for the OpenHands coding agent framework, demonstrating its real-world effectiveness by accelerating end-to-end task completion time by up to 1.87x.
  Our source code will be publicly available soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实现了一套名为 MARS 的智能体服务系统（基于 vLLM V1，约 5000 行 Python），通过「引擎外的工作集准入控制 + 引擎内的智能体中心调度器」的闭环反馈，在 GPU 显存受限的条件下同时实现低 KV cache 抖动与高工作流级 SLO goodput：相对最快基线平均端到端延迟降低 1.59×–7.56×，接入 OpenHands/OpenCode/Codex CLI 后工作流完成时间再提升 1.17×–1.87×。注意：arXiv 全文标题为「MARS: Towards High Goodput and Low KV Thrashing in Agent Serving under GPU Memory Constraints」，与所给摘要标题（MARS: Efficient, Adaptive Co-Scheduling for Heterogeneous Agentic Systems）不一致，摘要与正文在数值与措辞上也略有差异（摘要称 5.94× 与 OpenHands 1.87×）。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体正从单轮推理转向多轮「LLM-工具」循环，部署形态也从纯 GPU 的聊天级推理扩展到仓库级的 GPU-CPU 协同执行，这带来了时序与空间的双重转变，使异构资源协调成为关键系统问题。核心痛点有三：(1) KV cache thrashing——多轮工作流的上下文不断累积，活跃 KV 工作集轻易超出显存容量，引擎被迫驱逐正在等待工具返回的可复用前缀，续接时需重算/重载，作者称之为 prefix rebuild，在 ILR-1 上基线 12.9M–56.0M 的前缀 token 中有 37%–85% 属于此类重建；(2) 工作流级 goodput 不足——现有吞吐导向引擎（如 vLLM）偏好大批次，一次性准入大量请求会推高并发 KV 占用、驱逐可复用前缀，同时分摊 GPU 资源拖慢单轮解码，误差在多轮间累积导致工作流错过端到端 SLO；(3) 现有方案各有盲区：Autellix 用 PLAS 近似 SJF 但不约束 KV 需求，InferCept/LightLLM 基于静态 peak-token 难以应对不可预测的多轮上下文增长，Continuum 的 TTL 策略在活跃 KV 超容时仍付恢复代价，且这些缓存中心方法都忽略了工作流级优先级。作者指出根本原因在于「粒度错配」：可复用 KV 与延迟预算属于多轮工作流，而引擎却以孤立推理调用为粒度准入和调度。
AI.method: MARS 的设计围绕「admit-and-finish」替代「evict-and-recover」，将引擎可见工作集的构成与执行解耦，形成跨引擎边界的双组件闭环。①外部准入控制器（§4）：在根工作流粒度准入，读取引擎分配器的可分配 KV block 数 F 并扣除守护裕量 B_guard 得到预算 B=max(0, F−B_guard)；按输入前缀长度离线估计初始 footprint b_s；通过 KV 利用率反馈环自适应调整并发窗口 W（超高水位时乘性收缩、低于低水位时加性扩张），触发时机为工作流到达、终止或定时器 tick；候选排序在低压下保持 FIFO 保序，在竞争激烈时优先小 footprint 以抑制瞬时 KV 需求，超预算候选被跳过以避免队头阻塞；已准入根工作流跨轮次与工具阶段保留准入资格，其子会话继承父根名额、绕过等待队列；大前缀长尾通过 KV 预算的分批 drain 处理（软启动每次仅准入一个大前缀工作流，并在活跃集为空且最老工作流超出保守预算时单独准入以避免死锁）。②引擎内智能体中心调度器（§5）：以多级优先队列 Q1..QK 组织就绪调用，优先级由初始 prefill 长度、当前轮累计 prefill 服务量、等待时间三信号决定，达到 token quantum 且仍有 prefill 时降级一级，进入解码后立即提升至 Q1，等待每 30 秒老化升一级以缓解饥饿；批构造时若空闲 KV 不足则弹性收缩 prefill chunk（以单个 block 为下限），若运行中调用仍无法获得 block，则按逆优先级（QK→Q1）执行优先级感知的 KV 回收，优先保护活跃解码与高优先级 prefill，被抢占调用重置反馈并插入 Q1 队首；轮次完成后释放活跃 block 引用、转为可驱逐的前缀缓存块，借助准入控制保证工具间隔期缓存不被提前驱逐，从而命中前缀缓存、避免重建。实现基于 vLLM V1，通过扩展 OpenAI 兼容请求 schema 携带 root job_id 元数据并经 SamplingParams.extra_args 透传；与 OpenHands（instrumented runtime 边界）、OpenCode 与 Codex CLI（转发代理）集成，每个准入根运行在独立 worker 进程，前端保留工具选择、子会话创建与终止控制权，无需预先声明 agent 图。
AI.result: 动机研究（ILR-1）：所有系统处理相同的 8.2M 首次 prefill token，但基线额外处理 12.9M–56.0M 前缀 token，重建占比 37%–85%，MARS 几乎消除重建；单 token 执行时间分解显示 Continuum 仍有 1.48 ms/token 的 re-prefill 开销，与其 1.40 ms 的权重摊销成本相当，说明 KV 重建可抵消权重摊销收益。端到端实验：Qwen3-Coder-30B 在 H200 上 ILR-1~ILR-4 共 28 个工作点全部取得最低平均延迟，相对最快基线 1.90×–5.94×；归一化延迟 CDF 在 α=3 处，MARS 的 SLO 达成率在 ILR-1 为 71%（最强基线 7%）、ILR-4 为 60%（最强基线 2%）。泛化性：GPT-OSS-120B 单卡 H100（S-ILR1~S-ILR3）达 1.59×–7.56×；Qwen3-Coder-30B 在 4×A5000（TP=4）达 1.64×–6.53×。全栈集成：OpenHands（20 个工作点，H200）完成时间提升 1.20×–1.87×；OpenCode 提升 1.17×–1.56×，Codex 提升 1.31×–1.62×，全栈收益较小源于前端编排、RPC、沙箱与工具执行占据大量耗时。消融（H100、ILR-1）：工作集准入是主要收益来源，MARS-AC 相对 CONCUR-AC 提升 2.4×–4.2×，全量 MARS 在 0.2–0.5 RPS 下再相对 MARS-AC 提升 1.33×–1.54×、相对 CONCUR-AC 提升 3.47×–5.59×；平均总等待时间从 CONCUR-AC 的 2101 s 降至 MARS-AC 的 553 s（3.80×），再到全量 MARS 的 375 s（再降 1.47×）。
AI.conclusion: MARS 通过把「工作流级工作集准入」与「调用级执行与 KV 回收」解耦并用实时显存遥测闭环耦合，在显存受限的本地智能体部署中同时缓解 KV cache thrashing 与工作流级 goodput 不足，相对最强基线降低平均端到端延迟 1.59×–7.56×，并使主流智能体前端（OpenHands、OpenCode、Codex CLI）的工作流完成时间提升 1.17×–1.87×。作者也明确列出局限与未来工作：当前以平均延迟与 SLO goodput 为目标，租户级公平性（如 DRF）未纳入；仅管理节点内单副本，多副本集群的路由、准入与负载均衡（会话亲和 vs. Llumnix 式迁移）待解决；调度把每个就绪调用视为独立单元，未来可基于前端暴露的依赖图为调用加权并优先回收非关键路径上的受害者，将 admit-and-finish 从单根扩展到根内的结构化图。代码已开源于 github.com/Afterglow231/MARS_preview。

title: Improved Approximation Algorithm for Maximum Balanced Biclique
summary: We study the Maximum Balanced Biclique (MBB) problem: Given a bipartite graph $G$ with $n$ vertices on each side, find a balanced biclique in $G$ with maximum size. We give a polynomial-time $\left(\frac{n}{\widetildeΩ\left((\log n)^3\right)}\right)$-approximation algorithm for the problem, which improves upon an $\left(\frac{n}{Ω\left((\log n)^2\right)}\right)$-approximation by Chalermsook et al. (2020) and answers their open question. Furthermore, our approximation ratio matches that of the maximum clique problem by Feige (2004) up to an $O(\log \log n)$ factor.

AI.tldr: 本文针对二分图上的最大平衡二部图（MBB）问题，给出首个多项式时间 O(n·(log log n / log n)³) ≈ n/Ω̃((log n)³) 的近似算法，超越了 Chalermsook 等人 (2020) 的 n/Ω((log n)²) 结果，回答了其公开问题，并与 Feige (2004) 最大团算法的近似比仅差 O(log log n) 因子。核心是构造带“分数度数”约束的更强 SDP 松弛，并沿用 Håstad 式高斯阈值取整，但把分析从“存活顶点数”改为“存活边数”的下界估计，以解决取整后可能只保留一侧顶点、无法保证平衡性的问题。
AI.motivation: 最大平衡二部图（MBB）是最大团的二分图变体：给定两侧各 n 个顶点的二分图 G=(U,V,E)，找最大的 K_{k,k}。尽管其精确版本在 Garey–Johnson (1979) 中已被列为 NP 难，但即便在加强版唯一图猜想等假设下也只知 n^{1−ε} 难近似，且至今连 1+ε 都未证明难近似，算法侧进展也十分缓慢：朴素的“枚举式”算法仅给出 n/Ω̃(log n)，Chalermsook 等人 (2020) 通过对匹配使用图移除技术改进到 n/Ω((log n)²)，并留下公开问题——能否达到 Feige (2004) 最大团算法 n/Ω̃((log n)³) 的水平。作者的目标即回答该问题。分析中作者还发现，将最大团的 Lovász θ 型 SDP 直接推广到 MBB 会出现无界积分间隙（可取 u_i=(e+f)/2, u_j=(e−f)/2 使 k=n/2），这是必须设计更强松弛的根本原因。
AI.method: 方法分两部分：(1) 强 SDP 松弛（图2）：除最大团式约束（‖e‖²=1、‖u_i‖²=⟨u_i,e⟩、两侧投影和均为 k、非边正交 ⟨u_i,u_j⟩=0、全部内积非负）外，新增“分数度数”约束 (5)(6)：Σ_{j∈V}⟨u_i,u_j⟩=k⟨u_i,e⟩ 与对称的 U 侧版本，要求被选顶点必须有 k 个“被选邻居”，从而抑制不平衡解。(2) 取整（图3，Håstad (2002) 风格）：令 t=n/k，取重集 A={i∈U: c_i≥1/(8t)}、B={j∈V: c_j≥1/(8t)}；对重集顶点做平移 u'_i = u_i − α c_i e（α=1−1/√2）；采随机高斯 g，保留 ⟨g, u'_i/‖u'_i'‖⟩ ≥ τ（τ=√(0.1 log n)）的顶点得到子图 H；最后用引理2的贪心抽取：密度清洗（删去 d_F(i) ≤ 2r·d_Q(i) 的顶点）+ 构造（选 r 个 U 侧顶点并删其非邻点）。分析要点：由于约束 (5)(6) 可证 M(A,B) ≥ (3/4)k²，且 Σ_{A×B} c_i c_j ≤ k²，故存在 ≥ k²/4 条“好边”E⁺（⟨u_i,u_j⟩ > ½c_i c_j，必为图中的边），经平移后其相关系数非负，由正相关双变量高斯尾界得 E[F] ≥ (k²/4)·φ(τ)²/(4τ²) ≥ n^{1.8}；而非边处 ⟨u'_i,u'_j⟩ = −½c_i c_j，相关系数 ≤ −1/(16t)，由负相关尾界得 E[Q] ≤ n²·(√π/τ)φ(τ)²e^{−τ²/(16t)} = (1/4r)·E[F]。取 r = (1/(64√π τ t²))·e^{τ²/(16t)} ≥ n^{1/(D·t)}，则 E[F−2rQ] ≥ 4nr，而 F−2rQ ≤ n²，故以至少 1/n² 概率满足引理2的前提；重复 n³ 次取整达到高概率。最后与 Chalermsook 等人 (2020) 的定理2（匹配上的图移除，输出 Θ((log n/log t)²) 大小的二部图）拼接：最优解较大（t ≤ O(log n/log log n)）时用本文 SDP 取整；最优解较小时（SDP 不可行 ⇒ 最优 ≤ O(n log log n/log n)，或最优 ≤ n/log³n）用 CJO20 算法（此时 t ≤ log³n，输出 Θ((log n/log log n)²)）。
AI.result: 定理1：存在随机多项式时间 O(n·(log log n/log n)³) 近似算法，等价地 n/Ω̃((log n)³) 近似，优于 CJO20 的 n/Ω((log n)²)，并回答了其公开问题；与 Feige (2004) 最大团的 O(n(log log n)²/(log n)³) 仅差 O(log log n) 因子。定理3（核心技术）：存在常数 D>1，当 k ≥ n·D·log log n/log n（即 t=n/k ≤ log n/(D log log n)）时，对图2 SDP 的可行解存在高效取整，以高概率找到大小至少 n^{1/(D·t)} 的平衡二部图（证明中取 D=1000，r ≥ n^{1/(160t)}）。分析证实直接推广的“自然”SDP 积分间隙无界，故必须引入 (5)(6) 约束。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次让 MBB 的近似比达到与最大团同一量级（差 O(log log n)），方法学上把最大团的 SDP 取整思想迁移到二分图平衡性场景，关键创新是新增分数度数约束并改为估计存活边数而非存活顶点数。作者指出三个开放方向：(i) 继续改进近似比；(ii) 该“最优解较大”情形能否像最大团那样用纯组合的子图移除技术处理；(iii) 最大边二部图（MEB，不要求平衡、最大化边数）能否获得类似近似比（目前仅 n/Ω̃(log n)），特别是最优解较大时如何应用 SDP 取整仍不清楚。

title: Towards the Democratization and Standardization of Dynamic Resources with MPI Spawning
summary: This paper presents an efficient tool for managing dynamic resources in production high-performance computing (HPC) settings, focusing on flexibility, adaptability, and user-friendliness. We introduce a unified dynamic resource management application programming interface (API) that supports a wide range of HPC applications, allowing seamless integration without direct interaction with Dynamic Management of Resources (DMR). The DMR framework, evolved from the DMRlib structure, now supports various dynamic resource managers and includes the Proteo reconfiguration engine to enhance malleability strategies.
