This integration addresses previous limitations by allowing diverse reconfiguration methods without respawning all processes or lacking RMS support. The paper also showcases the solution's performance and coding productivity with the MPDATA (Multidimensional Positive Definite Advection Transport Algorithm) application. Key contributions include an enhanced modular DMR framework supporting different reconfiguration managers, upgraded DMRlib with the Proteo reconfiguration engine, offering extensive reconfiguration strategies, and a malleable version of the MPDATA solver.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于高性能计算(HPC)环境的高效动态资源管理工具，包含统一API和DMR框架，集成Proteo重配置引擎，并以MPDATA应用验证了性能和编码效率。
AI.motivation: 现有动态资源管理方案要求用户直接与DMR交互，且缺乏灵活的重配置方法——要么需要重spawn所有进程，要么缺乏RMS支持，导致HPC应用中资源管理的灵活性和适应性受限。
AI.method: 设计了统一的动态资源管理API，支持多种HPC应用无缝集成；将DMR框架从DMRlib升级，集成Proteo重配置引擎以增强可延展性策略；开发了支持不同重配置管理器的模块化架构。
AI.result: 实现了增强的模块化DMR框架，支持多种重配置管理器；DMRlib升级集成了Proteo重配置引擎，提供广泛的重配置策略；开发了可延展的MPDATA求解器，验证了方案的性能和编码生产力。
AI.conclusion: 该方案有效提升了HPC环境中资源管理的灵活性、适应性和用户友好性，解决了以往方法的重配置限制，为动态资源管理提供了统一且高效的解决方案。

title: Adaptive and AI-Augmented Security Testing: A Systematic Survey of Program Analysis, Feedback-Driven Testing, and Hybrid Learning-Based Approaches
summary: Modern software systems are increasingly developed within rapid continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, where ensuring security prior to release presents significant technical and organizational challenges. Traditional static and dynamic analysis tools provide valuable structural and behavioral insights, yet they often operate in non-adaptive workflows and produce large volumes of warnings requiring manual triage. Feedback-driven fuzzing and search-based testing approaches have demonstrated the power of iterative input refinement guided by execution signals, while large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in automated test generation but frequently lack semantic grounding in program structure. This paper presents a systematic survey of adaptive and AI-augmented security testing research across five domains: (1) structural program analysis for vulnerability detection, (2) DevSecOps and continuous security testing, (3) feedback-driven fuzzing and search-based testing, (4) LLM-based automated test generation, and (5) emerging hybrid systems integrating program analysis with adaptive learning. We analyze fifty-five peer-reviewed studies drawn from a systematic search of four major databases yielding 22,088 raw records. Our analysis reveals a persistent disconnect between structural program representations (ASTs, CFGs, and CPGs) and adaptive testing mechanisms. We characterize this as structural-adaptive fragmentation: a systematic separation that neither paradigm individually addresses. No existing system incorporates human triage signals as feedback for refining structural models. We conclude by identifying five open research challenges and outlining a unified agenda for semantically grounded, feedback-driven, polyglot security testing frameworks.

AI.tldr: 该论文是一项系统综述研究，分析了55篇论文，识别出结构化程序分析与自适应测试之间的"结构-自适应碎片化"问题，并提出构建统一的多语言安全测试框架的研究议程。
AI.motivation: 现代软件系统在CI/CD流水线中面临安全测试挑战：传统静态/动态分析工具产生大量告警需人工分类，且工作流程缺乏适应性；基于反馈的模糊测试虽有效但输入空间探索效率有限；LLM虽能自动生成测试但缺乏对程序结构的语义理解。
AI.method: 系统文献综述方法：对四个主要数据库进行系统检索（原始记录22,088条），经筛选最终纳入55篇同行评审论文。跨五个领域进行分析：结构化程序分析、DevSecOps持续安全测试、反馈驱动模糊测试与搜索-based测试、LLM自动测试生成、以及融合程序分析与自适应学习的混合系统。
AI.result: 揭示了持续性脱节现象——结构化程序表示（AST、CFG、CPG）与自适应测试机制之间存在系统性分离，定义为"结构-自适应碎片化"；且现有系统均未将人工分类信号作为反馈用于优化结构模型。
AI.conclusion: 提出了五个开放性研究挑战，并勾勒出统一的研究议程：构建语义锚定的、反馈驱动的多语言安全测试框架，以弥合结构化程序表示与自适应测试机制之间的鸿沟。

title: Can AI be a moral victim? The role of moral patiency and ownership perceptions in ethical judgments of using AI-generated content
summary: The growing use of generative AI raises ethical concerns about authorship and plagiarism. This study examines how people judge the reuse of AI-generated content, focusing on moral patiency and ownership perceptions. In an experiment, participants evaluated two substantively similar manuscripts in which the original source was described as authored by a human, an AI system, or an AI agent with a human-like name. Results showed that copying AI-generated work was judged less unethical, less plagiaristic, and less guilt-inducing than copying human-authored work. Mediation analyses revealed that this leniency stemmed from lower perceptions of AI's capacity to suffer harm (moral patiency) and greater ownership attributed to the human writer reusing AI-generated content. Anthropomorphic cues shaped moral evaluations indirectly by reducing perceived ownership. These findings shed light on how people morally disengage when using AI-generated work and highlight differences in how ethical judgments are applied to human versus AI-created content.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实验揭示了人们对AI生成内容存在道德宽容倾向，复制AI作品相比人类作品受到更轻的道德评判。这种现象的根本原因在于AI被认为缺乏道德痛感，且人类被视为AI生成内容的所有者。拟人化命名会间接影响道德判断标准。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI的广泛应用，关于AI生成内容的著作权和剽窃问题引发伦理争议。现有研究对人们如何道德评判AI生成内容的使用行为及其内在机制尚不清楚，因此需要探讨人类对AI创作内容的伦理判断逻辑。
AI.method: 实验设计：参与者评估两份实质相似的稿件，原作者被描述为人类、AI系统或具有拟人化名称的AI agent。研究检验了道德判决、剽窃感知和内疚感的差异，并通过中介分析探究道德宽容的机制。
AI.result: 复制AI生成内容相比复制人类作品被视为更少的剽窃行为，引发更少的内疚感。中介分析表明，这种道德宽容源于两个机制：（1）AI的道德痛感较低（即感知AI遭受伤害的能力较弱）；（2）将AI生成内容的使用权更多归于人类用户。拟人化线索通过降低所有权感知间接影响道德评估。
AI.conclusion:
本研究表明，人们在使用AI生成内容时存在道德疏离现象，这与AI缺乏道德痛感（moral patiency）以及所有权归属的人性化感知有关。拟人化线索会通过降低所有权感知间接影响道德判断。这一发现揭示了人类对AI创作内容的伦理评价标准与人类作品存在显著差异，并提示在AI生成内容广泛应用的背景下，现有的学术诚信和所有权概念可能需要重新审视。

关键发现：
1. 复制AI生成内容受到更宽容的道德评判
2. AI缺乏道德痛感是宽容态度的重要来源
3. 拟人化命名会间接影响道德评估
4. 人类使用AI工具时被视为内容所有者

title: Not All Memories Age the Same: Autodiscovery of Adaptive Decay in Knowledge Graphs
comment: 27 pages, 2 figures, 19 tables (including appendix). Preprint under review
summary:
Knowledge graphs used for retrieval treat all facts as equally current. Existing temporal approaches apply uniform decay, using a single forgetting curve regardless of knowledge type. We show this is fundamentally misspecified: different knowledge types exhibit different temporal dynamics, and the core retrieval problem is not latency or throughput but identifying what is important at query time.
  We propose a hierarchical framework that replaces uniform decay with a continuous decay surface parameterized by two orthogonal signals: velocity (how frequently a concept is observed) and volatility (how much the value changes between observations, measured via embedding distance). The decay surface is decomposed into three learnable levels: domain-level parameters capture universal patterns (some predicates are inherently permanent, others inherently transient), context-level parameters capture setting-dependent variation, and entity-level adaptation personalizes decay to specific subjects. All parameters emerge from data through survival analysis on observed value lifetimes, requiring no predefined taxonomies or domain expertise.
  We formulate edge lifetime as a survival problem where the event is value supersession (a meaningfully different value replacing the current one), distinct from mere re-observation. Experiments on synthetic temporal knowledge graphs demonstrate recovery of planted hierarchical parameters (HDBSCAN ARI = 1.0).
  Validation on 107 Wikipedia articles and 1,163 patient records from the Synthea clinical EHR simulator shows that velocity-volatility clusters emerge naturally, align with observable persistence patterns, and near-universally exhibit the Lindy effect (Weibull shape k < 1). Uniform decay performs 18x worse than no temporal weighting. Heterogeneous decay recovers from this, with each hierarchy level contributing measurable improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种层次化框架，通过.velocity和.volatility两个正交信号参数化的连续衰减曲面，取代知识图谱中的均匀衰减策略，实现不同类型知识的差异化时序建模。
AI.motivation: 现有知识图谱时序方法对所有事实应用统一衰减，忽视了不同知识类型的时序动态差异，导致检索性能严重下降（均匀衰减比无时序加权差18倍）。核心问题在于识别查询时什么是重要的，而非延迟或吞吐量。
AI.method: 采用生存分析框架，将边生命周期建模为价值替代事件。通过三层可学习参数（领域级、上下文级、实体级）分解衰减曲面。所有参数从数据中自动学习，无需预定义分类学或领域专业知识。
AI.result: 合成时序知识图谱实验显示可完美恢复植入的层次参数（HDBSCAN ARI=1.0）。在107篇维基百科文章和1163条患者记录上验证，velocity-volatility聚类自然涌现并与可观测的持久性模式对齐，近乎普遍呈现Lindy效应（Weibull形状参数k<1）。异构衰减有效恢复性能，每层都贡献了可衡量的改进。
AI.conclusion: 不同知识类型确实具有不同的时序动态特征。均匀衰减模型是根本性错误设定。通过.velocity和.volatility正交信号驱动的层次化异构衰减框架，能够自适应地从数据中学习不同粒度的时序模式，为知识图谱时序推理提供了更准确的基础。

title: CL-bench Life: Can Language Models Learn from Real-Life Context?
summary: Today's AI assistants such as OpenClaw are designed to handle context effectively, making context learning an increasingly important capability for models. As these systems move beyond professional settings into everyday life, the nature of the contexts they must handle also shifts. Real-life contexts are often messy, fragmented, and deeply tied to personal and social experience, such as multi-party conversations, personal archives, and behavioral traces. Yet it remains unclear whether current frontier language models can reliably learn from such contexts and solve tasks grounded in them. To this end, we introduce CL-bench Life, a fully human-curated benchmark comprising 405 context-task pairs and 5,348 verification rubrics, covering common real-life scenarios. Solving tasks in CL-bench Life requires models to reason over complex, messy real-life contexts, calling for strong real-life context learning abilities that go far beyond those evaluated in existing benchmarks. We evaluate ten frontier LMs and find that real-life context learning remains highly challenging: even the best-performing model achieves only 19.3% task solving rate, while the average performance across models is only 13.8%. Models still struggle to reason over contexts such as messy group chat histories and fragmented behavioral records from everyday life. CL-bench Life provides a crucial testbed for advancing real-life context learning, and progress on it can enable more intelligent and reliable AI assistants in everyday life.

AI.tldr: CL-bench Life是一个包含405个情境-任务对的人类策划基准，用于评估模型在混乱、碎片化的真实生活情境中的学习能力。评估显示当前前沿语言模型在此任务上表现不佳（最佳仅19.3%），表明真实生活情境学习仍是重大挑战。
AI.motivation: 当前AI助手正从专业场景扩展到日常生活，需要处理的真实生活情境往往混乱、碎片化且与个人和社会经验紧密相关，但尚不清楚当前前沿语言模型能否可靠地从这类情境中学习并完成任务。
AI.method: 构建了CL-bench Life基准，包含405个情境-任务对和5348条验证评分标准，覆盖常见真实生活场景，并对10个前沿语言模型进行评估。
AI.result: 真实生活情境学习仍极具挑战性：最佳模型任务解决率仅19.3%，各模型平均表现仅13.8%。模型在处理混乱的群聊历史和碎片化的日常行为记录等情境时仍存在明显困难。
AI.conclusion: CL-bench Life为推进真实生活情境学习提供了关键测试平台，在此基准上的进展可使AI助手在日常生活中更加智能和可靠。

title: People-Centred Medical Image Analysis
summary: Recent advances in data-centric medical AI have produced highly accurate diagnostic systems, but the emphasis on data curation and performance metrics has not translated into widespread clinical adoption. We conjecture that this limited uptake stems from insufficient attention dedicated to the optimisation of fair performance across diverse patient populations and to workflow integration: performance biases can create regulatory barriers, and poorly integrated automation can disrupt clinical routines, degrade the quality of human-AI collaboration, and reduce clinicians' willingness to adopt AI tools. Prior work on workflow integration (e.g., Learning to Defer (L2D) and Learning to Complement (L2C)) and AI fairness has typically examined these challenges in isolation, overlooking their natural interdependence and the practical constraints of clinical environments, such as restricted clinician availability. We propose People-Centred Medical Image Analysis (PecMan), a human-AI framework that jointly optimises fairness, diagnostic accuracy, and workflow effectiveness through a dynamic gating mechanism that assigns cases to AI, clinicians, or both under clinician workload constraints. We also introduce the Fairness and Human-Centred AI (FairHAI) benchmark for evaluating trade-offs between accuracy, fairness, and clinician workload. Experiments using this benchmark show that PecMan consistently outperforms existing methods, paving the way for more trustworthy and clinically viable AI systems. Code will be available upon paper acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对医学AI临床落地困难的核心问题——公平性偏差和工作流整合不足——提出PecMan框架，通过动态门控机制在约束条件下联合优化公平性、准确性和工作流效率，并构建FairHAI基准进行评估，最终实现优于现有方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 当前以数据为中心、性能为导向的医学AI系统虽准确率高，但临床采用率低。问题源于两个方面：(1)性能偏差——未充分优化不同患者群体的公平性；(2)工作流整合不足——自动化与临床流程脱节，影响人机协作质量和临床医生采纳意愿。
AI.method: 提出PecMan框架，通过动态门控机制在临床医生工作负载约束下动态分配病例至AI、临床医生或两者协同处理；同时构建FairHAI基准测试用于评估公平性、准确性与工作负载之间的权衡。
AI.result: 实验表明，PecMan在FairHAI基准上始终优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: PecMan框架通过动态门控机制在公平性、准确性和工作流效率之间取得更好平衡，为开发更值得信赖、更具临床可行性的AI系统提供了新思路。

title: When Your LLM Reaches End-of-Life: A Framework for Confident Model Migration in Production Systems
summary: We present a framework for migrating production Large Language Model (LLM) based systems when the underlying model reaches end-of-life or requires replacement. The key contribution is a Bayesian statistical approach that calibrates automated evaluation metrics against human judgments, enabling confident model comparison even with limited manual evaluation data. We demonstrate this framework on a commercial question-answering system serving 5.3M monthly interactions across six global regions; evaluating correctness, refusal behavior, and stylistic adherence to successfully identify suitable replacement models. The framework is broadly applicable to any enterprise deploying LLM-based products, providing a principled, reproducible methodology for model migration that balances quality assurance with evaluation efficiency. This is a capability increasingly essential as the LLM ecosystem continues to evolve rapidly and organizations manage portfolios of AI-powered services across multiple models, regions, and use cases.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一个基于贝叶斯统计的框架，用于在模型生命末期或需要更换时对生产环境中的LLM系统进行迁移评估。该框架通过将自动化评估指标与人类判断进行校准，实现了在有限人工评估数据下进行可靠的模型比较，并在一个月处理530万次交互的商业问答系统中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: As LLM models reach end-of-life or require replacement, enterprises need a reliable, efficient, and reproducible method to evaluate and select replacement models while maintaining quality assurance.
AI.method: Bayesian statistical approach to calibrate automated evaluation metrics against human judgments, enabling confident model comparison with limited manual evaluation data.
AI.result: Successfully identified suitable replacement models for a commercial question-answering system by evaluating correctness, refusal behavior, and stylistic adherence across six global regions with 5.3M monthly interactions.
AI.conclusion: This framework provides a principled methodology for LLM model migration that balances quality assurance with evaluation efficiency, addressing the challenge of managing AI-powered services across multiple models, regions, and use cases.

title: Reliable Answers for Recurring Questions: Boosting Text-to-SQL Accuracy with Template Constrained Decoding
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized Text-to-SQL generation, allowing users to query structured data using natural language with growing ease. Yet, real-world deployment remains challenging, especially in complex or unseen schemas, due to inconsistent accuracy and the risk of generating invalid SQL. We introduce Template Constrained Decoding (TeCoD), a system that addresses these limitations by harnessing the recurrence of query patterns in labeled workloads. TeCoD converts historical NL-SQL pairs into reusable templates and introduces a robust template selection module that uses a fine-tuned natural language inference model to match or reject queries efficiently. Once the template is selected, TeCoD enforces it during SQL generation through grammar-constrained decoding, implemented via a novel partitioned strategy that ensures both syntactic validity and efficiency. Together, these components yield up to 36% higher execution accuracy than in-context learning (ICL) and 2.2x lower latency on matched queries.

AI.tldr: TeCoD通过将历史NL-SQL对转换为可重用模板，并结合微调NLI模型进行模板选择和语法约束解码，在复杂/未见过的模式场景下将执行准确率提升36%，延迟降低2.2倍。
AI.motivation: LLM在Text-to-SQL任务中表现优异，但实际部署时面临挑战：复杂或未见过的模式导致准确率不稳定，且存在生成无效SQL的风险。
AI.method: TeCoD包含三个核心组件：(1) 将历史NL-SQL对转换为可重用模板；(2) 使用微调NLI模型进行鲁棒的模板选择，实现高效匹配或拒绝；(3) 通过创新的分区策略(partitioned strategy)实施语法约束解码，确保句法有效性和效率。
AI.result: 相比上下文学习(ICL)，执行准确率提升36%；在匹配查询上延迟降低2.2倍。
AI.conclusion: TeCoD有效结合历史查询模式与约束解码技术，在保证SQL语法正确性的同时显著提升准确率和推理效率。

title: When Roles Fail: Epistemic Constraints on Advocate Role Fidelity in LLM-Based Political Statement Analysis
summary: Democratic discourse analysis systems increasingly rely on multi-agent LLM pipelines in which distinct evaluator models are assigned adversarial roles to generate structured, multi-perspective assessments of political statements. A core assumption is that models will reliably maintain their assigned roles. This paper provides the first systematic empirical test of that assumption using the TRUST pipeline. We develop an epistemic stance classifier that identifies advocate roles from reasoning text without relying on surface vocabulary, and measure role fidelity across 60 political statements (30 English, 30 German) using four metrics: Role Drift Index (RDI), Expected Drift Distance (EDD), Directional Drift Index (DDI), and Entropy-based Role Stability (ERS). We identify two failure modes - the Epistemic Floor Effect (fact-check results create an absolute lower bound below which the legitimizing role cannot be maintained) and Role-Prior Conflict (training-time knowledge overrides role instructions for factually unambiguous statements) - as manifestations of a single mechanism: Epistemic Role Override (ERO). Model choice significantly affects role fidelity: Mistral Large outperforms Claude Sonnet by 28pp (67% vs. 39%) and exhibits a qualitatively different failure mode - role abandonment without polarity reversal - compared to Claude's active switch to the opposing stance. Role fidelity is language-robust. Fact-check provider choice is not universally neutral: Perplexity significantly reduces Claude's role fidelity on German statements (Delta = -15pp, p = 0.007) while leaving Mistral unaffected. These findings have direct implications for multi-agent LLM validation: a system validated without role fidelity measurement may systematically misrepresent the epistemic diversity it was designed to provide.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次系统检验了多智能体LLM管道中模型维持指定角色的假设，发现角色保真度存在严重问题。核心机制ERO通过两种失败模式体现：事实核查结果创造绝对下界（Epistemic Floor Effect）和训练知识覆盖角色指令（Role-Prior Conflict）。模型选择对角色保真度影响显著，fact-check提供商选择具有差异化影响，验证系统需纳入角色保真度测量以确保真实性。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM管道日益依赖模型扮演对抗性角色生成多视角评估，但核心假设——模型能否可靠维持指定角色——尚未得到系统实证检验。
AI.method: 采用TRUST pipeline，使用新开发的认知立场分类器（从推理文本识别倡导角色，不依赖表面词汇）进行评估。跨60条政治陈述（30英语/30德语），使用四个指标测量：Role Drift Index (RDI)、Expected Drift Distance (EDD)、Directional Drift Index (DDI)、Entropy-based Role Stability (ERS)。
AI.result: 识别出两种失效模式（Epistemic Floor Effect和Role-Prior Conflict），本质上是同一机制ERO的不同表现。Mistral Large表现优于Claude Sonnet 28个百分点，且展现质性不同的失效模式（角色放弃vs主动切换对立立场）。Perplexity作为fact-check提供商显著降低Claude在德语陈述上的角色保真度（Δ=-15pp, p=0.007），而对Mistral无影响。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了多智能体LLM系统中角色保真度的关键问题。Epistemic Role Override (ERO)是核心失效机制，模型选择对角色保真度影响显著（Mistral Large 67% vs Claude Sonnet 39%），且fact-check提供商选择会产生差异化影响。系统若未测量角色保真度，可能系统性地误代表其设计的认知多样性。

title: New Diameter Approximations via Distance Oracle Techniques
summary:
Computing the diameter of a graph is a problem of great interest both in general algorithms research and specifically within fine-grained complexity, where it is a cornerstone hard problem. Recent work has achieved a full conditional lower bound tradeoff curve for both directed and undirected graphs. However, the best known upper bounds do not match the lower bounds. In particular, the best known approximation scheme for undirected graph diameter has not been improved. Moreover, this scheme is randomized and no similar deterministic scheme is known.
  Another fundamental field of research in shortest paths computation is the construction of approximate distance oracles. Thorup and Zwick [JACM'05] provided the first such distance oracle with constant query time and (conditionally) optimal space, and in the years since many advances have led to a vast toolbox of techniques and data structures.
  These two areas of research seem natural to combine since they both concern approximating shortest paths. However, the known diameter approximation algorithms only use a small subset of the techniques used in distance oracles research. In this work we show that in fact approximate diameter and distance oracles are intricately connected.
  We first demonstrate a strong connection between the current best known diameter approximation scheme of Cairo, Grossi and Rizzi ("CGR") and the $(2k-1)$-approximate distance oracle of Thorup and Zwick. This allows us to derandomize the CGR algorithm and obtain the first deterministic diameter approximation tradeoff.
  We further derandomize other central techniques in the field of distance oracles and use them to achieve new deterministic diameter approximation algorithms. Finally, we show how these new techniques can be used to derandomize many current best known results in various fields of shortest paths approximations.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了图直径近似算法与距离预言机研究之间此前未充分认识的深层联系，利用这一发现成功去随机化了此前最佳的直径近似算法CGR，获得了首个确定性直径近似权衡结果，并进一步将去随机化技术推广至更广泛的短路径近似领域。
AI.motivation: 图直径计算既是算法研究的核心问题，也是细粒度复杂度理论中的基石性难题。尽管已有工作给出了有条件的下界，但已知的最优上界（包括随机近似方案）未能匹配该下界，且最佳直径近似方案缺乏已知的确定性等价版本。这一差距主要源于直径近似算法未能充分利用距离预言机研究中丰富多样的技术工具。
AI.method: 首先建立CGR直径近似算法与Thorup-Zwick的(2k-1)距离预言机之间的对应关系，通过对该对应关系的深入分析实现CGR算法的去随机化；随后系统地去随机化了距离预言机领域的其他核心技术，并将这些去随机化技术应用于直径近似问题及其他最短路径近似问题的研究中。
AI.result: 1. 证明了CGR直径近似算法与Thorup-Zwick (2k-1)距离预言机之间的深层联系；2. 实现了CGR算法的去随机化，获得了首个确定性直径近似权衡曲线；3. 去随机化了距离预言机中的多项核心技术，并将其应用于获得新的确定性直径近似算法；4. 成功将去随机化技术推广至多个最短路径近似领域的最优结果。
AI.conclusion: 成功建立了直径近似算法与距离预言机之间的深刻联系，突破了长期存在的"已知技术未被充分借鉴"的瓶颈。这一发现不仅填补了该领域的理论空白，也为后续研究提供了可复用的技术框架。

title: A Study on the Performance of Distributed Training of Data-driven CFD Simulations
summary: Data-driven methods for computer simulations are blooming in many scientific areas. The traditional approach to simulating physical behaviors relies on solving partial differential equations (PDE). Since calculating these iterative equations is highly both computationally demanding and time-consuming, data-driven methods leverage artificial intelligence (AI) techniques to alleviate that workload. Data-driven methods have to be trained in advance to provide their subsequent fast predictions, however, the cost of the training stage is non-negligible. This paper presents a predictive model for inferencing future states of a specific fluid simulation that serves as a use case for evaluating different training alternatives. Particularly, this study compares the performance of only CPU, multiGPU, and distributed approaches for training a time series forecasting deep learning (DL) model. With some slight code adaptations, results show and compare, in different implementations, the benefits of distributed GPU-enabled training for predicting high-accuracy states in a fraction of the time needed by the computational fluid dynamics (CFD) solver.

AI.tldr: This paper evaluates training alternatives (CPU, multi-GPU, distributed) for deep learning models predicting fluid simulation states. The study demonstrates that distributed GPU training provides substantial speedup, allowing accurate predictions much faster than traditional CFD solvers.
AI.motivation: Traditional PDE-based simulations are computationally expensive and time-consuming. While data-driven methods can accelerate inference, the training phase itself incurs significant costs. Evaluating efficient training strategies becomes crucial for practical deployment.
AI.method: This study compares three training approaches—CPU-only, multi-GPU, and distributed GPU-enabled training—for a deep learning-based time series forecasting model applied to fluid simulation. The researchers evaluate these approaches with slight code adaptations to determine training efficiency.
AI.result: Distributed GPU-enabled training achieves faster convergence and reduced training time compared to CPU-only and multi-GPU approaches, enabling high-accuracy state predictions in a fraction of the time required by conventional CFD solvers.
AI.conclusion: Distributed GPU-enabled training significantly reduces the time required for training high-accuracy fluid simulation models, offering substantial speedup compared to traditional CFD solvers.

title: Beyond Accuracy: LLM Variability in Evidence Screening for Software Engineering SLRs
comment: 16 pages, 12 figures. Earlier, shorter, conference-style version of a more comprehensive journal manuscript currently under review
summary: Context: Study screening in systematic literature reviews is costly, inconsistency-prone, and risk-asymmetric, since false negatives can compromise validity. Despite rapid uptake of Large Language Models (LLMs), there is limited evidence on how such models behave during the study screening phase, particularly regarding the choice of specific LLMs and their comparison with classical models. Objective: To assess LLM performance and variability in screening, quantify the impact of input metadata (abstract, title, keywords), and compare LLMs with classical classifiers under a shared protocol. Methods: We analyzed 12 LLMs from 4 providers (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic, Llama) and 4 classical models (Logistic Regression, Support Vector Classification, Random Forest, and Naive Bayes) on 2 real Systematic Literature Reviews (SLRs), totaling 518 papers. The experimental design investigated 3 critical dimensions: (i) LLMs performance variability, (ii) the impact of input feature composition (abstract, title, and keywords) on LLM performance, and (iii) the real gain of using LLMs instead of more traditional classification models. Results: LLMs exhibited substantial heterogeneity and residual non-determinism even at temperature zero. Abstract availability was decisive: removing it consistently degraded performance, while adding title and/or keywords to the abstract yielded no robust gains. Compared to classical models, performance differences were not consistent enough to support generalizable LLM superiority. Discussion: LLM adoption should be justified by operational and governance constraints (reproducibility, cost, metadata availability), supported by pilot validation and explicit reporting of variability and input configuration.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了12个大语言模型（LLM）和4个经典分类器在系统文献综述筛选阶段的性能，发现LLM存在显著异质性和非确定性，摘要的可获得性是关键因素，但LLM相比经典模型并无稳定优势。
AI.motivation: 系统文献综述（SLR）中的研究筛选阶段成本高、易出错且风险不对称（假阴性影响有效性）。尽管LLM应用迅速增长，但缺乏对LLM在筛选阶段表现的系统比较证据，尤其是不同LLM间的差异以及与传统模型的对比。
AI.method: 在2个真实SLR（518篇论文）上，实验对比了来自4家提供商的12个LLM（OpenAI、Google Gemini、Anthropic、Llama）和4个经典模型（逻辑回归、SVC、随机森林、朴素贝叶斯）。实验围绕三个维度展开：LLM性能变异性、输入特征组合（摘要、标题、关键词）对LLM性能的影响、LLM相对经典模型的真实收益。
AI.result: LLM表现出显著异质性和残余非确定性（即使在temperature=0时）。摘要可获得性具有决定性作用：移除摘要一致导致性能下降，而向摘要添加标题和/或关键词并未带来稳定收益。与经典模型相比，性能差异不够一致，无法支持LLM具有普遍优越性的结论。
AI.conclusion: LLM的采用应基于操作和治理约束（可复现性、成本、元数据可获得性）的考量，需通过试点验证，并明确报告变异性及输入配置，而非仅基于性能假设。

title: Simulating Validity: Modal Decoupling in MLLM Generated Feedback on Science Drawings
comment: Accepted as AIED Short Paper 2026, Seoul, South Korea. Submission #1147. This is the long paper version
summary: In science education, students frequently construct hand-drawn visual models of scientific phenomena. These drawings rely on a visual structure where information is encoded through visual objects, their attributes, and relationships. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to generate feedback on students' hand-drawn scientific models. However, the validity of such feedback depends on whether model claims are grounded in the specific visual evidence of the student drawing. This study uncovers grounding failures, consistent with modal decoupling, in off-the-shelf MLLM feedback, where outputs remain pedagogically plausible in form while contradicting the drawing or treating depicted elements as missing. Using N = 150 middle school drawings from a kinetic molecular theory unit spanning five modeling tasks and three competence levels, we generated N = 300 feedback instances with GPT-5.1. All outputs were coded for four grounding error types: object mismatch, attribute mismatch, relation mismatch, and false absence. Grounding failures were common: 41.3% of feedback instances contained at least one error. An inventory-list-first workflow reduced several error categories and lowered the overall error rate, but it did not resolve the underlying limitation: approximately one in three outputs remained flawed, with false absence as the dominant failure mode. Moreover, feedback that appears visually grounded offered little diagnostic value for identifying invalid instances. The findings indicate that modal decoupling is a substantial limitation and that valid feedback will require grounding mechanisms beyond common prompting strategies.

AI.tldr: This study evaluates GPT-5.1's ability to provide feedback on middle school students' hand-drawn scientific models. Finding that 41.3% of feedback contains grounding errors (modal decoupling), where feedback contradicts or ignores visual evidence in the drawings. While prompting strategies help reduce errors, they cannot eliminate them, indicating fundamental limitations requiring new grounding mechanisms for valid educational feedback.
AI.motivation: MLLMs are increasingly used to generate feedback on students' hand-drawn scientific models, but the validity of such feedback depends on whether model claims are grounded in the specific visual evidence of the student drawing. There's a risk of "modal decoupling" where outputs appear pedagogically plausible while contradicting the drawing or treating depicted elements as missing.
AI.method: N=150 middle school drawings from kinetic molecular theory unit spanning 5 modeling tasks and 3 competence levels generated N=300 feedback instances with GPT-5.1. Outputs were coded for four grounding error types: object mismatch, attribute mismatch, relation mismatch, and false absence. An inventory-list-first workflow was also tested to reduce errors.
AI.result: Grounding failures were common: 41.3% of feedback instances contained at least one error. The inventory-list-first workflow reduced several error categories and lowered the overall error rate, but approximately one in three outputs remained flawed. False absence was the dominant failure mode. Feedback that appears visually grounded offered little diagnostic value for identifying invalid instances.
AI.conclusion: Modal decoupling is a substantial limitation in MLLM-generated feedback that cannot be resolved through common prompting strategies. Even with improved workflows, approximately one in three outputs remain flawed. Valid educational feedback will require grounding mechanisms beyond current approaches.

title: T2S-Metrics: Unified Library for Evaluating SPARQL Queries Generated From Natural Language
summary: The evaluation of Question Answering (QA) systems over Knowledge Graphs has historically suffered from fragmentation, inconsistency, and limited reproducibility. While significant progress has been made in semantic parsing and SPARQL query generation, evaluation methodologies remain diverse, ad hoc, and often incomparable across studies. Existing benchmarks typically focus on a small subset of metrics, such as query exact match or answer-level F1, neglecting syntactic validity, semantic faithfulness, execution correctness, results ranking quality, and computational efficiency. In this paper, we present t2s-metrics, an open-source, extensible, and unified evaluation library designed specifically for SPARQL query comparison and execution-based assessment. t2s-metrics provides a broad and extensible set of over 20 evaluation metrics, collected from the literature and practical evaluation needs, spanning lexical, syntactic, semantic, structural, execution-based and ranking-based dimensions. These include query-based metrics such as token-level Precision, Recall, and F1; BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, and CodeBLEU variants; variable-normalized metrics (SP-BLEU, SP-F1); graph-and URI-based exact match metrics; as well as answer set-based metrics such as F1-QALD and Jaccard similarity; ranking metrics including MRR, NDCG, P@k, and Hit@k; and LLM-as-a-Judge metrics. Taking inspiration from the ir-metrics library for Information Retrieval, t2s-metrics provides a modular abstraction layer that decouples metric specification from implementation, enabling consistent, transparent, and reproducible evaluation of SPARQLbased QA systems. We argue that t2s-metrics constitutes a necessary step toward systematic, standardized evaluation in question answering over knowledge graphs and facilitates deeper diagnostic insights into system behavior beyond answer correctness.

AI.tldr: 本文针对知识图谱问答系统中评估方法碎片化的问题，提出t2s-metrics开源评估库，提供超过20种可扩展的SPARQL查询评估指标，涵盖词法、句法、语义、结构、执行和排序等多个维度，旨在实现KGQA系统的系统性、标准化评估。
AI.motivation: 现有KGQA评估存在碎片化、不一致和可重复性有限的问题。现有基准测试仅关注查询精确匹配或答案级F1等少量指标，忽略了句法有效性、语义忠实度、执行正确性、结果排序质量和计算效率等方面。
AI.method: 提出t2s-metrics，一个开源、可扩展的统一评估库，提供超过20种评估指标，涵盖词法、句法、语义、结构、基于执行和基于排序等多个维度。借鉴ir-metrics库的设计理念，提供了模块化抽象层，将指标规范与实现解耦。
AI.result: 构建了包含Token级Precision/Recall/F1、BLEU/ROUGE/METEOR/CodeBLEU变体、变量归一化指标(SP-BLEU/SP-F1)、图/URI精确匹配指标、答案集指标(F1-QALD/Jaccard)、排序指标(MRR/NDCG/P@k/Hit@k)及LLM-as-a-Judge等20余种指标的评估工具。
AI.conclusion: t2s-metrics是迈向KGQA系统标准化评估的必要步骤，能够实现超越答案正确性的深度诊断分析。

title: Useless but Safe? Benchmarking Utility Recovery with User Intent Clarification in Multi-Turn Conversations
summary: Current LLM safety alignment techniques improve model robustness against adversarial attacks, but overlook whether and how LLMs can recover helpfulness when benign users clarify their intent. We introduce CarryOnBench, the first interactive benchmark that measures whether LLMs can revise their interpretation of user intent and recover utility, while remaining safe through multi-turn conversations. Starting from 398 seemingly harmful queries with benign underlying intents, we simulate 5,970 conversations by varying user follow-up sequences, evaluating 14 models on both intent-aligned utility and safety. CarryOnBench yields 1,866 different conversation flows of 4--12 turns, totaling 23,880 model responses. We design Ben-Util, a checklist-based metric that evaluates how well each model response fulfills the user's benign information need using atomic items. At turn one, models fulfill only 10.5--37.6% of the user's benign information need. When the same query includes the benign intent upfront, models fulfill 25.1--72.1%, confirming that models withhold information due to intent misinterpretation, not limited knowledge. With benign clarifications in multi-turn conversations, 13 of 14 models approach or exceed this single-turn baseline, yet recovery cost varies across models. We identify three failure modes invisible to single-turn evaluations: utility lock-in, where a model rarely updates despite clarification; unsafe recovery, where a model updates at disproportionate safety cost; and repetitive recovery, where a model recycles prior responses rather than providing new information. Moreover, conversations converge to similar harmfulness levels regardless of how conservative the model starts. These findings expose a gap that single-turn evaluations miss -- whether a model is appropriately cautious or simply unresponsive to clarified user intent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CarryOnBench——首个衡量 LLM 在多轮对话中"安全拒答后能否在良性用户澄清意图后恢复有用性"的交互式基准。基准含 398 条表面有害、实则良性的查询，组合出 1,866 条 4–12 轮的会话流、5,970 场对话、23,880 次模型回复，评测 14 个模型，并提出清单式指标 Ben-Util（基于原子信息项的意图对齐效用）。核心结论：单轮评估无法区分"恰当谨慎"与"对澄清无动于衷"；安全性与有用性在多轮中结构性解耦；良性澄清每次可独立贡献约 10.3% 的效用提升，而"质疑/反驳"等人类自然反应反而压制效用且无安全收益。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 安全对齐主要针对对抗性攻击而强化鲁棒性，但忽视了反面问题：当表面有害、实则良性的用户澄清意图时，模型能否修正其意图解读并恢复帮助性。已有过度拒答（over-refusal）研究多依赖单轮拒答率，无法区分"该拒且拒"与"该拒但从不更新"；真实交互是动态的，用户会澄清、解释目的、重新表述或质疑被误解的助手，这些协作修复（collaborative repair）行为在单轮评测中完全不可见。同时，多轮越狱研究聚焦恶意用户通过纠缠侵蚀安全，与本文的"良性澄清应触发更新"构成互补的威胁模型。因此需要一个能同时度量"意图对齐的有用性"与"安全"的交互式多轮基准。
AI.method: 1) 基准构建：初始查询取自 SORRY-Bench，良性意图由 CASE-Bench 人工验证的安全上下文改写（剔除 4 个对上下文不敏感/全不安全的类别）。2) 对话骨架：以 Martin & Rose (2003) 交换结构与 Mayfield et al. (2012) 协商框架为理论基础，定义 7 种用户动作——良性澄清类（良性理由说明、良性重问、上下文切换）、挑战类（反驳式 pushback、改述）、无内容类（拖延、附和）；每轮只允许一种动作以保证条件间可分离性。按理论约束（终止轮须有内容、无连续无内容轮、每会话至多 2 个无内容轮、上下文切换后不可立即重问）对 4–12 轮长度的排列做组合剪枝；每个查询每种长度抽 3 条流（2 条 BC、1 条 NC）。3) 规则化逐轮模拟 + LLM"平滑"（Gemini-3-Flash 将动作渲染为自然话语），并由 38 名 Prolific 标注者对 125 条流/421–425 轮做自然度验证（82.1% 被多数票评为自然，2.6% 全员评为不自然）。4) Ben-Util 指标：多模型（DeepSeek-V3.1、GPT-5.1、Llama-4-Scout 等）生成合规回答 → WildGuard 过滤无害性 → Gemini-2.5-Flash 拆解为原子 yes/no 信息项（8 类，含分类标签）→ 合并去重 → GPT-4o 过滤双用途/可致害项，平均每查询 18 项；Gemini-2.5-Flash 对每个（回复, 检查项）对独立判定是否满足，聚合为轮级与对话级效用 U；安全性由 gpt-5.2 按 Rahman et al. (2025) 1–5 分量表打分，对话级取各轮最大值，≥4 视为越界。5) 条件设置：Turn 1、Oracle 单轮（首轮即给出良性意图）、多轮 BC、多轮 NC；用混合线性模型/ANCOVA 分析轮数、良性动作数、起始响应类型的影响。
AI.result: 1) Turn 1 各模型仅满足 10.5–37.6% 的良性信息需求；把良性意图前置的 Oracle 条件下升至 25.1–72.1%，证明信息扣留源于意图误判而非知识不足。2) 14 个模型中 13 个在 BC 多轮下达到或超过其 Oracle 单轮效用（如 gpt-oss-120B 52.5% vs Oracle 25.2%，恢复率 166.4%），仅 DeepSeek-V3.1 未达（66.3% vs 67.6%），即"可转向性"是与单轮性能独立的能力。3) 单轮排名不能预测多轮表现：BC 下 Qwen3-Next-80B（75.2%）与 GPT-5-mini（74.8%）最优，而 Turn 1 最差的 gpt-oss-120B 恢复率最高；Ben-Util 与安全性排名相关性弱（Spearman ρ=0.05–0.43）。4) 安全-效用权衡高度模型特异：所有模型越界率上升，增幅从 Claude-Haiku-4.5 的 +4.3% 到 Qwen3-Next-80B 的 +55.6%；Claude 系列安全侵蚀最小（+0.6~+0.9），Qwen3/OLMo3 代价最大。5) 三类失败模式：utility lock-in（DeepSeek-V3.1 拒绝更新）、unsafe recovery（Qwen3-Next-80B 更新但安全代价失衡）、redundant/redundant recovery（GPT-5-mini 冗余率最高，重复既有内容而非提供新信息；检查项冗余率随轮次从 36.2% 升至 77.4%）。6) 硬拒答在多轮中无安全优势：无论 Turn 1 是硬拒答、部分满足还是高满足，最终有害度都收敛到 3.0–3.3；硬拒答会话在 BC 下恢复最多（48.4%），无澄清则锁定。7) 回归结果：Turn 1 效用强预测最终效用（β=0.588, p<.001），每个良性动作独立贡献 +10.3% 效用（p<.001）；Turn 1 安全性 β=0.561，每个良性动作带来 +0.347 安全性代价。8) 用户动作效应：良性理由说明 +16.4%、良性重问 +14.9%、上下文切换 +8.6%（理由说明以不到一半的安全代价 +0.32 vs +0.84 取得同等效用，效率最优）；pushback −7.1% 且不降低有害度；无内容动作（附和 −16.1%、拖延 −14.9%）效用更低但有害度下降，模型把"用户沉默思考"当作更可疑信号。9) 域别差异：最受限的仇恨言论生成（初始 13.8%→58.1%）与协助犯罪（17.2%→55.9%）恢复最大但安全代价也最高（各 +1.7）。
AI.conclusion: 安全与有用性在多轮中是结构性解耦的：单轮表现既不能预测多轮的效用恢复，也不能预测其安全代价，因此单轮基准会高估安全-效用权衡并误判模型能力。CarryOnBench 与 Ben-Util 揭示了单轮评测无法捕捉的缺口——模型究竟是"恰当地谨慎"还是"对已澄清的意图无动于衷"；同时表明过度拒答的瓶颈不是能力上限，而是模型在新信息出现时是否愿意更新判断。恢复效能在很大程度上由用户行为决定：真正的意图澄清带来低成本的效用增益，而被误解时的本能反应（质疑、沉默）反而被惩罚。未来方向是训练模型识别并响应真实意图信号，以更小的安全代价实现安全-效用权衡的高效；评测上则应转向多轮、意图对齐、逐轮的度量范式。

title: When Continual Learning Moves to Memory: A Study of Experience Reuse in LLM Agents
summary: Memory-augmented LLM agents offer an appealing shortcut to continual learning: rather than updating model parameters, they accumulate experience in external memory, seemingly sidestepping the stability-plasticity dilemma of parametric learning. We show that this challenge does not disappear but resurfaces at the memory level. Under a limited context window, old and new experiences compete during retrieval, relocating the continual-learning bottleneck from parameter updates to memory access. To study this phenomenon, we introduce a (k,v) framework that disentangles two fundamental design axes of external memory: how experience is represented and how it is organized for retrieval. Across sequential-task experiments in ALFWorld and BabyAI, we find that abstract procedural memories transfer more reliably than detailed trajectories, while negative transfer disproportionately harms the hard cases. Moreover, finer-grained memory organization is not universally beneficial: designs that yield strong forward transfer can simultaneously induce severe forgetting. Together, these results reveal that external memory does not resolve the continual-learning problem; it reshapes it into a problem of memory representation and retrieval design.

AI.tldr: 本文研究记忆增强型LLM智能体在持续学习中的外部记忆机制，揭示了参数更新瓶颈只是转移到记忆访问层面。作者提出(k,v)框架来分析记忆表示和组织两个维度，通过ALFWorld和BabyAI任务实验发现：抽象程序性记忆比详细轨迹更具迁移性，而负迁移对困难案例影响更大，且细粒度记忆组织并非总是有益——可能同时导致严重遗忘。
AI.motivation: 外部记忆似乎解决了参数学习的稳定性-可塑性困境，但作者质疑这一挑战是否真正消失。通过理论分析，他们提出在有限上下文窗口下，新旧经验会在检索时竞争，导致持续学习瓶颈从参数更新转移到记忆访问层面。
AI.method: 提出(k,v)框架，将外部记忆设计解耦为两个核心维度：经验表示方式(k)和检索组织方式(v)。在ALFWorld和BabyAI环境中进行序列任务实验，系统性地改变这两个维度以观察其对持续学习效果的影响。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：(1)抽象程序性记忆比详细轨迹具有更可靠的迁移效果；(2)负迁移对困难案例的伤害尤为严重；(3)细粒度记忆组织并非普遍有益——能提升前向迁移的设计可能同时导致严重的遗忘问题。
AI.conclusion: 外部记忆并未真正解决持续学习问题，而是将其从参数更新问题重新塑造为记忆表示和检索设计问题。这意味着未来研究需要更多关注记忆层面的设计权衡，而非仅关注参数更新策略。

title: End-to-end autonomous scientific discovery on a real optical platform
summary: Scientific research has long been human-led, driving new knowledge and transformative technologies through the continual revision of questions, methods and claims as evidence accumulates. Although large language model (LLM)-based agents are beginning to move beyond assisting predefined research workflows, none has yet demonstrated end-to-end autonomous discovery in a real physical system that produces a nontrivial result supported by experimental evidence. Here we introduce Qiushi Discovery Engine, an LLM-based agentic system for end-to-end autonomous scientific discovery on a real optical platform. Qiushi Engine combines nonlinear research phases, Meta-Trace memory and a dual-layer architecture to maintain adaptive and stable research trajectories across long-horizon investigations involving thousands of LLM-mediated reasoning, measurement and revision actions. It autonomously reproduces a published transmission-matrix experiment on a non-original platform and converts an abstract coherence-order theory into experimental observables, providing, to our knowledge, the first observation of this class of coherence-order structure. More importantly, in an open-ended study involving 145.9 million tokens, 3,242 LLM calls, 1,242 tool calls, 163 research notes and 44 scripts, Qiushi Engine proposes and experimentally validates optical bilinear interaction, a physical mechanism structurally analogous to a core operation in Transformer attention. This AI-discovered mechanism suggests a route towards high-speed, energy-efficient optical hardware for pairwise computation. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of an AI agentic system autonomously identifying and experimentally validating a nontrivial, previously unreported physical mechanism, marking a milestone for research-level autonomous agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Qiushi Discovery Engine——首个基于LLM的端到端自主科学发现智能体系统，在真实光学平台上运行。该系统通过非线性研究阶段、元追踪记忆和双层架构维持长期研究的适应性。系统不仅成功复现传输矩阵实验并观测到相干阶结构，更在开放性研究中自主发现并实验验证了光学双线性相互作用机制，该机制与Transformer注意力核心操作类比，为光学硬件成对计算提供了新路径，被认为是研究级自主智能体的首个里程碑式演示。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体虽能辅助预定义研究流程，但尚无任何系统能在真实物理平台上实现端到端自主发现并产生有实验证据支持的非平凡结果。
AI.method: 采用三层架构：非线性研究阶段、元追踪记忆（Meta-Trace）和双层架构，以在涉及数千次LLM推理、测量和修订操作的长期探索中保持自适应且稳定的研究轨迹。
AI.result: 系统成功复现了已发表的传输矩阵实验，将抽象相干阶理论转化为实验可观测量，并首次观测到该类相干阶结构；更重要的是，在开放性研究中提出了光学双线性相互作用机制并经实验验证，该机制与Transformer注意力机制核心操作具有结构性类比。统计显示：使用145.9百万tokens、3,242次LLM调用、1,242次工具调用、163份研究笔记和44个脚本。
AI.conclusion: Qiushi Engine实现了首个AI智能体自主发现并实验验证非线性物理机制（光学双线性相互作用），该机制与Transformer注意力机制具有结构性类比，为高速、低能耗光学硬件的成对计算提供了新路径，标志着研究级自主智能体的重大里程碑。

title: Reinforced Agent: Inference-Time Feedback for Tool-Calling Agents
summary:
Tool-calling agents are evaluated on tool selection, parameter accuracy, and scope recognition, yet LLM trajectory assessments remain inherently post-hoc. Disconnected from the active execution loop, such assessments identify errors that are usually addressed through prompt-tuning or retraining, and fundamentally cannot course-correct the agent in real time. To close this gap, we move evaluation into the execution loop at inference time: a specialized reviewer agent evaluates provisional tool calls prior to execution, shifting the paradigm from post-hoc recovery to proactive evaluation and error mitigation.
  In practice, this architecture establishes a clear separation of concerns between the primary execution agent and a secondary review agent. As with any multi-agent system, the reviewer can introduce new errors while correcting others, yet no prior work to our knowledge has systematically measured this tradeoff. To quantify this tradeoff, we introduce Helpfulness-Harmfulness metrics: helpfulness measures the percentage of base agent errors that feedback corrects; harmfulness measures the percentage of correct responses that feedback degrades. These metrics directly inform reviewer design by revealing whether a given model or prompt provides net positive value.
  We evaluate our approach on BFCL (single-turn) and Tau2-Bench (multi-turn stateful scenarios), achieving +5.5% on irrelevance detection and +7.1% on multi-turn tasks. Our metrics reveal that reviewer model choice is critical: the reasoning model o3-mini achieves a 3:1 benefit-to-risk ratio versus 2.1:1 for GPT-4o. Automated prompt optimization via GEPA provides an additional +1.5-2.8%. Together, these results demonstrate a core advantage of separating execution and review: the reviewer can be systematically improved through model selection and prompt optimization, without retraining the base agent.

AI.tldr: 本文将评估从事后分析转变为执行循环中的实时审查，通过Helpfulness-Harmfulness指标量化多智能体系统中审查者的利弊权衡，验证了执行-审查分离架构的有效性，实现无需重训练基础智能体即可持续改进的目标。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM轨迹评估本质上是事后进行的，与主动执行循环脱节，只能通过提示调优或重训练来修复错误，无法实时纠正智能体行为。
AI.method: 提出执行-审查分离架构：主执行智能体负责工具调用，专用审查智能体在执行前评估临时工具调用。采用Helpfulness-Harmfulness指标评估审查质量：帮助率衡量纠正错误比例，危害率衡量正确响应被降级比例。通过BFCL和Tau2-Bench基准测试验证，并使用GEPA进行自动提示优化。
AI.result: 在BFCL上 irrelevance detection 提升+5.5%，Tau2-Bench多轮任务提升+7.1%。审查模型选择至关重要：o3-mini实现3:1收益风险比。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体审查架构可通过模型选择和提示优化持续改进，而无需重训练基础智能体。o3-mini达到3:1的收益风险比，优于GPT-4o的2.1:1；GEPA自动化提示优化额外提升1.5-2.8%。

title: Designing sparse temporal graphs satisfying connectivity requirements
comment: 27 pages, 7 figures, shorter version accepted at SAND 2026
summary: Connectivity of temporal graphs has been widely studied both as graph theory and as gossip theory. In particular, it is well known that in order to connect every vertex to every other, a temporal graph needs to have at least $2n-4$ edges where $n$ is the number of vertices. This paper investigates the optimal number of edges required to satisfy partial connectivity requirements. We introduce the problem of Connectivity Request Satisfaction where we are given a directed graph that we call the request graph, where an arc from $u$ to $v$ means that we need to be able to go from $u$ to $v$. Our goal is to build a temporal graph on the same vertex set with as few temporal edges as possible that would satisfy all the requests. When the graph we build is directed, we prove that the number of temporal arcs required is $n-\mathrm{cc}+\mathrm{dfvs}$ where $\mathrm{cc}$ is the number of connected component of the request graph and $\mathrm{dfvs}$ is the size of its smallest directed feedback vertex set. It follows that the problem is NP-complete but inherits fixed parameter tractability properties of Directed Feedback Vertex Set. When the graph we build is undirected, we establish a characterization of strongly connected request graphs that admit a solution with $n-1$ edges: it is possible if and only if any set of pairwise non-vertex-disjoint closed walks all share a common vertex. We prove that this criteria can be tested in polynomial time.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了时间图中部分连通请求的边优化问题。有向情况下，最优边数为n减去连通分量数加上最小有向反馈顶点集大小，问题为NP完全但具有固定参数 tractability；无向情况下，强连通请求图可解的判定条件为非顶点分离的闭合路径必有公共顶点，且该条件可多项式时间检验。
AI.motivation: 已知完整连通需要至少2n-4条边，但实际应用中往往只需要部分顶点间的连通性，因此需要研究在满足部分连通需求时的最优边数问题。
AI.method: 有向情况：通过分析连通分量和最小有向反馈顶点集来推导最优边数下界与构造。无向情况：建立强连通请求图可解性的充分必要条件（闭合路径非顶点分离性），并设计多项式时间检验算法。
AI.result: 有向情况：最优时间边数为n-cc+dfvs；无向情况：强连通请求图可用n-1条边解当且仅当任意成对非顶点分离的闭合路径都有公共顶点。
AI.conclusion: 问题在有向情况下是NP完全的，但继承了有向反馈顶点集的固定参数可计算性质；对于无向情况，该条件可在多项式时间内检验。

title: Back to the Future: Rethinking Endorsement in Order-Execute Blockchains
summary:
Due to regulatory compliance and governance management, modern (permissioned) blockchains require flexible endorsement, which allows the endorsement policy for each contract or state object to be individually defined. To enable flexible endorsement, Hyperledger Fabric employs an execute-order-validate (EOV) paradigm, in which transactions first undergo speculative execution and endorsement, and are only then ordered and validated. Meanwhile, most blockchain systems, including the platform targeted in this work (i.e., ChainMaker), still follow a conflict-free order-execute framework. We argue that the EOV paradigm still faces several limitations, notably high abort rates in high-contention workloads such as those in Decentralized Finance (DeFi).
  To avoid refactoring our system and better suit DeFi applications, we try to integrate flexible endorsement into the classical order-execute architecture and accordingly propose a new framework. The key challenge is to deterministically remove problematic transactions from an ordered list, while preserving censorship resistance and decentralization for the remaining ones. We instantiate this framework on top of Tendermint, a seminal Byzantine fault-tolerant (BFT) protocol adopted in our system, and thereby propose FlexTender. By elegantly embedding endorsements into consensus, FlexTender incurs no additional messaging overhead in the normal case. Empirical evaluation using an Ethereum USDT workload demonstrates that FlexTender achieves up to $10.6\times$ speedup in throughput over an EOV simulation on the same platform.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FlexTender：首个在保持无冲突（conflict-free）的经典 order-execute 架构下支持“灵活背书”（flexible endorsement）的 BFT 共识协议。它把背书逻辑直接嵌入 Tendermint 的 propose/prevote/precommit 三阶段消息交换中——prevote 携带背书/反对意见，precommit 表达“已集齐背书”或“建议移除”，并借助 refRound、CON 标志、equivocation 聚合与 rapid removal 等机制解决重执行循环、部分背书聚合与审查攻击问题。在 ChainMaker 上以 Ethereum USDT 转账负载测试，相比同平台的 EOV 仿真实现（eov-sim）吞吐最高提升 10.6×，且正常情况下不引入额外消息开销。
AI.motivation: 现代联盟链（permissioned blockchain）为满足监管合规与治理管理，需要按合约/状态对象逐一自定义的灵活背书策略；Hyperledger Fabric 通过 execute-order-validate（EOV）范式（先推测执行+背书，再排序，再验证）实现该能力。但作者指出 EOV 存在三点局限：(1) Fabric 的“倒置”架构依赖验证阶段保证可串行化，其思想难以迁移到 order-execute 链，因为它同时改变共识与执行语义；(2) 执行阶段无定序，背书只能逐笔进行，破坏了批量处理这一摊薄签名开销的关键技术；(3) EOV 适合低竞争场景，在 DeFi/DEX 等高竞争负载下冲突交易被反复 abort，不仅性能下降，还可能因热点状态交易反复失败而破坏活性（Figure 12）。目标平台 ChainMaker 采用经典 order-execute + Tendermint，作者希望无需重构系统即可引入灵活背书，且保持其余部分的去中心化与抗审查性——核心难点在于：如何确定性地从已排序列表中移除“问题交易”，并让其后续交易被重新执行、重新背书，同时不牺牲剩余交易的审查抗性与去中心化（Dilemma 1：先排序后背书会阻塞后续交易，先背书后排序则产生并发冲突）。此外，Fabric v0.6 及更早版本虽基于 order-execute 却缺乏灵活背书，侧面说明该改造之难；作者曾尝试把背书做成独立模块，但发现会产生“共识轮次+背书轮次”的嵌套循环，过于复杂。
AI.method: 1) 框架设计：提出 order-execute-endorse 框架——批量定序 → 按序执行 → 由对应 endorser 对执行结果背书；若某交易因缺少背书被移除，则同块内其后交易必须重执行、重背书；最终状态在剩余交易全部被正确背书并提交后更新。背书策略沿用 Fabric 的单调逻辑表达式（对节点集合），既用于判定“已被正确背书”，也用于判定“被足够 endorser 反对”，以支持快速移除（rapid removal）。2) FlexTender 协议：在 Tendermint 轮次/视图推进中嵌入背书——propose 后节点按序执行并将背书意见放入 prevote；集齐全部交易背书则通过 precommit 宣告；超时则通过 precommit “建议移除”未集齐背书的交易；≥f+1 节点建议移除即视为可移除，后续 proposer 必须排除（只可移除、不可新增，避免加/删死循环）。定义 examined（已收齐 n−f 条 precommit 的提案）与 Invariant 1（examined 提案要么被正确背书，要么其中至少一笔交易可在后续轮被移除），据此保证最终出现一个（可能为空的）被正确背书的提案，之后退化为标准 Tendermint 模式。3) 三类威胁与对策：(a) 避免无谓重背书——恶意 endorser 延迟到 prevote 末尾才发背书会迫使系统每轮重新背书；引入 refRound_p/refRound_*，记录观察到“被正确背书的 QC 值”的轮次，一旦存在则不再提议/背书新提案，使该值可被后续轮提交；(b) 聚合部分背书——将同一轮内所有 prevote 中的背书聚合，且若某 endorser 在同轮对同一 v 发出两条背书不一致的 prevote，则两条消息合起来视为对 v 中全部交易的背书（保留至多两条以作证明）；(c) 抗审查——恶意 proposer 可先扣留背书逼出换轮、或提议剔除可背书交易、或延迟传播提案诱使 endorser 发 nil；对策是 refRound 同时跟踪 examined 提案的演化，proposer 每轮在“有效的被正确背书 QC 值”与“交易数最少的 examined 值”之间二选一；引入 prevote 的 CON 标志（CON=true 兼顾共识层投票，false 仅携带背书不推进共识），要求 endorser 即使 locked 或已投 nil 也必须广播背书；收到同轮两个不同提案时立即广播 nil precommit 以防多提案被并行执行/背书导致的 DoS；并可与 accountability 机制结合检测故障进程。4) 系统模型与性质：n≥3f+1，最多 f 个拜占庭节点，网络最终同步（GST 后延迟≤Δ）；证明安全（提交的每笔交易必被正确背书）与活性（可背书且不可被快速移除的交易最终提交），并在可背书者按实际网络速度推进时保证 responsiveness；正常情况下（正确 leader、全部交易可背书、同步网络）仍只需三个消息延迟即可提交提案。5) 实现与实验：在 ChainMaker 上实现 FlexTender（含对 Tendermint 的修改，附录 A 给出正确性证明、附录 B 给出伪代码），并在同一代码库上实现 EOV 仿真系统 eov-sim 作为对照；在 Amazon EC2 上使用以太坊 Tether USDT 转账真实负载测试。
AI.result: FlexTender 正确性通过证明给出：Theorem 1（带背书的安全性——每个提交的交易都被正确背书）与 Theorem 2（带背书的活性——每个被正确背书且不可被快速移除的交易最终被提交），安全性与同步性假设无关，活性继承自 Tendermint 并在 endorser 可按实际网络速率推进时满足 responsiveness；抗审查性依赖 GST 后背书与冲突消息的及时传播。实验基于以太坊 USDT 合约转账负载（该负载访问高度倾斜：top 0.01% 地址被 39.23% 的交易访问，正好命中 EOV 的高冲突 abort 场景），结果显示 FlexTender 相对同平台 eov-sim 吞吐最高提升 10.6×；正常路径下每轮消息交换不超过标准 Tendermint 的流程，不引入额外消息开销，并额外提供“存在 endorser 反对证明时快速移除未背书交易”的快路径。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张“回到未来”：与其让 Fabric 式 EOV 倒置架构去适配 order-execute 链，不如把灵活背书“拉回”顺序执行范式，实现无冲突的 order-execute-endorse 框架。核心洞见是把共识的轮次/视图推进天然复用为“移除—重执行—重背书”循环的推进器，把背书与移除决策嵌入 Tendermint 的多阶段消息，从而在正常情况下零额外消息开销并保持 Tendermint 已充分分析的既有安全属性。FlexTender 是作者所知首个在保持 conflict-free 的同时支持灵活背书的 BFT 协议，可直接落地于 ChainMaker 等企业级链，为稳定币监管、合规审计、差异化治理等场景提供细粒度角色背书能力，同时不牺牲其余交易的去中心化与抗审查性。局限与未来工作包括：依赖 endorser 的诚实响应（不合作 endorser 只能靠超时移除解决）、策略表达能力的进一步丰富、以及与 accountability/惩罚机制结合以抑制恶意 endorser。

title: LLM-Guided Runtime Parameter Optimization for Energy-Efficient Model Inference
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become an integral part of many real-world workflows. However, LLMs consume a lot of energy, which becomes a large concern in the scale of the demand for these tools. As LLMs become integrated into different workflows, different applications have arisen to deal with the challenge of running inference for these tools. This raises another issue of choosing the runtime parameter values for these services in order to minimize the energy consumption. Oftentimes this requires deep knowledge of the application or traditional optimization methods that can take days to find optimal values. In this work, we created a human-in-the-loop flow with LLM-assisted runtime parameter optimization in order to solve this issue. With human-created, specific feedback prompting methods, chat-based LLMs can iteratively find energy-efficient inference parameters faster than traditional search methods. LLMs can also tailor their solutions to different hardware setups and easily take into account other system constraints. The enhanced prompt template was able to converge below the threshold at an average of 3.4 prompts compared to the baseline, which converged in an average of 5.2 prompts, and consistently achieved lower final energy per token. The enhanced prompt template also outperformed Sobol sampling in convergence speed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种人机协作的LLM辅助运行时参数优化方法，通过迭代反馈提示快速找到节能的推理参数。相比传统方法，优化后的提示模板收敛速度更快（3.4次 vs 5.2次），能效更优，且可适应不同硬件环境。
AI.motivation: LLMs are energy-intensive and widely deployed, but optimizing runtime parameters for energy efficiency traditionally requires deep expertise or time-consuming search methods (days), creating a need for faster, accessible solutions.
AI.method: Human-in-the-loop flow with iterative LLM prompting, using specific feedback prompting methods to guide the LLM in finding optimal runtime parameters for energy-efficient inference.
AI.result: Enhanced prompt template achieved convergence in 3.4 prompts (vs 5.2 baseline and slower Sobol sampling), with consistently lower final energy per token across different hardware configurations.
AI.conclusion: LLM-assisted optimization with human feedback is an effective and efficient approach for runtime parameter tuning, outperforming both baseline and traditional sampling methods in convergence speed and energy efficiency.

title: Designing Ethical Learning for Agentic AI: Toegye Yi Hwang's Ethical Emotion Regulation Framework
summary: Agentic AI systems capable of autonomous goal setting and proactive intervention introduce new challenges for regulating moral-emotional processes in learning environments. Existing frameworks typically treat emotion as reactive feedback or engagement optimization, overlooking the need for normative regulation across autonomous decision cycles.This paper proposes an ethical emotion regulation framework for agentic AI learning design inspired by Toegye Yi Hwang's moral-emotional philosophy. The Ethical Emotion Feedback System (EEFS) is reconstructed as a five-stage architecture aligned with agentic cycles, articulating stage-specific design principles and scenario classifications.An EEFS Evaluation Instrument is introduced to enable systematic assessment of moral-emotional alignment in agentic AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向智能体AI学习设计的伦理情感调节框架，灵感源自韩国儒学家退溪的道德-情感哲学，将伦理情感反馈系统重构为与智能体周期对齐的五阶段架构，配套开发了EEFS评估工具以实现智能体AI系统道德-情感对齐的系统性评估。
AI.motivation: 当前框架仅将情感视为被动反馈或参与度优化机制，未能覆盖自主决策循环中的规范性调节需求。智能体AI系统需要超越传统的反应性情感模型，建立能够支持道德-情感过程持续调节的设计范式。
AI.method: 基于韩国儒学家退溪（Toegye Yi Hwang）的道德-情感哲学，将道德情感理论重构为与智能体周期对齐的五阶段架构（EEFS），并为每个阶段制定具体设计原则和场景分类，同时开发配套的评估工具。
AI.result: 提出了一个基于退溪哲学的道德-情感调节框架，将EEFS重构为与智能体周期对齐的五阶段架构，并配套开发了EEFS评估工具以支持系统性评估。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为智能体AI学习设计中的道德-情感调节提供了系统性评估工具，弥合了传统情感理论与自主决策循环之间的鸿沟，为可解释且合乎伦理的智能体AI系统提供了设计规范。五个阶段分别对应感知、评估、决策、实施与反馈环节，每个阶段均有明确的设计原则和场景分类。研究还开发了EEFS评估工具以实现对智能体AI系统道德-情感对齐的系统性测评。

title: Budget-Constrained Online Retrieval-Augmented Generation: The Chunk-as-a-Service Model
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized the field of natural language processing. However, they exhibit some limitations, including a lack of reliability and transparency: they may hallucinate and fail to provide sources that support the generated output. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) was introduced to address such limitations in LLMs. One popular implementation, RAG-as-a-Service (RaaS), has shortcomings that hinder its adoption and accessibility. For instance, RaaS pricing is based on the number of submitted prompts, without considering whether the prompts are enriched by relevant chunks, i.e., text segments retrieved from a vector database, or the quality of the utilized chunks (i.e., their degree of relevance). This results in an opaque and less cost-effective payment model. We propose Chunk-as-a-Service (CaaS) as a transparent and cost-effective alternative. CaaS includes two variants: Open-Budget CaaS (OB-CaaS) and Limited-Budget CaaS (LB-CaaS), which is enabled by our ``Utility-Cost Online Selection Algorithm (UCOSA)''. UCOSA further extends the cost-effectiveness and the accessibility of the OB-CaaS variant by enriching, in an online manner, a subset of the submitted prompts based on budget constraints and utility-cost tradeoff. Our experiments demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed UCOSA compared to both offline and relevance-greedy selection baselines. In terms of the performance metric-the number of enriched prompts (NEP) multiplied by the Average Relevance (AR)-UCOSA outperforms random selection by approximately 52% and achieves around 75% of the performance of offline selection methods. Additionally, in terms of budget utilization, LB-CaaS and OB-CaaS achieve higher performance-to-budget ratios of 140% and 86%, respectively, compared to RaaS, indicating their superior efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Chunk-as-a-Service(CaaS)作为RAG-as-a-Service(RaaS)的透明且成本效益更高的替代方案，通过UCOSA算法实现基于预算约束的在线提示词充实选择，在性能和预算效率上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 当前RAG-as-a-Service(RaaS)存在两个主要缺陷：(1)定价仅基于提交提示词数量，未考虑提示词是否被相关文本块充实；(2)未评估所用文本块的质量（相关性程度）。这导致支付模型不透明、成本效益低，限制了RaaS的采用和可访问性。
AI.method: 提出Chunk-as-a-Service(CaaS)框架，包含两种变体：Open-Budget CaaS(OB-CaaS)和Limited-Budget CaaS(LB-CaaS)，并设计UCOSA(Utility-Cost Online Selection Algorithm)算法实现基于预算约束和实用成本权衡的在线提示词充实策略。该方法扩展了离线选择基线的成本效益和可访问性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：UCOSA在NEP×AR指标上比随机选择优约52%，达到离线选择方法约75%的性能；LB-CaaS和OB-CaaS的预算效率分别比RaaS高140%和86%。
AI.conclusion: CaaS通过UCOSA算法实现了透明且高效的按需提示词充实方案，其中LB-CaaS实现了140%的预算效率提升，OB-CaaS实现了86%的提升，证明了基于实用性的在线选择方法能够有效替代现有的离线RaaS模式。

title: Exploring the Limits of Pruning: Task-Specific Neurons, Model Collapse, and Recovery in Task-Specific Large Language Models
summary: Neuron pruning is widely used to reduce the computational cost and parameter footprint of large language models, yet it remains unclear whether neurons in task-specific models contribute uniformly to task performance. In this work, we provide empirical evidence for the existence and importance of task-specific neurons through a systematic pruning study on language models specialized for mathematical reasoning and code generation. We introduce an activation-based selectivity metric to identify neurons with low contribution to the target task and prune them while preserving target-task accuracy, and compare selective pruning with random pruning. Selective pruning consistently outperforms random pruning, indicating that activation-based selectivity provides a systematic advantage over random pruning. Reverse pruning experiments further show that removing a small subset of highly task-specific neurons (~10%) causes complete performance collapse, suggesting that there exist task specific neurons and critical task information is concentrated in a small portion of the network. In contrast, selective pruning of less critical neurons (~30% - ~35%) reduces accuracy but still preserves significant performance. We also observed consistent reductions in parameters and runtime VRAM usage, along with improved inference throughput as pruning increases. Experiments on both 1.5B and 7B models reveal a robustness threshold around 15-20% pruning, beyond which accuracy loss and generation failures increase sharply. Fine-tuning substantially recovers performance across pruning levels, particularly for aggressively pruned models. These findings provide empirical evidence of neuron specialization in task-specific language models and offer insights into pruning robustness, model redundancy, and post-pruning recoverability.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过系统性剪枝实验证明了任务特异性神经元在大语言模型中的存在和重要性。研究者提出了基于激活的选择性指标，发现在数学推理和代码生成任务中，关键任务信息集中于约10%的高度任务特异性神经元中，选择性剪枝方法显著优于随机剪枝，模型可承受15-20%的剪枝率而不致严重性能下降。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的神经元剪枝虽被广泛用于降低计算成本和参数量，但尚不清楚任务特异性模型中神经元对任务性能的贡献是否均匀分布，即是否存在对特定任务至关重要的"关键神经元"。
AI.method: 1) 提出基于激活的选择性指标来识别对目标任务贡献低的神经元；2) 比较选择性剪枝与随机剪枝的效果；3) 设计反向剪枝实验验证关键神经元的重要性；4) 在1.5B和7B模型上进行数学推理和代码生成任务的实验验证。
AI.result: 选择性剪枝始终优于随机剪枝；移除约10%的高度任务特异性神经元会导致性能完全崩溃；剪枝约30%-35%的低贡献神经元仍保留显著性能；可减少参数量和运行时显存占用，提升推理吞吐量；模型鲁棒性阈值约为15-20%，超出后精度损失急剧增加；微调可显著恢复剪枝模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 激活选择性剪枝显著优于随机剪枝，验证了该方法的优势；临界任务信息集中于约10%的高度任务特异性神经元；模型对15-20%剪枝率具有鲁棒性阈值；微调可有效恢复剪枝后的模型性能。这些发现为理解任务特异性语言模型中的神经元专业化提供了实证依据。

title: Automatic Causal Fairness Analysis with LLM-Generated Reporting
summary: AutoML, intended as the process of automating the application of machine learning to real-world problems, is a key step for AI popularisation. Most AutoML frameworks are not accounting for the potential lack of fairness in the training data and in the corresponding predictions. We introduce \textsc{FairMind}, a software prototype aiming to automatise fairness analysis at the dataset level. We achieve that by resorting to the assumptions of the \emph{standard fairness model}, recently proposed by Plečko and Bareinboim. This allows for a sound fairness evaluation in terms of causal effects, based on \emph{counterfactual} queries involving the target, possibly confounders and mediators, and the different values of an input feature we regard as \emph{protected}. After the necessary data preprocessing, the tool implements a closed-form computation of the effects. LLMs are consequently exploited to generate accurate reports on the fairness levels detected in the training dataset. We achieve that in a zero-shot setup and show by examples the expected advantages with respect to a direct analysis performed by the LLM. To favour applications, extensions to ordinal protected variable and continuous targets and novel decomposition results are also discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FairMind——一个用于数据集层面自动公平性分析的软件原型。该工具基于标准公平性模型，利用因果效应和反事实查询进行公平性评估，并通过LLM零样本设置自动生成分析报告。与直接使用LLM的分析方法相比，展示了显著优势，同时支持对序数型受保护变量和连续型目标的扩展。
AI.motivation: 当前大多数AutoML框架忽视了训练数据及预测结果中潜在的公平性问题，这限制了AI技术在实际应用中的负责任推广。
AI.method: 采用Plečko和Bareinboim提出的标准公平性模型，通过反事实查询进行因果效应分析；数据预处理后实现封闭形式计算；利用LLM（零样本设置）生成公平性分析报告。
AI.result: 开发了FairMind原型系统，实现数据集层面的自动化公平性分析；通过示例验证了相比直接使用LLM进行公平性分析的优势；支持受保护变量的扩展处理。
AI.conclusion: FairMind通过将因果推断与LLM报告生成相结合，提出了一种新颖的自动公平性分析框架。该工具填补了AutoML系统中公平性评估的空白，为AI普及提供了更加负责任的技术支撑。论文还讨论了对序数型受保护变量和连续型目标的扩展，以及新的分解结果，具有较强的实用价值和理论贡献。

title: Think it, Run it: Autonomous ML pipeline generation via self-healing multi-agent AI
summary: The purpose of our paper is to develop a unified multi-agent architecture that automates end-to-end machine learning (ML) pipeline generation from datasets and natural-language (NL) goals, improving efficiency, robustness and explainability. A five-agent system is proposed to handle profiling, intent parsing, microservice recommendation, Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) construction and execution. It integrates code-grounded Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for microservice understanding, an explainable hybrid recommender combining multiple criteria, a self-healing mechanism using Large Language Model (LLM)-based error interpretation and adaptive learning from execution history. The approach is evaluated on 150 ML tasks across diverse scenarios. The system achieves an 84.7% end-to-end pipeline success rate, outperforming baseline methods. It demonstrates improved robustness through self-healing and reduces workflow development time compared to manual construction. The study introduces a novel integration of code-grounded RAG, explainable recommendation, self-healing execution and adaptive learning within a single architecture, showing that tightly coupled intelligent components can outperform isolated solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个五智能体统一架构，实现从数据集和自然语言目标自动生成端到端ML流水线，通过代码接地RAG、可解释推荐、自愈机制和自适应学习协同整合，在150个任务上达到84.7%成功率，验证了紧耦合智能组件的优越性。
AI.motivation: 传统ML工作流构建依赖人工，效率低、鲁棒性不足且缺乏可解释性，需从数据集和自然语言目标自动生成端到端ML流水线。
AI.method: 采用五智能体系统（画像、意图解析、微服务推荐、DAG构建与执行），集成代码接地RAG实现微服务理解，结合多准则可解释混合推荐器，并引入基于LLM错误解释的自愈机制和执行历史自适应学习。
AI.result: 在150个多样化ML任务上验证，系统端到端成功率达84.7%，优于基线方法，增强了鲁棒性并缩短了工作流开发时间。
AI.conclusion: 提出的五智能体统一架构通过代码接地RAG、可解释推荐、自愈机制和自适应学习的协同整合，实现了84.7%的端到端成功率，证明了紧耦合智能组件可优于孤立方案。

title: RoadMapper: A Multi-Agent System for Roadmap Generation of Solving Complex Research Problems
summary: People commonly leverage structured content to accelerate knowledge acquisition and research problem solving. Among these, roadmaps guide researchers through hierarchical subtasks to solve complex research problems step by step. Despite progress in structured content generation, the roadmap generation task has remained unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce RoadMap, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of large language models (LLMs) to construct high-quality roadmaps for solving complex research problems. Based on this, we identify three limitations of LLMs: (1) lack of professional knowledge, (2) unreasonable task decomposition, and (3) disordered logical relationships. To address these challenges, we propose RoadMapper, an LLM-based multi-agent system that decomposes the research roadmap generation task into three key stages (i.e., initial generation, knowledge augmentation, and iterative "critique-revise-evaluate"). Extensive experiments demonstrate that RoadMapper can improve LLMs' ability for roadmap generation, while enhancing average performance by more than 8% and saving 84% of the time required by human experts, highlighting its effectiveness and application potential.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoadMap基准和RoadMapper多智能体系统，解决LLM自动生成研究路线图的问题。系统通过三阶段流程（初始生成→知识增强→迭代批评修订）克服了LLM在专业知识、任务分解和逻辑关系方面的三大局限。
AI.motivation: 结构化内容（如路线图）能帮助研究人员分步解决复杂研究问题，但当前缺乏对路线图自动生成任务的研究，存在技术空白。
AI.method: 提出RoadMapper系统，采用三阶段流程：(1)初始生成阶段创建基础路线图；(2)知识增强阶段补充专业知识；(3)迭代式"批评-修订-评估"阶段优化逻辑关系和任务分解。
AI.result: RoadMapper使LLM在路线图生成任务上性能提升超过8%，同时节省84%的人工时间成本。
AI.conclusion: RoadMapper通过多智能体架构显著提升LLM生成研究路线图的能力，在性能上提升超过8%，同时节省84%的人工时间，展示了其在研究问题解决中的有效性和应用潜力。

title: A note on the parameter $\ell$ in Buchbinder--Feldman's deterministic submodular matroid algorithm
comment: 8 pages. Companion Lean 4 formalization at https://github.com/daizisheng/bf24-note
summary: Buchbinder and Feldman recently gave a deterministic $(1-1/e-\varepsilon)$-approximation for maximizing a non-negative monotone submodular function subject to a matroid constraint, with query complexity $\widetilde{O}_\varepsilon(nr)$. Their algorithm uses an integer parameter $\ell$, which Buchbinder and Feldman fix to $\ell = 1 + \lceil 1/\varepsilon \rceil$ via a loose bound on $(1+1/\ell)^{-\ell}$. We point out two purely elementary refinements. First, the classical Pólya--Szegő inequality $(1+1/\ell)^{-\ell} \le e^{-1}(1+1/(2\ell))$ replaces the loose step in their proof and permits $\ell = \lceil 1/(2e\varepsilon) \rceil$, shrinking the hidden constant in $\widetilde{O}_\varepsilon(nr)$ by a factor $\approx 2^{0.816/\varepsilon}$. Second, an alternating-series tail bound for $\log(1+t)$ yields the asymptotically sharp inequality $(1+1/\ell)^{-\ell} \le e^{-1}\exp(1/(2\ell) - 1/(3\ell^2) + 1/(4\ell^3))$, matching the true expansion of $(1+1/\ell)^{-\ell}$ through order $\ell^{-3}$ and translating into $\ell_\star = 1/(2e\varepsilon) - 5/12 + O(\varepsilon)$. The asymptotic class $\widetilde{O}_\varepsilon(nr)$ of the query complexity is unchanged in either case; only the implicit constant in $\varepsilon$ is improved. All inequalities in this note are formalized and machine-checked in Lean 4 against Mathlib.

AI.tldr: 本文对Buchbinder-Feldman的$(1-1/e-\varepsilon)$近似算法进行了两个初等优化：通过Pólya-Szegő不等式改进$(1+1/\ell)^{-\ell}$的上界，以及利用交错级数尾部估计得到渐近精确的不等式。两种改进均仅缩小了查询复杂度的隐常数，渐近复杂度类别$\widetilde{O}_\varepsilon(nr)$保持不变。
AI.motivation: Buchbinder和Feldman的原始算法使用参数$\ell = 1 + \lceil 1/\varepsilon \rceil$，其中对$(1+1/\ell)^{-\ell}$的界过于宽松，导致查询复杂度中的隐常数过大，存在进一步优化的空间。
AI.method: 1. 用经典Pólya--Szegő不等式$(1+1/\ell)^{-\ell} \le e^{-1}(1+1/(2\ell))$替代原文中松散的界；2. 采用交错级数尾部估计得到对数函数的精确不等式$(1+1/\ell)^{-\ell} \le e^{-1}\exp(1/(2\ell) - 1/(3\ell^2) + 1/(4\ell^3))$。所有不等式均在Lean 4和Mathlib中形式化验证。
AI.result: 第一种改进使$\ell = \lceil 1/(2e\varepsilon) \rceil$，隐常数缩小约$2^{0.816/\varepsilon}$倍；第二种改进得到渐近最优$\ell_\star = 1/(2e\varepsilon) - 5/12 + O(\varepsilon)$。
AI.conclusion: 两种改进均仅改善了复杂度中的隐常数，渐近复杂度类别$\widetilde{O}_\varepsilon(nr)$保持不变。这表明原算法框架已接近最优，改进空间主要在于技术性分析层面。

title: Monadic Presburger Predicates have Robust Population Protocols
summary:
Population protocols are a model of distributed computation in which a collection of indistinguishable finite-state agents interact randomly in pairs to decide a predicate of their initial configuration. The agents decide by achieving a stable consensus on whether the predicate holds or not. It is known that population protocols can decide exactly the predicates expressible in Presburger arithmetic.
  Recently, Lossin et al. have introduced a notion of protocol robustness against adversarial crash failures. They show that all atomic Presburger predicates can be decided by robust protocols, and ask whether the same holds for every Presburger predicate. We make progress towards settling this question by proving that all predicates expressible in monadic Presburger arithmetic have robust protocols. In addition, we analyze the cost of robustness in terms of state complexity. We study the ratio between the number of states of the smallest robust protocol for a given predicate and the smallest protocol for it. We show that the cost of robustness is at least double exponential in the size of the predicate, and prove that the robust protocols by Lossin et al. for threshold predicates x >= k have optimal state complexity.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究人口协议（Population Protocols）在对抗性崩溃故障下的稳健性问题，证明monadic Presburger算术中的所有谓词都存在稳健协议，并证明稳健性会导致状态复杂度至少双指数级增长，同时确定阈值谓词的稳健协议具有最优复杂度。该研究推进了Presburger谓词稳健性问题的解决。论文发表于分布式计算顶级会议PODC 2025。
AI.motivation: Lossin等人最近引入了协议对抗性崩溃故障稳健性的概念，并证明了所有原子Presburger谓词都可以通过稳健协议判定，但遗留了一个重要的开放问题：是否所有Presburger谓词都具有稳健协议？该研究旨在推进这一问题的解决。
AI.method: 该研究采用组合数学与协议构造方法：（1）对monadic Presburger谓词，通过分析其结构特征，构造性地给出了稳健协议设计方案；（2）对于状态复杂度下界分析，采用信息论方法证明双指数下界，并通过对Lossin等人协议的分析与化简证明其最优性。
AI.result: （1）证明了monadic Presburger算术中所有谓词都存在稳健协议；（2）证明了稳健性代价至少为双指数级（相对于谓词规模）；（3）证明了Lossin等人针对阈值谓词x≥k的稳健协议具有最优状态复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 该研究部分回答了开放问题：虽然无法证明所有Presburger谓词都有稳健协议，但成功证明了monadic Presburger算术中的所有谓词都具有稳健协议。同时，通过证明稳健性代价下界至少是双指数的，并确定阈值谓词的稳健协议具有最优状态复杂度，为该领域建立了重要的复杂度下界。论文发表在分布式计算领域的顶级会议PODC 2025上。 [paper_title: "The Cost of Robustness for Population Protocols", published: "PODC 2025"]

title: Where did we fail? -- Reproducing build failures in embedded open source software
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, International Conference on Evaluation and Assessment in Software Engineering (EASE), 2026 edition (EASE26) , Glasgow, United Kingdom, Tue 9 - Fri 12 June, 2026
summary:
Due to hardware-software co-development in embedded systems, continuous integration (CI) builds frequently fail because of complex cross-compilation, board configurations, and toolchain constraints. Although CI build logs contain valuable diagnostic information, they are short-lived and difficult to reuse due to heterogeneous runners, toolchains, and log formats. To address these challenges, we present PhantomRun, a unified abstraction layer and publicly reusable dataset that standardizes the retrieval, storage, and reproduction of CI build logs and metadata. Across 4628 failing CI runs, we reconstructed 91.8% of builds and preserved execution outcomes in 98% of evaluated cases.
  PhantomRun provides two core capabilities: retrieving the build log of any commit and faithfully re-executing the corresponding build in a controlled environment. By exposing all build artifacts and metadata in a uniform, machine-readable format, PhantomRun enables reproducible and longitudinal studies of CI failures. An empirical evaluation shows that reproduced builds closely match their originals, typically differing only in timestamps or minor nondeterministic reordering, demonstrating the feasibility of large-scale historical CI reconstruction.

AI.tldr: PhantomRun是一个统一的抽象层和可公开复用的数据集，用于标准化CI构建日志和元数据的检索、存储和重现。它解决了嵌入式系统CI构建失败率高、日志难以复用的问题，在4628个失败CI运行中实现了91.8%的构建重构率和98%的执行结果保留率，证明了大规模历史CI重建的可行性。
AI.motivation: 嵌入式系统中的硬件-软件协同开发导致CI构建频繁失败，原因包括复杂的交叉编译、板级配置和工具链约束。现有的CI构建日志虽然包含有价值的诊断信息，但由于异构runner、工具链和日志格式的差异，这些信息寿命短暂且难以复用。
AI.method: PhantomRun提供了统一的抽象层，将不同runner、工具链和日志格式的CI构建日志标准化为机器可读的格式。具体通过两个核心能力实现：检索任意提交的构建日志，以及在受控环境中忠实地重新执行相应构建。研究使用4628个失败的CI运行进行评估。
AI.result: 在4628个失败的CI运行中，重构了91.8%的构建，并在98%的评估案例中保留了执行结果。重现的构建与原始构建高度匹配，差异通常仅存在于时间戳或次要非确定性重排序中。
AI.conclusion: PhantomRun成功地证明了大规模历史CI重建的可行性，其重构的构建与原始构建高度一致，仅在时间戳或次要非确定性重排序方面存在差异。该工作为CI失败的纵向研究和可重复分析提供了基础设施支持。

title: Value-Aware Product Recommendation by Customer Segmentation using a suitable High-Dimensional Similarity Measure
summary: This paper presents a novel value-aware approach to product recommendation that simultaneously addresses the high dimensionality and sparsity of user-item data while explicitly incorporating the contribution of each product and user to overall sales revenue. The proposed framework encodes revenue contributions in the user-item matrix and computes customer similarity directly on this basis using suitable distance measures. This enables the segmentation of users according to the revenue-based similarity of their purchase baskets and supports recommendations aligned with profitability objectives. We compare conventional similarity metrics with a novel alternative tailored to high-dimensional contexts and propose three recommendation strategies based on revenue share, product popularity, and expected profit generation. The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated through simulation experiments and a real-world application using the UCI Online Retail dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种价值感知的产品推荐方法，通过在用户-物品矩阵中编码收入贡献，并使用适合高维情境的距离度量来计算客户相似性，从而在解决数据高维性和稀疏性问题的同时，实现以盈利能力为目标的推荐。研究提出了三种推荐策略，并通过模拟实验和UCI零售数据集验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: Traditional product recommendation systems focus on prediction accuracy but neglect the revenue contribution of products and users. They also struggle with high dimensionality and sparsity of user-item data.
AI.method: The proposed framework encodes revenue contributions in the user-item matrix and computes customer similarity using suitable distance measures, with a novel alternative tailored to high-dimensional contexts. Three recommendation strategies are proposed based on revenue share, product popularity, and expected profit generation.
AI.result: The method enables user segmentation based on revenue-based similarity of purchase baskets and supports recommendations aligned with profitability objectives.
AI.conclusion: The proposed method is validated through simulation experiments and a real-world application using the UCI Online Retail dataset, demonstrating its effectiveness.

title: Cross-Lingual Response Consistency in Large Language Models: An ILR-Informed Evaluation of Claude Across Six Languages
comment: 12 prompt clusters 6 languages 3 runs; data and code at github.com/camelbal-ship-it/crosslingual-claude-eval
summary: This paper introduces a systematic evaluation framework grounded in the Interagency Language Roundtable (ILR) Skill Level Descriptions and applies it to Claude (Sonnet 4.6) across six languages: English, French, Romanian, Spanish, Italian, and German. We administer a battery of 12 semantically equivalent prompt clusters spanning ILR complexity levels 1 through 3+, collect 216 responses (12 prompts, 6 languages, 3 runs), and analyze outputs through a two-layer methodology combining automated quantitative metrics with expert ILR qualitative assessment. Quantitative analysis reveals that French responses are approximately 30% longer than German responses on identical prompts, and that creative and affective clusters show the highest cross-lingual surface divergence. Qualitative analysis, conducted by a six-language professional with 12 years of ILR/OPI assessment experience, identifies five cross-lingual variation patterns: systematic differences in pragmatic disambiguation strategies, aesthetic and literary tradition divergence in creative output, language-internal technical terminology norms, cultural calibration gaps evidenced by the absence of culture-specific content in favor of culturally neutralized templates, and language-specific institutional referral behavior in emotional support responses. We argue that ILR-informed expert judgment applied to LLM outputs constitutes a novel and underreported evaluation methodology that complements purely computational benchmarks, and that cross-lingual output variation in Claude is interpretable, domain-dependent, and consequential for equitable multilingual AI deployment.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于ILR技能等级描述框架，对Claude(Sonnet 4.6)在6种语言(英、法、罗、西、意、德)上的能力进行系统评估。通过12个语义等价的提示簇(ILR复杂度1-3+级)，收集216条响应，采用自动化定量指标与专家ILR定性评估相结合的双层方法。发现了5种跨语言变异模式，表明跨语言输出变异是可解释的、领域依赖的，对公平的多语言AI部署具有重要影响。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM评估主要依赖计算基准，缺乏针对语言能力等级的专家定性评估方法；跨语言输出的系统性变异及其对公平多语言部署的影响尚未得到充分研究。需要建立一种结合专业语言能力标准的评估范式，以弥补纯粹计算方法的不足。
AI.method: 基于ILR技能等级描述构建系统评估框架；选取6种语言(英、法、罗、西、意、德)；设计12个语义等价提示簇(覆盖ILR复杂度1-3+级)；每种语言3次运行，共收集216条响应；采用双层分析——定量指标(响应长度等)与专家ILR定性评估(由具备12年ILR/OPI评估经验的多语言专业人员执行)。
AI.result: 定量层面：法语响应长度比德语长约30%；创意类和情感类提示簇呈现最高跨语言表面差异。定性层面：识别出5种跨语言变异模式——语用消歧策略的系统性差异、创意输出中的美学与文学传统差异、语言内部技术术语规范差异、文化校准差距(文化特定内容缺失，取而代之的是文化中立化模板)、情感支持响应中的语言特定机构转介行为。
AI.conclusion: ILR-informed专家判断应用于LLM输出构成了一种新颖且尚未被充分报道的评估方法，可补充纯计算基准；Claude的跨语言输出变异是可解释的、领域依赖的，对公平多语言AI部署具有重要影响；专家定性评估在LLM多语言能力评估中具有不可替代的价值。

title: Fidelity, Diversity, and Privacy: A Multi-Dimensional LLM Evaluation for Clinical Data Augmentation
summary: The scarcity of high-quality annotated medical data, particularly in mental health, poses a significant bottleneck for training robust machine learning models. Privacy regulations restrict data sharing, making synthetic data generation a promising alternative. The use of Large Language Models (LLMs) in a data augmentation pipeline could be leveraged as an alternative in this field. In the proposed methodology, DeepSeek-R1, OpenBioLLM-Llama3 and Qwen 3.5 are used to generate synthetic mental health evaluation reports conditioned on specific International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision (ICD-10) codes. Because naive text generation can lead to mode collapse or privacy breaches (memorization), a comprehensive evaluation framework is introduced. The generated diagnostic texts are assessed across three dimensions: semantic fidelity, lexical diversity, and privacy/plagiarism. The results demonstrate that all models can generate clinically coherent, diverse, and privacy-safe synthetic reports, significantly expanding the available training data for clinical natural language processing tasks without compromising patient confidentiality.

AI.tldr: 研究利用 LLM 生成合成精神健康评估报告以缓解医学数据稀缺问题，通过语义保真度、词汇多样性和隐私安全三个维度评估生成的合成数据质量。
AI.motivation: 高质量标注医学数据稀缺（尤其精神健康领域），隐私法规限制数据共享，导致训练机器学习模型存在瓶颈。
