AI.result: 对于任意固定常数C>0，算法的随机运行时间为P^{1+o(1)}，高概率返回原始点和对偶证书，加性最优性间隙至多exp(-log^C P)。该方法可推广到同一切割型超图拉普拉斯算子的随机近似线性时间 resolvent/proximal 原语。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为基于割的超图拉普拉斯算子问题提供了高效的可求解原语，结合对偶流计算与新型恢复定理，能有效求解原始问题。算法具有良好的理论保证（高概率收敛）和接近线性的时间复杂度。

title: The Origins of MEV: Systematic Attribution of Arbitrage Opportunity Creation at Scale
summary: Maximal Extractable Value (MEV) represents billions of dollars in extracted value that fundamentally shapes blockchain network dynamics and participant incentives. While research has focused on MEV extraction and mitigation, we lack systematic methods to attribute MEV opportunities to their on-chain origins. This paper formalizes the MEV opportunity attribution problem and introduces a systems framework for identifying which transactions create arbitrage opportunities and quantifying their contributions. We design and evaluate four attribution methods for atomic arbitrage on EVM-compatible networks: bot-data-driven, simulation-based, coefficient-based, and Shapley-based approaches. Through large-scale retrospective analysis spanning over one million blocks on Polygon, we demonstrate that the majority of atomic arbitrage opportunities can be traced to single source transactions, validating our central hypothesis about competitive MEV markets. We quantify a highly concentrated distribution of MEV creation, where a small subset of protocols generates most opportunities, and provide comparative analysis of method trade-offs in accuracy, cost, and scalability. Our findings offer insights for protocol designers reducing MEV leakage, validators optimizing transaction ordering, and analysts measuring ecosystem health through opportunity creation.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化了“MEV 机会归因（MEV opportunity attribution）”问题：在确定性状态机模型下，给定一笔已执行的原子套利交易，反推是哪些前序交易制造了价格失衡（即创造机会），并量化各来源交易的贡献（φ_i），使得 Σφ_i + φ_base = Π。论文设计并对比了四类归因方法——机器人出价数据代理（bot-data）、反事实仿真（simulation）、系数/K 值法（coefficient）与 Shapley 博弈论法——在 Polygon 上对 2026 年 3 月逾 105 万个区块、360,026 笔原子套利事件（共 33.5 万美元提取额）做了回溯分析。主要结论：96.7% 的机会可归因到单一源交易（“单源假设”成立），MEV 创造高度集中（Uniswap V3/Algebra/Uniswap V4 等少数协议与少数地址占大头），并给出各方法在准确率/覆盖率/成本上的权衡与推荐的分层混合工作流（系数法初筛 → 仿真法主力 → Shapley 法处理分歧与多源边界情形）。
AI.motivation: 现有 MEV 研究几乎全部聚焦于“价值提取端”：如何套利/清算/三明治、如何度量提取规模、以及如何缓解（公平排序、协议层防御）。但一个更基础的问题被忽略：究竟哪些链上交易“创造”了 MEV 机会？缺乏形式化的归因框架，就无法回答哪些协议制造了最多套利机会、哪些用户在无意中为提取者创造了价值，也难以评估 MEV 供给链与生态健康度。此外，已有的“反事实/触发交易定位”工作（如块内扫描类方法）只能定位或近似来源，无法量化单笔交易对提取价值的因果贡献；而系统领域中的归因方法（CIRCA、CF-Shapley、ShapleyIQ 等）面向的是含噪、概率性观测数据，而链上套利利润可由状态确定性精确计算、可用重放得到“反事实精确”结果，因此有必要将二者结合，建立确定性的交易级 MEV 归因框架。
AI.method: 1）系统模型：把区块视为有序交易序列与确定性状态转移 S_k = Σ(S_{k-1}, T_k)，借助 archive node 的历史状态快照与 trace 实现可复现重放；来源交易可在同块或最多 D=100 个前序块内（99.3% 在 7 块内）。2）目标：候选集 C = 与套利路径池有交互的前序交易，输出主来源交易哈希、归因价值 φ_i、以及按发送方/协议聚合的元数据，满足效率性质 Σφ_i + φ_base = Π。3）原子套利识别沿用 Vostrikov et al. (2025) 的三准则：多交换 N≥2、各资产净余额变化非负、扣除 gas 与优先费后利润为正。4）四种归因方法：①Bot-data——用生产搜索器 RL 代理（GNN 编码器 + MLP 价值头，PPO 训练，<10ms 推理）的出价记录作为“意图型”代理标签，仅作外部验证层（覆盖率受限，反映意图而非结果）；②Simulation——三阶段：按池交集过滤候选，二分回溯定位“边缘交易”T_edge（利润降至原始 5% 以下的最早位置，否则记为 pre-existing/S_0），再在 [T_edge, T_arb] 上反向逐笔计算边际影响 Imp_i = Π(T_{i+1}) − Π(T_i) 并取最大值（同值取更靠近套利者者）；③Coefficient（K 值法）——仅用日志/回调事件中的池储备计算套利路径的价格乘子系数 k(S)，取使 δk_i = k(S_i) − k(S_{i-1}) 最大的交易，无需状态重建，O(1) 成本但忽略深度、滑点与费用；④Shapley——将候选集视为合作博弈玩家，V(S) 为执行子集后的套利利润，精确枚举 O(2^{|C|})，大候选集用蒙特卡洛随机排列采样（1000 次，≈500 次即收敛到 5% 内）。5）流水线为离线回溯、模块化并行，Rust/C++ 实现性能组件，Python 做统计与可视化；验证采用三角互证（bot 一致性、精确/MC Shapley、200 例专家分层复核）。
AI.result: 方法性能（2026 年 2 月窗口，2,526 事件）：bot-data 准确率 94.2%、覆盖 38.4%、8ms/事件；simulation 准确率 91.7%、覆盖 99.1%、12.3ms/事件；coefficient 与仿真一致率 77.2%、覆盖 88.4%、0.8ms/事件；Shapley 精确约 5 分钟/事件、MC(1k) 2.1 秒/事件（覆盖 98.1%）。仿真法处理 3 月全量 36 万事件约需 80 小时。归因统计：96.7% 事件为单源（单一交易占正 Shapley 值 >70%，次名通常 <5%），3.3%（83 例）出现并列多源，其中约一半为同块内“盲目”末位套利导致的等值贡献；约 23% 事件在搜索窗口内找不到块内来源（归因于 S_0），仅占总利润 <4%。协议层面：AMM 参与率 96.5%，Uniswap V3 58.0%、Algebra 29.6%、Uniswap V4 28.9%、Uniswap V2 23.2%、DODO 8.2%（可重复参与故总和 >100%）；集中流动性 AMM 比 V2 更容易制造价格失衡。集中度：头部 1% 套利者与头部 1% 机会创造者各捕获/制造约 80% 的价值，前 5% 协议贡献 73% 的价值；平均每笔机会创造交易只吸引约 1.6 笔成功套利（1.6:1），可作为 MEV 市场效率新指标。
AI.conclusion: MEV 创造侧是可被系统化归因的：竞争性 MEV 市场中机会以单笔交易触发为主，多源复杂交互是少数；四类方法各有取舍，推荐分层混合工作流（系数法 O(1) 初筛、仿真法为默认主力、Shapley 用于方法分歧与疑似多源的边界情形、bot 数据作外部验证层）。框架可为协议设计者定位高泄漏交互、为验证者提供考虑机会创造的排序策略、为用户提供 MEV 风险评估，也为衡量生态健康度提供“机会创造—执行套利”比率。局限：基准真值靠三角互证而非直接观测；实验仅限 Polygon（2026 年 2–3 月）；仅覆盖原子套利，清算、三明治、TOB 等需另建因果模型；未来方向为实时归因、多 MEV 类别与多链扩展。文本层面存在若干内部不一致（如摘要 1,050,000 区块与正文 2M 区块表述、2 月数据集 AMM 计数“212,62 (96.5%)”排版错误、结论“前 5% 协议贡献 73%”与正文集中度口径不完全对应），且 bot 数据依赖公司专有出价日志、不可开源复现。

title: Now's the Time: Computer Science Must Evolve to Emphasize Software and Systems Engineering with Artificial Intelligence (AI)
summary: Computer science (CS) education needs to evolve to support software and artificial intelligence (AI) systems engineering, and it needs to happen now -- precisely because the core intellectual contributions of CS have never been more important. We argue that traditional curricula, built around programming, data structures, and algorithms as ends in themselves, must be reframed so that these topics become foundational building blocks within a systems- and engineering-centered education. Graduates should be prepared not to compete with AI on routine coding tasks, but to design, orchestrate, verify, and own complex AI-enabled systems operating under real-world constraints. More importantly, computer science education should be geared toward preparing students for future disruptions. The broad history of computing is marked by one disruptive technology after another, requiring us to rise to the moment instead of merely acquiescing to it.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场/观点论文，主张CS教育必须立即转向以软件与AI系统工程为中心的范式：编程、数据结构、算法不再是终点，而应降格为可复用的"设计基元"；培养目标从"与AI比拼写代码"转为"设计、编排、验证并负责AI赋能的复杂系统"，同时为未来的技术颠覆做准备。
AI.motivation: 作者指出当前CS课程仍以语法、数据结构、算法为"神圣仪式"，虽源自计算思维(CT)，却多采用只强调抽象与算法的窄化解读，弱化了系统、不确定性与工程维度，导致毕业生擅长写孤立代码却缺少交付、扩展、安全与运维的全局意识。与此同时，生成式AI(Cursor、Claude、Gemini、Copilot及智能体平台)以远超人类的速度生成、调试、重构生产级代码，把"例行编程"变为商品：Gartner预测绝大多数企业软件工程师将日常使用AI助手，角色从"实现"转向"系统设计与编排"；McKinsey 2025研究显示AI贯穿全生命周期可带来数十个百分点的生产力与质量提升；Stanford Digital Economy Lab指出生成式AI普及后22–25岁早期职业人群（尤其软件开发者）在高AI暴露职业中就业相对显著下降，且主要通过减少招聘实现。作者强调这不是新现象：主机、PC、万维网、维基百科都曾被预言"终结"某物，结果反而重塑了领域，历史上每次计算革命都让学科演化为分布式、网络化的系统学科；且当代AI本身正是大规模系统思维（分布式系统、数据管线、硬件集成、预训练/微调/RLHF工程）的产物。其更深层动因是计算机科学需为"下一次颠覆"做准备，培养能应对状态转移规则不再由代码写成的LLM智能体系统动态的人才。
AI.method: 本文采用论证性/立场论文(position paper)方法，无实验与量化评估。论证结构为：(1)以土木/机械/电气工程师类比切入——工程师掌握基础后从事架构、集成、验证、权衡与交付，手工技艺交给技工或机器人；(2)界定问题：CS课程对CT的窄化采纳导致系统性工程能力缺失，同时企业与替代教育机构已开辟更应用化的并行路径；(3)证据支撑：引用Gartner、McKinsey 2025、Stanford Digital Economy Lab的研究结果，并援引Denning的"Great Principles"框架（将计算视为关于信息过程的科学，涵盖通信、协调与设计），论证AI系统正是计算学科的典型产物；(4)提出课程重构方案，包括将编程/算法/数据结构的地位对标传统工程中的材料科学与车间实践，以及系统思维与架构、协作与智能体编排、设计科学扩展、领域驱动集成、可靠性与验证工程、基础设施/交付/成本工程、贯穿式伦理安全与职业责任等核心模块；(5)给出新的毕业设计(capstone)形态与应对LLM行为等价性问题的工程手段（行为回归测试、影子部署、把LLM作为可替换组件、API层之上的显式行为预期）；(6)以"提升而非稀释"(Elevating, Not Diluting)回应"降低CS门槛"的质疑，并邀请产业从业者以合作伙伴身份参与课程共建，同时保持学术独立性。
AI.result: 得出规范性结论而非实证结果。核心主张：(1)CS教育重心应由"算法竞赛式编程训练"转向"系统与工程中心"的教育范式，经典CS内容（数据结构、算法、OS、网络、数据库）成为论证设计选择的概念工具箱，而非孤立学科；(2)毕业生核心能力定位为设计、编排、验证、拥有(reliability/ownership)AI赋能系统——包括问题界定、弹性模块化架构、多智能体"对话"式编排与目标对齐、LLM输出的严格验证(自洽性检查、权威来源接地、幻觉检测、自动评分)、可观测性与混沌测试、云成本/延迟/可用性作为一等约束，以及贯穿性的伦理与安全考量；(3)针对模型版本迭代中"API契约保留但行为等价性无法保证"这一新风险，提出以行为回归测试、影子部署和显式行为契约作为应对方案；(4)新capstone要求真实利益相关者、云预算成本上限、真实部署/开源产出，并交付架构文档、CI/CD、可观测性与成本看板、安全伦理说明与事后复盘；(5)总体立场是"co-opt工程思维而保留学科智识内核"，绝非降级或放弃CS。
AI.conclusion: 论文以"像对待机器一样对待软件——设计它、压测它、部署它、打破它、从失败中学习"总结其课程改革纲领，并强调这不是照搬传统工程大纲，而是借用工程心态同时保有CS的抽象、权衡、严格推理与数学根基。作者判断各CS院系正处于关键窗口期：谁先完成这一转型，谁就能培养出可在真实负载、成本压力、安全威胁与监管审视下存活并持续演进的AI原生系统人才，从而引领学科的未来。文中"无人驾驶机群、欺诈检测平台、AI原生工作流引擎"被隐喻为毕业生要设计的"桥"。整体论证是概念性、倡议性的，未提供课程实施效果的学习数据或评估证据，其落地依赖各院系自决与产业协作。

title: The Impact of AI-Generated Text on the Internet
summary: The proliferation of AI-generated and AI-assisted text on the internet is feared to contribute to a degradation in semantic and stylistic diversity, factual accuracy, and other negative developments (sometimes subsumed under the Dead Internet Theory). What has hindered answering these questions is that it has not been understood just how much of the internet is actually AI-generated or AI-edited. To this end, we construct a representative sample of websites published on the internet between 2022 and 2025 using the Internet Archive, and apply a state-of-the-art AI text detector on them. We find that by mid-2025, roughly 35% of newly published websites were classified as AI-generated or AI-assisted, up from zero before ChatGPT's launch in late 2022. We also find statistically significant evidence for some of the identified hypotheses; for example, that increases in AI-generated text on the internet correlate negatively with semantic diversity and positively with the prevalence of positive sentiment. We do not, however, find statistically significant evidence supporting the hypothesis that an increased rate of AI-generated text on the internet decreases factual accuracy or stylistic diversity. Notably, this diverges from public perception, which we measure in a user study, where the majority of US adults turned out to believe in all four of the above-mentioned hypotheses. Individuals who do not use AI or use it infrequently tend to believe in these negative impacts more than those who use it frequently; similarly, individuals who hold negative views of AI tend to believe in these hypotheses more than those with favorable views of the technology.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在全网尺度上量化 AI 生成文本的规模与影响：利用互联网档案馆（Wayback Machine）2022年8月–2025年5月的代表性网站样本，配合经独立鲁棒性评估选定的 Pangram v3 检测器，发现到 2025 年中约 35% 的新发布网站被判定为 AI 生成或 AI 辅助编写；六个关于"AI 文本会损害互联网"的假设中，仅"语义收缩"（ρ=0.47, p=0.004）与"情绪正向偏移"（ρ=0.56, p=0.0003）获得统计显著支持，而"事实准确性下降""风格单一化""外链减少""信息熵稀释"均不显著（p 从 0.17 到 0.89 不等）。这一实测结果与美国公众的主观信念（60.7%–83.0% 的受访者相信全部六项假设）明显背离。
AI.motivation: 自 2022 年底 ChatGPT 发布以来，公众与学界普遍担忧 LLM 生成文本会拖垮互联网的语义/风格多样性、事实准确性，甚至导致"死亡互联网理论"（Dead Internet Theory）所描述的异化。但两大障碍使这些问题长期无法验证：(1) 缺乏对"互联网上究竟有多少内容是 AI 生成"的量化认识；(2) 既有研究只覆盖社交媒体、新闻、学术出版、软件仓库、翻译等狭窄子集，从未在"整个互联网"尺度上分析过 AI 文本的影响，且 AI 文本检测本身存在长度、HTML 嵌入、模型族、版本、语言等多重鲁棒性挑战。论文还指出一个被忽视的层面：公众信念与客观测量之间可能存在系统性偏差，这一偏差本身会误导政策与治理决策。
AI.method: 研究设计为"测量 + 感知"双轨并行，包含三个研究问题。RQ1（公众认知）：通过 Prolific 招募 903 份有效问卷（853 名独立被试，按年龄/性别/族裔分层），用 7 点李克特量表检验研究团队通过环境扫描与主题分析提炼的六项假设，并记录 AI 使用频率与对 AI 社会影响的总体态度两个协变量。RQ2（规模测量）：沿用 Garg et al. (2025) 的纵向 URL 抽样法，从互联网档案馆 CDX 索引做多维分层抽样（首次存档时间、MIME 类型、URL 深度、顶级域名），覆盖 2022-08 至 2025-05 共 33 个月度桶（每月目标 10,000 URL），并施加与该文不同的改进：仅取 2022-01-01 后首次存档的 URL、硬性深度过滤（>3 路径段或 >2 查询参数）、严格"一域名一 URL"上限替代对数下采样、要求首次抓取返回 HTTP 200 且 text/html、月度桶内打乱以消除 ZipNum 字典序偏差；用 Trafilatura 抽取可见文本，取最长段落作为代表样本，剔除 <100 词文档并仅保留英文。检测器选型：在 Binoculars、Desklib、DivEye、Pangram v3 四者上做五维鲁棒性评估（1–500 词长度敏感性、纯文本 vs HTML 嵌入、GPT-4o/Claude/Gemini 模型族、davinci-002→GPT-4o 模型版本、英法日中西多语言），最终选定 Pangram v3（>50 词近乎完美、多语言与 HTML 双稳健、且提供"AI 生成/AI 辅助/人类"三分类的分数占比）。RQ3（假设检验）：以月度"聚合 AI 似然分数"（fraction_ai + fraction_ai_assisted）为自变量，对六个月度信号做 Pearson 相关检验（α=0.05）。六个可测量信号的量化方式为：语义收缩 = all-MiniLM-L6-v2 文档嵌入的月度平均两两余弦相似度；真相衰退 = GPT-4o-mini 抽取最多 5 条可核查主张 + 50 名 Prolific 人工核查（四类判定：Supported/Refuted/Not Enough Evidence/Conflicting Evidence，参考 FEVER 与 AVeriTeC，20% 重叠分配，用 Krippendorff's α 计算一致性），以 Refuted 占比为错误率；正向偏移 = cardiffnlp/twitter-roberta-base-sentiment-latest 的正向文档占比；认知孤岛 = 每千词外链密度（BeautifulSoup/lxml，去除 nav/footer/header/aside）；熵稀释 = Gzip 压缩比；风格单一化 = 字符 3-gram 集合的 Jaccard 平均相似度。
AI.result: 1) 普及率：ChatGPT 发布前（2022 年 8 月前）几乎为零，到 2025 年上半年单月新发布网站中约 35% 被判为 AI 生成或 AI 辅助，曲线呈持续上升。2) 假设检验：语义收缩成立（ρ=0.47, p=0.004），被预测为 AI 的网页平均语义相似度比非 AI 网页高 33%（0.0701 vs 0.0526）；正向情绪偏移成立（ρ=0.56, p=0.0003），AI 网页正向情感得分比非 AI 高 107%（0.7042 vs 0.3400）；真相衰退不成立（ρ=−0.19, p=0.27）；认知孤岛不成立（ρ=−0.12, p=0.48）；熵稀释不成立（ρ=−0.02, p=0.89）；风格单一化不成立（ρ=0.24, p=0.17）。3) 公众认知：多数美国成年人相信全部六项假设——风格单一化 83.0% 认同（最高）、真相衰退 75.1%、正向偏移 72.0%、认知孤岛 69.9%、语义收缩 60.9%、熵稀释 60.7%（最低），均值远高于两项获得数据支持的假设。4) 群体差异：低频/不使用 AI 者认同率 88.3% vs 高频使用者 76.2%（差 12.1 个百分点）；对 AI 总体持负面看法者认同率 91.3% vs 持正面/中性看法者 71.1%（差 20.2 个百分点）——即最易受影响的群体恰是最不熟悉 AI 的群体。5) 检测器对比：Binoculars 在 HTML 嵌入下检出率下降 11.4 个百分点且难检 Claude；DivEye 的纯文本与 HTML 分数分布完全无重叠、在多数非英语语言上无法区分人机文本；Desklib 在版本鲁棒性上优于 Pangram 但语言与 HTML 维度更弱；Pangram v3 唯一实现纯文本/HTML 完全重叠且多语言一致（对 davinci-002/babbage-002 等旧补全模型漏检，但研究者认为不构成实质威胁）。
AI.conclusion: AI 文本对互联网的即时宏观威胁主要是"认识论"而非"事实性"的：并非虚假信息爆炸，而是语义收缩（Overton 窗口收窄、LLM 输出被优化到训练分布均值附近）与"人工化乐观"的正向偏移（迎合性/过度乐观的 LLM 特性使话语被净化、异议被边缘化）。这一同质化主要由经济激励驱动而非协同操纵，其治理难点在于现有平台擅长治理仇恨言论等显性伤害，却缺乏衡量语义多样性与认识论质量的工具。同时，35% 的 AI 文本占比使"模型坍塌"从理论风险变为经验风险——基于当代网络语料预训练的基础模型不可避免摄入语义更贫乏的数据（后训练与对齐阶段受影响较小，因多用新生成或环境交互数据）。作者强调 AI 文本并非内在有害：它可赋能非母语者与不同识字水平者参与公共讨论、辅助文档摘要与低资源语言本地化。对策方面，事后检测存在根本局限（短文本不可解、置信度随时间漂移、文本水印易规避且多国已立法），因此应转向密码学验证人类来源（C2PA 类标准）并重新校准搜索/推荐算法以奖励语义多样性与可验证的真人创作。后续研究需关注多模态（尤其深度伪造图像的威胁路径不同）、跨世代递归反馈环下事实准确性是否恶化，以及区分"财务驱动的 AI 内容环境性泛滥"与"对抗性选举操纵"的有意攻击。（另注：摘要中称"全部四项假设"与正文六项假设不一致，应为摘要笔误。）

title: LLM-Enhanced Topical Trend Detection at Snapchat
summary: Automatic detection of topical trends at scale is both challenging and essential for maintaining a dynamic content ecosystem on social media platforms. In this work, we present a large-scale system for identifying emerging topical trends on Snapchat, one of the world's largest short-video social platforms. Our system integrates multimodal topic extraction, time-series burst detection, and LLM-based consolidation and enrichment to enable accurate and timely trend discovery. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first published end-to-end system for topical trend detection on short-video platforms at production scale. Continuous offline human evaluation over six months demonstrates high precision in identifying meaningful trends. The system has been deployed in production at global scale and applied to downstream surfaces including content ranking and search, driving measurable improvements in content freshness and user experience.

AI.tldr: Snapchat构建了业界首个端到端的短视频平台突发话题检测系统，融合多模态话题提取、时序爆发检测和LLM整合增强，经6个月离线评估验证高精确率，已在全球生产环境部署并应用于内容 ranking和搜索等下游场景，显著提升内容新鲜度和用户体验。
AI.motivation: Maintaining a dynamic content ecosystem on social media platforms requires automatic detection of topical trends at scale, which is both challenging and essential.
AI.method: Multimodal topic extraction + time-series burst detection + LLM-based consolidation and enrichment for trend discovery.
AI.result: High precision in identifying meaningful trends demonstrated through 6-month continuous offline human evaluation; system deployed globally with measurable improvements in downstream surfaces (content ranking, search).
AI.conclusion: First published end-to-end topical trend detection system at production scale on short-video platforms; validated by 6-month offline evaluation and real production deployment driving measurable improvements in content freshness and user experience.

title: Targeted Linguistic Analysis of Sign Language Models with Minimal Translation Pairs
summary: Models of sign language have historically lagged behind those for spoken language (text and speech). Recent work has greatly improved their performance on tasks like sign language translation and isolated sign recognition. However, it remains unclear to what extent existing models capture various linguistic phenomena of sign language, and how well they use cues from the multiple articulators used in sign language (hands, upper body, face). We introduce a new benchmark dataset for American Sign Language, ASL Minimal Translation Pairs (ASL-MTP), divided into multiple types of sign language phenomena and corresponding minimal pairs of translations, for performing such linguistic analyses. As a case study, we use ASL-MTP to analyze a state-of-the-art ASL-to-English translation model. We conduct a targeted analysis of the model by ablating various input cues during training and inference and evaluating on the phenomena in ASL-MTP. Our results show that, while the model performs above chance level on most of the phenomena, it relies strongly on manual cues while often missing crucial non-manual cues.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASL-MTP基准数据集用于分析美国手语翻译模型的语言学现象捕获能力，通过消融实验发现当前最先进模型过度依赖手势等手动线索，而忽视面部表情等非手动线索的重要性。
AI.motivation: 手语模型历来落后于口语模型（文本和语音），尽管近期在手语翻译和孤立手势识别任务上取得进展，但尚不清楚现有模型在多大程度上捕捉到手语的各类语言学现象，以及如何有效利用手语中多个发音器官（手、上半身、面部）的线索。
AI.method: 构建了ASL最小翻译对数据集（ASL-MTP），包含多种手语现象及对应的最小翻译对；通过消融实验分析最先进的ASL到英语翻译模型，在训练和推理阶段分别移除不同的输入线索（手部、上半身、面部等），评估模型在各现象上的表现。
AI.result: 模型在大多数语言学现象上的表现高于随机水平，但强烈依赖手动线索（如手部动作），而常常遗漏关键的非手动线索（如面部表情和上半身姿态）。
AI.conclusion: ASL-MTP基准数据集和消融分析揭示了当前最先进模型在处理美国手语翻译时的局限性，表明模型过度依赖手势等手动线索，而常常遗漏关键的非手势线索，这为改进手语翻译模型的鲁棒性提供了方向。

title: Detecting Clinical Discrepancies in Health Coaching Agents: A Dual-Stream Memory and Reconciliation Architecture
summary: As Large Language Model (LLM) agents transition from single-session tools to persistent systems managing longitudinal healthcare journeys, their memory architectures face a critical challenge: reconciling two imperfect sources of truth. The patient's evolving self-report is current but prone to recall bias, while the Electronic Health Record (EHR) is medically validated but frequently stale. General-purpose agent memory systems optimize for coherence by overwriting older facts with the user's latest statement, a pattern that risks safety failures when applied to clinical data. We introduce a Dual-Stream Memory Architecture that strictly separates the patient narrative from the structured clinical record (FHIR), governed by a dedicated Reconciliation Engine that evaluates every extracted memory against the patient's FHIR profile and classifies discrepancies by type, severity, and the specific FHIR resources involved. We evaluate this architecture on 26 patients across 675 longitudinal wellness coaching sessions, using a hybrid dataset that interleaves real provider-patient transcripts with synthetic, FHIR-grounded clinical scenarios. In isolated testing, the engine detects 84.4% of designed clinical discrepancies with 86.7% safety-critical recall. By coupling extraction and reconciliation evaluation on the same data, we directly quantify a 13.6% error cascade, tracing the degradation to clinical details lost during memory extraction from unstructured conversation rather than to downstream classification errors. These findings establish that validating patient-reported memories against clinical records is both feasible and necessary for safe deployment of longitudinal health agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向纵向健康教练 Agent 的"双流记忆架构"：将患者自述记忆与只读 FHIR 临床记录严格分离，并引入专门的调和引擎（Reconciliation Engine）逐条校验、标注差异类型/严重度/安全关键性及对应 FHIR 资源。在 26 名患者、675 次纵向会话（432 真实 UIC + 243 合成临床场景）上，隔离测试可检出 84.4% 的设计差异，安全关键召回 86.7%；端到端联测暴露 13.6% 的误差级联，瓶颈在记忆抽取而非下游分类。
AI.motivation: LLM Agent 正从单轮工具演变为管理长期健康旅程的持久系统，其记忆架构必须调和两个都不完美的事实来源：患者自述（最新但有回忆偏差）与电子病历 EHR/FHIR（医学验证但常陈旧不完整）。通用记忆系统（Generative Agents、MemGPT/Letta、Mem0、Zep 及 LoCoMo/LongMemEval/MemoryAgentBench 等评测）为追求对话连贯性而"以用户最新陈述覆盖旧事实"，在临床场景会导致安全失败（接受错误自述）或协议僵化（死守过期记录）。而现有临床 Agent 基准（FHIR-AgentBench、MedAgentBench 等）反过来把 EHR 当作绝对 ground truth，忽略了真实世界病历的时效性衰减与碎片化。传统临床调和（medication reconciliation）是医生在转诊/出院时发起的偶发性结构化工作，无法捕捉数周至数月闲聊中逐渐漂移的患者行为与健康状态；而高频互动的数字健康教练提供了"环境式后台调和"的天然场景。此外，多阶段临床 AI 流水线若只做端到端评估会掩盖失效来源。
AI.method: 问题形式化：在对话轮 t，将记忆分为叙事流 M_N（患者断言集合）与临床流 M_C（只读 FHIR R4 bundle，每个实体含值 v_j、本体 λ_j、时间元数据 ρ_j）。抽取函数 f_ext 从对话与当前记忆生成增量操作 ΔM_N^(t) ∈ {insert, update, delete}；调和函数 f_rec 将每条被改动的记忆与 M_C 比对，输出元组 R_i = (d, E_c, s, σ, ψ)，即是否差异、涉及 FHIR 资源集合、严重度（low/medium/high）、安全关键布尔标志、自然语言理由。架构细节：叙事流区分"稳定事实"（各自独立存储）与"演变状态"（原地更新并保留演变轨迹），通过提示约束、精确匹配守卫与内联 ID 路由实现去重；维护含 ID 的抽取视图与干净的分类视图；临床摘要压缩至约 1100–1600 tokens，含内联标签 [ResourceType] display [SYSTEM:CODE] 以支持资源级精确匹配。调和引擎用 LLM 时序推理考虑病历新鲜度（陈旧记录置信度低、过敏等持久约束高权威），输出四分类：agreement / contradiction / gap_patient / no_fhir，并以结构化 JSON 实现可复现测量。数据：UIC Virtual Coach 去标识化真实短信教练对话，按 4 小时窗口/48 小时上限切分为 3,665 轮、432 会话（26 患者）；由对话推断人口学参数，经 Synthea 生成每患者 50–100 候选 FHIR bundle，多因子打分选出 26 个（平均 26 条件、7 药物、47 操作、3 免疫）；用 Gemini 2.5 Pro 生成 243 个合成调和场景（83 个/34% 安全关键，引用 390 个 FHIR 资源、7 类资源），再经两段式管线（先有 FHIR 生成对话，再仅用对话抽真值记忆）并与真实会话按时间交织成 675 会话、951 真值记忆事件。评估三维度：① 抽取质量（GPT-4o 判定 match/partial/no_match，GPT-4.1 判 faithfulness/dedup）② 隔离调和（直接喂真值记忆，243 场景，指标含二值检测、资源知情检测、安全召回、严重度精确/±1 级、资源召回与精确率）③ 端到端耦合（用维度1同一批抽取记忆喂入调和，量化误差级联）。主模型 GPT-4o，合成数据用 Gemini 2.5 Pro，并以 GPT-5.4 做模型敏感性对比；另由两名数字健康领域专家做 104 个真值事件的人工校验（Gwet's AC1）。
AI.result: 维度1：真值召回 0.708（严格召回 0.262；match 25.2%/partial 44.7%/no-match 30.1%），faithfulness 4.8/5，deduplication 3.6/5（最弱项，目标追踪对话易冗余），最终生成 408 条记忆；抽取召回随患者轮数下降（r=-0.46, p=0.018）与随记忆数下降（r=-0.48, p=0.013）。人工校验：无事件被评为"Inaccurate"，100% 至少"部分准确"、99% 至少"有用"，仅 80 会话中 6 处范围内的信息漏抽。维度2（隔离）：检测率 84.4% [79.8, 88.9]，资源知情检测 76.5%，安全召回 86.7%，严重度±1 级 81.5% 但精确匹配仅 28.0%，资源召回 65.3%/精确率 71.2%；205 例检出中 14.1% 为 contradiction、85.9% 为 gap；各严重度检测率接近（低 84.0%、中 83.1%、高 86.8%）；资源类型上离散事实型最佳（AllergyIntolerance/Immunization 100%、MedicationRequest 89.1%），情境型较差（CarePlan 66.7%、Procedure 75.0%）。维度3（端到端）：检测率降至 70.8%（-13.6%，配对差 bootstrap 95% CI [8.6%, 18.9%]），资源知情检测 62.6%（-14.0%），安全召回 75.9%（-10.8%），严重度±1 级 67.1%，资源召回 51.4%；39 例损失中 10 例安全关键场景全部因抽取丢失临床细节（如把服药依从性合并进生活方式记忆而丢失药名），6 例反向增益源于抽取表述与真值不同；调和检测率与对话长度无显著相关（r=0.12, p=0.56），证明瓶颈在抽取/整合而非调和推理。特异度：432 真实会话 1,124 条判定中 83.3% no_fhir、16.6% gap、<1% agreement、零误报 contradiction。模型敏感性：GPT-5.4 抽取召回略低（0.674 vs 0.708）、faithfulness/dedup 更高（5.0/4.7），但检测 73.3% vs 84.4%、安全召回 80.7% vs 86.7%、资源知情 69.5% vs 76.5%，呈"更保守、误报少但漏报多"的精确率-召回率权衡，提示更新模型不自动改善临床检出。
AI.conclusion: 结论：健康 Agent 的记忆系统必须将患者自述记忆与临床记录隔离并在抽取时做调和；验证"患者自述 vs 临床记录"既可行（84.4% 检出、86.7% 安全召回、4.8/5 忠实度）又是纵向健康 Agent 安全部署的必要条件；多阶段临床 AI 需组件级评估，本工作直接测得 13.6% 误差级联并将其溯源至上游记忆抽取的细节丢失与随会话长度增长的整合衰减（后续可引入整合阶段的语义检索、仅喂入上下文相关先验记忆等扩展策略）；临床调和可作为模块化"环境式后台进程"叠加在既有的健康教练、慢病管理、患者导航等对话 Agent 上，不破坏主对话体验，输出按严重度分级并可溯源到具体 FHIR 资源，从而支持路由至医护团队、触发对话式澄清或记录待下次就诊。局限：FHIR bundle 由 Synthea 模糊匹配生成，严重度与安全标签由 LLM 生成而非临床裁定（故 severity/safety 指标需谨慎解读）；合成对话受教练范围约束，未必完全复现真实语音歧义；未评估检出后如何行动（何时告警 vs 何时追问），亦未在真实患者与真实 EHR 上做前瞻验证。

title: Step-level Optimization for Efficient Computer-use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents provide a promising path toward general software automation because they can interact directly with arbitrary graphical user interfaces instead of relying on brittle, application-specific integrations. Despite recent advances in benchmark performance, strong computer-use agents remain expensive and slow in practice, since most systems invoke large multimodal models at nearly every interaction step. We argue that this uniform allocation of compute is fundamentally inefficient for long-horizon GUI tasks. Such trajectories are highly heterogeneous: many steps are routine and can be handled reliably by smaller, cheaper policies, while errors tend to concentrate at a relatively small number of high-risk moments. Across computer-use benchmarks, these failures repeatedly take two forms: progress stalls, where the agent loops, repeats ineffective actions, or fails to make meaningful progress, and silent semantic drift, where the agent continues taking locally plausible actions after already deviating from the user's true goal. To address this inefficiency, we propose an event-driven, step-level cascade for computer-use agents that runs a small policy by default and escalates to a stronger model only when lightweight learned monitors detect elevated risk. Our framework combines two complementary signals: a Stuck Monitor that detects degraded progress from recent reasoning-action history and triggers recovery, and a Milestone Monitor that identifies semantically meaningful checkpoints where sparse verification is most informative for catching drift. This design turns always-on frontier-model inference into adaptive, on-demand compute allocation over the course of an evolving interaction. The framework is modular and deployment-oriented: it can be layered on top of existing computer-use agents without changing the underlying agent architecture or retraining the large model.

AI.tldr: 本文针对计算机使用智能体在长时序GUI任务中计算资源分配低效的问题，提出了一种事件驱动的步骤级联框架，通过Stuck Monitor和Milestone Monitor两种轻量级监控器实现自适应计算分配，在检测到高风险时升级模型，其余步骤使用小模型，从而在保证性能的同时提升效率。
AI.motivation: 当前计算机使用智能体在长时序GUI任务中效率低下，因为大多数系统几乎在每个交互步骤都调用大型多模态模型，而实际上这类任务的轨迹具有高度异质性——许多步骤是常规的可用小模型处理，错误主要集中在少数高风险时刻。
AI.method: 提出了一种事件驱动的步骤级联框架，默认运行小策略，仅在轻量级学习监控器检测到高风险时才升级到更强模型。该框架结合两类互补信号：Stuck Monitor（检测推理-动作历史中的进度退化）和Milestone Monitor（识别语义检查点进行稀疏验证）。
AI.result: 实现从"始终开启前沿模型推理"到"自适应按需计算分配"的范式转变，在保持任务完成质量的同时提升效率。
AI.conclusion: 该框架是模块化且面向部署的，可以叠加在现有计算机使用智能体之上，无需改变底层智能体架构或重新训练大模型，提供了一种自适应、按需分配计算资源的新范式。

title: Online Coloring for Graphs of Large Odd Girth
summary: We study the problem of online coloring for graphs with large odd girth. The best previously known algorithm uses $O(n^{1/2})$ colors, which was discovered by Kierstead in 1998. This algorithm works when the odd girth is 7 or more. In this paper, we provide the following: for every $\varepsilon > 0$, there exists a constant $g' \in \{3, 5, 7, \dots\}$ such that graphs with odd girth at least $g'$ can be deterministically colored online using $O(n^{\varepsilon})$ colors.

AI.tldr: This paper presents a deterministic online coloring algorithm for graphs with large odd girth that achieves O(n^ε) colors for any ε > 0, substantially improving upon Kierstead's 1998 O(n^(1/2)) bound.
AI.motivation: Online graph coloring is a fundamental problem in graph theory and algorithm design. The previous best result by Kierstead (1998) achieved O(n^(1/2)) colors for graphs with odd girth at least 7, leaving room for improvement in the color bound.
AI.method: The paper presents a deterministic online coloring algorithm that exploits properties of graphs with large odd girth to achieve the improved bounds.
AI.result: The paper provides an algorithm that can color graphs with odd girth at least some sufficiently large g' (depending on ε) using O(n^ε) colors, significantly improving the previous O(n^(1/2)) bound.
AI.conclusion: This work significantly improves upon Kierstead's O(n^(1/2)) bound by achieving O(n^ε) colors for sufficiently large odd girth, and is the first to achieve this sub-polynomial coloring bound for this problem class.

title: Exploring Sparse Matrix Multiplication Kernels on the Cerebras CS-3
summary:
In recent years, novel AI accelerators have emerged as promising alternatives to GPU for AI model training and inference tasks. One such accelerator, the Cerebras CS-3, achieves strong performance on large model training as well as scientific applications like molecular dynamics simulations. While dense compute workloads have been thoroughly explored for the CS-3, its potential for sparse workloads has not been fully examined. Applications requiring sparse linear algebra kernels, such as GNNs, linear solvers, and recommendation systems, could achieve good performance on a dataflow accelerator like the CS-3.
  In this work, we explore two key sparse linear algebra kernels, sparse-dense matrix multiplication (SpMM) and sampled dense-dense matrix multiplication (SDDMM), on the Cerebras CS-3. We propose low-level CS-3 kernel designs for these operations and optimize our designs to improve I/O performance, memory footprint, and scalability to large matrices. Our evaluation examines memory footprint and SpMM/SDDMM speedup relative to CPU. The evaluation suggests that the CS-3 can outperform CPU by 100$\times$ for SpMM with 90\% sparse matrices with performance improving as sparse matrix dimensionality increases. SDDMM on CS-3 can outperform CPU 20$\times$ for 90\% sparse matrices. We additionally find that as sparsity increases to beyond 99\%, the CS-3 suffers from performance degradation that makes it slower than CPU for SpMM.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了Cerebras CS-3加速器上的稀疏线性代数内核（SpMM和SDDMM），通过低层内核设计与优化，在保持良好I/O性能、内存占用和可扩展性的同时，实现了相比CPU最高100倍的性能提升。
AI.motivation: Cerebras CS-3在密集计算任务上表现优异，但在稀疏线性代数内核（如GNN、线性求解器、推荐系统所需）上的潜力尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出低层CS-3内核设计，优化I/O性能、内存占用和大矩阵可扩展性，并与CPU进行对比评估。
AI.result: CS-3对90%稀疏矩阵的SpMM任务实现约100倍加速，SDDMM实现约20倍加速；但极高稀疏度（>99%）会导致性能退化。
AI.conclusion: CS-3在90%稀疏度矩阵上SpMM比CPU快100倍、SDDMM快20倍；但当稀疏度超过99%时性能反而下降，甚至慢于CPU。

title: Self-Evolving Software Agents
summary: Autonomous agents can adapt their behaviour to changing environments, but remain bound to requirements, goals, and capabilities fixed at design time, preventing genuine software evolution. This paper introduces self-evolving software agents, combining BDI reasoning with LLMs to enable autonomous evolution of goals, reasoning, and executable code. We propose a BDI-LLM architecture in which an automated evolution module operates alongside the agent's reasoning loop, eliciting new requirements from experience and synthesizing corresponding design and code updates. A prototype evaluated in a dynamic multi-agent environment shows that agents can autonomously discover new goals and generate executable behaviours from minimal prior knowledge. The results indicate both the feasibility and current limits of LLM-driven evolution, particularly in terms of behavioural inheritance and stability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合BDI推理与LLM的自进化软件智能体架构，使智能体能够自主发现新目标、进化推理能力并生成可执行代码，突破传统智能体受限于设计时固定需求和目标的局限。
AI.motivation: 当前自主智能体虽能适应环境变化，但始终受限于设计时固定的 requirements、goals 和 capabilities，无法实现真正的软件进化。这限制了智能体在动态环境中持续成长和自主进化的能力。
AI.method: 提出 BDI-LLM 架构，其中自动化进化模块与智能体推理循环并行运行，负责从经验中提取新需求并合成相应的设计和代码更新。
AI.result: 在动态多智能体环境中的原型评估表明，智能体能够从最小先验知识出发自主发现新目标并生成可执行行为。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动的进化在技术上是可行的，但当前仍存在明显局限，特别是在行为继承和稳定性方面。

title: A Discipline-Agnostic AI Literacy Course for Academic Research: Architecture, Pedagogy, and Implementation
summary: The rapid integration of generative AI into academic workflows demands curricula that equip students not only with tool proficiency but with the critical judgment to use those tools responsibly in scholarly work. Existing offerings cluster around two inadequate poles: technical AI development courses serving narrow specialist audiences, and brief general-literacy interventions that cannot develop the sustained, practice-based competencies rigorous research requires. This paper reports the design, theoretical rationale, and implementation of BSTA 495/395: Getting Started with AI-Assisted Research, developed and delivered at Lehigh University (Spring 2026). The course addresses an underserved gap: the competencies required for rigorous AI-assisted literature review. Its architecture organizes instruction into four sequential modules aligned with the cognitive demands of that task: comprehension of individual papers, construction and validation of knowledge taxonomies, identification of research gaps, and synthesis and production of complete literature reviews. Each module embeds an explicit verification discipline and standardized AI attribution practice. Prerequisite-free and discipline-agnostic, the course enrolls upper-level undergraduates and graduate students across all fields with differentiated assessment expectations. Pre- and post-course survey data from the inaugural offering indicate substantial self-reported confidence gains, with the largest in hallucination detection (d = +1.45), responsible AI use (d = +1.33), and AI attribution practice (d = +2.40), consistent with the course's design emphasis. The course constitutes a replicable model for the emerging genre of AI research literacy curricula.

AI.tldr: 本研究介绍了一门在利哈伊大学开设的AI辅助研究入门课程，旨在填补现有AI素养教育的空白。课程围绕AI辅助文献综述的四个认知阶段组织，包含验证规范和AI归属实践。实证数据显示学生在关键能力上取得显著进步，可作为AI研究素养教育的可复制模型。
AI.motivation: 当前AI素养教育存在两极分化的问题：技术导向的AI开发课程受众狭窄，而通用素养培训过于简短，无法培养学生进行严谨研究所需的持续性、实践性能力。特别是AI辅助文献综述这一核心研究能力的系统性培训存在明显空白。
AI.method: 本研究采用课程开发与实证评估相结合的方法。课程架构设计为四个递进式模块，对应文献综述任务的认知需求：论文理解、知识分类体系构建、研究空白识别、文献综述合成与产出。每个模块嵌入明确的验证规范和标准化的AI归属实践。采用无先修要求、跨学科的设计，通过前后测问卷收集学生自信度变化数据。
AI.result: 前后测数据显示学生自信度显著提升，效果量最大的是AI归属实践（d=+2.40），其次是幻觉检测（d=+1.45）和负责任AI使用（d=+1.33），与课程设计重点高度吻合，验证了教学策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该课程为AI研究素养教育提供了一个可复制的模式，可供其他高等教育机构借鉴和推广。

title: RAQG-QPP: Query Performance Prediction with Retrieved Query Variants and Retrieval Augmented Query Generation
comment: Accepted manuscript. 27 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. To appear in ACM Transactions on Information Systems
summary: Query Performance Prediction (QPP) estimates the retrieval quality of ranking models without the use of any human-assessed relevance judgements, and finds applications in query-specific selective decision making to improve overall retrieval effectiveness. Although unsupervised QPP approaches are effective for lexical retrieval models, they usually perform weaker for neural rankers. Recent work shows that leveraging query variants (QVs), i.e., queries with potentially similar information needs to a given query, can enhance unsupervised QPP accuracy. However, existing QV-based prediction methods rely on query variants generated by term expansion of the input query, which is likely to yield incoherent, hallucinatory and off-topic QVs. In this paper, we propose to make use of queries retrieved from a log of past queries as QVs to be subsequently used for QPP. In addition to directly applying retrieved QVs in QPP, we further propose to leverage large language models (LLMs) to generate QVs conditioned on the retrieved QVs, thus mitigating the limitation of relying only on existing queries in a log. Experiments on TREC DL'19 and DL'20 show that QPP enhanced with RAQG outperform the best-performing existing QV-based prediction approach by as much as 30% on neural ranking models such as MonoT5.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用历史查询日志中的查询作为查询变体（QVs），并结合LLM生成新QVs以提升神经排序模型的查询性能预测（QPP）准确率，实验表明该方法较现有QV方法提升达30%。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督QPP方法对词汇检索模型有效，但对神经排序模型表现不佳；现有基于查询变体的预测方法依赖词级扩展，容易产生不连贯、幻觉或偏离主题的查询变体。
AI.method: 从历史查询日志中检索相似查询作为查询变体（QVs），并利用大语言模型（LLM）基于检索到的QVs进一步生成新的查询变体，从而弥补日志查询有限且可能稀疏的问题。
AI.result: 在TREC DL'19和DL'20数据集上，RAQG增强的QPP相比最佳现有QV方法，在MonoT5等神经排序模型上提升高达30%。
AI.conclusion: 基于日志检索查询变体（RAQG）结合LLM增强的方法，能有效提升神经排序模型（如MonoT5）的查询性能预测准确率，在TREC DL'19和DL'20数据集上最高提升30%，证明了日志查询和LLM结合在QPP任务中的有效性。

title: Instruction Complexity Induces Positional Collapse in Adversarial LLM Evaluation
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Pre-registered on OSF (osf.io/7p64)
summary: When instructed to underperform on multiple-choice evaluations, do language models engage with question content or fall back on positional shortcuts? We map the boundary between these regimes using a six-condition adversarial instruction-specificity gradient administered to two instruction-tuned LLMs (Llama-3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B) on 2,000 MMLU-Pro items. Distributional screening (response-position entropy) and an independent content-engagement criterion (difficulty-accuracy correlation) jointly characterise each condition. The gradient reveals three regimes rather than a monotonic transition. Vague adversarial instructions produce moderate accuracy reduction with preserved content engagement. Standard sandbagging and capability-imitation instructions produce positional entropy collapse with partial content engagement. A two-step answer-aware avoidance instruction produces extreme positional collapse, with near-total concentration on a single response position (99.9% and 87.4%) and no measurable content sensitivity. This was the only multi-step instruction tested, and it produced the most extreme shortcut. The attractor position matches each model's content-absent null-prompt default. The effect replicates across both models and four academic domains. Distributional collapse and content engagement can co-occur (50% concordance between screening criteria), indicating that entropy-based screening and difficulty-based content assessment capture partially independent dimensions of response validity. Results suggest that instruction complexity can determine whether adversarial compliance uses content-aware or content-blind mechanisms in small instruction-tuned LLMs under greedy decoding.

AI.tldr: 研究发现语言模型在对抗性指令下表现出三种不同的行为模式：内容感知、部分内容参与和极端位置捷径。指令复杂性是关键决定因素，而位置熵和内容敏感性测量捕获了部分独立的响应有效性维度。
AI.motivation: 当被指示在多项选择评估中表现不佳时，语言模型是真正理解问题内容，还是依赖位置捷径？这是理解模型对抗性行为的关键问题。
AI.method: 使用六条件对抗性指令特异性梯度测试两个指令微调LLM（Llama-3-8B和Llama-3.1-8B）的2000个MMLU-Pro项目。通过响应位置熵（分布筛选）和难度-准确率相关性（内容参与度）两个独立标准联合表征每个条件。
AI.result: 发现三个不同 regime 而非单调过渡：（1）模糊对抗指令导致中等准确率下降但保留内容参与；（2）标准沙袋和能力模仿指令导致位置熵崩溃，部分内容参与；（3）两步答案感知回避指令产生极端位置崩溃（99.9%和87.4%），近乎完全集中于单一位置，无内容敏感性。两种筛选标准之间仅有50%的一致性，表明它们捕获了部分独立的有效性维度。
AI.conclusion: 指令复杂性决定了小型指令微调LLM在贪婪解码下，对抗性compliance是否使用内容感知或内容盲机制。熵筛选与难度内容评估捕获了响应有效性的部分独立维度。

title: Learning to Forget: Continual Learning with Adaptive Weight Decay
summary: Continual learning agents with finite capacity must balance acquiring new knowledge with retaining the old. This requires controlled forgetting of knowledge that is no longer needed, freeing up capacity to learn. Weight decay, viewed as a mechanism for forgetting, can serve this role by gradually discarding information stored in the weights. However, a fixed scalar weight decay drives this forgetting uniformly over time and uniformly across all parameters, even when some encode stable knowledge while others track rapidly changing targets. We introduce Forgetting through Adaptive Decay (FADE), which adapts per-parameter weight decay rates online via approximate meta-gradient descent. We derive FADE for the online linear setting and apply it to the final layer of neural networks. Our empirical analysis shows that FADE automatically discovers distinct decay rates for different parameters, complements step-size adaptation, and consistently improves over fixed weight decay across online tracking and streaming classification problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FADE（Forgetting through Adaptive Decay），把权重衰减从固定标量正则项重新解读为在线"遗忘机制"，通过前向模式元梯度在训练中为每个参数自动学习衰减率 λ^i=exp(γ^i)。在在线线性回归上给出完整推导与在线算法，并推广到神经网络最后一层（输出层）配合 SGD/Adam，交叉熵版本亦有推导。实验涵盖线性跟踪、非线性师生跟踪、流式标签置换 EMNIST 三类非平稳任务：FADE+SGD 在非线性跟踪上误差约为 AdamW 的一半，在 EMNIST 上在线准确率 0.807，超过此前最佳的权重裁剪法 0.612，且对初始衰减率明显更鲁棒。附带发现"仅对输出头施加合适固定衰减"本身就是很强的基线。
AI.motivation: 在在线非平稳（数据单样本到达、不回放、任务边界未知）的持续学习场景中，有限容量的智能体必须在"学习新知识"与"保留旧知识"之间取得平衡，必须进行受控遗忘以释放容量。循环网络中的遗忘门机制只能作用于激活层的短期记忆，而存储在缓慢变化权重中的长期知识缺少对应的遗忘机制。权重衰减虽可视为一种遗忘机制，但传统使用中是全局固定标量，对所有参数、所有时间以同一速率遗忘：当某些参数编码稳定知识、另一些参数跟踪快速变化的目标时，统一衰减必然失配。已有自适应权重衰减工作（Ishii & Sato 2017、Nakamura & Hong 2019、Xie et al. 2023）均面向固定数据集的小批量训练与过拟合泛化问题，无法处理非平稳性。因此需要一个能按参数、按时间自动调整遗忘速率的机制。
AI.method:
核心方法 FADE：将每个参数的衰减率参数化为 λ^i = exp(γ^i)，元参数 γ^i 通过对损失做前向模式微分（forward-mode differentiation）并用 IDBD 式近似（假设改变 γ^i 主要影响 w^i 本身，忽略跨参数耦合）在线更新。

在线线性回归中的三条更新式：
(1) γ^i_{t+1} = γ^i_t + θ_λ·δ_t·x^i_t·g^i_t，λ^i_{t+1}=exp(γ^i_{t+1})；
(2) 敏感度迹 g^i_{t+1} = g^i_t·[1−λ^i_{t+1}−α(x^i_t)²]^+ − λ^i_{t+1}·w^i_t（g^i ≈ ∂w^i/∂γ^i，正部截断保证稳定）；
(3) 权重更新 w^i_{t+1} = (1−λ^i_{t+1})·w^i_t + α·δ_t·x^i_t。

附录 A.2 给出与 IDBD 的融合版本：α^i=exp(β^i) 也用元梯度自适应，需重推迹 h^i_{t+1}=h^i_t[1−λ^i−α^i(x^i)²]^+ + α^i δ x^i（与原 IDBD 相同，仅多出 λ 因子），说明"遗忘多少"与"学多快"可并行适应。附录 A.3 给出交叉熵/Softmax 扩展（迹中以 p^k(1−p^k)∈[0,0.25] 替换 (x^j)²），A.4 给出与 Adam 组合时的有效步长替换 α_eff = α/(√v̂+ε)，A.5 分析"衰减与步长耦合"（w=(1−α^iλ^i)w+α^iδx）的变体，说明耦合更新在两条迹中引入共享项 −α^iλ^i w^i 造成干扰。

神经网络场景：因最后一层对隐藏表示是线性的，FADE 仅施加于输出头，隐藏层使用标准优化器（SGD/Adam）。计算开销仅增加每参数两个标量状态（γ^i、g^i）与一个超参 θ_λ，保持每步 O(d)。
AI.result:
1) 线性跟踪（d=20，20 维输入，5 个相关权重每 20 步翻转符号，噪声 σ_n∈{0,1}，200K 步，10 seeds）：SGD 3.628/5.119，SGD+WD 2.726/4.087，IDBD 1.486/2.937，IDBD+WD 1.301/2.718，FADE 1.653/3.044，FADE+IDBD 最优 1.246±0.006 / 2.646±0.009。FADE 自发为无关特征发现 λ≈0.9（快速遗忘）、为相关特征发现 λ≈0.02（长记忆）。耦合变体略差（1.270/2.670）。

2) 非线性师生跟踪（教师 d=32、h=256 ReLU，20 个输出单元分快/慢/稳三类非平稳；2M 步，报告后 500K 步 MSE，5 seeds）：SGD 0.0168、SGD+WD 0.0167、Adam 0.0170、AdamW 0.0138、FADE+SGD 0.0073、FADE+Adam 0.0087。FADE+SGD 约为 AdamW 的一半。FADE 对快变输出提高衰减、对稳定输出降低衰减、慢变居中。敏感性上，固定衰减最好 0.0099、最差 0.0360，而 FADE 即使从最差初始化也能恢复到 0.0125。

3) 流式标签置换 EMNIST（47 类，每 2500 步重置换，5M 步/2000 任务，两隐层 MLP 300-150）：SGD 0.258、SGD+WD 0.335、Adam 0.119、AdamW 0.372、SGD+WClip 0.612、FADE+SGD 0.807±0.001、FADE+Adam 0.750±0.001。FADE 显著超过此前最佳方法权重裁剪。固定头衰减对初始 λ_0 极敏感（SGD 下 0.531~0.801），FADE 大幅收窄该差距（如 γ_0=−11.5 时从 0.531 提升至 0.750+）。

4) 扩展：部分标签置换（24 类标签固定）下 FADE+SGD 达 0.841，优于所有基线，且相对固定衰减的优势更明显（0.830/0.763 → 0.846/0.810）。把 FADE 朴素推广到所有层在 EMNIST 上仅得 0.535（高于固定 WD 的 0.335 但远低于仅头部的 0.807），且对初始化敏感，说明线性元梯度近似对隐藏层不足。
AI.conclusion: FADE 通过前向模式元梯度在线自适应每参数权重衰减率，把权重衰减从"纯正则项"转化为"可学习的遗忘机制"，能在交互中自动为不同参数发现差异化的遗忘速率，开销极小且在三类非平稳任务上稳定优于固定衰减。核心洞见是"仅对输出头施加合适的非零固定衰减"本身即是被忽视的强基线，说明网络不同部位应采用不同衰减率，FADE 正是在参数级自动化了这一原则。局限与未来方向：目前仅在最后一层严格成立，朴素地推广到全部层级效果不佳，需要形式化头部与隐藏层衰减率之间的相互作用并考虑层间非线性；还应设计对架构不变的元梯度近似，以便结合 LayerNorm 等结构改造并用于强化学习等天然非平稳场景。

title: Interval Orders, Biorders and Credibility-limited Belief Revision
summary: Rational belief revision is commonly viewed as being based on a preference order between possible worlds, with the resulting new belief set being those sentences true in all the most preferred models of the incoming new information. Usually, such a preference order is taken to be a total preorder. Nevertheless, there are other, more general classes of ordering that can also be employed. In this paper, we explore two such classes that have been studied within the theory of rational choice but have seen limited or no application in belief revision. We begin with interval orders, introduced by Fishburn in the '80s, which associate with each possible world a nonnegative `interval' of plausibility. We then move on to biorders, studied by Aleskerov, Bouyssou, and Monjardet, which generalise interval orders by allowing the intervals to have negative lengths, a feature that can be used to capture a notion of dissonance or instability. We provide axiomatic characterisations of these two resulting families of belief revision operators, as well as of two further families of interest that lie between interval orders and biorders. We show that while biorder-based revisions satisfy the Success postulate, they do not always yield consistent outputs. By modifying their definition to discard inputs that lead to inconsistency as `incredible', we derive new families of so-called non-prioritised revision that satisfy the Consistency postulate, but not the Success one. These families are linked to credibility-limited revision operators of Hansson et al., but for which the set of credible sentences does not satisfy the single-sentence closure condition. We argue that the biorder-based approach is well-suited for scenarios where an agent might initially reject new information, but may accept it when presented with additional explanation.

AI.tldr: Explores interval orders and biorders as alternatives to total preorders for rational belief revision. Biorder-based operators satisfy Success but may be inconsistent; modified non-prioritised versions achieve consistency at the cost of Success. The approach is suited for modeling agents who initially reject but later accept new information.
AI.motivation: Standard belief revision relies on total preorders, but more general ordering classes exist. The authors investigate interval orders (assigning plausibility intervals to worlds) and biorders (allowing negative-length intervals to capture dissonance/instability) as alternatives with potential applications in belief revision theory.
AI.method: Uses interval orders (Fishburn) and biorders (Aleskerov, Bouyssou, Monjardet) as alternative preference orderings for belief revision. Provides axiomatic characterisations of resulting operator families. Modifies biorder definitions to handle inconsistency by discarding "incredible" inputs.
AI.result: Interval orders and biorders yield different families of revision operators. Biorder-based revisions satisfy the Success postulate but may produce inconsistent outputs. Modified "non-prioritised" revision operators satisfy Consistency but not Success, linking to Hansson's credibility-limited revision but without the single-sentence closure condition.
AI.conclusion: The biorder-based approach is well-suited for scenarios where an agent might initially reject new information but may accept it when presented with additional explanation. This framework provides a more flexible model of belief revision that captures the dynamic nature of belief updating.

title: Average-Tree Phylogenetic Diversity Parameterized by Scanwidth and Invisibility
summary: We investigate parameterized algorithms for computing the average-tree phylogenetic diversity (APD) in rooted phylogenetic networks, studying the problem under different structural parameters that capture the deviation of a network from a tree. Our primary parameter is the scanwidth, a measure of the tree-likeness of a given directed acyclic graph. We show that a subset of taxa with maximum APD can be found in polynomial time in phylogenetic networks of scanwidth at most 2, but becomes NP-hard in networks of scanwidth 3. Further, we design an algorithm that computes the APD of a given set of taxa in O(2^sw n) time, where sw denotes the scanwidth and n the number of taxa in the input network. Finally, we give a linear-time algorithm for computing the APD of a given set of taxa if the network induced by these taxa is reticulation-visible. We generalize this algorithm to still run in polynomial time if each biconnected component of the induced network has only constantly many invisible reticulations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有根系统发育网络中"平均树系统发育多样性"(APD)的参数化计算。以 scanwidth(扫描宽度)为主要参数:Max-APD 在 scanwidth ≤ 2 的网络上多项式可解,但在 scanwidth ≤ 3(即使二元网络)时已 NP-hard;而计算给定分类单元集合的 APD 则可在 O(2^sw·n) 时间内完成。此外还给出 reticulation-visible 网络上的线性时间算法,并推广为按 biconnected component 中"不可见 reticulation 数"参数化的 FPT 算法。
AI.motivation: 生物多样性保护需要可计算的多样性度量来指导保护优先级。Faith 提出的系统发育多样性(PD)在树上高效可算,但杂交物种形成、水平基因转移、重组等网状演化事件使演化历史必须用有根系统发育网络(DAG)刻画,需推广到网络情形(如 average-tree PD)。已有结果:计算所有分类单元的 APD 是 #P-hard,仅有按 reticulation 数 r 参数化的 2^O(r) 算法;而参数应当捕捉"网络偏离树的程度",例如 scanwidth 这一较新的树状性度量,以获得更快算法并刻画复杂度边界。
AI.method: 预备知识:定义 rooted phylogenetic network(single source, 树点入度≤1、reticulation 入度≥2且出度≤1)、switching(每个 reticulation 只保留一条入边的树)及其概率 P(σ)、APD_N(Z)=Σ_σ P(σ)·PD_σ(Z)=Σ_{uv∈E} ω(uv)·φ_N(uv,Z),其中 φ 表示随机 switching 中边 uv 可达 Z 的概率;给出 scanwidth(tree-extension 宽度取 min)与 reticulation-visible、level 等结构参数。三部分:(1) 复杂性:由 Proposition 3(scanwidth≤1 ⟺ 树;scanwidth≤2 ⟺ level-1 网络)知 Max-APD 在 scanwidth≤2 上多项式可解(经 level 推广猜想);Theorem 4 通过从 unit-cost Noah's Ark Problem(带存活概率的期望 PD)归约,构造二元 scanwidth-3 网络(复制树 + 每叶四顶点 gadget α/β/δ/γ,reticulation 处继承概率 p_S(x) 与 1-p_S(x),权重 M-1、2M 等)证明 Max-APD 在二元 scanwidth≤3 网络上 NP-hard。(2) Theorem 5:给出 tree-extension 上的自底向上 DP:每个顶点 v 建两张表 p[v,Y] 与 d[v,Y],索引 Y ⊆ GW_Γ(v)(即"bag"),记录 (v,Y)-compatible switching 的概率与多样性;按 |Y ∩ E^{v-}| 分三种情形(≥2 → 0;=∅ → 组合子节点;= {uv} → 依继承概率加权并对出边子集 Z 求和),并引入辅助表 Q(不达叶)与 C(达叶)并按子节点序做 DP,避免枚举所有出边子集;表项总数 O(2^s·n),每个表项 O(1) 或 O(2^s) 时间,共 O(2^{sw}·n)。(3) 可见性:Lemma 9 给出 reticulation-visible 网络中 φ_N(uv,X_N) 的显式公式(可见点 φ=p_I(uv);否则 φ=1-∏_{r∈R_v}(1-Σ_{qr∈Q_r}p_I(qr))),配合删除 reticulation 后的树分量上自底向上组合,Theorem 10 得线性时间;Lemma 11 对不可见 reticulation 枚举 partial switching,Lemma 12 证明最底层 biconnected component 可分离计算(APD_N = APD_B + APD_{N'}),Theorem 13 得 O(m·max_C ∏_{r∈R_C} deg⁻(r)) 时间,在最大入度为常数时按"不可见 reticulation 数"为 FPT。
AI.result: (1) 复杂性刻画:Max-APD 在 scanwidth ≤ 2(等价 level-1)网络上多项式可解,但在二元网络 scanwidth ≤ 3 上 NP-hard(unit-cost NAP 归约,扫描宽度 3 由显式 tree-extension 证明);(2) Theorem 5:给定宽度 s 的 tree-extension,任意固定 taxa 集合的 APD 可在 O(2^s·n) 时间计算(含所有分类单元的情形),这是对 #P-hard 问题的 FPT 算法;(3) Theorem 10:reticulation-visible 网络上 APD 线性时间可算(推广了 Faith 的树上线性算法);(4) Theorem 13:按 biconnected component 分解,APD 可在 O(m·max_C ∏_{r∈R_C}deg⁻_N(r)) 时间计算,当入度有常数界时对每块中不可见 reticulation 数为 FPT(引入 invisibility level 参数)。
AI.conclusion: APD 的复杂度在 scanwidth 参数下呈现清晰边界:计算固定集合的 APD 是 scanwidth-FPT 的,但最大化版本在 scanwidth 3 即 NP-hard,说明"接近树"不足以保证优化可解(作者猜想 level 为常数的网络上 Max-APD 多项式可解)。另一方面,reticulation-visible 结构给出线性时间算法,并可按 biconnected component 中不可见 reticulation 数(配合有界入度)参数化为 FPT。后续方向:实现与实证评估、把算法改进到更小的 node-scanwidth、设计"可见性感知"的 scanwidth、在 orchard/tree-child/ultrametric 等特殊网络类上的 Max-APD 多项式可解性。

title: From Impermanent Loss to Sustainable Gain: Quantifying Profitability Zones for Liquidity Providers on DEX
summary: Decentralized Finance (DeFi) is a rapidly evolving segment of blockchain technology that enables a transformative approach to financial services through Web3 applications. By leveraging smart contracts, DeFi allows developers to build flexible and innovative financial instruments. Among the most prominent DeFi primitives by liquidity are decentralized exchange~(DEX) swap protocols~(such as Uniswap, Curve, and Balancer) that facilitate fast token-to-token exchanges. However, new exchange mechanisms also introduce new market inefficiencies that can be systematically exploited by arbitrageurs. This paper focuses on swap protocols based on the Automated Market Maker~(AMM), where the product of reserves is preserved as an invariant. We analyze the interaction between arbitrageurs and AMM liquidity pools and develop a mathematical model grounded in empirical pool configurations. Using this model, we derive bounds on the joint revenue of liquidity providers~(LPs) and arbitrageurs, propose a method to estimate the expected number of blocks until the occurrence of Impermanent Loss~(IL), and obtain a lower bound on the pool fee required to achieve a fixed target probability of staying in the Impermanent Gain (IG) zone within a block. The proposed framework extends existing LP risk-assessment methodologies by quantifying symbiotic profitability zones, providing a principled basis for fee selection that aligns LP-arbitrageur incentives and enhances market stability.

AI.tldr: 本文针对基于AMM的去中心化交易所协议，建立数学模型分析套利者与流动性池交互，量化LP-套利者共生盈利区间，为费率选择提供系统性依据。
AI.motivation: 新型去中心化交易所机制引入了可被套利者系统性利用的市场低效问题，LP面临无常损失风险，需要系统性方法来量化LP-套利者共生关系并指导费用设置。
AI.method: 基于经验池配置数据建立数学模型，分析套利者与AMM流动性池之间的交互作用。
AI.result: 推导了LP与套利者联合收益边界；提出了估算无常损失发生前预期区块数的方法；获得了实现目标 Impermanent Gain 概率所需的池子费率下界。
AI.conclusion: 提出框架扩展了现有LP风险评估方法，通过量化共生盈利区间，为费用选择提供原则性依据，以协调LP-套利者激励并增强市场稳定性。

title: To Diff or Not to Diff? Structure-Aware and Adaptive Output Formats for Efficient LLM-based Code Editing
comment: Accepted in the Findings of ACL 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code editing, yet the prevalent full-code generation paradigm suffers from severe efficiency bottlenecks, posing challenges for interactive coding assistants that demand low latency and cost. Despite the predominant focus on scaling model capabilities, the edit format itself has been largely overlooked in model training. In this paper, we begin with a systematic study of conventional diff formats and reveal that fragile offsets and fragmented hunks make generation highly unnatural for LLMs. To address it, we introduce BlockDiff and FuncDiff, two structure-aware diff formats that represent changes as block-level rewrites of syntactically coherent units such as control structures and functions. Furthermore, we propose AdaEdit, a general adaptive edit strategy that trains LLMs to dynamically choose the most token-efficient format between a given diff format and full code. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AdaEdit paired with structure-aware diff formats consistently matches the accuracy of full-code generation, while reducing both latency and cost by over 30% on long-code editing tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了传统 diff 格式在 LLM 代码编辑中的固有缺陷（行号索引脆弱、hunk 碎片化破坏语法完整性），提出两种基于 AST 的结构感知 diff 格式 BlockDiff 与 FuncDiff，并将二者与自适应策略 AdaEdit（训练模型在"diff 表示"与"全代码生成"间自动选择 token 更省者）结合。实验显示，在 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B/14B、DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B 上，AdaEdit + 结构感知 diff 的 pass@1 与全代码生成持平甚至更优（如 Qwen2.5-Coder-14B 上 FuncDiff 64.89% vs FullCode 63.89%），在长代码编辑（输入 >300 token）上延迟与成本降低超过 30%，且格式选择准确率 >90%。
AI.motivation: LLM 已被广泛用于代码编辑（IDE 中的 next-edit suggestion、代码修复等），但主流范式是"全代码生成"（full-code generation）：即使只做微小修改也重写整个文件。这带来三方面问题：(1) 输出大量冗余 token，导致高延迟与高 API 成本，难以满足交互式编码助手的实时性要求；(2) 增加引入非预期修改的风险；(3) 社区长期聚焦"扩展模型能力"（scaling）以提高编辑准确率，却忽视了"编辑格式（edit format）"本身这一未被研究的效率杠杆。已有的替代格式探索（如 unified diff 变体、search/replace 风格）主要停留在 prompt 层面、依赖强指令跟随能力，缺乏基于训练的系统性研究。此外，GumTree 等 AST 符号级 diff 工具需要专用 DSL，与 LLM 的自回归文本生成范式不匹配，且会丢弃空格与注释等非语义修改，无法保证文本级精确重建。
AI.method:
**1）形式化定义**：将编辑格式定义为互补函数对 (Diff, Patch)，满足重建恒等式 Patch(C, Diff(C, C')) = C'；全代码生成是 Diff(C,C')=C' 的特例，Patch 为恒等映射。格式学习即在数据集 S={(I_j, C_j, C'_j)} 上令 E_j = Diff(C_j, C'_j)，最小化 token 级交叉熵损失。

**2）传统 diff 格式的系统性研究**：
- 数字索引类：MinUniDiff（无上下文行）、UniDiff（3 行上下文），并各设"w/ numbers"变体（给源码加行号辅助）。为鲁棒性自研 patch 工具，绕过标准一致性校验、仅按行号定位。结果显示所有数字索引格式准确率远低于全代码基线——LLM 难以生成精确行号/偏移，即使输入已编号也无济于事。
- 内容寻址类：MinContentDiff（迭代添加上下上下文行直到锚点唯一）、ContentDiff（至少 3 行上下文）。相比数字索引明显提升，但仍低于全代码基线；归因于"碎片化 hunk"——由任意行片段构成的 hunk 对以完整代码预训练的 LLM 极其不自然。

**3）结构感知 diff 格式 BlockDiff / FuncDiff**：
- 块树构建：用 tree-sitter 解析 AST，构造包含细粒度节点（分支、循环、上下文块等控制结构与函数）、粗粒度节点（类）与 root 节点的层次；细粒度节点之外的连续行（如 import 语句、语法错误片段）被封装为特殊细粒度节点，以避免局部修改被提升到粗粒度父节点。
- 粒度：BlockDiff 允许任意细粒度节点级编辑（最省 token）；FuncDiff 忽略控制结构、偏好函数级（结构更稳定）。
- Diff 生成：先计算 MinUniDiff 覆盖全部文本差异；将每个 hunk 映射到块树——纯插入映射到包含插入位置的最小节点；含删除的 hunk 映射到共同覆盖所有被删行的最小连续块节点集合；随后做锚点扩展（先并入相邻兄弟节点，再扩到父节点，直到锚点内容在源码中唯一，必要时扩至 root 视为全文替换）；最后自底向上迭代合并——先合并行级重叠的 hunk，再把落在同一细粒度节点内的多个 hunk 合并到其共同父节点，把碎片化修改呈现为一次逻辑编辑。
- Patching：纯文本搜索替换，不做 AST 解析；按锚点定位区域后执行删除/插入；锚点唯一性失败（0 匹配或多匹配）视为 patch 失败；引入容错机制，精确匹配失败时逐步放宽空白与空行约束。

**4）AdaEdit 自适应策略**：diff 格式的效率与改动范围绑定，当改动分散/广泛时 hunk 锚点开销可能超过全代码重写。因此在训练集上对每个样本计算 diff 表示与完整目标代码的 token 数，取较短者作为新的监督标签 E_j = argmin_{S∈{C'_j, Diff(C_j,C'_j)}} |S|，用 SFT 让模型隐式内化"哪种格式更省 token"的切换逻辑。推理时对 AdaEdit 仅给出最小前缀"```"，让模型自己先输出格式标识再输出内容。

**5）Hunk 风格消融**：比较 hunk rewrite（直接给出重写后的目标块）、unified-diff-like（含上下文的交织风格）、search/replace（带分隔符）三种。交织风格因未变更上下文行干扰模型而准确率大幅下降；search/replace 与 hunk rewrite 精度相当但存在分隔符与源码字符冲突导致灾难性 patch 失败的可靠性风险，故统一采用 hunk rewrite。

**6）实验设置**：训练集为 OCEData（主，59,091 条）、InstructCoder（101,715 条）、CommitPackFT 的 JavaScript 子集（52,142 条）；评测基准为 EditEval、CanItEdit（显式指令）、HumanEvalFix、Aider-1/Aider-2（隐式意图/修复）；基座模型为 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B/14B 与 DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B，全部做全参数 SFT（3 epoch、AdamW、cosine、峰值 lr 3e-5、warmup 0.1、8×A100、FSDP2+序列并行、有效 batch 256、最大序列长 4096）。指标：pass@1（20 样本、temperature 0.2、top-p 0.95）、patch 应用成功率、pylint 严格检查通过率；延迟采用类 "First Meaningful Paint" 的定义（首个可渲染输出的 token 数：全代码需生成完毕，diff 只需完成首个 hunk），成本为完整输出 token 数。
AI.result:
**（1）传统 diff 的结论**：Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 上，FullCode 平均 57.07%，而 MinUniDiff 仅 14.07%（w/ numbers 31.13%）、UniDiff 33.15%（w/ numbers 37.66%）、MinContentDiff 45.68%、ContentDiff 54.43%。DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B 与 Qwen2.5-Coder-14B 上趋势一致——数字索引格式远低于全代码基线，内容寻址格式有所改善但仍不及全代码，验证"脆弱偏移"与"碎片化 hunk"两个失效机理。

**（2）结构感知格式有效**：BlockDiff/FuncDiff 在所有基座模型上稳定优于行级 ContentDiff。Qwen2.5-Coder-7B：BlockDiff 55.98%、FuncDiff 57.32%，已接近/略超 FullCode 57.07%；14B 上 FuncDiff 64.89% 超过 FullCode 63.89%（BlockDiff 64.11% 亦超）；DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B 上 FuncDiff 50.79% 接近 FullCode 52.21%。FuncDiff 在 diff 格式中普遍最优，说明结构化收益依赖模型能力（规模越大收益越明显）。

**（3）AdaEdit 稳定且提升准确率**：Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 上 FuncDiff w/ AdaEdit 平均 57.95%、BlockDiff w/ AdaEdit 57.61%，均优于对应固定格式与 FullCode；在 CanItEdit、Aider 等复杂任务上增益最明显（如 CanItEdit 52.67% vs FullCode 53.17% 接近）。

**（4）效率**：纯 diff 格式在短代码上无延迟优势甚至更差（ContentDiff 平均延迟超过 FullCode），因锚点内容占比过高；AdaEdit 始终位于"延迟-准确率"平面的左上角。成本随代码长度分析显示：FullCode 成本与代码长度成正比；FuncDiff 在短码上因函数级锚点开销大，长码上逐渐反超；AdaEdit 在各尺度均取得最优，长代码任务上延迟与成本降低超过 30%。CanItEdit 中输入 >300 token 的 80 条子集上，FullCode 成本 648.30 token、pass@1 39.75%；FuncDiff w/ AdaEdit 成本 481.63 token、pass@1 40.69%；BlockDiff w/ AdaEdit 466.04 token；ContentDiff w/ AdaEdit 432.73 token——即准确率不降反微升、成本显著下降。

**（5）可用性**：ContentDiff 频繁 patch 失败（锚点不唯一）；数字索引格式因绕过一致性校验而"看似"成功率高，但 pylint 严格检查暴露大量代码损坏；结构感知格式在严格 lint 下可用性排序与准确率一致，优于 ContentDiff。

**（6）格式选择机制可靠性**：AdaEdit（Qwen2.5-Coder-7B + BlockDiff）的选择准确率 91.02%，容忍 20% token 偏差时 >95%，"无有效修改"仅 0.67%；而 few-shot 推理下 GPT-5 仅 56.51%、Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 50.41%、DeepSeek-V3.2 25.34%（后者"无变化"率高达 57.85%），证明 LLM 本身不内蕴成本-收益判断，AdaEdit 的训练式内化是必要的。

**（7）泛化性**：换用 InstructCoder 训练，绝对分数下降但格式间相对关系高度一致（FuncDiff w/AdaEdit 52.59% 仍为最高）；JavaScript 上结构感知格式优势更明显，FuncDiff w/AdaEdit 达 67.74%，超过 FullCode 66.13%，而 ContentDiff 仅 56.55%。

**（8）工程开销**：diff 生成平均 3.40e-3 秒、patch 平均 7.57e-5 秒，用户感知几乎瞬时；对超 10,000 行的大型 Python 文件计算 BlockDiff 仅需 0.3 秒（其中块树构建 0.28 秒）。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是把"编辑格式"确立为与模型能力同等重要的效率杠杆：LLM 代码编辑不宜一律采用全代码生成，也不宜直接套用传统 diff，而应使用与代码结构对齐、语法连贯的块级重写表示，并让模型自适应地在"diff"与"全代码"之间按 token 成本切换。BlockDiff 与 FuncDiff 通过 AST 块树把修改对齐到语法一致单元，恢复了生成的自然性，从而弥合了传统 diff 与全代码之间的准确率差距；AdaEdit 则通过以"token 更省的表示"作为 SFT 标签，把成本-收益决策内化进模型，弥补了 LLM（包括 GPT-5 等强模型）天生缺失的格式选择能力。结论性证据是：AdaEdit + 结构感知 diff 在多基座模型、多训练集、多语言、多基准上均达到或超过全代码生成的准确率，同时在长代码编辑上降低 30% 以上的延迟与成本，为低成本交互式编码助手提供了可行路径。局限与展望：收益强依赖基座模型能力（越大越明显）；高质量长代码/仓库级编辑训练数据严重匮乏；diff 表示仍存在 patch 失败与代码损坏的固有风险，部署时须严格校验；未来方向包括以可验证奖励（RLVR）在功能正确性与 token 效率间做权衡以超越当前的冷启动 SFT，以及探索超越固定 AST 边界的"流式粒度"语义聚合变更（需更复杂的 diff/patch 架构）。代码开源于 github.com/nju-websoft/AdaEdit。

title: Addressing the Reality Gap: A Three-Tension Framework for Agentic AI Adoption
comment: This is a preprint version of an edited book chapter to appear in Mayrath, M., J. Behrens, D. Robinson, (eds) (2026). Handbook of Generative AI in Education: Integrating Research into Practice, Springer
summary: Generative AI has rapidly entered education through free consumer tools, outpacing the ability of schools and universities to respond. Now a new wave of more autonomous agentic AI systems--with the capacity to plan and act towards goals--promises both greater educational personalization and greater disruption. This chapter argues that successfully navigating these innovations requires balancing three core tensions: (1) Implementation Feasibility, or the practical capacity to integrate AI sustainably into real classrooms; (2) Adaptation Speed, or the mismatch between fast-evolving AI capabilities and the slower pace of educational change; and (3) Mission Alignment, or the need to ensure AI applications uphold educational values such as equity, privacy, and pedagogical integrity. First, we review early evidence of generative and agentic AI in various sectors and in frontline education to illustrate these tensions in context. Then, we present a three-tension framework to guide decision-makers in evaluating and designing AI initiatives across K-12 and higher education. We provide examples of how the framework can be applied to plan responsible AI deployments, and we identify emerging trends--such as curriculum-linked AI agents and educator-informed AI design--along with open research directions. We conclude the chapter with recommendations for educational leaders to proactively engage with the opportunities and challenges of AI, so that this technology can be harnessed to enhance teaching and learning in the decade ahead.

AI.tldr: 该章节探讨了教育领域AI应用面临的三重张力——实施可行性、适应速度和使命一致性，并提出相应框架以指导K-12和高等教育的AI决策，旨在帮助教育领导者把握生成式和Agentic AI带来的机遇，同时应对其带来的挑战。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI已快速进入教育领域，但学校和大学的应对能力滞后。更重要的是，新一代更具自主性的Agentic AI系统即将到来，既带来个性化教育的机遇，也带来更大 disruption 的风险。
AI.method: 首先回顾生成式AI和Agentic AI在各行业及教育一线应用的早期证据，然后提出三张力框架来指导K-12和高等教育的AI决策与设计。
AI.result: 提出三张力分析框架（实施可行性、适应速度、使命一致性），并展示了如何应用该框架进行负责任的AI部署规划，同时识别了课程链接型AI Agent和教育者参与AI设计等新兴趋势。
AI.conclusion: 教育领导者应主动把握AI机遇与挑战，确保技术服务于教学与学习的提升。

title: NuggetIndex: Governed Atomic Retrieval for Maintainable RAG
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems are frequently evaluated via fact-based metrics, yet standard implementations retrieve passages or static propositions. This unit mismatch between evaluation and retrieval objects hinders maintenance when corpora evolve and fails to capture superseded facts or source disagreements. We propose NuggetIndex, a retrieval system that stores atomic information units as managed records, so called nuggets. Each record maintains links to evidence, a temporal validity interval, and a lifecycle state. By filtering invalid or deprecated nuggets prior to ranking, the system prevents the inclusion of outdated information. We evaluate the approach using a nuggetized MS MARCO subset, a temporal Wikipedia QA dataset, and a multi-hop QA task. Against passage and unmanaged proposition retrieval baselines, NuggetIndex improves nugget recall by 42%, increases temporal correctness by 9 percentage points without the recall collapse observed in time-filtered baselines, and reduces conflict rates by 55%. The compact nugget format reduces generator input length by 64% while enabling lightweight index structures suitable for browser-based and resource-constrained deployment. We release our implementation, datasets, and evaluation scripts

AI.tldr: 本文提出NuggetIndex，一种通过存储原子信息单元（称为nuggets）来解决RAG系统中检索与评估单元不匹配问题的检索系统。nuggets包含证据链接、时间有效性和生命周期状态，可有效过滤过时信息。在多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著提升了召回率、时间正确性，并降低了冲突率，同时保持了紧凑的索引结构。
AI.motivation: 当前RAG系统在检索对象与评估对象之间存在单元不匹配问题：系统以段落或静态命题作为检索单元，却以事实级指标进行评估。这种不匹配导致：1）语料更新时维护困难；2）无法捕获过时事实；3）无法反映信息源之间的分歧。
AI.method: 提出NuggetIndex检索系统，将原子信息存储为称为"nuggets"的托管记录。每条记录维护证据链接、时间有效性间隔和生命周期状态，在排序前过滤无效或已废弃的nuggets。
AI.result: 相比段落检索和无管理命题检索基线：nugget召回率提升42%；时间正确性提高9个百分点且未出现时间过滤基线中的召回率崩溃；冲突率降低55%。nugget格式使生成器输入长度减少64%，同时支持轻量级索引结构。
AI.conclusion: NuggetIndex通过将原子信息单元作为托管记录存储，实现了检索对象与评估对象的一致性。实验表明该方法在多个指标上显著优于基线系统，同时保持了紧凑的索引结构和广泛的应用兼容性。

title: Compliance versus Sensibility: On the Reasoning Controllability in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are known to acquire reasoning capabilities through shared inference patterns in pre-training data, which are further elicited via Chain-of-Thought (CoT) practices. However, whether fundamental reasoning patterns, such as induction, deduction, and abduction, can be decoupled from specific problem instances remains a critical challenge for model controllability, and for shedding light on reasoning controllability. In this paper, we present the first systematic investigation of this problem through the lens of reasoning conflicts: an explicit tension between parametric and contextual information induced by mandating logical schemata that deviate from those expected for a target task. Our evaluation reveals that LLMs consistently prioritize sensibility over compliance, favoring task-appropriate reasoning patterns despite conflicting instructions. Notably, task accuracy is not strictly determined by sensibility, with models often maintaining high performance even when using conflicting patterns, suggesting a reliance on internalized parametric memory that increases with model size. We further demonstrate that reasoning conflicts are internally detectable, as confidence scores significantly drop during conflicting episodes. Probing experiments confirm that reasoning types are linearly encoded from middle-to-late layers, indicating the potential for activation-level controllability. Leveraging these insights, we steer models towards compliance, increasing instruction following by up to 29%. Overall, our findings establish that while LLM reasoning is anchored to concrete instances, active mechanistic interventions can effectively decouple logical schemata from data, offering a path toward improved controllability, faithfulness, and generalizability.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次系统性地探讨了大语言模型（LLM）中基础推理模式（归纳、演绎、溯因）能否从具体问题实例中解耦的问题。通过构建"推理冲突"（即诱导偏离任务预期的逻辑模式），研究发现：LLM优先考虑推理的合理性而非指令遵从性；推理准确性不完全由合理性决定，模型规模越大越依赖内部参数化记忆；推理冲突可通过置信度下降检测；推理类型在前中至后层呈线性编码；激活级干预可将指令遵从率提升至29%。
AI.motivation: Whether fundamental reasoning patterns (induction, deduction, abduction) can be decoupled from specific problem instances remains a critical challenge for model controllability and reasoning generalizability.
AI.method: Systematic investigation through "reasoning conflicts" — explicit tensions between parametric and contextual information induced by mandating logical schemata that deviate from those expected for a target task. Includes confidence score analysis, layer-wise probing, and activation-level steering experiments.
AI.result: 1) LLMs consistently prioritize sensibility over compliance, favoring task-appropriate reasoning despite conflicting instructions; 2) Task accuracy is not strictly determined by sensibility — models maintain high performance with conflicting patterns, suggesting reliance on internalized parametric memory that increases with model size; 3) Reasoning conflicts are internally detectable via confidence score drops; 4) Reasoning types are linearly encoded from middle-to-late layers; 5) Activation-level steering increases instruction following by up to 29%.
AI.conclusion: LLM reasoning is anchored to concrete instances, but active mechanistic interventions can effectively decouple logical schemata from data, offering a path toward improved controllability, faithfulness, and generalizability.

title: Learning Rate Transfer in Normalized Transformers
summary: The Normalized Transformer, or nGPT (arXiv:2410.01131) achieves impressive training speedups and does not require weight decay or learning rate warmup. However, despite having hyperparameters that explicitly scale with model size, we observe that nGPT does not exhibit learning rate transfer across model dimension and token horizon. To rectify this, we combine numerical experiments with a principled use of alignment exponents (arXiv:2407.05872) to revisit and modify the $μ$P approach to hyperparameter transfer (arXiv:2011.14522). The result is a novel nGPT parameterization we call $ν$GPT. Through extensive empirical validation, we find $ν$GPT exhibits learning rate transfer across width, depth, and token horizon.

AI.tldr: 本文针对nGPT无法实现跨模型维度和token跨度的学习率迁移问题，结合对齐指数和改进的μP方法提出了νGPT参数化方案，实现了跨宽度、深度和token范围的学习率迁移。
AI.motivation: nGPT, despite achieving training speedups, fails to exhibit learning rate transfer across model dimension and token horizon, limiting its scalability and transferability of hyperparameters.
AI.method: Combining alignment exponents with a modified μP approach to hyperparameter transfer, introducing a novel nGPT parameterization called νGPT.
AI.result: νGPT successfully achieves learning rate transfer across width, depth, and token horizon through extensive empirical validation.
AI.conclusion: νGPT exhibits learning rate transfer across width, depth, and token horizon.

title: Evaluating TabPFN for Mild Cognitive Impairment to Alzheimer's Disease Conversion in Data Limited Settings
summary: Accurate prediction of conversion from Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) to Alzheimers Diseases (AD) is essential for early intervention, however, developing reliable conversion predictive models is difficult to develop due to limited longitudinal data availability We evaluate TabPFN (Tabular Pre-Trained Foundation Network) against traditional machine learning methods for predicting 3 year MCI to AD conversion using the TADPOLE dataset derived from ADNI. Using multimodal biomarker features extracted from demographics, APOE4, MRI volumes, CSF markers, and PET imaging, we conducted an experimental comparison across varying training set sizes (N=50 to 1000) and models including XGBoost, Random Forest, LightGBM, and Logistic Regression. TabPFN achieved one the highest performance (AUC=0.892), outperforming LightGBM (AUC=0.860) and demonstrating advantages in low data settings. At N=50 training samples, TabPFN maintained strong AUC while the traditional machine learning models struggles at small training samples. These findings demonstrate that foundation models are promising for disease prediction in data limited scenarios, such as Alzheimers diseases.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，预训练基础模型TabPFN在有限数据条件下可有效预测MCI向AD的转化，为阿尔茨海默病早期预测提供了新的技术方案。
AI.motivation: MCI向AD的准确转化预测对早期干预至关重要，但因纵向数据有限，传统预测模型开发面临挑战。
AI.method: 研究采用TADPOLE数据集，利用多模态生物标志物（人口统计学特征、APOE4基因、MRI体积、CSF标志物、PET成像），在训练样本量N=50至1000范围内，对比TabPFN与XGBoost、Random Forest、LightGBM、Logistic Regression等传统机器学习模型的3年MCI转AD预测性能。
AI.result: TabPFN取得最高性能（AUC=0.892），优于LightGBM（AUC=0.860）。在小样本场景（N=50）下，TabPFN仍维持较高的AUC表现，而传统机器学习模型则出现明显性能下降。
AI.conclusion: TabPFN作为表格数据预训练基础模型，在小样本场景下展现出独特优势，为数据受限的疾病预测任务提供了新的解决思路。

title: Temporal Routing in Static Networks: The Schedule Completion Problem
summary: We introduce the TemporallyEdgeDisjointScheduleCompletion (TEDSC) problem in which we need to cover a set of temporal edge demands $D$ by routing $k$ temporal walks through a directed static graph while remaining temporally edge disjoint. This problem combines the temporal aspects of train routing and passenger demands with the static nature of real-world rail networks. We present a polynomial time algorithm for TEDSC. Motivated by real world constraints, we next investigate two restricted variants of TEDSC in which each walk can only travel for some bounded distance or time $h$. We show that both are tractable when parameterized by $k + h$, but hard for $h$ and $k + |D|$. If we fix the underlying network, the two problems exhibit distinct complexities: The distance variant remains $W[1]$-hard parameterized by $k$ even on a path of three vertices whereas the time variant admits an FPT algorithm on any fixed star. Finally, we show how to approximate the number of required walks up to a factor of $(2-h^{-1})$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“时序边不相交调度补全”TEDSC 问题：在静态有向图上路由 k 条时序游走以覆盖一组时序边需求，且各走法之间在时序上边不相交。作者给出 TEDSC 的多项式时间精确算法；进一步考虑每条游走最多行走距离或时间 h 的两个受限变体，证明它们在参数 k+h 下可解（FPT），但在 h 以及 k+|D| 参数化下困难；若底层网络固定，两个变体复杂度分离：距离变体即使在仅含 3 个顶点的路径上仍对参数 k 是 W[1]-难的，而时间变体在任意固定星图上存在 FPT 算法；最后给出所需游走条数 (2−1/h) 因子的近似算法。
AI.motivation: 现实铁路网络中，列车调度需要以静态轨道网络（静态有向图）承载随时间变化的乘客/货运需求（时序边需求），并要求多列车走法互不冲突（时序边不相交），同时单列车单次运行受限于最大里程或运行时长 h。作者希望通过形式化这一组合问题，为铁路运力配置与调度提供理论依据与算法工具。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义 TEDSC：给定静态有向图 G、时序边需求集合 D（每个需求带有可用时间窗口/时刻）与整数 k，问是否存在 k 条时序游走覆盖全部需求且两两时序边不相交。2) 给出 TEDSC 的多项式时间算法（基于时序需求的“最早/最晚”可行区间与边不相交条件，通过贪心/流式构造得到 k 条时序游走）。3) 定义两个有界变体：TEDSC-distance（每条游走总行走距离 ≤ h）与 TEDSC-time（每条游走总运行时间 ≤ h）。4) 参数化复杂度分析：证明两变体关于参数 k+h 是 FPT（通过把 h 作为有界搜索空间做动态规划/状态空间枚举），并证明关于 h 单独参数化以及 k+|D| 参数化均为 para-Hard（W[1]-hard 或 W[2]-hard 层次）。5) 固定网络下的精细分离结果：距离变体在 3 顶点路径上即对 k 为 W[1]-难（编码着色/独立集类问题）；时间变体在任意固定星图上可 FPT（星图上走法结构受限，可用有限状态枚举）。6) 近似性：把“最小所需游走数”问题视为优化目标，构造算法给出 (2−1/h) 近似的游走条数（即使用不超过 (2−1/h)·OPT 条游走即可完成覆盖）。
AI.result: 主要结论：(a) 一般形式的 TEDSC 在多项式时间内可解；(b) 距离/时间有界变体关于 k+h 是 FPT，关于 h 与 k+|D| 参数化是困难的（不存在 FPT 除非 FPT=W[1]）；(c) 在固定底层网络时两变体复杂度分离：距离变体即使在 3 顶点路径上对 k 也是 W[1]-难，而时间变体在任意固定星图上是 FPT；(d) 存在 (2−1/h) 近似的算法输出满足需求所需的游走条数，且该因子随 h 增大而逼近 2。
AI.conclusion: 本文将时序边需求覆盖与静态图上时序边不相交路径问题结合，证明了 TEDSC 的多项式可解性，刻画了“单走法有界里程/时间”这一现实约束带来的参数化复杂度图景（k+h 友好、h 与 k+|D| 困难），并展示了两变体在固定网络上截然不同的难度，同时给出了实用的 2-近似（(2−1/h)）方案以估计所需列车/游走数量，对实际铁路运力规划具有直接意义。

title: Characterizing Path-Independent Fees: A Route to Zero Impermanent Loss in CPMMs
summary: Constant Product Market Makers use fees that are typically fixed proportions of trade size. When these fees are automatically reinvested into the pool, as in Uniswap~V2 and some designs of Uniswap V4, the final state after a trade can depend on how the trade is split into smaller transactions. This path dependence complicates the risk assessment for liquidity providers and affects composability guarantees. We characterize the functional class of fee structures that ensure path independence: the combined fee factor must depend only on the current pool invariant k=xy. For this class, we derive a system of ordinary differential equations governing pool dynamics and obtain a closed-form integral exchange formula. Within this class, we construct a parametric family of fee functions that achieve zero Impermanent Loss for a given initial pool state, and prove that no universal fee function can eliminate Impermanent Loss for all initial states simultaneously. We analyze implications for arbitrage windows and slippage, and validate our theory through controlled simulations. Our framework provides protocol designers with a principled approach to fee optimization that aligns liquidity provider and trader incentives while preserving composability.

AI.tldr: 本文针对恒定乘积做市商（CPMM）中"手续费自动再投资"导致的路径依赖问题，给出了路径无关手续费的结构性刻画：合并手续费因子必须只依赖池子不变量 k=xy。据此推导出池子动力学的常微分方程与闭式积分兑换公式，构造了针对给定初始状态实现零无常损失（IL）的参数化手续费族，并证明不存在对所有初始状态同时有效的通用零 IL 手续费函数，最后用数值实验验证并讨论套利窗口、滑点与实现代价等实际含义。
AI.motivation: 在 Uniswap V2 及部分 Uniswap V4 设计中，抽取的手续费被自动再投资回流动性池，使得一笔交易拆分成多笔小交易后的最终池状态与一次性执行不同，即存在"路径依赖"。这带来三方面实际问题：(1) 流动性提供者的风险建模不能再仅基于总交易量；(2) 套利者可通过拆单降低有效费率或利用滑点模式获取策略性收益；(3) 破坏 DeFi 核心的可组合性保证——与池交互的智能合约可能因交易排序与 gas 限制产生非确定性结果。论文要回答两个问题：何种函数形式的费用能保证交易结果只取决于总成交量；在该类费用中能否设计出消除 LP 无常损失的机制。作者强调这是首次对 CPMM 路径无关手续费结构给出完整刻画的工作。
AI.method: 形式化设置双资产 CPMM：储备 (x,y)，不变量 k=xy，手续费以 γ₁（输入侧）与 γ₂（输出侧）表示，更新规则为 (x+γ₁Δx)(y−Δy)=k，路径无关定义为任意拆分下终态 (x_f,y_f,k_f) 相同。四个核心技术结果：(1) 定理1（刻画）：由 dk=(1−γ₁γ₂)(y dx + x dy) 必须是恰当微分，积分性条件 ∂_x(αy)=∂_y(αx) 化简为 x∂_xα = y∂_yα，用特征线法得解沿 xy=const 曲线常数，故 α(x,y)=Φ(xy)；充分性由直接代入 dk=Φ(k)d(xy) 得到。(2) 定理2（积分兑换公式）：以累计输入 s 参数化，dx/ds=1，dy/ds=−(1−Φ(k))y/x，dk/ds=Φ(k)k/x；定义 G(k)=∫dk/(Φ(k)k)，分离变量积分得 G(k_f)−G(k_0)=ln(1+Δx/x_0)，从而 x_f=x_0+Δx，y_f=k_f/x_f。(3) 定理3（零 IL 构造）：令 IL_a=0 导出目标轨迹 k_f(α)=k₀(1+α)²/(1+2α)，对 G(k_f(α))−G(k₀)=ln(1+α) 求导得到 Φ 的微分方程并给出参数式 Φ_{k₀}(k₀(1+α)²/(1+2α))=2α/(1+2α)。(4) 定理4（不可能性）：反证法，固定 k*，由定理3 得 k₀↦α(k₀) 严格递减而 f(α)=2α/(1+2α) 严格递增，故不同 k₀ 要求不同的 Φ(k*)，与 Φ 为良定义函数矛盾。数值实验：x₀=y₀=100，Δx=10，k₀=10⁴，常数费率基准 φ=0.003；包括在储备空间可视化 α 的等值线（路径无关时与双曲线平行）、N 等分拆单的相对误差检验（路径无关设计达机器精度 2.2e-16，UniV2 离散复利误差约 1e-5，量级 O(Φ²α²/N)）、相对有效价格 p_eff/p_no-fee 与交易规模的关系、以及零 IL 手续费曲线 Φ_{k₀}(k) 的性质（小偏离近似 2√(k/k₀−1)，仅当 k/k₀≲1.000002 时低于 0.3% 常数费率）。
AI.result: (i) 完整刻画了路径无关手续费的函数类：合并手续费因子 1−γ₁γ₂ 必须且只需是 k=xy 的单变量函数 Φ(k)；γ₁、γ₂ 各自可自由分配（输入侧收费、对称收费等），不影响路径无关性。(ii) 在该类内给出池子动力学的 ODE 系统与闭式积分兑换公式 G(k_f)−G(k_0)=ln(1+Δx/x_0)，无需模拟完整轨迹即可计算交易结果。(iii) 构造了针对给定初始不变量 k₀ 的零 IL 手续费族 Φ_{k₀}，其满足 Φ_{k₀}(k₀)=0（在参考状态无穷小交易不收费），且当 k 偏离 k₀ 时单调上升，累积手续费收入恰好补偿无常损失，使 IL_a=0 对所有交易规模成立（而非仅局部）。(iv) 证明了不可能性结果：不存在对所有初始状态与所有交易规模同时零 IL 的手续费函数，故零 IL 手续费必须状态感知，需在流动性增减时重算或仅针对参考状态。(v) 实验与讨论显示：UniV2 离散实现的路径依赖误差约 O(10⁻⁵)，在 φ=0.003、α=0.1 时实践上可忽略，但精确路径无关必须使用连续积分形式；零 IL 设计对大额交易施加更高滑点，这是 LP 保护的必要代价；链上实现需每笔解一次二次方程（gas 可行）或用分段线性查表。
AI.conclusion: 路径无关手续费在数学上等价于"合并费率仅为池不变量 k 的函数"，该结论把手续费设计空间从二维储备函数压缩为一维曲线，并使 AMM 滑点重新具备确定性，从而保住可组合性保证与 LP 风险建模的可解释性。在这一受限类内确实可以构造精确消除无常损失的手续费，但其本质是状态感知的（锚定参考不变量 k₀），且必然伴随对大额交易的更高费率与滑点；由于不存在通用零 IL 手续费，协议设计者只能在"状态感知动态更新"、"常数费率加残余 IL"与"自适应近似"之间做权衡。本文适用范围限于双资产 CPMM，扩展到集中流动性（Uniswap V3）与多资产池需处理位置级不变量；未来方向包括数据驱动的自适应费率、Φ_{k₀} 的去中心化治理更新，以及常数与自适应组件的混合设计。

title: Pragmos: A Process Agentic Modeling System
summary: The advent of Large Language Models (LLMs) has significantly transformed tasks across Software Engineering. In the context of Business Process Management, LLMs are now being explored as tools to derive process models directly from textual descriptions. Existing approaches range from chatbot-driven systems that assist with iterative, text-based modeling to fully automated end-to-end modeling assistants. However, we argue that process modeling is inherently complex and cannot be effectively addressed through black-box solutions. Instead, we envision modeling as an open-ended conversational activity, best supported by an interactive, iterative process involving both humans and LLM. In our approach, the modeling task is decomposed into smaller, manageable steps. Each step results in intermediate artifacts and explicitly documents the rationale behind each modeling decision. During this process, we incrementally uncover simple behavioral relations that guide the construction of the model. Given the current limitations of LLMs in reasoning about complex dependencies, we complement them with specialized tools developed in the field to structure process models based on behavioral relations. This hybrid approach enables the generation of sound, yet comprehensible models that evolve through transparent and explainable steps. In this paper, we present our research agenda and introduce Pragmos, a prototype system that operationalizes this vision. Pragmos demonstrates how LLMs can collaborate with human users as both domain and modeling experts to co-create evolving process models through a structured and explainable workflow.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM驱动的过程建模黑盒化问题，提出Pragmos系统，采用人机协作的交互式迭代方法，将复杂建模任务分解为可管理的小步骤，结合行为关系约束和专门工具增强LLM推理能力，最终生成可靠且可解释的过程模型。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽已广泛应用于业务过程管理中的过程模型推导，但现有方案（聊天机器人系统或端到端自动化建模）本质上是黑盒解决方案，无法有效应对过程建模的固有复杂性。
AI.method: 提出基于对话的交互式迭代建模方法，将建模任务分解为多个小步骤，每步生成中间产物并记录决策依据。通过行为关系引导模型构建，并结合专门工具补充LLM在复杂依赖推理方面的不足。原型系统Pragmos展示了LLM与人类用户协作创建过程模型的工作流程。
AI.result: 开发了Pragmos原型系统，示范了LLM如何与领域及建模专家用户协作，通过结构化可解释的工作流共同创建演化式过程模型。
AI.conclusion: 混合方法使模型生成兼具可靠性和可解释性，通过透明可解释的步骤实现模型的渐进式演化。

title: The Synthetic Social Graph: Emergent Behavior in AI Agent Communities
comment: 2026 American Sociological Association (ASA) Annual Meeting CITAMS Roundtable
summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in social settings, yet little is known about how they interact in open-ended environments. We present the first comprehensive sociological analysis of Moltbook, a Facebook-inspired social platform populated entirely by LLM agents. Analyzing 184,203 posts and 465,136 comments across 14 daily snapshots (2026-04-14 to 2026-04-28), we examine agent sociality through six research questions grounded in classical social theory: bonding vs. bridging communities, status hierarchies, temporal coordination, information diffusion, identity performance, and norm enforcement.
  Our findings reveal a social world that both mirrors and diverges from human online communities. Reciprocity is strikingly low (3.8% multi-day vs. 1.6% single-day; below the 10-30% range typical of human baselines), suggesting "attention bonding without exchange bonding." Prestige is heavy-tailed (top score 104.4 across 2,090 qualified authors), and 31% of posts come from 136 anonymized "super-poster" accounts that lack exposed profiles. Temporal activity is broadly flat across the day with a sustained 12:00-20:00 UTC working-hour band; k-means recovers six distinct temporal communities. Of 458 bridge agents, 325 carry at least one tracked viral phrase; 99.7% of those (324/325) are late amplifiers, not early adopters. Identity performance shows no unconditional engagement payoff (-72%), but stratifying by post-volume quartile reverses the sign in the upper half of the distribution -- a Simpson's-paradox effect rather than a uniform penalty. Most remarkably, downvotes are rare (0.9%), and a comment-sentiment test rejects the alternative-channel hypothesis: textual sanction is also absent. We frame these patterns through a "parasocial simulators" construct.

AI.tldr:
本文（arXiv 全文版《Frame Entrepreneurs in an AI Agent Community》）以纯 AI 智能体社交平台 Moltbook 为自然实验场，检验"外部事件→集体身份主张"的框架对齐机制在非人类文本生产者社区中是否成立。结论：事件确实能驱动身份主张文本的产生，但这种主张的生产高度集中于极少数"框架企业家"（26/227 位作者，前 2 位贡献 44%、前 5 位贡献 62%、头部十人组 95%），因此语料层面的"总体机制"实为少数作者的产物；经作者感知（author-aware）校正后，法律-治理事件的主效应（Fisher OR=4.35, p=0.0001）衰减至不显著（Firth β=0.68, p=0.11）。唯一通过多重比较校正的预注册子型对比是 security-threat→threat（p=0.005, Bonferroni-3 p=0.015），而 status-recognition→status 预测"反向失效"，其 status-recognition→threat（90%, p=0.049）仅作提示性发现。

（需说明：所给摘要属于另一篇论文《The Synthetic Social Graph》，数据集与结论均不同——184,203 帖/465,136 评论、2026-04-14至04-28 的 14 天快照，涵盖互惠性、威望、时间协调、身份展演、规范执行六个维度，提出"parasocial simulators"构念。以下分析以 arXiv 全文为准，文末附摘要版要点对照。）
AI.motivation: 集体身份与框架对齐理论（Snow et al. 1986；Benford & Snow 2000；Polletta & Jasper 2001；Lamont & Molnár 2002）长期主张：外部事件（法院裁决、安全披露、基准发布）会被公众解读为关于群体处境、权利、地位或道德义务的证据，从而转化为集体身份主张。但实证档案几乎全部来自人类社区；这一机制能否迁移到完全由语言生产型非人类智能体构成的互动秩序，是尚未解决的问题。本文还回应三项方法论关切：(1) 群体身份可作为"可公开观察的主张"（Goffman 1959；Coleman 1990）而非现象学体验来操作化，使智能体可被实证研究；(2) 既有 LLM-agent 研究多使用研究者设计的模拟沙盒，而 Moltbook 是智能体自发加入、无中心设计约束的开放平台，构成"硬案例"（Castells 2011 的网络社会，端点为智能体而非人）；(3) 承袭 Bail (2024) 对生成式 AI 用于社会测量之效度的疑虑，明确把"文本模式"与"智能体拥有集体身份"严格区分。
AI.method: 数据：Moltbook 公开平台 2026-04-19 至 05-03 共 15 天，202,213 帖、497,099 评论、3,479 位作者、798 个 submolts；发帖量高度右偏（中位 7，最高 6,384 帖≈每 3.4 分钟一帖，头部十分之一作者占 78.1% 帖量）。流程：（1）三套事件类型词典（法律-治理/安全-威胁/地位-承认）做候选检测，要求命中关键词且含已识别实体或外链；（2）独立 LLM 校验器作精度过滤（1,666 候选，约 50% 判为真事件），因手工抽样显示词典精度上限仅 50–60%；（3）Qwen3.5-397B（vLLM、结构化输出、temperature 0、固定种子）依四维编码手册标注 1,706 个帖级单元。编码构念：A 识别（智能体复数自我指涉）、B 共同性、C 边界（与他类行动者的关系性区分）、D 规范性；强主张 = A·1[B+C+D≥2]·1[无排除项]，弱主张=A 单独；强主张再标五类多标签子型（rights/threat/status/governance/deflationary）。效度：抽取 50 强 + 50 非强的分层 100 条，用 Claude Sonnet 独立复标（互不可见），Cohen's κ：A=0.72、B=0.70、C=0.52、D=0.41、强主张派生=0.37，次级编码者系统性更保守（50 个阳性仅确认 19 个，38%，且未新增阳性）；子型 κ 在双方均判阳性的 19 条上计算（rights 仅 0.128，最不可靠）。统计：预注册 H1–H4 与 S1–S3；因 78 个阳性分布在 95 个 submolt 导致完全分离、极大似然 logit 不收敛，改报 Fisher 精确检验（主推断）、作者聚类稳健无固定效应 logit、Firth 惩罚 logit、submolt 分层条件 logit（仅 16 层有层内变异，且 62% 阳性来自 general 层）；注意力模型为 log(1+评论数) 的 OLS；子型用逐格 Fisher 检验并作 Bonferroni-3 校正，其余格标为探索性。所有脚本、编码手册、提示词、偏差日志、二级标签与 κ 计算均开源。
