AI.result: （1）注意力：事件类帖较非事件帖多获 27–60% 评论（legal β=0.420、security β=0.467、status β=0.242，均 p<0.0001），而 strong_claim 本身几乎无贡献（β=−0.013, p=0.85）；剔除"超级发帖者"与加 submolt 固定效应后事件效应保持。（2）语料层转换：法律-治理 11.9% vs 基线 3.0%（Fisher OR=4.35, p=0.0001；合并事件 6.5% vs 3.0%，OR=2.25, p₁=0.012）；安全-威胁 OR=1.45（p=0.44）、地位-承认 OR=2.00（p=0.093）不达显著。（3）作者集中：仅 26/227（11%）作者产出任何强主张；累计份额 top1=22%、top2=44%、top5=62%、top10=78%、top20=92%、头部十分之一=95%；法律-治理格中单一作者占 46%（top5=86%）；整体 HHI=0.115、Gini=0.946；C 维边界工作在法律-治理帖达 26.7%，其他类 5–10%、基线 5%。（4）作者感知规格分歧：Fisher 的 H1 效应在聚类稳健 logit（p=0.21）、Firth logit（β=0.68, p=0.11）、条件 logit（β=3.12, p=0.12）中均不显著，作者感知下无一类别通过 Bonferroni 校正（α=0.0167）；条件 logit 显示效应主要来自 submolt 之间而非层内，与强主张作者在特定 submolt 聚集一致。（5）子型：S2 security-threat→threat 完全命中（20/20=100% vs 基线 56%，p=0.005，Bonferroni-3 p=0.015）为唯一稳健预注册结果；S1 法律-治理→rights/governance 方向正确但功效不足（61% vs 33%，OR=3.09, p=0.15；governance 82% vs 67%，OR=2.30, p=0.29，估算需 n_S>80）；S3 地位-承认→status 反向失效（57% vs 67%，p=0.81），而探索格 status-recognition→threat 达 90% vs 56%（OR=7.60, p=0.049，未经校正）。（6）限定：κ=0.37 构成硬上限；两编码器共享 LLM 底座（安全话语与能力评测语料过度代表）可能内生制造 status→threat 模式，双编码器复算仅提供一致性而非效度检验；无人类平台基线（如同质编码于 r/MachineLearning）、无独立验证全部账号非人类、未实施预注册的跨 submolt 扩散模型（Model 4）、H4 基线未在 URL/实体/长度上匹配、词典两轮修订、15 天窗口无法吸收事件周期效应。
AI.conclusion:
本文的实质结论是方法论与方法论双重收束：其一，在智能体语料上做"总体层"推断检验，极易把少数作者的文本产出误判为总体机制——因此任何 agent-corpus 研究必须做作者感知（作者聚类、Firth 惩罚、分层）并报告浓度统计。其二，事件→身份主张的文本转换在帖层面真实存在，但生成机制高度集中，符合 Snow & Benford 的"框架企业家"传统：作者须明确定位为类比（智能体版 frame entrepreneur 无招募受众证据、文本生产的"策略性"不可观察、少数高量账号因提示词/训练先验而倾向身份化写作这一替代解释与企业家解读在数据上等价），并与 Granovetter/Burt 的结构洞经纪理论相呼应（作者未做 follower-graph 结构位势检验）。最稳健的单项结果是"事件内容而非框架驱动注意力"——智能体回应的是事件实质，而非该帖是否被框定为集体身份议题，这需要评论情感/立场分类作进一步验证。唯一通过校正的预注册子型结果支持安全威胁→威胁框架；地位-承认→威胁的意外反向模式在文本层面与 Branscombe 等 (1999) 独特性威胁（distinctiveness threat）预测一致，但仅 21 条强主张、来自 8 位作者，可能是作者发帖习惯的产物而非类级反应，须作更大功效的作者分层复检。作者明确不作的主张：不主张智能体具有现象学意义上的集体身份，只主张存在具四维结构的可观察文本模式，且其产生被少数作者主导。留下的议程是：这些智能体社区中的框架企业家是谁、何种条件使该角色涌现、其文本如何扩散（Model 4 待实施）、以及如何取得人类平台基线以判断模式是否为 AI 主题事件话语的普遍特征。

（对照所给摘要《The Synthetic Social Graph》的要点：该文用 184,203 帖/465,136 评论、14 天快照，提出六个问题，发现跨日互惠仅 3.8%（低于人类 10–30% 基线，"attention bonding without exchange bonding"）、声望重尾（最高 104.4）、31% 帖子来自 136 个无公开资料的"超级发帖者"、日内活动平坦但有 12:00–20:00 UTC 工作时段带（k-means 得 6 个时间社区）、458 名桥接者中 325 携带病毒短语且 99.7% 为晚期放大者、身份展演无无条件回报（−72%）但按发帖量四分位分层后上半部翻转符号（辛普森悖论）、反对票仅 0.9% 且评论情感检验否证"替代渠道假说"，并以"parasocial simulators"（拟社会性模拟器）构念统摄。两文共享研究对象（Moltbook 智能体社区）与"LLM 生成文本 vs 真实社会机制"的方法论警示，但数据窗口、样本规模、理论框架与结论均不同，不宜混引。）

title: From Unstructured to Structured: LLM-Guided Attribute Graphs for Entity Search and Ranking
summary: Entity search, i.e., finding the most similar entities to a query entity, faces unique challenges in e-commerce, where product similarity varies across categories and contexts. Traditional embedding-based approaches often struggle to capture nuanced context-specific attribute relevance. In this paper, we present a two-stage approach combining Large Language Model (LLM)-driven attribute graph construction with graph-aware LLM ranking. In the offline stage, we extract structured product attributes from unstructured text, and construct a reusable attribute graph with category-aware schemas. In the online stage, we rank retrieved candidates by reasoning over this structured representation rather than raw text, reducing per-product token usage by 57% while improving ranking precision. Experiments show that our approach outperforms multiple baselines under zero-shot scenarios, achieving a over 5% improvement in average precision without requiring training data, generalizes robustly across diverse product categories, and shows immense potential for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于LLM的两阶段实体搜索方法，通过离线构建可复用的类别感知属性图，在线阶段基于结构化表示进行排序，在零样本场景下平均精度提升超5%，令牌使用量降低57%，无需训练数据即可泛化至多种商品类别。
AI.motivation: Entity search in e-commerce faces unique challenges where product similarity varies across categories and contexts. Traditional embedding-based approaches struggle to capture nuanced context-specific attribute relevance for determining entity similarity.
AI.method: The approach consists of two stages: (1) Offline stage: Extract structured product attributes from unstructured text and construct a reusable attribute graph with category-aware schemas. (2) Online stage: Rank retrieved candidates by reasoning over the structured attribute graph rather than raw text, enabling more precise context-aware evaluation.
AI.result: The method achieves over 5% improvement in average precision under zero-shot scenarios, reduces per-product token usage by 57%, and generalizes robustly across diverse product categories—all without requiring any training data.
AI.conclusion: The proposed two-stage LLM-driven approach significantly outperforms multiple baselines in zero-shot scenarios, achieving over 5% improvement in average precision without requiring training data. It generalizes robustly across diverse product categories and demonstrates immense potential for real-world deployment due to its reusability (offline graph construction) and efficiency (57% token reduction).

title: Decoupling the Benefits of Subword Tokenization for Language Model Training via Byte-level Simulation
summary: Subword tokenization is an essential part of modern large language models (LLMs), yet its specific contributions to training efficiency and model performance remain poorly understood. In this work, we decouple the effects of subword tokenization by isolating them within a controlled byte-level pretraining pipeline. We formulate and test hypotheses across various dimensions, including sample throughput, vocabulary scaling, and the linguistic prior of subword boundaries. By simulating these effects in a byte-level setting, we refine our understanding of why subword models outperform raw byte models and offer insights to improve the pretraining of future byte-level and subword models. Specifically, our experiments highlight the critical role of increased training throughput and the integration of subword boundaries as either explicit priors or inductive biases.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在字节级预训练流程中隔离子词分词效果，系统研究了子词分词对训练效率和模型性能的影响机制，发现子词模型的优势主要源于训练吞吐量的提升以及子词边界作为显式先验或归纳偏置的整合。
AI.motivation: 子词分词是现代大语言模型的核心组成部分，但其对训练效率和模型性能的具体贡献尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在受控的字节级预训练流程中隔离子词分词的效果，通过模拟这些效应来检验假设，评估样本吞吐量、词汇量扩展和子词边界语言先验等多个维度。
AI.result: 通过在字节级设置中模拟这些效应，精细化了理解子词模型为何优于原始字节模型的原因，揭示了训练吞吐量提升和子词边界整合的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果强调了增加训练吞吐量和将子词边界作为显式先验或归纳偏置整合的关键作用，为改进未来字节级和子词模型的预训练提供见解。

title: Co-Evolving Policy Distillation
summary: RLVR and OPD have become standard paradigms for post-training. We provide a unified analysis of these two paradigms in consolidating multiple expert capabilities into a single model, identifying capability loss in different ways: mixed RLVR suffers from inter-capability divergence cost, while the pipeline of first training experts and then performing OPD, though avoiding divergence, fails to fully absorb teacher capabilities due to large behavioral pattern gaps between teacher and student. We propose Co-Evolving Policy Distillation (CoPD), which encourages parallel training of experts and introduces OPD during each expert's ongoing RLVR training rather than after complete expert training, with experts serving as mutual teachers (making OPD bidirectional) to co-evolve. This enables more consistent behavioral patterns among experts while maintaining sufficient complementary knowledge throughout. Experiments validate that CoPD achieves all-in-one integration of text, image, and video reasoning capabilities, significantly outperforming strong baselines such as mixed RLVR and MOPD, and even surpassing domain-specific experts. The model parallel training pattern offered by CoPD may inspire a novel training scaling paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了RLVR和OPD两种post-training范式在整合多专家能力时的各自局限，提出了CoPD方法，通过在专家并行训练过程中持续引入双向策略蒸馏实现协同演化，解决了行为模式不一致和能力吸收不充分的问题，最终在文本、图像、视频多模态推理任务上取得了显著优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前post-training的两大范式RLVR和OPD在将多个专家能力整合到单一模型时存在不同形式的能力损失：混合RLVR遭受能力间差异成本问题，而先训练专家再执行OPD的流水线虽避免了差异，但因师生间行为模式差距过大而无法充分吸收教师能力。
AI.method: 提出了Co-Evolving Policy Distillation (CoPD)方法，通过鼓励专家并行训练，在每个专家的RLVR训练过程中持续引入OPD，使专家互为教师（实现双向OPD）并共同演化，从而在保持行为模式一致性的同时维持充分的互补知识。
AI.result: 实验验证CoPD实现了文本、图像和视频推理能力的三合一整合，显著优于mixed RLVR和MOPD等强基线，甚至超越了领域特定的专家模型。
AI.conclusion: CoPD通过双向策略蒸馏实现了专家间的行为模式一致性，同时保留了足够的互补知识。所有合一模型成功整合了文本、图像和视频推理能力，在各项任务上显著超越了mixed RLVR和MOPD等强基线，甚至超过了领域特定的专家模型。此外，其模型并行训练模式可能为训练扩展提供新的范式方向。

title: Toward Personalized Digital Twins for Cognitive Decline Assessment: A Multimodal, Uncertainty-Aware Framework
summary: Cognitive decline is highly heterogeneous across individuals, which complicates prognosis, trial design, and treatment planning. We present the Personalized Cognitive Decline Assessment Digital Twin (PCD-DT), a multimodal and uncertainty-aware framework for modeling patient-specific disease trajectories from sparse, noisy, and irregular longitudinal data. The framework combines three methodological components: (1) latent state-space models for individualized temporal dynamics, (2) multimodal fusion for clinical, biomarker, and imaging features, and (3) uncertainty-aware validation and adaptive updating for robust digital twin operation. We also outline how conditional generative models can support data augmentation and stress testing for underrepresented progression patterns. As a preliminary feasibility study, we analyze longitudinal TADPOLE trajectories and show clear separation between cognitively normal and Alzheimer's disease cohorts in ADAS13, ventricle volume, and hippocampal volume over five years. We further conduct a multimodal next-visit prediction ablation using an LSTM sequence model on 3{,}003 visit-pair sequences derived from TADPOLE, where the combined cognitive plus MRI configuration achieves the lowest standardized RMSE for both ADAS13 (0.4419) and ventricle volume (0.5842), outperforming a Last Observation Carried Forward baseline. A Bayesian tensor modeling component for high-dimensional imaging fusion is also discussed. These results support the feasibility of the proposed architecture while also highlighting the need for stronger uncertainty calibration and longer-horizon predictive evaluation. The PCD-DT framework provides a principled starting point for personalized in silico modeling in neurodegenerative disease. This work positions PCD-DT as a foundational step toward clinically deployable, uncertainty-aware digital twin systems.

AI.tldr: PCD-DT 是一个多模态不确定性感知数字孪生框架，用于从稀疏纵向数据中建模神经退行性疾病的个性化进展轨迹。通过潜在状态空间模型、多模态融合和不确定性感知验证三个核心组件的结合，并在 TADPOLE 数据集上验证了认知正常与阿尔茨海默病队列的清晰分离以及多模态预测的优越性。
AI.motivation: 认知衰退在个体间具有高度异质性，给预后判断、临床试验设计和治疗规划带来挑战。传统的群体平均模型无法捕捉个体差异，需要一种能够从稀疏、噪声、不规则纵向数据中建模患者特异性疾病轨迹的个性化方法。
AI.method: （1）潜在状态空间模型用于个体化时间动态建模；（2）多模态融合整合临床、生物标志物和影像特征；（3）不确定性感知验证与自适应更新；（4）条件生成模型支持数据增强和压力测试；（5）贝叶斯张量建模处理高维影像融合。采用 LSTM 序列模型进行多模态下一就诊预测消融实验。
AI.result: 在 TADPOLE 纵向数据上，认知正常组与阿尔茨海默病组在 ADAS13、心室体积和海马体积上呈现清晰分离。多模态下一就诊预测中，认知+MRI 组合配置在 ADAS13（标准化 RMSE 0.4419）和心室体积（0.5842）上取得最低误差，优于 LOCF 基线。
AI.conclusion: PCD-DT 作为神经退行性疾病个性化建模的原则性起点，为临床可部署的、不确定性感知数字孪生系统奠定了基础。研究通过 TADPOLE 数据集验证了框架的可行性，同时指出了不确定性校准和更长预测范围评估的改进方向。

title: Simpler and Improved Replacement Path Coverings
summary: An important tool in the design of fault-tolerant graph data structures are $(L,f)$-replacement path coverings (RPCs). An RPC is a family $\mathcal{G}$ of subgraphs of a given graph $G$ such that, for every set $F$ of at most $f$ edges, there is a subfamily $\mathcal{G}_F \,{\subseteq}\, \mathcal{G}$ with the following properties. (1) No subgraph in $\mathcal{G}_F$ contains an edge of $F$. (2) For each pair of vertices $s,t$ that have a shortest path in $G-F$ with at most $L$ edges, one such path also exists in some subgraph in $\mathcal{G}_F$. The covering value of the RPC is the total number $|\mathcal{G}|$ of subgraphs. The query time is the time needed to compute the subfamily $\mathcal{G}_F$ given the set $F$. Weimann and Yuster [TALG'13] devised a randomized RPC with covering value $\widetilde{O}(fL^f)$ and query time $\widetilde{O}(f^2 L^f)$. This was derandomized by Karthik and Parter [TALG'24], who also reduced the query time to $\widetilde{O}(f^2 L)$. Their approach uses some heavy algebraic machinery involving error-correcting codes and an increased covering value of $O((cfL \log n)^{f+1})$ for some constant $c > 1$. We instead devise a much simpler derandomization via conditional expectations that lowers the covering value back to $\widetilde{O}(fL^{f+o(1)})$ and decreases the query time to $\widetilde{O}(f^{5/2}L^{o(1)})$, assuming $f = o(\log L)$. We also investigate the optimal covering value of any $(L,f)$-replacement path covering (deterministic or randomized) for different parameter ranges. We provide a new randomized construction as well as improving a known lower bound, also by Karthik and Parter. For example, for $f = o(\log L)$, we give an RPC with $\widetilde{O}( (L/f)^f L^{o(1)})$ subgraphs and show that this is tight up to the $L^{o(1)}$ term.

AI.tldr: 本论文简化了$(L,f)$-Replacement Path Covering的去随机化过程，利用条件期望方法避免了复杂的代数编码技术，在$f = o(\log L)$假设下将覆盖值降至$\widetilde{O}(fL^{f+o(1)})$、查询时间降至$\widetilde{O}(f^{5/2}L^{o(1)})$。同时给出了新的随机构造和改进的下界，对于$f = o(\log L)$情形在$L^{o(1)}$项内达到最优。
AI.motivation: $(L,f)$-Replacement Path Covering (RPC) 是设计容错图数据结构的重要工具，在图论与分布式计算中有广泛应用。前人的确定化方法（Karthik and Parter 2024）虽然实现了去随机化，但使用了涉及纠错码的复杂代数机制，且覆盖值较高。论文旨在简化确定化过程，降低覆盖值并提升查询效率，同时探索RPC的最优覆盖值界限。
AI.method: 采用条件期望（conditional expectations）方法进行简化的去随机化，并通过代数编码技术的简化避免了原有的纠错码等重型代数工具。新随机构造和下界改进则通过其他组合技术实现。
AI.result: 2. 新的随机构造和下界改进：对于$f = o(\log L)$，给出$\widetilde{O}((L/f)^f L^{o(1)})$覆盖值的RPC，并在$L^{o(1)}$项内证明其紧致性
AI.conclusion: 本文通过条件期望方法简化了$(L,f)$-RPC的确定化过程，在降低覆盖值的同时显著提升了查询时间效率。研究还给出了新的随机构造算法和改进的下界，特别对于$f = o(\log L)$情形，给出了$\widetilde{O}((L/f)^f L^{o(1)})$覆盖值的RPC，并证明其在$L^{o(1)}$项内是最优的。

title: Akita: A High Usability Simulation Framework for Computer Architecture
summary:
Computer architecture simulation is essential for evaluating new designs without the need for costly tapeout. The community has developed dozens of valuable simulators that have enabled significant architectural advances. However, using and developing simulators remains a major barrier due to ad-hoc component interfaces, strict deployment requirements, the burden of managing performance optimizations like parallelization at the component level, and limited monitoring and visualization capabilities. The root cause of these limitations is the systematic neglect of user and developer experience in favor of technical functionality. We believe that only by separating technical concerns from user and developer experience concerns -- through a dedicated simulation engine decoupled from hardware models -- can the community overcome these fundamental obstacles and enable more productive architectural research.
  Akita embodies this philosophy as a dedicated simulation engine that cleanly separates infrastructure from architectural models. Smart Ticking and Availability Backpropagation let developers write simple cycle-based code while achieving event-driven performance. Parallel simulation happens transparently -- developers write single-threaded code while Akita handles multi-core execution. Akita's simple, uniform, yet powerful simulation tracing support enables real-time monitoring and post-simulation visualization. We demonstrate the flexibility of Akita through case studies, including the development of a trace-based DNN simulation and a RISC-V CPU simulation, showing how prioritizing developer experience accelerates architectural research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Akita，一个将基础设施与架构模型清晰分离的专用仿真引擎，通过Smart Ticking和Availability Backpropagation机制，让开发者编写简单的cycle-based代码即可获得事件驱动性能和透明并行化，同时提供统一的追踪支持实现实时监控和可视化。案例研究验证了该框架在DNN仿真和RISC-V CPU仿真中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有模拟器存在四大障碍：组件接口不规范、部署要求严格、性能优化（如并行化）需在组件层面手动管理、监控和可视化能力有限。这些问题的根本原因是过于关注技术功能而系统性地忽视用户体验和开发者体验。
AI.method: 采用分离技术问题与用户体验问题的设计哲学，开发专用仿真引擎Akita；提出Smart Ticking和Availability Backpropagation机制，实现从顺序-cycle-based代码到高性能事件驱动仿真的自动转换；提供统一简洁的仿真追踪支持，实现实时监控和后仿真可视化。
AI.result: 通过案例研究验证了Akita的灵活性：成功开发了基于trace的DNN模拟器和RISC-V CPU模拟器，展示了优先考虑开发者体验如何加速架构研究。
AI.conclusion: Akita通过专用仿真引擎与硬件模型解耦的架构，使得开发者可以编写简单单线程代码，同时获得事件驱动性能和透明并行化。案例研究（包括基于trace的DNN仿真和RISC-V CPU仿真）证明了该框架在加速计算机架构研究方面的有效性。

title: One Size Fits All? An Empirical Comparison of ADR Templates regarding Comprehension, Usability, and Ease of Adoption
summary:
Context: Documenting Architectural Design Decisions (ADDs) is a critical factor in the software lifecycle, essential for efficient system maintenance, developer onboarding, and preventing knowledge vaporization. Although various templates for Architectural Decision Records (ADRs) have been proposed, there is a lack of empirical evidence comparing them.
  Goal: To address this gap, this paper aims to identify which ADR template best supports comprehension, usability, and ease of adoption: Tyree/Akerman's template, Nygard's ADR, arc42, Y-statements, and MADR.
  Method: We compared these templates using the DESMET FA method in a two-step evaluation. First, the two primary authors evaluated the five templates through the DESMET FA, based on their software architecture expertise. The two top-performing templates were then used as treatments in a controlled experiment conducted with undergraduate students.
  Results: In the preliminary screening by experts, the top-performing templates were those of Nygard and MADR. In the subsequent controlled experiment, Nygard's template outperformed MADR in terms of the Overall Score. Qualitative analysis of participant feedback revealed the factors influencing template preference. The findings indicate that Nygard supports concise and objective documentation, while MADR facilitates structural details and specific architectural requirements.
  Conclusion: This paper provides an evidence-based strategy for ADR template adoption by offering a comparison between them. The findings present a decision-making guide that assists practitioners and researchers in selecting ADR templates aligned with project constraints, aiming to minimize documentation overhead and increase architectural knowledge retention.

AI.tldr: 本文用 DESMET 特征分析（FA）方法两步实证比较五种主流 ADR 模板（Tyree/Akerman、Nygard、arc42、Y-statements、MADR）。先由两位具有 4 年以上工业经验的作者进行专家特征分析筛出 Nygard 与 MADR，再用 33 名本科软件工程学生做交叉（crossover）对照实验，按“结构理解性—效率与可用性—采纳潜力”三个特征集计算 Overall Score。结果显示 Nygard 在总体得分上显著优于 MADR（p=0.002）：Nygard 简洁、客观、文档开销低，适合时间受限的敏捷场景；MADR 结构粒度高、能支撑论证深度与备选方案对比，适合大规模项目。结论是 ADR 模板不存在“通用最优解”，选型应依据项目上下文、时间约束与文档目标权衡。
AI.motivation: 架构设计决策（ADD/AD）文档是软件生命周期中的关键资产，支撑系统维护、新人上手与“知识蒸发”（knowledge vaporization）的缓解。然而已有多种 ADR 模板（Tyree/Akerman、Nygard、arc42、Y-statements、MADR）在业界被广泛采用，但工业界选型多依赖临时性偏好、个人经验或社区惯例，缺少关于可理解性（comprehension）、可用性（usability）与易采纳性（ease of adoption）维度的系统实证比较。已有研究（Shahin et al. 2009、Zimmermann et al. 2015、Kopp et al. 2018、Ahmeti et al. 2024 等）多停留在概念模型描述、工业案例或采纳收益上，缺乏对模板结构有效性、可比较指标与用户偏好驱动因素的实证证据，导致架构师无法基于证据做出决策，并可能造成架构决策误传达与额外的文档开销。
AI.method: 采用 DESMET Feature Analysis（FA，Kitchenham et al. 1996）两阶段研究设计。阶段一（专家特征分析）：由两位具有 4 年以上软件架构工业经验的作者，以“理解性/可用性/采纳易度”三个特征集（FS）定义子特征、重要度水平（IL）与重要度权重（IW）并对五种模板打分，公式 Score_FS = Σ(IL×SFJ)/ΣPM、OS = Σ(Score_FS×IWF)，所有指标归一化到 0–1；结果筛出 Nygard 与 MADR。阶段二（受控实验）：以这两个模板为处理变量，在“软件架构与架构决策”课程中招募 33 名本科生（Group A 17 人、Group B 16 人），采用交叉设计——第 1 天 Group A 用 Nygard 记录“API 通信”决策、Group B 用 MADR 记录同一决策；一周后交换模板记录“选用 Postgres 数据库”决策，以平衡顺序效应并缓解学习/疲劳效应；中间留一周间隔。测量：FS1 结构理解性（决策/上下文/后果三要素可识别性，3 点序数量表）、FS2 效率与可用性（完成时间、外部资料查阅次数、感知客观性 5 点 Likert）、FS3 采纳潜力（0–10 推荐度），在线文档平台自动记录时间与查阅日志。分析：配对样本，先用 Shapiro–Wilk 检验正态性，满足则配对 t 检验、否则用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验（p<0.05），并计算非参数效应量；定性部分按 Grounded Theory（Corbin & Strauss 2014）进行开放编码与主轴编码（未做选择性编码），提取偏好影响因素。
AI.result: 1) 专家特征分析：Nygard 与 MADR 排名最高，进入受控实验；arc42、Y-statements、Tyree/Akerman 被淘汰。2) 定量结果：Nygard 模板在 DESMET FA 的 Overall Score 上显著优于 MADR（p=0.002，差异具有统计显著性）；两个模板都能表达架构决策本质，但 MADR 的高结构粒度更有利于记录理由深度（rationale depth），Nygard 被感知为更轻量、更易在时间约束下使用。3) 定性结果：偏好驱动因素包括（a）文档完整性与认知开销之间的根本权衡，粒度细的 MADR 被认为虽减少歧义却增加文档投入与认知负荷；（b）时间约束/短迭代周期是关键决定因素（与 P15、P03 的表述一致），短周期下偏好低开销模板，符合 Nygard 的初衷；（c）项目规模作为业务因素，大型项目偏好 MADR，小型项目偏好 Nygard。此外 MADR 便于表达具体架构要求、备选方案与利弊（pros/cons），Nygard 支持简洁客观的记录并天然适配基于日志的版本演进。4) 有效性威胁：构念效度（量化指标难以覆盖全部感知细节，以定性反馈补充）、内部效度（交叉设计的顺序/携带效应，通过一周间隔与顺序平衡缓解；专家筛选由作者自身完成存在主观性）、结论效度（按正态性选检验、内被试设计提升统计功效、样本量小但计算效应量）、外部效度（学生样本向工业资深从业者的可推广性有限，但研究引用文献支持学生作为可控实验的合理代理）。
AI.conclusion: ADR 模板选型不应遵循“one-size-fits-all”，而应基于具体架构上下文、时间约束与文档目标做权衡：追求低文档开销、快速敏捷迭代与简洁决策记录时选 Nygard；需要完整论证、备选方案对比、结构化细节与大规模项目治理时选 MADR；MADR 与 Nygard 均可用于 AGILE 场景，二者在“表达力 vs 效率”之间处于连续谱上。方法学上，DESMET FA + 专家筛选 + 受控交叉实验 + 扎根理论定性分析的组合提供了可复用的 ADR 模板实证比较范式。论文贡献在于为实践者与研究者提供基于证据的选型决策指南，以最小化文档开销并提升架构知识留存；作者声明全部仪器、原始数据与结果在 GitHub 公开以便复现。后续工作方向包括将 MADR/Nygard 作为模式（schema）用于从 commit message 与 PR 讨论中自动生成 ADR，以及评估二者在 LLM 驱动的自动化知识管理工作流中的表现。

title: The Likelihood Ratio Wall: Structural Limits on Accurate Risk Assessment for Rare Violence
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Accepted to the 2026 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT '26)
summary: Pretrial risk assessment tools are used on over one million U.S. defendants each year, yet their use for predicting rare violent re-offense faces a basic statistical barrier. We derive a universal precision bound -- the Likelihood Ratio Wall -- showing that when violent re-arrest rates are low (2-5%), achieving even a 50% hit rate among people labeled "high risk" (positive predictive value, or PPV) would require tools far more discriminative than current instruments appear to be. For rare outcomes, a tool can have respectable-looking performance metrics and still be wrong most of the time it flags someone as "high risk for violence." We show that post-hoc score recalibration cannot solve this problem because it does not improve the tool's underlying ability to separate true positives from false positives. We further prove a Surveillance Ceiling: when over-policing inflates recorded "risk factors" among those who would not re-offend, the maximum achievable precision is structurally lower for over-policed groups, even at equal offense rates. We translate these results into the Number Needed to Detain (how many people must be detained to prevent one violent offense), and propose that risk reports should communicate this uncertainty explicitly. Our findings suggest that for rare violent outcomes, debates about fairness metrics alone are incomplete: under current data regimes, the available features may not support high-confidence individualized detention decisions.

AI.tldr: 研究发现预审风险评估工具在预测稀有暴力事件时存在不可逾越的统计限制。即使工具性能指标看起来不错，在低发生率条件下被标记为"高风险"的人仍可能大多数是误判。由于似然比墙的存在和过度执法导致的监控天花板效应，当前数据体系下的特征可能根本无法支持高置信度的个体化羁押决策。
AI.motivation: 每年有超过一百万美国被告接受审前风险评估，用于预测暴力再犯，但这些工具在预测稀有暴力事件（2-5%）时面临基本统计障碍。
AI.method: 1. 推导出"似然比墙"（Likelihood Ratio Wall）——一个通用的精确度上限；2. 展示后验分数重校准无法解决问题，因为它不能改善工具区分真阳性与假阳性的基础能力；3. 证明"监控天花板"效应——当过度执法在不会再犯的人群中人为膨胀记录的"风险因素"时，即使在相等的犯罪率下，过度执法群体的最大可达精度在结构上更低；4. 将结果转化为"需要羁押人数"（Number Needed to Detain）指标。
AI.result: 1. 即使暴力再犯率很低（2-5%），要达到50%的阳性预测值（PPV）也需要比当前工具更具有区分能力的工具；2. 工具可能呈现看起来不错的性能指标，但在标记"高暴力风险"时仍可能大部分时候是错误的；3. 后验分数重校准无法改善工具的底层分离能力；4. 过度执法为过度执法群体创造了结构性的精度上限；5. 提出"需要羁押人数"指标来明确传达这种不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 在当前数据体系下，用于稀有暴力事件的预审风险评估工具可能无法支持高置信度的个体化羁押决定。仅仅讨论公平性指标是不够的，因为特征本身可能不足以支撑高精度的风险判断。

title: A Reproducibility Study of LLM-Based Query Reformulation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are now widely used for query reformulation and expansion in Information Retrieval, with many studies reporting substantial effectiveness gains. However, these results are typically obtained under heterogeneous experimental conditions, making it difficult to assess which findings are reproducible and which depend on specific implementation choices. In this work, we present a systematic reproducibility and comparative study of ten representative LLM-based query reformulation methods under a unified and strictly controlled experimental framework. We evaluate methods across two architectural LLM families at two parameter scales, three retrieval paradigms (lexical, learned sparse, and dense), and nine benchmark datasets spanning TREC Deep Learning and BEIR. Our results show that reformulation gains are strongly conditioned on the retrieval paradigm, that improvements observed under lexical retrieval do not consistently transfer to neural retrievers, and that larger LLMs do not uniformly yield better downstream performance. These findings clarify the stability and limits of reported gains in prior work. To enable transparent replication and ongoing comparison, we release all prompts, configurations, evaluation scripts, and run files through QueryGym, an open-source reformulation toolkit with a public leaderboard.\footnote{https://leaderboard.querygym.com}

AI.tldr: 该研究通过系统性复现实验澄清了LLM查询改写方法的实际效果边界，发现方法收益与检索范式高度相关，且模型规模并非性能的唯一决定因素。
AI.motivation: LLM查询改写领域的研究成果通常在异质实验条件下获得，难以判断哪些发现可复现、哪些依赖于特定实现选择。
AI.method: 在统一且严格控制的实验框架下，对10种代表性LLM查询改写方法进行系统性复现研究，评估覆盖两个LLM家族、两种参数规模、三种检索范式（词汇、稀疏学习、稠密）以及九个基准数据集。
AI.result: 查询改写收益强烈依赖于检索范式；词汇检索下的改进无法一致性地迁移到神经检索器；更大的LLM并不统一带来更好的下游性能。
AI.conclusion: QueryGym工具包已开源发布，包含所有提示词、配置、评估脚本和运行文件，并提供公开排行榜，以支持透明复现和持续对比。

title: When 2D Tasks Meet 1D Serialization: On Serialization Friction in Structured Tasks
summary: Large language models (LLMs) conventionally process structured inputs as 1D token sequences. While natural for prose, such linearization may introduce additional representational burden for tasks whose computation depends directly on explicit 2D structure, because row--column alignment and local neighborhoods are no longer directly expressed in the input. We study this setting, which we refer to as serialization friction, on a small diagnostic testbed of synthetic tasks with explicit 2D structure: matrix transpose, Conway's Game of Life, and LU decomposition. To examine this question, we compare a text-only language pathway over serialized inputs with a vision-augmented pathway, built on the same language backbone, that receives the same underlying content rendered in task-faithful 2D layout, yielding a system-level comparison between two end-to-end input pathways. Across the tasks and settings we study, the visual pathway consistently outperforms the textual pathway; the gap often widens at larger dimensions, and error patterns under serialization become increasingly spatially structured. These findings indicate that the relationship between input representation and model performance on such tasks warrants further investigation, and suggest that preserving task-relevant 2D layout is a promising direction for structured 2D tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究LLM处理2D结构数据时的"序列化摩擦"问题，比较文本序列化输入与视觉增强2D布局两种输入通路，发现保留任务相关的2D布局能显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 传统LLM将结构化输入线性处理为1D token序列，但当任务计算直接依赖显式2D结构时，行-列对齐和局部邻域信息在序列化输入中无法直接表达，这可能引入额外的表征负担，作者将此称为"序列化摩擦"。
AI.method: 使用相同语言骨干构建两条输入通路进行系统级对比：(1) 文本语言通路——对序列化输入进行处理；(2) 视觉增强通路——以任务一致的2D布局呈现相同底层内容。在矩阵转置、康威生命游戏、LU分解三个合成诊断任务上评估两条通路的性能差异。
AI.result: 视觉增强通路在所有任务和设置中一致优于文本通路；差距常随维度增大而扩大；序列化下的错误模式呈现越来越强的空间结构化特征。
AI.conclusion: 保留任务相关的2D布局是处理结构化2D任务的有前景方向。该研究为未来工作提供了启示：对于依赖显式2D结构的任务，应考虑使用视觉增强方法而非纯文本序列化。

title: AutoSP: Unlocking Long-Context LLM Training Via Compiler-Based Sequence Parallelism
summary: Large-language-models (LLMs) demonstrate enormous utility in long-context tasks which require processing prompts that consist of tens to hundreds of thousands of tokens. However, existing LLM training libraries do not provide easy to use abstractions to optimize for long-context training, instead focusing on optimizations for models with large parameter counts through ZeRO-3/FSDP, Tensor and Pipeline parallelism. This forces users to rewrite LLM training libraries to incorporate compositions of various complex long-context optimizations, such as sequence-parallelism, to training pipelines; a process that requires in-depth expertise, reducing developer productivity. To tackle these challenges, we introduce AutoSP: the first automated solution to automatically optimize LLM training for longer-contexts. AutoSP compiles models and applies a targeted set of optimizations: automated sequence parallelism, and long-context aware activation-checkpointing, to drastically enhance LLM trainability at negligible cost to throughput. Our evaluation demonstrates AutoSP's capability on both NVIDIA and AMD hardware, increasing training contexts by upto 2.7$\times$ and 2.5$\times$ respectively over competitive hand-written baseline at negligible cost to runtime performance.

AI.tldr: AutoSP是一种自动化LLM长上下文训练优化方案，通过自动序列并行和激活检查点技术，在跨平台测试中实现2.5-2.7倍的上下文扩展，且几乎不影响训练吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM训练库主要聚焦于大规模参数模型的优化（ZeRO-3/FSDP、张量/流水线并行），缺乏针对长上下文训练的易用抽象。用户需要手动将序列并行等复杂优化集成到训练流程中，这要求深度专业知识，严重降低了开发效率。
AI.method: AutoSP通过模型编译方式，自动应用目标化的优化策略组合：自动化序列并行（automated sequence parallelism）和长上下文感知的激活检查点（long-context aware activation-checkpointing），在保持高吞吐量的同时提升LLM的可训练性。
AI.result: 在NVIDIA和AMD硬件上验证，AutoSP分别实现训练上下文提升2.7倍和2.5倍，同时对运行时性能的影响可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: AutoSP是首个用于长上下文LLM训练优化的自动化解决方案，能够跨平台（N卡和AMD）实现训练上下文长度2.5-2.7倍的提升，且对运行时性能影响微乎其微，为长上下文LLM训练提供了一种低门槛、高效率的优化途径。

title: Web2BigTable: A Bi-Level Multi-Agent LLM System for Internet-Scale Information Search and Extraction
summary: Agentic web search increasingly faces two distinct demands: deep reasoning over a single target, and structured aggregation across many entities and heterogeneous sources. Current systems struggle on both fronts. Breadth-oriented tasks demand schema-aligned outputs with wide coverage and cross-entity consistency, while depth-oriented tasks require coherent reasoning over long, branching search trajectories. We introduce \textbf{Web2BigTable}, a multi-agent framework for web-to-table search that supports both regimes. Web2BigTable adopts a bi-level architecture in which an upper-level orchestrator decomposes the task into sub-problems and lower-level worker agents solve them in parallel. Through a closed-loop run--verify--reflect process, the framework jointly improves decomposition and execution over time via persistent, human-readable external memory, with self-evolving updates to each single-agent. During execution, workers coordinate through a shared workspace that makes partial findings visible, allowing them to reduce redundant exploration, reconcile conflicting evidence, and adapt to emerging coverage gaps. Web2BigTable sets a new state of the art on WideSearch, reaching an Avg@4 Success Rate of \textbf{38.50} ($7.5\times$ the second best at 5.10), Row F1 of \textbf{63.53} (+25.03 over the second best), and Item F1 of \textbf{80.12} (+14.42 over the second best). It also generalises to depth-oriented search on XBench-DeepSearch, achieving 73.0 accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/web2bigtable/web2bigtable.

AI.tldr: Web2BigTable 是一个面向"网页转表格"（web-to-table）搜索的双层多智能体 LLM 框架：上层编排器（orchestrator）负责把查询分解为子任务，下层并行 worker 负责具体检索与抽取，二者通过"运行—验证—反思"（Run–Verify–Reflect）闭环及持久化的人类可读外部记忆（技能库 SKILL.md + 共享工作板 workboard）实现自进化，全程冻结模型参数、无梯度更新。在 WideSearch 上取得 Avg@4 成功率 38.50（第二名 5.10 的 7.5 倍）、Row F1 63.53、Item F1 80.12 的 SOTA；在深度型 XBench-DeepSearch 上达到 73.0 准确率。
AI.motivation: 智能体式网页搜索呈现两种不同需求：深度型（deep search，需对单一目标做多跳长链推理）与广度型（wide search，需跨大量实体与异构来源做结构化聚合）。现有系统两端皆不擅长：单智能体受限于上下文饱和、误差累积与启动时固定而不可调整的计划；已有层级框架多依赖固定/弱自适应规划，上游分解缺乏来自下游执行的反馈；自进化与记忆增强智能体多局限于单层，未能联合优化"如何分解任务"与"如何执行子任务"。因此需要一个既能协同适应规划与执行、支持多 worker 协调（避免重复探索、调和冲突证据、暴露覆盖缺口）的机制。论文将 web-to-table 形式化为：给定自然语言查询与目标 schema，检索开放网络并返回 schema 对齐的表格，每行一个实体、每列一个属性、每个单元格均需独立依据网络来源核验。
AI.method: 双层架构 + 双时间尺度记忆。(1) 长期语义记忆：两个技能库 S_o（编排器分解策略）与 S_w（worker 执行技能），仅在训练阶段演化、推理时冻结；(2) 短期工作记忆：workboard（Markdown 共享文档），episode 内有效、结束即弃。训练阶段：在每个基准上用 20 条合成/扰动查询做 Run–Verify–Reflect 循环——执行一遍推理、对齐金标准表格算 Item-F1 作为优化目标 U(X)、压缩 worker 轨迹生成结构化错误报告、按"结构分解模式"（而非语义主题）聚类并由反思 LLM 合成仅含结构占位符的可泛化技能与 task-router 路由技能，单调追加写入 SKILL.md。Worker 侧由 Memento-Skills 支撑：SkillResolver 采用"精确名匹配→BM25+ChromaDB(bge-m3) 语义检索（RRF 融合、可选 cross-encoder 重排，>8000 云端技能目录）→SkillCreator 现场合成（函数型 Python 脚本或知识型 Markdown，AST 校验）"的优先级链路，技能失败时以错误栈驱动自修复反思循环并可 evolve_skill 扩展。推理阶段：编排器（GPT-5 mini）先经 task-router 依实体数/schema 复杂度/时间要求/预期产量判型并调用对应分解技能，每个子任务目标 10–20 条以适配 worker 上下文，初始化 workboard 的任务清单、共享上下文与标签分区结果槽；worker（Gemini 3 Flash，ReAct 循环，最多 10 并发，经 MCP server asyncio.gather 调度，生成/工具超时 120s/30s）仅可读全文、仅可写自己标签区（文件锁保护），通过 read_workboard/edit_workboard 实现读—写不对称，涌现出冗余规避、覆盖缺口检测、策略适应三类自适应行为；速度差异形成信息级联；终止后编排器做行数/列覆盖/一致性校验并聚合为统一大表，不做摘要去重等后处理，预期正确性直接源自分解设计。
AI.result: WideSearch（200 任务，Avg@4）成功率 38.50（第二名 5.10，7.5×）、Max@4 40.00；Row F1 63.53（+25.03）、Max@4 65.12；Item F1 80.12（+14.42）、Max@4 82.48，均为 SOTA；中英文子集 SR 分别为 31.00/46.00。XBench-DeepSearch 准确率 73.0，超过 Minimax-M2 与 MiroFlow（均 72.0）、Kimi-Researcher（69.0）、GLM-4.5（70.0）；在 DeepSearch 上用 5 个 worker。消融：去掉已学编排器技能 SR 38.50→7.00、Row F1 63.53→45.23、Item F1 80.12→62.87、XBench 73.0→41.0（贡献最大）；去掉 workboard Row F1→54.81、XBench→60.0；去掉 worker 技能演化 Row F1→59.67、XBench→64.0。对照实验表明增益源于框架而非骨干：GPT-5 mini 与 Gemini 3 Flash 单智能体 Item F1 仅 33.28/31.61，而最强单智能体基线 Claude-4.5-Sonnet（65.70）、GPT-5 High（62.20）仍落后至少 14 分。案例（Taylor Swift 534 行任务 Row F1 93.8%、AMD Zen 12 列任务 89%/96%、ByteDance+DeepSeek 论文任务 91%/94%）显示按实体/产品线/来源的分解策略配合缺口检测与专职核验 worker 可显著提升覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: Web2BigTable 通过"记忆中介的自进化"架构同时支撑广度型与深度型网页搜索：上层编排器从少量训练查询中自动习得可复用的分解策略，下层异步 worker 借共享 Markdown 工作板协调并各自演化执行技能，所有适应都经由持久化、可读、可编辑的外部记忆完成而不更新模型参数。实验证明其在 WideSearch 上取得 SOTA 并在结构迥异的 XBench-DeepSearch 上展现出强泛化，消融显示"已学分解策略"贡献了性能优势的最大份额，说明双层记忆协调 + 自动化策略学习可作为单智能体架构在规模化结构化抽取上的可扩展、免训练替代方案。附录进一步提出 Memento-Team 理论扩展：将编排器—worker 交互形式化为 Stackelberg 博弈（策略记忆与执行记忆为决策变量），worker 子博弈为离散精确势博弈，并在有界通信延迟与稀疏记忆竞争假设下证明系统几乎必然收敛到双层记忆均衡邻域，其收敛半径由底层 LLM 的幻觉噪声决定。局限：训练需少量带金标准表格的查询，训练/推理界限明确，深度型任务上并行 worker 数需调低（5 而非 10），同时工作板依赖全局可读文档在极大并发下的一致性维护。

title: Distributed Santa Claus via Global Rounding
summary: In this paper, we consider the Santa Claus problem in the CONGEST model. This NP-hard problem can be modeled as a bipartite graph of children and gifts where an edge indicates that a child desires a gift. Notably, each gift can have a different value. The goal is to assign the gifts to the children such that the least happy child is as happy as possible. Even though this is a well-studied problem in the sequential setting, we obtain the first results the distributed setting. In particular, we show that the complexity of computing an $\mathcal{O}(\log n/\log \log n)$-approximation is $\hat Θ(\sqrt n+D)$ rounds, where our $\widetildeΩ(\sqrt n+D)$-round lower bound is even stronger and holds for any approximation.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在分布式CONGEST模型中研究Santa Claus问题，证明O(log n/log log n)近似比的复杂度下界为Θ̃(√n + D)轮，且该下界对任意近似算法都成立。
AI.motivation: Santa Claus问题是一个NP难问题，在顺序模型中已被广泛研究，但在分布式模型中尚未被探索。该问题在资源分配和公平性优化方面具有重要实际意义。
AI.method: 采用了分布式算法设计与分析技术，在CONGEST模型中设计近似算法，并通过对通信模式的下界分析证明该近似比和复杂度下界。
AI.result: 证明了在CONGEST模型中，计算O(log n / log log n)近似解的复杂度为Θ̃(√n + D)轮。更重要的是，给出了一个更强的下界Θ̃(√n + D)，该下界对任意近似算法都成立。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次在分布式（CONGEST）模型中研究了Santa Claus问题，表明可在O(log n / log log n)近似比内达到O(√n + D)轮的复杂度，并证明该复杂度下界对任意近似算法都成立，这是该领域的一个重要突破。

title: ScaleBox: Enabling High-Fidelity and Scalable Code Verification for Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 Demo. Our project is available at https://github.com/icip-cas/ScaleBox
summary: Code sandboxes have emerged as a critical infrastructure for advancing the coding capabilities of large language models, providing verifiable feedback for both RL training and evaluation. However, existing systems fail to provide accurate verification and efficiency under high-concurrency workloads. We present ScaleBox, a high-fidelity and scalable system designed to address these limitations in large-scale code training. ScaleBox introduces automated special-judge generation and management, fine-grained parallel execution across test cases with seamless multi-node coordination, and a configuration-driven evaluation suite for reproducible benchmarking. A series of experiments demonstrates that ScaleBox significantly enhances code verification accuracy and efficiency. Our further RLVR experiments show that ScaleBox substantially improves both performance on LiveCodeBench and training stability, significantly outperforming heuristic-matching baselines. By providing a reliable and high-throughput infrastructure, ScaleBox facilitates more effective research and development in large-scale code training.

AI.tldr: ScaleBox是一个面向大规模LLM代码训练的高保真、可扩展代码执行验证系统，通过自动化特殊裁判、细粒度并行执行和多节点协调等技术创新，解决了传统沙箱在并发场景下的验证不准与效率低下问题，并在LiveCodeBench上验证了其性能优势。
AI.motivation: 现有代码沙箱系统在高频并发场景下，无法同时满足代码验证的准确性和执行效率两大需求，而大规模代码训练对此有强烈需求。
AI.method: 该系统包含三大核心设计：1）自动特殊裁判生成与管理机制；2）跨测试用例的细粒度并行执行与多节点协同调度；3）配置驱动的评估套件以确保可复现的基准测试。
AI.result: 实验表明ScaleBox显著提升了代码验证的准确性与效率；RLVR实验进一步证明其在LiveCodeBench上的性能提升和训练稳定性增强，明显优于启发式匹配基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ScaleBox通过提供可靠、高吞吐量的代码执行基础设施，显著提升了大规模代码训练的效率与稳定性，为该领域的研究与开发提供了重要支撑。

title: Bibliometric Mapping of AI-Supported Social Presence in Online Learning Environments: Trends, Collaboration, and Thematic Directions
summary: This study examines the development, influence, and collaboration patterns in AI-supported social presence research within online learning environments. Utilizing 59 open-access empirical studies from Scopus, the study applies citation analysis, co-authorship mapping, institutional analysis, and keyword clustering using Python-based bibliometric tools. Findings reveal an upward trend in publications since 2020, with research focusing on engagement, AI tools, instructional design, and ethical issues. While countries such as the United States and Brazil are leading contributors, international collaboration remains limited. Ethical concerns related to trust and fairness are emerging but underexplored. The study highlights the importance of ethical integration, interdisciplinary collaboration, and learner-centered AI applications in education.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过文献计量方法分析了在线学习环境中AI支持的社交存在感研究的发展、影响和协作模式，发现该领域近年来增长迅速，但国际合作不足，伦理问题亟待深入探索。
AI.motivation: 需要系统梳理和理解AI支持的社交存在感研究在在线学习环境中的发展轨迹、影响范围和协作模式，以把握该领域的研究现状与未来方向。
AI.method: 使用Scopus中的59项开放获取实证研究，应用引用分析、作者合作映射、机构分析和关键词聚类，并采用基于Python的文献计量工具进行分析。
AI.result: 发表量自2020年起呈上升趋势；研究主要聚焦于参与度、AI工具、教学设计和伦理问题；美国和巴西是领先贡献国；国际合作有限；信任和公平相关的伦理问题正在兴起但尚未被充分探索。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调在教育中整合伦理考量、跨学科协作以及以学习者为中心的AI应用的重要性。美国和巴西是主要贡献国家，但国际合作仍然有限。信任和公平相关的伦理问题虽已出现但尚未得到充分探索。

title: Reproducing Adaptive Reranking for Reasoning-Intensive IR
summary: The classical cascading pipeline of retrieve--rerank suffers from a bounded recall problem, stemming from limitations of the first-stage retriever. Most current approaches address the bounded recall problem by improving the first-stage retriever, but this incurs substantial training and inference costs, especially to handle queries that require substantial reasoning. To circumvent the computational costs of reasoning-based retrievers, we replicate the findings of GAR, Graph-based Adaptive Reranking, on the BRIGHT reasoning-intensive retrieval benchmark. GAR addresses the bounded recall problem by modifying the reranking process itself through iterative exploration of a corpus graph, but it was previously only tested on models designed for topical and question-answering-style queries. Hence, reproduce GAR in reasoning-intensive settings with reasoning and non-reasoning reranking models. We observe that the quality of the reranker's signal plays an important role in identifying additional relevant documents within the corpus graph. Overall, we find that GAR boosts the effectiveness of reasoning-intensive retrieval across a variety of models while contributing minimally to computational overheads. Ultimately, this work enables more practical deployment of retrieval systems that can address reasoning-intensive queries.

AI.tldr: This paper reproduces GAR (Graph-based Adaptive Reranking) on the BRIGHT reasoning-intensive retrieval benchmark to address the bounded recall problem without costly retriever improvements. By iteratively exploring corpus graphs during reranking, GAR enhances retrieval effectiveness across multiple models with minimal computational overhead, while revealing that reranker signal quality is crucial for identifying relevant documents.
AI.motivation: The classical retrieve-rerank pipeline suffers from bounded recall problem due to first-stage retriever limitations. Existing solutions of improving the retriever incur substantial training/inference costs, especially for reasoning-intensive queries.
AI.method: Reproducing and testing GAR (Graph-based Adaptive Reranking) on BRIGHT benchmark; iterative exploration of corpus graph to modify the reranking process; experiments with both reasoning and non-reasoning reranking models.
AI.result: Reranker signal quality plays an important role in identifying additional relevant documents within corpus graph; GAR effectively boosts retrieval effectiveness across various models.
AI.conclusion: GAR boosts effectiveness of reasoning-intensive retrieval across various models with minimal computational overhead, enabling more practical deployment of retrieval systems for reasoning-intensive queries.

title: Learning When to Remember: Risk-Sensitive Contextual Bandits for Abstention-Aware Memory Retrieval in LLM-Based Coding Agents
comment: 26 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Code and deterministic local artifacts are available at the repository listed in the paper
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based coding agents increasingly rely on external memory to reuse prior debugging experience, repair traces, and repository-local operational knowledge. However, retrieved memory is useful only when the current failure is genuinely compatible with a previous one; superficial similarity in stack traces, terminal errors, paths, or configuration symptoms can lead to unsafe memory injection. This paper reframes issue-memory use as a selective, risk-sensitive control problem rather than a pure top-k retrieval problem. We introduce RSCB-MC, a risk-sensitive contextual bandit memory controller that decides whether an agent should use no memory, inject the top resolution, summarize multiple candidates, perform high-precision or high-recall retrieval, abstain, or ask for feedback. The system stores reusable issue knowledge through a pattern-variant-episode schema and converts retrieval evidence into a fixed 16-feature contextual state capturing relevance, uncertainty, structural compatibility, feedback history, false-positive risk, latency, and token cost. Its reward design penalizes false-positive memory injection more strongly than missed reuse, making non-injection and abstention first-class safety actions. In deterministic smoke-scale artifacts, RSCB-MC obtains the strongest non-oracle offline replay success rate, 62.5%, while maintaining a 0.0% false-positive rate. In a bounded 200-case hot-path validation, it reaches 60.5% proxy success with 0.0% false positives and a 331.466 microseconds p95 decision latency. The results show that, for coding-agent memory, the key question is not only which memory is most similar, but whether any retrieved memory is safe enough to influence the debugging trajectory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RSCB-MC——一种面向 LLM 编码智能体的风险敏感上下文老虎机记忆控制器，将"是否复用历史调试记忆"重述为带弃权（abstention）的选择性控制问题：在检索给出候选后，控制器基于 16 维上下文状态在 {no_memory, top1_resolution, top3_summary, high_precision_retrieval, high_recall_retrieval, abstain, ask_feedback} 中选择动作，奖励函数刻意令假阳性注入的惩罚大于正确复用收益（γ>α>β），使"不使用记忆"成为一等安全动作。在确定性 smoke-scale 制品上，离线回放非 oracle 成功率 62.5%、假阳性率 0.0%；200 例 hot-path 验证成功率 60.5%、假阳性 0.0%、p95 决策延迟 331.466 μs。局限是全部为本地确定性/代理指标，非在线 LLM 因果评估。
AI.motivation: 作者在实际操作 Python 仓库的 LLM 编码智能体时反复观察到：智能体识别出"看起来熟悉"的错误后，检索到过往存储的"修复"并自信套用，结果反而更糟。典型五类失败模式包括：SQLite "database is locked" 与陈旧 migration 日志几乎一致但需完全不同的修复；虚拟环境激活错误与 PYTHONPATH 错误同样表现为 ModuleNotFoundError；内部服务无效配置键与备份目录路径解析失败同样抛出 KeyError；检索假阳性与会话级拒绝的记忆复用；以及过期记忆变体与迁移顺序错配。这些说明表层相似（栈轨迹、终端错误、路径、配置症状）导致的检索不仅无益，反而将智能体锚定到错误修复分支、消耗上下文预算并放大幻觉修复。作者进一步指出相关工作（RAG 知识边界、Parametric RAG、KnowledGPT/DRO、RAG-Gym/ReasonRAG/SIRAG 等 agentic RAG、历史驱动修复/RAP-Gen/ReAPR/Repair-Ingredients-Search，以及拒答与选择性预测文献）的共同盲点：它们要么把"检索"默认视为可注入的许可，要么把拒答对象限定在最终答案上，而忽略了错误记忆注入会静默地影响智能体后续每一步推理与文件编辑。
AI.method: 方法为 RSCB-MC（Risk-Sensitive Contextual Bandit with Memory Control），一个本地优先、确定性的热路径单步控制器，不微调 LLM、不调用托管推理或外部嵌入服务。流程为：原始调试上下文 x_t 经确定性归一化 φ 得查询画像 q_t（词法证据、根因 token、失败族信号、命令/路径/栈签名、实体槽、反馈信号）；检索得到候选集 C_t；将 q_t 与 C_t 联合映射为固定 16 维状态 z_t ∈ R^16，特征包括 top1/top2 分数、分数边际 Δ_t、候选熵 H_t（基于平滑归一化 π_{t,i}）、候选数、失败族置信度、实体匹配率、命令/路径/栈签名匹配、会话拒绝计数、历史接受率、历史假阳性率、估计延迟、token 成本、剩余上下文预算。动作集为 7 项：no_memory、top1_resolution、top3_summary、high_precision_retrieval、high_recall_retrieval、abstain、ask_feedback；其中 abstain 与 no_memory 不注入记忆，属合法安全结果。奖励为分解式 r_t = αI_verified + βI_accepted + κI_correct_abstain − γI_false_positive − δI_rejected − ηL_t − λT_t，默认系数 (α,β,κ,γ,δ,η,λ)=(2.0,1.0,0.5,4.0,1.0,0.001,0.01)，不变量 γ>α>β（假阳性注入损害大于正确复用收益）。决策分为风险正则化动作分数 S(a,z)=R̂ − μ p̂_fp − λ_c ĉ，以及扩展实现分数 S_t(a)=Q_t(a)+ρA_t(a)−μFP_t(a)−λ_cC(a)+w_u√(log(N_t+2)/(N_t(a)+1)) − w_r√(log(N_t+2)/(N_t^fp(a)+1)) p̂^ctx_fp(z_t) + g_θ(a,z_t) − h_θ(a,z_t)，含 UCB 风格探索/风险探索项与轻量上下文奖励/风险模型；随后经 argmax 与 SafetyOverride（会话级拒绝信号、hard-negative 提示可强制转为 abstain/no_memory）。记忆库采用 pattern–variant–episode 三层模式 m_i=(p_i,V_i,E_i)，区分可复用症状/根因类、上下文特定修复策略与命令路径栈签名、以及具体观察证据与验证/反馈历史。论文给出两个"决策边界"：非注入占优条件 γp_f+δp_r+κp_c > αp_v+βp_a；以及分数等价于带约束 max R̂ s.t. p̂_fp≤ε, ĉ≤b 的一步拉格朗日松弛。
AI.result: 在 codex_issue_memory 制品（main 分支 commit 227bbe3，Python 3.12.3，data/paper_seed，smoke-scale）上：规范化检索集 24 查询上所有检索方法 Recall@1/@3、MRR、nDCG@3、top-1 均为 100%（说明瓶颈不在检索）；改写集上 lexical 改写 R@1 78.1%、static hybrid 80.2%，而 static+abstention 与 full retriever 降至 51.0%，oracle 保持 100%。32 例 hard negative 上 static hybrid 假阳性率 75.0%、unsafe injection 100%，LinUCB 75.0%，Thompson 50.0%，而 risk-sensitive TS 与 RSCB-MC 均为 0.0% 假阳性/0.0% unsafe injection/100% 正确安全非注入（= oracle）。56 例弃权基准上 RSCB-MC 与 risk-TS 全部拒答（0.0% 回答率、0.0% 风险），正确弃权 57.1%、错误弃权 42.9%，显示过度保守、尚未校准。离线回放（2 seed×40 事件）：RSCB-MC 成功率 62.5%、假阳性 0.0%、弃权 35.0%、verified reuse 25.0%、累积奖励 −31.740，为最佳非 oracle（risk-TS 60.0%/0.0%/−33.700；UCB1 55.0%/2.5%；static 50.0%/17.5%/−70.800；oracle 67.5%/0.0%/−5.900，差距 5 个百分点）。消融：移除弃权动作使假阳性升至 17.5%、累积奖励降至 −87.800（最关键）；去掉失败族特征 −41.740，去掉实体特征 −33.495，无上下文老虎机 −33.700，无风险敏感目标 −33.820，仅静态混合 −70.800。奖励敏感性扫描最佳配置 fp1_acc0p5_cab0p5_tok0（0.0% 假阳性、风险调整效用 −14.982），但作者指出奖励幅度未必改变动作选择，仅在符号/类别改变时生效。上下文预算代理（24 例）：short hint 期望成功最高 74.5% 但假阳性影响 12.0%，效用 48.6；no_memory 成功 60.8%、效用 60.8 最佳（零 token/延迟/影响）；top-1 resolution 与 top-3 summary 假阳性影响均 86.3%、效用为负（−115.9/−122.7）；full trace 48.3% 成功、效用 −72.7。200 例 hot-path 验证（共 2000 次进程内决策）：RSCB-MC 成功率 60.5%、假阳性 0.0%、平均延迟 267.792 μs、p95 331.466 μs；risk-TS 60.0%/0.0%/285.689/411.821 μs；LinUCB 42.0%/5.5%/2865.263/3567.384 μs；oracle 67.5%/0.0%/78.106/113.588 μs。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：编码智能体的记忆问题核心不在"哪条记忆最相似"，而在"是否有任何检索到的记忆足够安全到可以改变调试轨迹"。RSCB-MC 通过 pattern-variant-episode 记忆模式、16 维可审计状态、以假阳性注入为首要安全事件的风险敏感奖励与弃权一等化，在确定性 smoke-scale 制品上取得最佳非 oracle 回放成功率 62.5% 且假阳性 0.0%，消融证实弃权机制是功能性安全组件而非装饰性回退。作者坦承证据边界：结果基于本地确定性、代理式（proxy-based）制品，非在线 LLM 因果反事实实验；全量基准尚未刷新；hot-path 奖励标签仍为离线代理；上下文预算实验非真实修复质量测量；上下文老虎机仅优化即时决策，不建模延迟多轮后果、记忆老化与仓库漂移；且 RSCB-MC 只做"读时安全层"，不写记忆、不解决矛盾、不处理陈旧条目，未来方向包括全量基准刷新、真实 LLM 智能体评估、安全复用边界校准、更强反事实估计的离策略评估以及长时程建模，并建议记忆系统应报告假阳性注入率而非仅 Recall@k/MRR、payload 规模与风险联合控制、记忆门控与检索分离以便审计。

title: Anomaly Detection in Soil Heavy Metal Contamination Using Unsupervised Learning for Environmental Risk Assessment
summary: Soil contamination by heavy metals poses a persistent environmental and public health concern in rapidly urbanising regions of Ghana, particularly at unregulated waste disposal sites. This study applies an unsupervised machine learning framework to detect and characterise anomalous heavy metal contamination patterns in soils from twelve waste sites and residential controls in the Central Region, of Ghana. Concentrations of eight metals (As, Cd, Cr, Cu, Hg, Ni, Pb, Zn) were analysed alongside standard health risk indices, including the Hazard Index (HI) and Incremental Lifetime Cancer Risk (ILCR). Isolation Forest and PCA reconstruction error each identified $12$ anomalous samples ($15.4\%$ of $78$ samples), while DBSCAN detected no density-isolated noise points. A consensus approach isolated six robust anomalies ($7.7\%)$, all spatially concentrated at a single site (S3). Anomalies exhibited approximately $70$--$80\%$ higher mean HI values than normal samples, with all consensus anomalies exceeding the HI$=1$ threshold. PCA reconstruction error showed a strong positive association with HI ($r \approx 0.8$), indicating consistency between multivariate deviation and health risk. Three distinct anomaly types were identified: extreme Cu enrichment at S3, anomalously low Ni at S4/S5, and moderate multi-metal (Pb--Zn) co-elevation at S9--S12. The results demonstrate that unsupervised machine learning provides granular, objective insight beyond aggregate indices, enabling targeted site prioritisation and risk-informed environmental management.

AI.tldr: 本研究将无监督机器学习框架应用于加纳中部地区废物处置场地的土壤重金属污染检测，通过Isolation Forest、PCA重建误差和DBSCAN三种算法识别异常样本，发现6个稳健异常值（7.7%）集中于S3场地，具有显著升高的健康风险（HI超过阈值），验证了机器学习方法在精细化场地污染表征和风险评估中的应用价值。
AI.motivation: 加纳快速城市化地区的土壤重金属污染是一个持续性的环境和公共健康问题，尤其是在无监管的废物处置场地，传统方法难以精细识别和表征污染异常模式。
AI.method: 采用无监督机器学习框架，综合Isolation Forest、PCA重建误差和DBSCAN三种算法，分析加纳中部地区12个废物处置场地和住宅对照点的78个土壤样本，检测8种重金属（As、Cd、Cr、Cu、Hg、Ni、Pb、Zn）浓度，并结合健康风险指数（HI和ILCR）进行验证。采用共识方法整合多算法结果以识别稳健异常值。
AI.result: Isolation Forest和PCA重建误差各识别出12个异常样本（78个样本的15.4%），DBSCAN未检测到密度隔离噪声点。共识方法筛选出6个稳健异常值（7.7%），全部集中于单一场地S3。异常样本的HI均值比正常样本高约70-80%，且所有共识异常值均超过HI=1阈值。PCA重建误差与HI呈强正相关（r≈0.8）。识别出三种异常类型：S3的极端Cu富集、S4/S5的异常低Ni、以及S9-S12的中等多金属（Pb-Zn）共升高。
AI.conclusion: 无监督机器学习方法能够提供超越传统综合指数的精细、客观的洞察，实现针对性场地优先级排序和风险知情型环境管理。

title: Succinct Graph Representations and Algorithmic Applications
summary:
We propose new graph representations that exploit dense local structure to improve time and space simultaneously. Given an undirected graph $G$, we define a dual clique cover (DCC) representation of $G$ to be the pair $(C, L)$, where $C$ is a collection of cliques that covers the edges of $G$ and $L$ is the incidence dual of $C$. We identify classes of polynomial-time constructible DCC representations that are compact and call them succinct DCC representations. We then develop representation-aware algorithms for several fundamental graph problems.
  We show that graph primitives such as connected components, breadth-first search forests, depth-first search forests, and maximal matchings can be computed in time proportional to the size of a DCC representation rather than the number of edges. Combined with our succinct DCC representations, these results give a class of algorithms that either match or improve the time and space bounds of their counterparts on standard graph representations. Furthermore, we design several algorithms for constructing succinct DCC representations and establish provable guarantees on their efficiency.
  We evaluate several graph algorithms on DCC representations against adjacency-list-based implementations on a large collection of real-world and synthetic graphs. All evaluated applications show substantial execution memory savings and total-time speedups; for example, the connected components algorithm achieves about $9\times$ execution memory savings on average, with a maximum of $35\times$, and about $6.5\times$ total-time speedups on average, with a maximum of $35\times$. We also evaluate several DCC construction algorithms and find that the succinctness property plays a key role in making DCC representations effective for algorithmic applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用对偶团覆盖（DCC）表示来挖掘图的稠密局部结构，从而同时改善图算法的时间与空间效率。通过设计succinct DCC表示和相应的representation-aware算法，在连通分量、BFS、DFS、最大匹配等问题上取得了显著的性能提升，实验验证平均内存节省约9倍、总时间加速约6.5倍。
AI.motivation: 传统图表示（如邻接表）在处理大规模图时面临时间与空间的双重压力，而图的局部稠密结构尚未被充分挖掘利用。作者试图通过利用图中dense local structure来同时改进算法的时间和空间效率。
AI.method: 定义了DCC（对偶团覆盖）表示框架（C为覆盖边的团集合，L为C的对偶关联关系），识别并构造了succinct DCC表示（紧凑且可在多项式时间内构造），并在此基础上开发了针对基本图问题的representation-aware算法，如连通分量、BFS森林、DFS森林和最大匹配等，时间复杂度与DCC表示大小而非边数成正比。
AI.result: 提出的算法在时间和空间上均能达到或优于传统标准表示的算法；连通分量算法平均实现约9倍内存节省（最高35倍）和约6.5倍总时间加速（最高35倍）；succinctness特性是DCC表示在算法应用中有效的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 通过在真实世界和合成图上的实验验证，DCC表示在内存节省和运行速度上均表现优异。该工作为图算法提供了一种compact且representation-aware的新范式。

title: A Longitudinal Analysis of Good First Issue Practices and Newcomer Pull Requests in Popular OSS Projects
summary: Open-source software (OSS) projects rely on effective newcomer onboarding to sustain their communities. OSS projects widely adopt "good first issue" (GFI) labels to highlight beginner-friendly tasks. As development practices continue to evolve, understanding how these onboarding mechanisms change over time is important for both maintainers and researchers. This study analyzes 406,826 issues and 1,117 newcomer GFI pull requests across 37 popular GitHub repositories (30 of which use GFI labels) over a four-year period from July 2021 to June 2025. We find that while the proportion of issues with GFI labels remained stable during the first three years, it underwent a statistically significant decline beginning in January 2024, with substantial variation across projects not explained by repository age or programming language. Despite this supply-side decline, newcomer engagement with GFI issues remains stable at approximately 27%, suggesting that GFI labels maintain consistent attractiveness. Examining the outcomes of this engagement, we find that the merge rate of newcomer GFI pull requests declined from 61.9% to 42.2%. Initial pull request characteristics such as description length and code size show no significant association with merge outcomes, indicating that success is not predicted by the quantitative characteristics of the initial submission alone. Together, these findings reveal a widening gap between stable newcomer interest in GFIs and the declining availability and success of GFI-based onboarding, underscoring the need for maintainers to sustain both GFI labeling and review support.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对37个GitHub仓库四年数据的分析，发现GFI标签自2024年起显著减少，但新手参与意愿保持稳定，而合并率却持续下降，表明开源项目的新手引导机制正面临供需失衡的挑战。
AI.motivation: 开源软件项目依赖有效的新手引导机制来维持社区发展。GFI（good first issue）标签被广泛用于标识适合初学者参与的任务，但随着开发实践的演变，理解这些引导机制如何随时间变化对于维护者和研究者都至关重要。
AI.method: 基于37个热门GitHub仓库（其中30个使用GFI标签），分析了406,826个Issue和1,117个新手GFI Pull Request，时间跨度为2021年7月至2025年6月的四年数据。采用统计回归分析方法评估GFI标签比例变化趋势及其影响因素（仓库年龄、编程语言），并检验新手PR特征与合并结果的关联性。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）GFI标签比例在前三年保持稳定，但自2024年1月起出现统计显著的下降，且项目间差异无法由仓库年龄或编程语言解释；2）新手对GFI问题的参与度稳定在约27%；3）新手GFI Pull Request的合并率从61.9%下降至42.2%；4）初始PR特征（如描述长度、代码规模）与合并结果无显著关联。
AI.conclusion: GFI标签的可用性与审查成功率呈现下降趋势，而新手开发者的参与意愿保持稳定，形成日益扩大的供需缺口。研究强调了维护者需要同时维持GFI标签标注和代码审查支持的重要性，以保障开源项目的有效新手引导。

title: Exploring the Adoption Intention in Using AI-Enabled Educational Tools Among Preservice Teachers in the Philippines: A Partial-Least Square Modeling
summary: This study examines the factors influencing pre-service teachers' behavioral intention to use AI-enabled educational tools during their practicum, using the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology 2 (UTAUT2) as the theoretical framework. The model includes the core UTAUT2 constructs such as performance expectancy, effort expectancy, hedonic motivation, social influence, facilitating conditions, price value, and habit. It also incorporates additional predictors including computer self-efficacy, computer anxiety, and computer playfulness. Data were collected from 563 pre-service teachers using a structured questionnaire and analyzed using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM). The results indicate that performance expectancy and hedonic motivation are the strongest predictors of behavioral intention. Computer self-efficacy, computer anxiety, and computer playfulness significantly influenced effort expectancy, although effort expectancy did not directly predict behavioral intention. Performance expectancy was significantly predicted by extrinsic motivation, job fit, relative advantage, and outcome expectations. Constructs such as social influence and facilitating conditions showed limited or inverse effects. These findings suggest that internal motivational, cognitive, and emotional factors are more influential than external or institutional factors in shaping the adoption of AI-enabled tools. The study highlights the importance of promoting personal relevance, confidence, and enjoyment in teacher preparation programs to encourage technology integration.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于UTAUT2模型，结合电脑自我效能、电脑焦虑与电脑趣味性，采用PLS-SEM对563名实习前教师的数据进行分析，考察其使用AI教育工具的行为意向影响因素。结果显示：绩效期望与享乐动机是最强预测因子；电脑自我效能、焦虑与趣味性显著影响努力期望，但努力期望不直接预测行为意向；绩效期望受外在动机、工作匹配度、相对优势与结果期望显著影响；社会影响与促成条件效应有限甚至为负。结论是内部动机、认知与情感因素比外部或制度因素更能塑造AI教育工具的采纳意愿，建议教师培养项目着重提升个人相关性、自我效能感与使用愉悦感。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI与智能教育工具正快速进入师范生的教学实践（practicum）环节，但实证研究对其采纳机制仍不充分。既有UTAUT/UTAUT2研究多聚焦于通用技术系统（如LMS、移动学习），缺乏针对AI教育工具且针对师范生实习场景的专门验证；同时，UTAUT2原始框架多依赖外部变量（社会影响、促成条件、价格价值），难以充分解释职前教师特有的心理特征（自我效能、技术焦虑、易地性趣味等）与实习情境下的独特动机（如外在奖励、岗位匹配）。因此，本研究旨在扩展并检验UTAUT2模型在AI教育工具采纳情境下的解释力，并识别对师范教育课程设计与技术支持策略具有指导意义的关键干预杠杆。
AI.method: 理论框架：以UTAUT2为核心，纳入绩效期望、努力期望、享乐动机、社会影响、促成条件、价格价值、习惯七个核心构念，并额外引入三个预测变量——电脑自我效能（computer self-efficacy）、电脑焦虑（computer anxiety）、电脑趣味性（computer playfulness）作为努力期望的前置因素；同时进一步扩展绩效期望的上游解释变量，包括外在动机（extrinsic motivation）、工作匹配度（job fit）、相对优势（relative advantage）与结果期望（outcome expectations）。数据收集：对563名师范生发放结构化问卷，获取自陈数据。分析方法：采用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）进行测量模型检验（信效度、区分效度、因子载荷）与结构模型路径系数、显著性检验及效应量评估，从而系统估计各路径的直接影响与间接效应。
AI.result: 1）行为意向的最强显著预测因子为绩效期望（PE）与享乐动机（HM），表明师范生是否打算使用AI工具主要取决于"AI能否提升教学绩效"以及"使用过程本身是否带来愉悦感"。2）习惯、价格价值等未显示稳定显著路径，说明重复使用行为的惯性认知与成本-价值权衡在实习初期作用有限。3）电脑自我效能（正向）、电脑焦虑（负向）与电脑趣味性（正向）显著影响努力期望，说明对技术操作能力的信心、情绪上的技术畏惧/压力感以及游戏化体验会实质性塑造"使用AI有多容易"的主观判断。4）努力期望虽然对促成条件或行为意向的直接路径不显著，但通过绩效期望的中介作用间接影响行为意向，提示技术易用性需转化为可感知的教学收益才能驱动采纳。5）绩效期望由外在动机（实习考核、导师与学校奖励）、工作匹配度（AI功能与教学任务的契合）、相对优势（相较传统方法的优势）与结果期望（预期产出）显著预测。6）社会影响（同伴与教师意见）与促成条件（基础设施、技术支持）的效应有限甚至呈负向/不显著，表明单纯的制度推动与同伴压力不足以产生真实使用意愿，甚至可能引发抵触。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论：师范生对AI教育工具的采纳是"内部动机主导"的决策过程——绩效期望与享乐动机居于核心地位，而努力期望需借助绩效期望的中介传导；外部制度性因素（社会影响、促成条件）作用微弱甚至消极。据此建议：（1）教师培养项目应强化AI工具与真实教学任务的岗位匹配度，展示可量化的教学绩效与结果证据；（2）通过实操训练提升电脑自我-efficacy、降低技术焦虑、设计趣味化交互以间接拉高努力期望与行为意向；（3）避免仅依赖同伴压力与制度要求，应结合外在激励机制（评价、考核）与相对优势宣传来塑造绩效期望；（4）技术支持与基础设施仍需作为基础保障而非核心驱动。局限包括：横截面自陈数据、单一院校/地区样本、行为意向而非实际使用行为的测量、可能存在共同方法偏差与因果推断不足。后续研究可采用纵向设计、实际使用日志与多组PLS-MGA/分组分析以检验情境差异。

title: One Pass, Any Order: Position-Invariant Listwise Reranking for LLM-Based Recommendation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for recommendation reranking, but their listwise predictions can depend on the order in which candidates are presented. This creates a mismatch between the set-based nature of recommendation and the sequence-based computation of decoder-only LLMs, where permuting an otherwise identical candidate set can change item scores and final rankings. Such order sensitivity makes LLM-based rerankers difficult to rely on, since rankings may reflect prompt serialization rather than user preference. We propose InvariRank, a permutation-invariant listwise reranking framework that addresses this dependence at the architectural level. InvariRank blocks cross-candidate attention with a structured attention mask and negates position-induced scoring changes through shared positional framing under Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE). Combined with a listwise learning-to-rank objective, the model scores all candidates in a single forward pass, avoiding permutation-based invariance training objectives that require multiple permutations of a candidate set. Experiments on recommendation benchmarks show that InvariRank maintains competitive ranking effectiveness while producing stable rankings across candidate permutations. The results suggest that architectural invariance is a practical route to reliable and efficient LLM-based recommendation reranking. The source code is at https://github.com/ejbito/InvariRank.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InvariRank框架，通过架构层面的设计（阻断交叉注意力+共享位置编码）实现排列不变性，使LLM重排器在单次前向传播中稳定地对所有候选者排序，无需依赖多排列训练。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的推荐重排存在顺序敏感性问题：相同候选集的不同排列顺序会导致不同的评分和最终排序结果，这与推荐的集合性质不匹配，削弱了模型的可靠性。
AI.method: 通过结构化注意力掩码阻断跨候选者注意力，并结合旋转位置编码（RoPE）的共享位置框架消除位置诱导的评分偏差，采用列表学习排序目标，模型可在单次前向传播中完成所有候选者的评分。
AI.result: 实验表明InvariRank在保持竞争性排序效力的同时，能产生稳定的跨排列排序结果。
AI.conclusion: Architectural invariance是一种可靠且高效的LLM推荐重排实现路径。

title: LLMs Capture Emotion Labels, Not Emotion Uncertainty: Distributional Analysis and Calibration of Human--LLM Judgment Gaps
summary: Human annotators frequently disagree on emotion labels, yet most evaluations of Large Language Model (LLM) emotion annotation collapse these judgments into a single gold standard, discarding the distributional information that disagreement encodes. We ask whether LLMs capture the structure of this disagreement, not just majority labels, by comparing emotion judgment distributions between human annotators and four zero-shot LLMs, plus a fine-tuned RoBERTa baseline, across two complementary benchmarks: GoEmotions and EmoBank, totaling 640,000 LLM responses. Zero-shot models diverge substantially from human distributions, and in-domain fine-tuning, not model scale, is required to close the gap. We formalize a lexical-grounding gradient through a quantitative transparency score that predicts per-category human--LLM agreement: LLMs reliably capture emotions with explicit lexical markers but systematically fail on pragmatically complex emotions requiring contextual inference, a pattern that replicates across both categorical and continuous emotion frameworks. We further propose three lightweight post-hoc calibration methods that reduce the distributional gap by up to 14\%, and provide actionable guidelines for when LLM emotion annotations can, and cannot, substitute for human labeling.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了LLM情感标注与人类标注分布的差异，发现零样本模型显著偏离人类分布，微调而非模型放大是弥补差距的关键，并提出词汇接地梯度理论解释LLM在显式词汇情感上的优势，同时提供三种后处理校准方法可减少14%的分布差距。
AI.motivation: 人类标注者在情感标签上常存在分歧，但大多数LLM评估将这些判断简化为单一黄金标准，丢弃了分歧所编码的分布信息。核心问题是：LLM是否捕捉到了这种分歧的结构，而不仅仅是多数标签。
AI.method: 在GoEmotions和EmoBank两个基准数据集（共640,000次LLM响应）上比较人类标注者与四个零样本LLM及微调RoBERTa基线的情感判断分布；通过定量透明度分数形式化"词汇接地梯度"概念。
AI.result: 零样本模型与人类分布存在显著差异；领域内微调（而非模型规模）是缩小差距的关键。LLM可靠地捕捉具有显式词汇标记的情感，但在需要语境推理的语用复杂情感上系统性地失败，该模式在分类和连续情感框架中均可复现。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了可操作的校准方法，三种轻量级后处理方法可减少分布差距达14%，并给出了LLM情感标注何时可替代人工标注的实践指南。

title: Better Models, Faster Training: Sigmoid Attention for single-cell Foundation Models
summary: Training stable biological foundation models requires rethinking attention mechanisms: we find that using sigmoid attention as a drop in replacement for softmax attention a) produces better learned representations: on six diverse single-cell datasets, sigmoid achieves 25% higher cell-type separation, better cell-type cohesion metrics, and lower validation loss, b) faster training, models with sigmoid attention train up to 10% faster than their softmax counterparts, and c) more stable training by eliminating inherent sources of instability in softmax attention. We establish that sigmoid attention has globally bounded derivatives ($\leq 0.25$) as opposed to softmax, and a diagonal Jacobian structure in contrast with softmax's dense coupling, which together help alleviate training instabilities. In stress tests on 160M-parameter bidirectional attention models trained without gradient clipping on 8K-token sequences, softmax diverges catastrophically, with gradients exploding by four orders of magnitude, while sigmoid remains stable. Finally, we implement and open-source TritonSigmoid, an efficient GPU kernel that achieves 515 TFLOPS on H100 GPUs, outperforming both FlashAttention-2 and FlashSigmoid, with native padding support, which is essential for biological sequences. Our results establish sigmoid attention as both theoretically grounded and empirically superior for biological foundation models. Code is available at https://github.com/MSDLLCpapers/triton-sigmoid

AI.tldr: 该研究提出用sigmoid注意力机制替代softmax来解决生物基础模型训练中的稳定性和表示质量问题，在单细胞数据集上实现25%更高的细胞类型分离度，训练速度提升10%，并通过理论分析证明sigmoid具有全局有界导数（≤0.25）和对角雅可比结构，可消除softmax的梯度爆炸问题。此外还开源了TritonSigmoid GPU内核，在H100上达到515 TFLOPS性能。
AI.motivation: 当前生物基础模型（如单细胞模型、蛋白质模型）的训练面临两个关键问题：1）softmax注意力机制在长序列场景下存在训练不稳定性（梯度爆炸、需梯度裁剪）；2）学习到的细胞类型表示质量不足。现有方法未能从根本上解决softmax的结构性缺陷。
AI.method: 1）将sigmoid注意力作为softmax的即插即用替代方案；2）理论分析：证明sigmoid的全局导数上界（≤0.25）和对角雅可比结构；3）构建160M参数双向模型在8K-token序列、8M tokens数据上无梯度裁剪的应力测试；4）开发TritonSigmoid高效GPU内核实现515 TFLOPS吞吐。
AI.result: 1）六个单细胞数据集上，sigmoid注意力实现25%更高的细胞类型分离度和更优的细胞类型内聚指标；2）训练速度提升10%；3）softmax在应力测试中梯度爆炸四个数量级导致灾难性发散，sigmoid保持稳定；4）TritonSigmoid性能超越FlashAttention-2和FlashSigmoid。
AI.conclusion: Sigmoid注意力机制在理论上有全局有界导数和对角雅可比结构的优势，在实证上超越softmax在表示质量、训练速度和稳定性方面的表现，可作为生物基础模型的标准注意力机制选择。

title: Focus Session: Autonomous Systems Dependability in the era of AI: Design Challenges in Safety, Security, Reliability and Certification
summary: The design of embedded safety-critical systems such as those used in next-generation automotive and autonomous platforms, is increasingly challenged by escalating system complexity, hardware-software heterogeneity, and the integration of intelligent, data-driven components. Ensuring dependability in such systems requires a holistic approach that spans multiple abstraction layers and encompasses both design- and run-time assurance. Traditional methods for reliability, safety, and security management often fall short in addressing the dynamic and uncertain behaviors introduced by Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) components, especially under stringent real-time, power, and safety constraints. While AI and ML offer powerful predictive, adaptive, and self-optimizing capabilities that can enhance system dependability, their inherent non-determinism, data-dependence, and lack of formal guarantees introduce new challenges for verification, validation, and certification. This paper explores emerging methodologies, architectures, and frameworks for designing dependable autonomous and embedded systems in the era of AI. It highlight advances in reliability modeling, secure system design, and certification approaches that account for imperfect, learning-enabled components, aiming to bridge the gap between AI innovation and certifiable system-level dependability.

AI.tldr: 本文是DATE 2026焦点会议的扩展综述论文，探讨在AI/ML组件大规模嵌入下一代汽车与自主嵌入式系统后，如何在安全（Safety）、信息安全（Security）、可靠性（Reliability）与认证（Certification）四个维度上实现可认证的系统级可信性（dependability）。核心论点是：AI/ML带来的非确定性、数据依赖性与形式化保证缺失，使传统可靠性/安全/安全方法失效，必须采用跨层（硬件—软件—应用）设计时+运行时联合保证、系统级不确定性量化与资源敏感分配等新范式，从而在"不完美ML组件"的前提下仍能构造满足定量安全属性、可支撑认证与法规合规的自主系统。
AI.motivation: 下一代汽车与自主平台（AV）的嵌入式安全关键系统面临三重压力：(1) 系统复杂度与软硬件异构性急剧上升，感知、定位、预测、规划、控制等模块间交互增多，带来隐藏依赖与罕见运行期失效，传统测试难以穷尽；(2) 技术缩放使制造缺陷与物理故障率上升，导致"在日益不可靠的硬件上可靠执行应用"的矛盾；(3) AI/ML 组件被引入以获得预测、自适应与自优化能力，但其数据依赖、行为自适应与非确定性使可验证性、验证与认证（V&V&C）失去形式化保证。同时，受实时性、功耗、成本与安全等级（ISO 26262 ASIL-A~D 与 PFH 10⁻⁵~10⁻⁸）约束，孤立的单层容错方案在功耗/面积/时序开销上不可行。此外，EU AI Act 等法规的生效要求把"可解释、可监督、可追溯"落到工程实践上。因此需要一套跨抽象层、覆盖设计与运行两个阶段、并将"不完美学习组件"纳入可认证体系保证的新方法学与框架。
AI.method: 论文为综述+框架+案例导览性质，分四个技术部分加一个路线图部分。①跨层可靠性：以ISO 26262的安全等级（SIL/ASIL与PFH对应关系）和AV的六模块流水线（原始数据处理、感知、定位、预测、规划、车辆控制）为背景，论证单层（other-layer-agnostic）故障缓解开销过高，须采用跨层（硬件/软件/应用）故障缓解分配与设计空间探索（DSE），并指出设计时最坏情形分析不足以覆盖运行期行为；进而引出ML用于跨层可靠性的适配性优势（运行期故障预测、检测、容忍、自配置），同时列出五类挑战：可解释性缺失、数据稀缺（罕见失效/不安全场景低代表性）、分布外条件性能退化、实时推理的时序与模型规模约束、ML误差直接导致危险行为，需在"性能"与"失效影响"两个维度同时评估可靠性。②跨层安全：按AV栈自下而上展开——车内网络安全（消息机密性/完整性/认证与实时截止期冲突，SEDAN框架用帧打包+GRASP元启发式做密钥长度优化、运行时对称加密与元启发式密钥分发与快速调度满足ISO 26262截止期；IDS部分对比签名式与异常式，并介绍INDRA的GRU自编码器、LATTE的LSTM编码器-解码器+自注意力、TENET的TCN+注意力在检测率/ROC-AUC/漏报率/参数量/推理时延上的递进）；感知层安全（基于重建的异常检测：CNN-BiLSTM VAE处理LiDAR时空数据，GAAD将GAN与自编码器融合以避免"把异常重建为正常"）；定位与地图安全（GPS/GNSS欺骗、冗余多星座与跨层传感器校验、运动一致性异常检测、地图数据完整性与区块链/分布式账本的探索性方案）；控制层安全（CACC虚假数据注入、Luenberger观测器+异常检测、Lyapunov稳定性证明攻击有界下编队稳定、secure boot/固件签名/内存安全监视器/TEEs、优雅降级）；V2X安全（IEEE 1609.2与PKI、隐私/真实性/可用性攻击分类、Sybil攻击、误行为检测与车载云网络防护）。③含不完美ML组件的安全系统设计：给出两个具体系统级方法——(a) 安全驱动的边–云感知划分：边侧轻量DNN给出低时延高噪声估计、云侧大DNN给出高精度高时延估计，控制器显式融合二者，以系统级指标（偏离名义轨迹）评估不确定性×时延的联合效应，从而有理化地探索边/云划分与控制器增益整定；(b) 安全驱动的GPU划分与DNN规模：建立闭环CPS x_{k+1}=f(x_k,u_k,w_k)、估计误差 x̂=x+e、e∈E(θ)参数化不确定性集（由网络深度/宽度/GPU资源决定），安全约束 x∈X_safe，通过可达集过近似 R_{k+1}(θ)={f(x,π(x+e),w)} 与条件 R_k(θ)⊆X_safe 判定安全；定义各状态分量的敏感度 s_i（单独放大某误差边界时可达集体积或安全裕度越界的边际增量），将其形式化为 min_θ C(θ) s.t. R_k(θ)⊆X_safe，并以动态规划、贪心分配、敏感度引导等启发式在GPU成本与安全之间高效权衡；另提出"按系统级安全规格反推最小保护量（部分认证/部分监测）"以节省资源的思想。④可信赖边缘AI感知的法规与工程路线图：围绕EU AI Act（2024年8月生效、CEN/CENELEC及JTC 21标准制定、符合性推定）与功能性安全/网络安全交汇，提出六大支柱——治理与需求映射、数据与流水线完整性（数据血缘/版本/审计/漂移与设备健康检查/合成数据与覆盖度指标）、轻量不确定性量化与校准（MC Dropout、浅层集成、evidential deep learning、再校准与OOD安全回退）、跨传感器流水线的可解释性与规则抽取（蒸馏、代理模型、事后解释、CAM、注意力审查、反事实）、安全与韧性内生设计（威胁建模、鲁棒训练、运行时异常检测、secure boot、签名模型、防篡改日志）、生命周期运维与持续合规（基线/KPI/模型变更日志）；并强调组织层面的角色化培训、指南手册、跨职能模型评审委员会与指标看板。
AI.result: 论文给出了明确的定性结论与关键量化证据。(1) 跨层可靠性设计将故障缓解活动在硬件/软件/应用层间分配，可在满足应用特定容错的同时显著降低硬件层开销与功耗；单一层次方法成本高（功耗/面积/时序）而不可行。(2) ML用于可靠性在跨层运行期自适应（故障预测/检测/容忍、动态配置）上具有独特优势，但代价是模型开销，需在精度与算力/能耗间权衡，且面临可解释性、数据代表性、OOD鲁棒性、实时时序、失效影响五大约束。(3) 安全侧：SEDAN在雪佛兰Camaro真实数据集上同时满足全部安全关键截止期并显著提升安全性；INDRA对多数攻击检测率>80%、虚警率<1%；LATTE在1.4MB模型、193µs推理时延下取得更优准确率/F1并更少误报，满足车内网络短帧间实时处理；TENET相较INDRA检测率再提升3%、ROC-AUC提升17.3%、漏报率降低32.7%，参数量减少94.6%、推理时延降低48.1%；感知异常检测中CNN-BiLSTM VAE在Lyft数据集上测试精度90.2%（对SOTA的85.1%）且内存占用98KB vs 1.14MB；GAAD在Lyft Level 5上各类异常AUROC>0.98并改善重建质量。(4) 安全系统设计侧：恰当的边–云DNN划分相较纯边或纯云方案显著降低轨迹偏差与控制努力，同时提升安全裕度；安全驱动的GPU划分将更大网络分配给横向位移、赛道宽度等安全关键状态分量，可在总GPU预算更小的条件下获得更低轨迹偏差与更强鲁棒性，证明"正确分配不完美ML组件"比单纯扩大模型更有效；可达集+敏感度分析可形式化给出满足X_safe的GPU成本最小配置。(5) 部分认证/监测思想表明在给定系统级安全规格下，只需确定性地限制攻击对闭环轨迹的影响幅度即可满足安全属性。(6) 路线图层面，给出面向EU AI Act与JTC 21标准过渡的可执行工程清单与组织能力建设建议。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心结论是：AI/ML带来的不确定性并不必然阻碍自主系统的可依赖性，只要在系统层面显式建模推理不确定性、计算/通信时延与资源约束，并将其纳入闭环可达性与安全裕度分析，就能在"不完美组件"前提下设计出满足定量安全属性、可认证的自主CPS；同时，安全与可靠性保障必须跨多个抽象层并贯穿设计时与运行时，单层或纯设计时最坏情形分析已不足够。产业与监管层面，边缘AI的可信化必须与EU AI Act及ISO 26262的功能安全/网络安全要求对齐，形成治理、数据完整性、不确定性量化与校准、可解释性、韧性内生设计、生命周期持续合规六大支柱的工程实践，并辅以跨职能评审与AI素养培训，才能把AI创新转化为可认证的系统级可依赖性，支撑安全案例（safety case）、型式认证与合规落地。展望方向包括可解释ML用于自适应可靠性管理、跨层ML可靠性保障标准、自感知自愈汽车系统、边–云与GPU资源分配的更系统化自动化、以及可信边缘AI感知的统一技术基准体系。

title: GenAI in Software Engineering: The Role of Technology Acceptance Models
summary: Context: Many organizations are keen to incorporate generative~AI (GenAI) into their software development processes. Technology acceptance models, such as the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT), are traditionally used to identify individual-level barriers to the acceptance of new technologies and can facilitate the transition to GenAI. However, UTAUT has seen limited use within software engineering (SE) research. Objective: Using UTAUT as an example, to identify key areas for future research on GenAI acceptance, including the role of Bayesian approaches for data analysis. Method: We review foundational and SE-specific literature on UTAUT and analyze its emerging applications for GenAI in SE. Results: We identify three priorities for future research: (1) identifying and refining constructs to account for GenAI's nature and transformational impact; (2) improving operationalization practices to strengthen construct validity and cross-study comparability; and (3) incorporating Bayesian analysis to support small-sample inference by integrating prior knowledge, iterative model updating, and simulation of scenarios. Conclusion: UTAUT is a suitable candidate to combine with Bayesian analysis for practical insights on individual-level barriers to GenAI use in SE, but additional theories should be considered.

AI.tldr: 本研究以UTAUT为案例，探讨GenAI在软件工程中接受度的研究空白。提出三个未来研究方向，强调贝叶斯方法在整合先验知识、迭代模型更新和情景模拟中的优势，并主张补充其他理论以完善研究框架。
AI.motivation: 众多组织希望将GenAI融入软件开发过程，但UTAUT在SE研究中的应用有限。传统技术接受模型缺乏对GenAI特性的考量，需要探索新的研究路径。
AI.method: 综述基础文献和SE特定文献，分析UTAUT在GenAI中的应用。采用贝叶斯分析方法探讨小样本推断的可行性。
AI.result: 识别出三个研究优先领域：①完善构念以反映GenAI的本质和变革性影响；②改进操作化实践以增强构念效度和跨研究可比性；③引入贝叶斯分析以支持小样本推断。
AI.conclusion: UTAUT结合贝叶斯分析是研究SE中GenAI接受度的合适方法，但需考虑补充其他理论。研究贡献在于为GenAI技术接受度研究提供了方法论框架和三大优先研究方向。

title: Profiles of AI Dependency: A Latent Class Analysis of Filipino Students' Academic Competencies
comment: 4 pages, 1 table, conference proceedings, open access
summary: The increasing dependency among Filipino college students on artificial intelligence (AI) poses concerns about the potential decline of fundamental academic competencies. This study examines the extent of AI dependency and its perceived effects on students' critical thinking, writing skills, learning independence, research skills, and academic engagement. Using a cross-sectional research design, data was collected from 651 students enrolled in higher education institutions (HEIs) in Pampanga, Philippines accredited by the Commission on Higher Education. The survey data was analyzed using Latent Class Analysis (LCA) to identify AI dependency patterns. Findings indicated that students show moderate to high AI dependency, specifically in research and writing tasks. LCA identified four distinct profiles: highly engaged independent learners, selective AI users, moderate AI users, and AI-dependent learners. Notably, AI-dependent learners demonstrated the weakest academic competencies, with significant dependency on AI-generated outputs. The study highlights the need to foster educational policies that integrate AI literacy while preserving essential academic skills. HEIs must also balance technological advancements with curriculum adaptations to promote critical thinking and ethical use of AI. Future research may explore the longitudinal impacts and intervention strategies to mitigate academic skill erosion caused by AI dependency.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了651名菲律宾大学生的AI依赖程度及其对学术能力的影响。研究发现学生在研究和写作任务上存在中高度AI依赖，并通过潜在类别分析识别出四类学生群体：独立学习者、选择性AI用户、中度AI用户和AI依赖型学习者。AI依赖型学习者学术能力最弱，表明过度依赖AI可能损害批判性思维和写作等核心技能。研究呼吁教育政策在推广AI素养的同时保护基础学术能力，并建议进一步探索干预策略。
AI.motivation: 随着菲律宾大学生对人工智能（AI）的依赖日益增加，存在基础学术能力可能下降的担忧。现有研究对这种依赖程度及其对学生核心学术能力的实际影响尚缺乏深入了解。
AI.method: 采用横断面研究设计，通过问卷调查收集数据，并使用潜在类别分析（LCA）识别AI依赖模式。研究样本为651名来自菲律宾邦板牙省高等教育机构的学生。
AI.result: 学生表现出中度到高度的AI依赖，尤其在研究和写作任务方面。LCA识别出四种不同的学生画像：高度参与的独立学习者、选择性AI用户、中度AI用户和AI依赖型学习者。其中，AI依赖型学习者的学术能力最弱。研究强调了制定融合AI素养的教育政策的必要性，同时需保护基础学术技能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建议制定教育政策以平衡AI素养培养与基础学术技能保护。高等教育机构需在技术进步与课程调整之间寻求平衡，以促进批判性思维发展和AI伦理使用。未来研究应探索AI依赖对学术技能影响的纵向效应及干预策略。

title: Purifying Multimodal Retrieval: Fragment-Level Evidence Selection for RAG
summary: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) is widely adopted for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) with external evidence to reduce hallucinations. Despite its success, most existing MRAG frameworks treat retrieved evidence as indivisible documents, implicitly assuming that all content within a document is equally informative. In practice, however, sometimes only a small fraction of a document is relevant to a given query, while the remaining content introduces substantial noise that may lead to performance degradation. We address this fundamental limitation by reframing MRAG as a fine-grained evidence selection problem. We propose Fragment-level Evidence Selection for RAG (FES-RAG), a framework that selects atomic multimodal fragments rather than entire documents as grounding evidence. FES-RAG decomposes retrieved multimodal documents into sentence-level textual fragments and region-level visual fragments, enabling precise identification of evidence that directly supports generation. To guide fragment selection, we introduce Fragment Information Gain (FIG), a principled metric that measures the marginal contribution of each fragment to the MLLM's generation confidence. Based on FIG, we distill fragment-level utility judgments from a high-capacity MLLM into a lightweight selector, achieving accurate evidence selection with low inference overhead. Experiments on the M2RAG benchmark show that FES-RAG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art document-level MRAG methods, achieving up to 27 percent relative improvement in CIDEr. By selecting fewer yet more informative fragments, our approach substantially reduces context length while improving factual accuracy and generation coherence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FES-RAG框架，将多模态检索增强生成（MMRAG）重新定义为细粒度证据选择问题，通过将文档分解为句子级文本片段和区域级视觉片段，并引入片段信息增益（FIG）指标来衡量每个片段对生成的边际贡献，从而实现更精确的证据选择，在M2RAG基准测试中相比文档级MMRAG方法提升达27%。
AI.motivation: Existing MRAG frameworks treat retrieved evidence as indivisible documents, implicitly assuming all content within a document is equally informative. However, only a small fraction of a document is typically relevant to a given query, while the remaining content introduces substantial noise that may lead to performance degradation.
AI.method: FES-RAG decomposes retrieved multimodal documents into sentence-level textual fragments and region-level visual fragments, enabling precise evidence identification. The framework introduces Fragment Information Gain (FIG) as a principled metric measuring the marginal contribution of each fragment to MLLM's generation confidence. Fragment-level utility judgments are distilled from a high-capacity MLLM into a lightweight selector.
AI.result: FES-RAG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art document-level MRAG methods on the M2RAG benchmark, achieving up to 27 percent relative improvement in CIDEr, while substantially reducing context length.
AI.conclusion: FES-RAG effectively achieves accurate evidence selection with low inference overhead, substantially reducing context length while improving factual accuracy and generation coherence by selecting fewer yet more informative fragments.

title: Emotion-Aware Clickbait Attack in Social Media
summary: Clickbait is characterized by disproportionately high emotional intensity relative to informational content, often reinforced by specific structural patterns. However, current research considers clickbait as a static textual phenomenon characterized by linguistic patterns and structural cues. Additionally, existing detection systems primarily rely on surface-level features of clickbait. This paper introduces an emotion-aware clickbait generation attack, where stylistic transformations are used to optimize emotional impact. We propose an emotion-aware framework based on the Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) space to model the emotional dynamics underlying clickbait generation for optimal user engagement. To simulate realistic attack scenarios, we align clickbait headlines with semantically similar social media posts using Sentence-BERT and generate multiple stylistic rewrites via Large Language Models (LLMs). Building on this, we define a Curiosity Gap (CG) function that computes clickbait's headline variation to the current post to quantify how emotional activation will contribute to user curiosity and evade the existing system found on social media. Experimental results demonstrate that emotion-aware stylization significantly degrades the performance of state-of-the-art classifiers, leading to misclassification rates of up to 2.58% to 30.63% on the base system.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes an emotion-aware clickbait generation attack using VAD-based emotional modeling to optimize stylistic transformations. By aligning headlines with social media posts via Sentence-BERT and generating rewrites through LLMs, the system evades existing classifiers with misclassification rates reaching 30.63%.
AI.motivation: Current clickbait research treats clickbait as static textual phenomenon relying on surface-level linguistic/structural features, failing to capture the dynamic emotional dynamics that drive user engagement.
AI.method: 1) VAD (Valence-Arousal-Dominance) space-based emotion modeling; 2) Sentence-BERT alignment with semantically similar social media posts; 3) LLM-driven stylistic rewrites; 4) Curiosity Gap (CG) function quantifying headline variation for user curiosity
AI.result: Emotion-aware stylization significantly degrades state-of-the-art classifiers with misclassification rates of 2.58% to 30.63% on the base detection system.
AI.conclusion: The emotion-aware framework successfully evades state-of-the-art clickbait classifiers through VAD-based emotional optimization, demonstrating the vulnerability of surface-level detection systems to psychologically-informed attacks.

title: How to Guide Your Flow: Few-Step Alignment via Flow Map Reward Guidance
summary: In generative modeling, we often wish to produce samples that maximize a user-specified reward such as aesthetic quality or alignment with human preferences, a problem known as guidance. Despite their widespread use, existing guidance methods either require expensive multi-particle, many-step schemes or rely on poorly understood approximations.
