In practice, experimental stimuli are segmented into linguistically motivated units (e.g., words), while pretrained language models assign probability mass to a fixed token alphabet that typically does not align with those units. As a result, surprisal-based predictors depend implicitly on ad hoc procedures that conflate two distinct modeling choices: the definition of the unit of analysis and the choice of regions of interest over which predictions are evaluated. In this paper, we disentangle these choices and give a unified framework for reasoning about surprisal over arbitrary unit inventories. We argue that surprisal-based analyses should make these choices explicit and treat tokenization as an implementation detail rather than a scientific primitive.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前surprisal理论与实践之间的单位定义不匹配问题，提出将tokenization解耦为实现细节而非科学原语，为surprisal分析提供统一框架。
AI.motivation: 当前实证研究中，实验刺激按语言学动机分割为单位（如词），但预训练语言模型基于固定token alphabet分配概率，两者不对齐，导致surprisal预测器隐含依赖临时程序。
AI.method: 将语言学动机的单位定义与评估时的兴趣区域选择解耦，构建了一个统一的框架来处理任意单位清单上的surprisal计算。
AI.result: 能够对任意单位清单上的surprisal进行统一推理和计算。
AI.conclusion: 提出tokenization应被视为实现细节而非科学原语，建议在实际研究中明确区分单位定义和兴趣区域选择这两个建模选择。

title: When Does Structure Matter in Continual Learning? Dimensionality Controls When Modularity Shapes Representational Geometry
summary: To preserve previously learned representations, continual learning systems must strike a balance between plasticity, the ability to acquire new knowledge, and stability. This stability-plasticity dilemma affects how representations can be reused across tasks: shared structure enables transfer when tasks are similar but may also induce interference when new learning disrupts existing representations. However, it remains unclear when and why structural separation influences this trade-off. In this study, we examine how network architecture, task similarity, and representational dimensionality jointly shape learning in a sequential task paradigm inspired by transfer-interference studies. We compare a task-partitioned modular recurrent network with a single-module baseline by systematically varying task similarity (low, medium, high) and the scale of weight initialization, which induces different learning regimes that we empirically characterize through the effective dimensionality of the learned representations. We find that architecture has minimal impact in high-dimensional regimes where representations are sufficiently unconstrained to accommodate multiple tasks without strong interference. In contrast, in lower-dimensional (rich) regimes, architectural separation is decisive: modular networks exhibit graded alignment of task-specific subspaces with overlap for similar tasks, partial orthogonalization for moderately dissimilar tasks, and stronger separation for dissimilar tasks. This graded geometry is absent in the single network baseline. Our findings suggest that representational dimensionality acts as a key organizing variable governing when structural separation becomes functionally relevant, and highlight adaptive geometry as a central principle for designing continual learning systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究模块化结构分离在持续学习中何时才起作用。作者发现：表征维度是关键的“门控”变量——在高维（lazy）表征区间，模块化与单网络基线在行为与几何上几乎无差异；当表征被压缩到低维（rich）区间，模块化网络才会按任务相似度梯度地组织任务子空间（相同任务共享重叠、近似任务部分正交、差异大任务强分离），且干扰更低、迁移更稳定；单网络基线不呈现这种梯度几何。
AI.motivation: 持续学习的核心是稳定性—可塑性权衡：共享结构在任务相似时带来迁移，在任务不相似时造成干扰。虽然已有工作提出正则化（EWC）、回放和模块化架构等缓解手段，但“结构分离究竟在何时、为何影响该权衡”仍不清楚。已有研究（Holton 等、Johnston 等）提示：模块化组织往往只在输入/表征受约束的低维条件下才涌现；在高维无约束空间中，简单的共享读出即可解决问题，显式模块化的作用被稀释。据此作者提出假设：架构性结构偏置只有在表征空间被充分约束、几何结构成为约束性因素时，才会对持续学习产生功能影响。
AI.method: 采用 Holton 等的顺序迁移—干扰范式，三阶段 A1→B→A2（先学任务A，再学新刺激的任务B，再回测任务A）。任务为“改变季节”式实验：把 6 个离散植物线索映射到圆盘位置，两个季节上下文的位置由固定角度偏移（task rule）关联，Same/Near/Far 三种条件通过规则相同/小角度偏移/大角度偏移来操控任务相似度。输入为 one-hot，输出为 4 维（两组余弦-正弦对，分别编码夏季与冬季位置），仅在被探测季节对应的输出对上计算 MSE，指标为角度准确率、迁移（B 阶段前 6 个冬季试次减 A1 末 6 个冬季试次）、干扰（A2 阶段用 von Mises 混合模型，1 减去任务A成分的混合权重）。两种架构：单网络基线（共享循环群体+共享读出）与任务分区模块化网络（按任务掩码路由输入到两个独立循环模块、模块间无循环通信，共享读出拼接两模块隐状态）。表征维度通过初始化后对所有可训练权重乘以全局因子 γ 来控制（γ 大为 lazy/高维，γ 小为 rich/低维；文中明确 γ 仅作为表征区间的实用探针，不假定其纯维度控制效应）。表征分析包括：99% 方差所需主成分数作为有效维度、B 阶段后任务特异子空间间最大主角、跨 A1/B/A2 联合 PCA 的前三维轨迹投影。
AI.result: 行为层面：模块化网络在所有相似度条件与各 γ 下准确率保持稳定、迁移变化有限、干扰始终较低；单网络对相似度与 γ 敏感，far 条件与最小 γ 下 A2 性能明显下降，且在小 γ 时（尤其 near 条件）干扰显著更大。几何层面：γ 增大时两者有效维度均高、子空间几何相近，架构影响微弱；γ 减小时有效维度急剧下降，模块化网络呈现清晰的相似度依赖梯度——same 高度对齐、near 居中、far 分离更强，而单网络的依赖性更弱更无结构。3D PCA 显示 lazy 区轨迹弥散、架构差异小，rich 区（γ=0.001）轨迹收缩成紧凑低维几何，模块化网络的排列明显反映相似度梯度，单网络则更易在各条件下彼此贴近。消融（模块大小、输入路由）显示定性模式稳健。
AI.conclusion: 主要结论：模块化不是持续学习的普适解，其效应被表征维度所“门控”——只有在表征容量受约束时，架构性分离才会以相似度依赖的方式塑造任务几何并降低迁移—干扰成本。因此持续学习应被视为“自适应表征分配”问题，而非“共享还是隔离”的二元选择；理想目标是相似度依赖的几何（相同任务重叠、相关任务部分重组、差异任务强分离），并提出自适应几何与动态调控维度/子空间分配应成为设计持续学习系统的核心原则。局限：有效维度仅为 PCA 近似代理；γ 同时影响优化动态与条件数，无法纯归因于维度；3D PCA 仅为定性说明；仅限 A-B-A 三阶段短序列，未涵盖更长序列或相似度随时间变化的轨迹；架构仅为特定输入分区+无模块间通信的设计。

title: Iterative Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Medical Question Answering
summary: Medical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems typically operate on text chunks extracted from biomedical literature, discarding the rich visual content (tables, figures, structured layouts) of original document pages. We propose MED-VRAG, an iterative multimodal RAG framework that retrieves and reasons over PMC document page images instead of OCR'd text. The system pairs ColQwen2.5 patch-level page embeddings with a sharded MapReduce LLM filter, scaling to ~350K pages while keeping Stage-1 retrieval under 30 ms via an offline coarse-to-fine index (C=8 centroids per page, ANN over centroids, exact two-way scoring on the top-R shortlist). A vision-language model (VLM) then iteratively refines its query and accumulates evidence in a memory bank across up to 3 reasoning rounds, with a single iteration costing ~15.9 s and the full three-round pipeline ~47.8 s on 4xA100. Across four medical QA benchmarks (MedQA, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, MMLU-Med), MEDVRAG reaches 78.6% average accuracy. Under controlled comparison with the same Qwen2.5-VL-32B backbone, retrieval contributes a +5.8 point gain over the no-retrieval baseline; we also note a +1.8 point edge over MedRAG + GPT-4 (76.8%), with the caveat that this is a cross-paper rather than head-to-head comparison. Ablations isolate +1.0 from page-image vs text-chunk retrieval, +1.5 from iteration, and +1.0 from the memory bank.

AI.tldr: MED-VRAG是一个面向生物医学文献的迭代多模态RAG系统，通过直接检索和推理页面图像而非文本块，在四个医学QA基准上达到78.6%平均准确率，显著优于传统文本RAG和GPT-4增强方案。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗RAG系统仅处理从生物医学文献提取的文本块，丢弃了原始文档页面中丰富的视觉内容（表格、图像、结构化布局），这些信息对医疗问答具有重要价值。
AI.method: MED-VRAG采用多模态RAG框架：1）使用ColQwen2.5生成patch级页面嵌入；2）通过C=8 centroids的粗细索引实现快速ANN检索（<30ms）；3）VLM进行最多3轮迭代推理，并在记忆银行中累积证据。系统可在~350K页面规模下运行。
AI.result: 在MedQA、MedMCQA、PubMedQA、MMLU-Med四个基准上平均准确率达78.6%；单轮推理约15.9秒，三轮完整流程约47.8秒（4xA100）。检索本身相比无检索基线提升+5.8点；跨论文对比优于MedRAG+GPT-4达+1.8点。
AI.conclusion: MED-VRAG通过图像检索+迭代推理机制，在保持~30ms检索延迟的同时，显著优于文本RAG基线（+5.8点）和GPT-4增强方案（+1.8点）。消融实验表明页面图像检索、迭代机制和记忆银行分别贡献+1.0、+1.5、+1.0个百分点的提升。

title: Optimized Deferral for Imbalanced Settings
summary: Learning algorithms can be significantly improved by routing complex or uncertain inputs to specialized experts, balancing accuracy with computational cost. This approach, known as learning to defer, is essential in domains like natural language generation, medical diagnosis, and computer vision, where an effective deferral can reduce errors at low extra resource consumption. However, the two-stage learning to defer setting, which leverages existing predictors such as a collection of LLMs or other classifiers, often faces challenges due to an expert imbalance problem. This imbalance can lead to suboptimal performance, with deferral algorithms favoring the majority expert. We present a comprehensive study of two-stage learning to defer in expert imbalance settings. We cast the deferral loss optimization as a novel cost-sensitive learning problem over the input-expert domain. We derive new margin-based loss functions and guarantees tailored to this setting, and develop novel algorithms for cost-sensitive learning. Leveraging these results, we design principled deferral algorithms, MILD (Margin-based Imbalanced Learning to Defer), specifically suited for expert imbalance settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, showing clear improvements over existing baselines on both image classification and real-world Large Language Model (LLM) routing tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了两阶段延迟学习中的专家不平衡问题，将延迟损失优化重新建模为成本敏感学习问题，推导了新的基于边界的损失函数并设计了MILD算法。该方法在图像分类和LLM路由任务上展示了显著改进。
AI.motivation: 两阶段延迟学习框架面临专家不平衡问题，导致延迟算法偏向多数专家，性能次优。需要一种能够平衡准确性和计算成本的有效延迟机制。
AI.method: 将延迟损失优化建模为输入-专家域上的成本敏感学习问题；推导出针对该场景的新的基于边界的损失函数及理论保证；开发了成本敏感学习的新算法；基于这些结果设计了MILD（Margin-based Imbalanced Learning to Defer）算法。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在图像分类和真实世界LLM路由任务上都优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出MIL（Margin-based Imbalanced Learning to Defer）算法，专为专家不平衡场景设计的原则性延迟学习算法，在图像分类和LLM路由任务上均优于基线方法。

title: Consumer Attitudes Towards AI in Digital Health: A Mixed-Methods Survey in Australia
summary: AI applications are increasingly being introduced into digital health. While technical performance has advanced rapidly, successful deployment mainly depends on consumer attitudes, especially to patient-facing applications. However, most existing research examines consumer attitudes towards healthcare AI at an abstract level rather than in response to concrete artefacts. We report a mixed-methods survey study in Australia (N=275) examining consumer readiness, acceptance, trust, and risk perceptions of healthcare AI, combined with a scenario-based evaluation of an AI-generated versus clinician-written consultation summary. Participants expressed moderate optimism and strong perceived usefulness and ease of use, but also substantial concerns about accuracy, safety, and data use. In the scenario task, the AI-generated summary was strongly preferred for quality, empathy, and overall usefulness, yet identification of the AI summary was near chance. Findings show that consumers judge AI through concrete communication quality and visible human governance, underscoring the need for clinically supervised deployment frameworks beyond technical performance alone.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了消费者对医疗AI的具体态度，发现尽管人们普遍担忧AI的准确性和数据安全，但在实际评估中AI生成的医疗沟通内容反而获得较高评价，且消费者难以有效区分AI与人类生成的内容。这提示医疗AI的成功部署需要关注沟通质量和人类监督，而非单纯追求技术性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多在抽象层面探讨消费者对医疗AI的态度，缺乏对具体AI应用场景的实证评估。随着AI在数字健康领域的快速部署，理解消费者对具体AI产品的真实反应成为部署成功的关键。
AI.method: 采用混合方法研究设计，在澳大利亚开展问卷调查（N=275），评估消费者对医疗AI的准备度、接受度、信任度和风险感知。同时设计场景化任务，比较AI生成的咨询摘要与临床医生撰写的摘要供参与者评估。
AI.result: 消费者表现出中等程度的乐观态度和较高的感知有用性及易用性，但也对准确性、安全性和数据使用存在显著担忧。场景任务中，AI生成的摘要反而在质量、共情性和整体有用性方面获得更强偏好，但参与者识别AI摘要的概率接近随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了超越单纯技术性能之外、建立临床监督部署框架的必要性。消费者通过具体沟通质量和可见的人类治理来评判AI，而非抽象的技术指标，这为AI医疗应用的落地提供了重要的社会人文维度参考。

title: Mind the Gap: Structure-Aware Consistency in Preference Learning
summary: Preference learning has become the foundation of aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human intent. Popular methods, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), minimize surrogate losses as proxies for the intractable pairwise ranking loss. However, we demonstrate that for the equicontinuous hypothesis sets typical of neural networks, these standard surrogates are theoretically inconsistent, yielding vacuous generalization guarantees. To resolve this, we formulate LLM alignment within a margin-shifted ranking framework. We derive rigorous $H$-consistency bounds that depend on enforcing a separation margin $γ$. Crucially, we extend this to Structure-Aware $H$-consistency, introducing a novel objective (SA-DPO) that adapts the margin based on the semantic distance between responses to handle synonyms and hard pairs. Finally, we analyze the trade-off between consistency and model limitations via the Margin-Capacity Profile, proving that heavy-tailed surrogates (such as the Polynomial Hinge family) offer superior consistency guarantees for capacity-bounded models compared to the standard logistic loss used in DPO.

AI.tldr: 本文指出 DPO 等对齐方法所依赖的凸代理损失（logistic）在神经网络的等连续（equicontinuous）假设集上是理论不一致的（Thm 4.3：H-一致性界空洞/无效）；并证明强制置信间隔 γ 是恢复一致性的必要且充分条件（Thm 5.1、5.2、6.2）。为解决统一间隔在同义/近义响应上的"幻觉性分离"与不稳定问题，提出按响应语义距离自适应调整间隔的 SA-DPO（Thm 6.6）；进一步用 Margin-Capacity Profile 证明重尾损失（Polynomial/Cubic Hinge、IPO 平方损失）在容量受限模型上严格优于 DPO 的 logistic 损失。实验上 SA-DPO 在 UltraFeedback 与 Argilla DPO-Mix-7k 上稳定优于 DPO 与 SimPO，下游生成质量对 DPO 取得 58.5% 胜率。
AI.motivation: LLM 对齐（显式奖励建模 + PPO，或 DPO 这类隐式方法）本质上都是用凸代理损失（如 logistic loss）去逼近非凸、不连续的 0-1 成对排序损失。论文指出这一普遍做法存在根本理论缺陷：神经网络的等连续性使得模型可以通过"压缩"响应间的分数差而非真正学习排序来"作弊"，因此任何标准代理损失都只能给出空洞（vacuous）的 H-一致性保证——即使代理风险趋于最优，真实排序误差仍可能任意高。作者的核心问题是：最小化这些代理损失是否真的保证最小化真实排序误差？答案是否定的，而现有经验方法（SimPO、SLiC、IPO）虽实证有效却缺乏理论依据，其统一间隔设计也并非最优。
AI.method: 以 H-一致性框架（Mao, Mohri, Zhong）为分析工具，把 LLM 偏好学习形式化为成对排序问题。①提出 Equicontinuity 与 Regularity 两个假设，Theorem 4.3 证明：对等连续、正则且含零函数的假设集，任何 H-一致性界必为空洞（Γ(t)≥1），核心机制是代理误差与排序误差的解耦（利用集中于单一元组的分布构造反例）。②为恢复一致性，定义带最小间隔 γ>0 的假设集族 H_γ（条件 (i)(ii)），Theorem 5.1 给出一般一致性界 1/(Φ(-γ)-Φ(γ))，Corollary 5.2 对 DPO 特化为 1/(βγ)；Theorem 5.5 证明在有限支撑 + 严格可分 + logit 缩放不变性下，通过缩放 logits 可使 γ→∞ 从而恢复一致性；并讨论 H_γ 在连续输入域上的拓扑障碍（中间值定理）仅适用于不连续/全局偏好模型。③提出 Margin-Shifted Surrogate（软间隔，损失 Φ(wΔh-γ)，仍保持凸性），Theorem 6.2 给出 γ-近似 H-一致性界与 margin approximation gap A_γ；Proposition 6.4 证明一致性系数 1/Φ(-γ) 最优；Proposition 6.3 指出乘性平移不变性（如指数损失）会使间隔失效。④引入成对相关间隔 Γ(y,y')=τΔ(y,y')（语义嵌入距离、编辑距离、Gold 奖励差），Theorem 6.6 给出结构感知 H-一致性界（逆间隔加权损失），并据此提出 SA-DPO 目标。⑤定义 Margin-Capacity Profile ρ_Φ(γ,K)=Φ(K-γ)/Φ(-γ)，Proposition 7.1/7.2 分析无限容量（gap→0）与容量受限（gap>0）两种情形，Proposition 7.5 给出 Polynomial Hinge 的 ρ_k=((1+γ-K)/(1+γ))^k 并建立 ρ_cubic<ρ_sq-hinge≈ρ_IPO<ρ_logistic 的严格层级，Proposition 7.6 说明有界损失（GCE/MAE）ρ→1 的缺陷，Proposition 7.7 给出 logistic 的最优间隔 γ*≈K+(1/β)log(ε/(βK))。⑥扩展：Bregman 散度与代理损失对应表（KL→DPO、L2→IPO、Tsallis→Sparse-DPO）、Theorem 8.3 证明 Ψ-正则 RLHF 与 Φ-排序的最优解等价、间隔的松弛变量（soft-margin）解释、分数空间的凸正则化不可能性、Bradley-Terry 假设下 logistic 的 minimizability gap 为零（Prop 8.4）以及非传递偏好的局限说明。实验用 LoRA 微调 Llama-3-8B / Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，涵盖同义词压力测试、Margin-Capacity 验证、UltraFeedback 与 Argilla DPO-Mix-7k 排序准确率、MT-Bench 风格的 PairRM 头对头胜率，以及 Margin Satisfaction Rate 代理指标。
AI.result: 理论层面：(1) 证明标准代理损失在等连续假设集上不一致，H-一致性界必空洞；(2) 给出统一间隔下的一般界 1/(Φ(-γ)-Φ(γ))，DPO 特化为 1/(βγ)，并证明 γ 是恢复一致性的必要条件；(3) 提出 margin-shifted 界（系数 1/Φ(-γ) 且该系数最优）并引入结构感知版本，逆间隔加权形式避免了统一间隔被最相似样本对支配；(4) Margin-Capacity Profile 给出损失的严格一致性层级：重尾（Poly-3、IPO）优于轻尾 logistic，有界损失（GCE/MAE）最差。实验层面：同义词压力测试中 DPO 停滞于损失 0.1695±0.003（隐式间隔≈1.70），SA-DPO 收敛至 0.003±0.001（间隔≈6.32）；固定 γ=1.0 的 Margin-Capacity 实验中最终排序准确率 DPO 71.6%±1.1、IPO 94.5%±0.8、Poly-3 99.7%±0.3；UltraFeedback（Llama-3-8B）RA：SA-DPO 在 Distinct/Ambiguous/Hard Subset 分别为 0.790/0.734/0.700，优于 SimPO 的 0.780/0.722/0.650 与 DPO 的 0.766/0.716/0.590（最难子集增益最显著）；Argilla DPO-Mix-7k（Qwen2.5-7B）Distinct 0.798、Ambiguous 0.746，均优于 DPO 与 SimPO；Margin Satisfaction Rate 由 DPO 的 58.0%、SimPO 的 63.0% 提升至 SA-DPO 的 72.3%，与 Proposition 7.2 的容量受限预测吻合；PairRM 评估下 SA-DPO 对 DPO 的头对头胜率 58.5%。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了当前主流对齐范式的根本理论局限：DPO 等方法所依赖的代理损失最小化并不蕴含真实排序误差下降；并给出系统性修复方案——引入（结构感知的）间隔使一致性得以恢复。具体而言：置信间隔 γ 是深学习区间一致性的必要且（经软化后）可操作的充分条件；均匀间隔是钝器，会迫使模型在同义响应上制造不存在的差异（引入偏差与不稳定），SA-DPO 依据语义距离 Δ(y,y') 自适应缩放间隔，在保持对可区分样本严格分离的同时放松歧义样本的约束，是 SimPO/SLiC 统一间隔设计的原则性演进；分析显示模型实际容量 K 与间隔 γ 的权衡由损失尾部行为决定，重尾损失在容量受限（尤其 LoRA 微调）场景下具有严格更优的一致性保证，且有界损失（GCE/MAE）在此框架下最弱；框架亦统一了 KL/L2/Tsallis 等 Bregman 正则化 RLHF 方法，并指出 IPO 的经验鲁棒性源于其内含间隔。作者指出局限与未来方向：理论限于打分函数范式（不处理非传递/循环偏好）、硬间隔假设集在连续域存在拓扑约束需软化、后续可扩展至 listwise 排序、在线探索与非传递偏好模型。

title: Differential Subgroup Discovery: Characterizing Where Two Populations Differ, and Why
summary: We study the problem of understanding where two populations differ within a feature space, which we formalize in the concept of a differential subgroup: a subset of individuals from both populations who, despite sharing similar characteristics, exhibit exceptional differences in a target outcome. Differential subgroups reveal the regions of the feature space where population-level gaps are most pronounced and can help practitioners identify the covariate combinations that are structurally responsible for these differences, e.g.~in clinical analysis, model diagnostics, or treatment-effect studies. We introduce a general optimization objective for discovering differential subgroups and establish conditions under which the resulting subgroups admit a causal interpretation of population differences. We propose DiffSub, a gradient-based approach that discovers interpretable differential subgroups in tabular data. Across synthetic benchmarks, medical case studies, model-error analyses, and treatment-effect settings, DiffSub identifies informative subgroups that reveal where population differences arise and why.

AI.tldr: DiffSub是一种用于发现两个群体间差分子群的梯度优化方法，能够在表格数据中找到具有可解释性的子群，揭示群体差异最显著的特征区域，并提供因果解释性保证。
AI.motivation: 传统方法关注整体群体差异，但无法识别哪些特征组合导致差异最深，即"差分子群"问题缺乏系统解决。
AI.method: 提出DiffSub方法，采用梯度下降优化发现差分子群，涵盖合成数据、医学案例、模型误差分析及因果效应场景。
AI.result: DiffSub在多场景下识别出信息丰富的差分子群，揭示群体差异的来源和原因。
AI.conclusion: DiffSub通过梯度优化有效发现可解释的差分子群，在多场景验证中表现有效，为理解群体差异提供了实用的因果解释工具。

title: Intent2Tx: Benchmarking LLMs for Translating Natural Language Intents into Ethereum Transactions
summary: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) offers a transformative interface for Web3, yet existing benchmarks fail to capture the complexity of translating high-level user intents into functionally correct, state-dependent on-chain transactions. We present \textsc{Intent2Tx}, a high-fidelity benchmark featuring 29,921 single-step and 1,575 multi-step instances meticulously derived from 300 days of real-world Ethereum mainnet traces. Unlike prior works that rely on synthetic instructions, \textsc{Intent2Tx} grounds natural language intents in real-world protocol interactions across 11 categories, including diverse long-tail Decentralized Finance (DeFi) primitives. To enable rigorous evaluation, we propose an execution-aware framework that transcends surface-level text matching by employing differential state analysis on forked mainnet environments. Our extensive evaluation of 16 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals that while scaling and retrieval-augmentation enhance logical consistency and parameter precision, current models struggle with out-of-distribution generalization and multi-step planning. Crucially, our execution-based analysis demonstrates that syntactically valid outputs often fail to achieve intended state transitions, highlighting a significant gap in current "reasoning-to-execution" capabilities. \textsc{Intent2Tx} serves as a critical foundation for developing autonomous, reliable agents in intent-centric Web3 ecosystems. Code and data: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Intent2Tx_Bench-97FF .

AI.tldr: 本文提出Intent2Tx基准测试，用于评估大语言模型将自然语言意图转化为以太坊链上交易的能力。研究发现，虽然当前模型在参数精度上有所提升，但在多步规划和跨领域泛化方面存在明显不足，且语法正确不等于执行正确。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试无法充分捕捉将高级用户意图转化为功能正确、状态依赖的链上交易的复杂性；LLM作为Web3接口的潜力尚未得到系统评估。
AI.method: 1) 构建高保真基准数据集：从真实以太坊主网300天追踪数据中提取29,921个单步实例和1,575个多步实例，覆盖11类协议交互及多种DeFi长尾原语；2) 提出执行感知评估框架：基于分叉主网环境进行差分状态分析，超越表面文本匹配；3) 对16个SOTA大语言模型进行系统评测。
AI.result: 1) 模型规模扩展和检索增强可提升逻辑一致性和参数精度；2) 当前模型在分布外泛化和多步规划方面表现欠佳；3) 语法有效的输出常无法实现预期的状态转换，"推理-执行"能力存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: Intent2Tx为意图驱动的Web3生态系统中开发自主、可靠的智能体提供了关键基础。实验结果表明，尽管当前LLM在逻辑一致性和参数精度方面有所提升，但在分布外泛化和多步规划方面仍存在显著不足，且存在"推理-执行"能力缺口，需要进一步改进以满足Web3应用需求。

title: Linear-Core Surrogates: Smooth Loss Functions with Linear Rates for Classification and Structured Prediction
summary: The choice of loss function in classification involves a fundamental trade-off: smooth losses (like Cross-Entropy) enable fast optimization rates but yield slow square-root consistency bounds, while piecewise-linear losses (like Hinge) offer fast linear consistency rates but suffer from non-differentiability. We propose Linear-Core (LC) Surrogates, a new family of convex loss functions that resolve this tension by stitching a linear core to a smooth tail. We prove that these surrogates are differentiable everywhere while retaining strict linear $H$-consistency bounds, effectively combining the optimization benefits of smoothness with the statistical efficiency of margin-based losses. In the structured prediction setting, we show that this smoothness unlocks a massive computational and energy advantage: it allows for an unbiased stochastic gradient estimator that bypasses the quadratic complexity $O(|\mathscr{Y}|^2)$ of exact inference (e.g., Viterbi). Empirically, our method achieves a 23$\times$ speedup over Structured SVMs on large-vocabulary sequence tagging tasks and demonstrates superior robustness to instance-dependent label noise, outperforming Cross-Entropy by 2.6% on corrupted CIFAR-10.

AI.tldr: 提出Linear-Core Surrogates损失函数族，通过结合线性核心与光滑尾部，同时获得可微性和线性H-consistency bound，在结构化预测中实现23倍加速并提升对标签噪声的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 分类任务中损失函数选择存在根本性权衡：光滑损失(如交叉熵)虽然优化速度快但一致性界仅为平方根收敛；而分段线性损失(如Hinge)虽然具有线性一致性率但存在不可微问题。现有方法难以同时获得优化效率和统计效率。
AI.method: 通过将线性核心与光滑尾部缝合(stitching)，设计了一种新的凸损失函数族。该函数在保持margin-based loss的统计效率的同时，通过光滑尾部实现全程可微，从而支持高效的随机梯度估计，避免了结构化预测中O(|𝒴|²)的精确推断复杂度。
AI.result: 理论证明LC Surrogates在保持严格线性H-consistency bound的同时实现全程可微。在结构化预测中解锁了无偏随机梯度估计器，回避了精确推断的二次复杂度。实验表明：大词汇量序列标注任务比结构化SVM快23倍，噪声CIFAR-10上比交叉熵高2.6%。
AI.conclusion: Linear-Core Surrogates成功解决了分类损失函数中优化速度与统计效率之间的权衡问题，在保持线性H-consistency bound的同时实现了全程可微，并在结构化预测任务中实现了23倍加速，同时展现出对标签噪声的强鲁棒性。

title: WindowsWorld: A Process-Centric Benchmark of Autonomous GUI Agents in Professional Cross-Application Environments
summary: While GUI agents have shown impressive capabilities in common computer-use tasks such as OSWorld, current benchmarks mainly focus on isolated and single-application tasks. This overlooks a critical real-world requirement of coordinating across multiple applications to accomplish complex profession-specific workflows. To bridge this gap, we present a computer-use benchmark in cross-application workflows, named WindowsWorld, designed to systematically assess GUI Agents on complex multi-step tasks that mirror real-world professional activities. Our methodology uses a multi-agent framework steered by 16 occupations to generate four difficulty-level tasks with intermediate inspection, which are then refined by human review and executed in a simulated environment. The resulting benchmark contains 181 tasks with an average of 5.0 sub-goals across 17 common desktop applications, of which 78% are inherently multi-application. Experimental results of leading large models and agents show that: 1) All computer-use agents perform poorly on multi-application tasks (< 21% success rate), far below the performance of simple single-app tasks; 2) They largely fail at tasks requiring conditional judgment and reasoning across $\geq$ 3 applications, stalling at early sub-goals; 3) Low execution efficiency, where tasks often fail despite far exceeding human step limits. Code, benchmark data, and evaluation resources are available at github.com/HITsz-TMG/WindowsWorld.

AI.tldr: WindowsWorld 是一个面向 Windows 桌面环境、以"跨应用专业工作流"为核心的 GUI 智能体基准。它通过人类在环的多智能体流水线自动生成 181 个任务（覆盖 17 个桌面应用、16 种职业角色、4 个难度等级，其中 77.9% 为多应用任务），并引入细粒度的中间检查点评测（平均每任务 4.97 个检查点）以替代"全有或全无"的终态判定。实验显示所有 SOTA 模型/智能体在多应用任务上成功率均低于 21%，最佳者 Gemini-3-flash-preview 仅约 20%。
AI.motivation: 现有 GUI 智能体基准（如 OSWorld、AndroidWorld、Windows Agent Arena）主要聚焦单应用、短视野的孤立任务，无法反映真实专业工作中跨应用协同的核心需求。作者指出三大缺陷：(1) 跨应用任务比例极低（多数基准 <28%），且成功率随应用数增加而急剧下降；(2) "全有或全无"的终态评分缺乏诊断粒度，无法区分"取得显著部分进展"与"第一步即失败"；(3) 任务构建依赖论坛爬取+人工编辑或模板替换，难以规模化，也缺乏真实职业情境与自动合成的文件依赖。因此需要一个新的、以过程为中心、面向真实职业跨应用工作流的基准。
AI.method: 构建于高保真 Windows 虚拟机（继承 OSWorld 基础设施，仅允许 GUI 操作，禁用 API/特权调用）。任务形式化为 POMDP（状态、观测、动作、转移、奖励），动作空间为 PyAutoGUI（另有 OSWorld 的 computer_13）。四个难度等级：L1 单应用原子、L2 多应用线性、L3 动态推理/条件判断（≥3 应用）、L4 不可行任务（测试拒绝与弃权能力）；16 个 persona 分属 5 大领域。生成流程为人在环多智能体流水线：Generator（DeepSeek-V3.2，persona 条件化提示，开放平台 URL 白名单）→ Refiner（4 节点质检：语义去重 τ=0.85、有效性审计（异步 HTTP 校验 URL 与文件）、依赖推理（动作态→状态态转换）、指标精炼（可编程断言））→ 人工复核（4 名标注者过滤歧义指令/主观评判/依赖不可用服务）→ Environment Generator（LLM 合成 .xlsx/.docx/.py 等环境文件，含 Smart File Merging 策略）。评测采用 VLM 裁判（Qwen3-VL-Plus）给出逐检查点二值判定：S_int 为中间检查点平均通过率（L1–L3），S_final 为终态正确率（L1–L4）。检查点为状态型而非轨迹型，人工验证为"路径必需"而非特定操作，允许快捷键/菜单等替代路径。裁判可靠性经 100 个分层任务、518 个检查点与两名标注者对比验证（Pearson 0.9108/0.8316，Cohen's κ 0.8668/0.8271）。实验涵盖 5 个通用多模态模型（Gemini-3-pro/flash-preview、GPT-5.2、Claude-Sonnet-4.5、Qwen3-VL-Plus）在 Screenshot / Screenshot+Accessibility Tree(Hybrid) / Set-of-Marks 三种输入下，以及 Agent-S3、UiPath Screen Agent 两个 GUI 专用框架（以 UI-TARS-1.5-7B 作 grounding）。步数预算按等级设定为 15/25/40/20。
AI.result: (1) 效率-完成落差显著：Gemini-3-flash (Hybrid) 的 S_int 达 50.32%，但 S_final 仅 20.44%，说明智能体常"游走"于流程中，完成子目标却无法整合为成功终态。(2) 复杂度瓶颈：S_final 从 L1 的 35.90% 跌至 L3 的 16.67%，条件推理与跨应用状态维护是主要短板。(3) 负约束处理失败（L4）：最佳 GPT-5.2(SoM) 仅 25%，模型缺乏识别不可行指令的"自我意识"，倾向幻觉成功。(4) 观测模态：Hybrid 最佳（Gemini-3-pro +7.9% S_int）；Gemini-3-flash 零样本坐标定位强（S_int 43.5%），而 Claude/GPT-5.2 像素解析 <8%；SoM 收益不稳定，会引入认知噪声。(5) 框架协同：S3 框架使 Qwen3-VL-Plus 的 S_int 近乎翻倍，但对原生 grounding 强的 Gemini 收益递减。(6) 中间检查的判别力：L3 任务上 S_final 普遍 <15% 饱和，而 S_int 分布在 2.04%–38.63%，能区分系统性进展与彻底失败。(7) Persona 异质性：生产力类 persona 进展-完成落差大（失败多在晚期协调），技术/IT 类耦合更紧。(8) 效率：Qwen3-VL-Plus 最快（~6s/步），Gemini-3-pro 在 SoM 下延迟最高；失败轨迹的"低效漂移"随难度扩大（Hybrid 下 L1 4.64 → L3 14.14 步）。(9) 语言偏差：英文指令稳定优于等价中文。(10) 首次失败多发生在早期检查点（c1–c3），错误集中在中文文件打开与跨应用信息传递（窗口焦点管理不稳导致内容被粘回源应用）。(11) 步数匹配对照（L1 10.92 步 vs L2 11.26 步）下 S_int 由 65.74% 降至 35.14%、S_final 由 46.15% 降至 14.29%，证明难度主因是上下文切换与跨应用状态维护而非步数本身。
AI.conclusion: WindowsWorld 是首个面向跨应用职业工作流的"过程感知"计算机使用基准：78% 为专业级多应用任务，提供平均 4.97 个中间检查点的细粒度过程评分，并给出低成本、可扩展的多智能体自动任务构建流水线。实验揭示当前 GUI 智能体在单应用内表现尚可，但跨应用成功率与效率急剧下降，最佳模型仅约 20% 成功率，且存在无效漂移、负约束识别弱、跨应用信息传输不稳等系统性缺陷。局限：中间分数依赖完整轨迹执行与人工审核检查点，限制长时序在线 RL 的可扩展性；环境主要针对单语言 OS 界面；尚未纳入 MCP 工具评测。作者承诺开源环境、任务指令与评测代码（github.com/HITsz-TMG/WindowsWorld）。

title: On the Expressive Power of GNNs to Solve Linear SDPs
summary: Semidefinite programs (SDPs) are a powerful framework for convex optimization and for constructing strong relaxations of hard combinatorial problems. However, solving large SDPs can be computationally expensive, motivating the use of machine learning models as fast computational surrogates. Graph neural networks (GNNs) are a natural candidate in this setting due to their sparsity-awareness and ability to model variable-constraint interactions. In this work, we study what expressive power is sufficient to recover optimal SDP solutions. We first prove negative results showing that standard GNN architectures fail on recovering linear SDP solutions. We then identify a more expressive architecture that captures the key structure of SDPs and can, in particular, emulate the updates of a standard first-order solver. Empirically, on both synthetic and \textsc{SdpLib} benchmarks of various classes of SDPs, this more expressive architecture achieves consistently lower prediction error and objective gap than theoretically weaker baselines. Finally, using the learned high-quality predictions to warm-start the first-order solver yields practical speedups of up to 80%.

AI.tldr: 本文严格刻画了 GNN 求解线性半定规划（SDP）所需的最小表达能力：证明标准 1-WL/2-WL 类消息传递架构（VC-WL、VC-2-WL）在表示 SDP 最优解时必然失败，而 2-FWL 等价架构（VC-2-FWL / VC-2-FMPNN）足以模拟 PDHG 一阶求解器的迭代轨迹并恢复最优解；该架构在合成与 SdpLib 基准上误差与目标间隙最低，并可为 SCS 等一阶求解器提供热启动，最高加速约 80%。
AI.motivation: SDP 是为 NP-hard 组合优化（max-cut、最大团、图着色等）提供紧松弛以及描述 SOCP/QCQP/LP 等凸问题的重要工具，但大规模 SDP 求解代价高昂（内点法每次迭代 O(n^3) 甚至 O(n^6)）。用 GNN 作为快速代理求解器在 LP/MILP 中已取得成功，但 SDP 存在根本性障碍：原变量是矩阵元素而非向量元素，受 PSD 锥约束，具有行列同时置换等独特结构对称性，标准"变量-约束"二部图表示无法刻画。此前学界缺乏能够表示线性 SDP 的神经架构，也缺乏关于"从线性 SDP 实例到最优解矩阵"这一映射所需表达力的理论刻画。
AI.method: 1) 以"最小 Frobenius 范数唯一最优解"作为明确的学习目标（Proposition 1.1 证明其唯一性）；2) 把 SDP 编码为 V-C 二部图：n² 个矩阵元素作为变量节点（特征由 C_ij 与对角指示子初始化），m 个约束节点（特征为 b_k），边权为 A_k,ij；3) 定义三个颜色细化变体：VC-WL（1-WL 式）、VC-2-WL（2-WL 式，分别聚合行/列邻居）、VC-2-FWL（folklore 2-FWL 式，联合聚合无序二元多重集 {{v_uj, v_iu}}），并给出 VC-2-FWL+（有序二元组版本）作为消融；4) 建立表达能力层级 VC-2-FWL+ ⊏ VC-2-FWL ≢ VC-2-WL ⊏ VC-WL，并用反例证明 VC-WL 与 VC-2-WL 无法表示 SDP 解（Latin square 目标矩阵等），而 Theorem 2.3 通过模拟 PDHG 更新证明 VC-2-FWL 充分：先证明带 Frobenius 正则的 PDHG 弱收敛（有限维下强收敛），再证明多重集 2-FWL 的稳定着色精化 M 的谱投影（Lemma C.15，归纳证明其能模拟矩阵乘法），归纳得稳定着色精化 PDHG 每一步迭代；5) 将 VC-2-FWL 神经化为 VC-2-FMPNN（INIT/MSG/MAP/UPD 均为 MLP），并给出等价 VC-MPNN、VC-2-MPNN 以及 δ-VC-2-MPNN、VC-2-IGN（9 个对称等变基操作）、VC-ET（Edge Transformer）等对照；6) 实验：合成数据集（max-cut ER/10-正则、max-clique、MIS、vertex cover、max 2-SAT、控制论 LMI，每类 10000 例，8:1:1 划分）与 SdpLib 13 个 MCP 实例，以 MSE 监督训练，评估测试损失、原始/投影后相对目标间隙、约束违反与推理/热启动耗时，对比 SDPLR、MOSEK、SCS。
AI.result: 理论上：VC-WL 与 VC-2-WL 均存在反例使其稳定着色无法区分最优解中取值不同的矩阵元素（Proposition 2.1/2.2）；VC-2-FWL 与 VC-2-WL 表达能力互不可比，VC-2-FWL+ 严格更强于 VC-2-FWL；VC-2-FWL 的着色精化 PDHG 全迭代轨迹，故足以表示最优解（Theorem 2.3）；VC-2-FMPNN 的最大表达能力等于 VC-2-FWL；VC-2-FWL 收敛复杂度 O((n³+nnz(A)) log n)，单步 O(n³+nnz(A))，与最快 IPM 实现相当且 GPU 友好。实验上：VC-2-FMPNN 与 VC-ET 在所有任务上损失最低（如 max-cut 测试损失 5.5e-5 对 1.2e-1，原始目标间隙 0.11%–0.44% 对 0.8%–2.0%），且 PSD 投影后间隙几乎不劣化（~0.1%–0.9%），而弱模型投影后崩塌（如 VC-MPNN 在 max-cut 由 1.3% 升至 26%）；约束违反在投影前后均约 1e-3；SdpLib 上 VC-2-FMPNN 训练损失达 1e-4 量级，而 VC-MPNN/VC-2-MPNN 无法过拟合；推理时间 0.01–0.15 秒，远快于 MOSEK/SCS/SDPLR；以预测热启动 SCS 使收敛时间最多降低 80.7%（如 MCP500-1 由 328s 降至 77s）；相对 OptGNN 目标间隙小一个数量级；与精确 SDP 的下游 CO 间隙几乎一致（max-cut 相差约 0.06%），说明模型学到的是连续 SDP 几何而非离散整数解；深度增至 30 层性能仍稳定提升。
AI.conclusion: GNN 求解线性 SDP 需要 2-FWL 级别的表达能力：标准 1-WL/2-WL 式消息传递因丢失矩阵的联合几何结构而存在可证明的表达力缺陷，而 folklore 2-FWL 式的联合（无序）邻居聚合既能保持对称性/等变性/不变性，又能精化 PDHG 迭代，从而在理论上足以恢复最优解。实验证实表达力层级与近似质量、可行性（投影后间隙、约束违反）一致，并将该架构的预测用于热启动一阶求解器可带来最高约 80% 的加速。局限与未来方向：2-FWL 需考虑所有变量对（计算与内存开销大）；理论只保证存在合适参数，不保证梯度下降可训练收敛，且为非统一（不保证尺寸泛化）；后续可针对特定 SDP 子类设计更高效架构、利用与 PDHG 的严格对应开展自监督原始-对偶学习、以及推广到一般锥规划与分支切割框架。

title: Post-Optimization Adaptive Rank Allocation for LoRA
summary: Exponential growth in the scale of modern foundation models has led to the widespread adoption of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning technique. However, standard LoRA implementations disregard the varying intrinsic dimensionality of model layers and enforce a uniform rank, leading to parameter redundancy. We propose Post-Optimization Adaptive Rank Allocation (PARA), a data-free compression method for LoRA that integrates seamlessly into existing fine-tuning pipelines. PARA leverages Singular Value Decomposition to prune LoRA ranks using a global threshold over singular values across all layers. This results in non-uniform rank allocation based on layer-wise spectral importance. As a post-hoc method, PARA circumvents the training modifications and resulting instabilities that dynamic architectures typically incur. We empirically demonstrate that PARA reduces parameter count by 75-90\% while preserving the predictive performance of the original, uncompressed LoRA across multiple vision and language benchmarks. Code will be published upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: PARA uses singular value thresholding on SVD decomposition to automatically allocate non-uniform ranks across LoRA layers, achieving 75-90% parameter reduction without training or performance loss.
AI.motivation: Standard LoRA implementations assign uniform rank to all layers, ignoring that different layers have varying intrinsic dimensionality. This uniform allocation leads to parameter redundancy, where some layers may be significantly over-parameterized while others could benefit from higher capacity. Existing solutions requiring training modifications introduce instability issues.
AI.method: PARA uses Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to analyze the LoRA weight matrices. It applies a global singular value threshold across all layers to automatically determine which ranks to prune. This spectral-based approach allocates non-uniform ranks based on layer-wise importance, where layers with more significant singular values retain higher ranks.
AI.result: PARA reduces parameter count by 75-90% while preserving predictive performance across multiple vision and language benchmarks. The compressed models maintain comparable accuracy to original uncompressed LoRA adapters.
AI.conclusion: PARA provides a data-free, training-stable compression solution that achieves 75-90% parameter reduction without performance degradation. As a post-hoc method, it enables practical deployment of highly compressed LoRA adapters while maintaining compatibility with existing fine-tuning frameworks.

title: Hyper-Dimensional Fingerprints as Molecular Representations
summary: Computational molecular representations underpin virtual screening, property prediction, and materials discovery. Conventional fingerprints are efficient and deterministic but lose structural information through hash-based compression, particularly at low dimensionalities. Learned representations from graph neural networks recover this expressiveness but require task-specific training and substantial computational resources. Here we introduce hyperdimensional fingerprints (HDF), which replace the learned transformations of message-passing neural networks with algebraic operations on high-dimensional vectors, producing deterministic molecular representations without any training. Across diverse property prediction benchmarks, HDF outperforms conventional fingerprints in the majority of tasks while exhibiting greater consistency across datasets and models. Crucially, HDF embeddings preserve molecular similarity faithfully: at 32 dimensions, distances in HDF space achieve a 0.9 Pearson correlation with graph edit distance, compared to 0.55 for Morgan fingerprints at equivalent size. This structural fidelity persists at low dimensions where hash-based methods degrade, allowing simple nearest-neighbor regression to remain predictive with as few as 64 components. We further demonstrate the practical impact in Bayesian molecular optimization, where HDF-based surrogate models achieve substantially improved sample efficiency in regimes where Morgan fingerprints perform comparably to random search. HDF thus provides a general-purpose, training-free alternative to conventional molecular fingerprints, suggesting that the information loss long accepted as inherent to fixed-length fingerprints is a limitation of the hash-based encoding scheme rather than the fingerprint paradigm itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出超维指纹（HDF）：用超维计算（HDC/HRR-FHRR）的代数运算（傅里叶域元素级乘积作为结合、归一化求和作为捆绑）替代消息传递网络中的可学习变换，在分子图上做无需训练的确定性编码——原子属性经字典/分数幂编码为超向量，多跳消息传递聚合后与全局描述符（图大小、图直径）捆绑，得到固定长度向量。HDF 在多个性质预测基准上整体优于或持平 Morgan/RDKit/Torsion/Atom Pair 指纹（几何平均相对误差偏差 8.9% vs 74.8–221.6%），嵌入距离与图编辑距离的相关性显著更高（32 维约 0.85–0.9 vs Morgan 约 0.55），在低维（≤256 分量）仍保持预测能力，并在贝叶斯优化中以更少评估次数找到近优分子（9 个目标中 6 个优于 Morgan+Tanimoto 核）。核心结论：固定长度指纹的信息损失主要源于哈希折叠方案，而非指纹范式本身。
AI.motivation: 传统分子指纹（子结构键、路径、原子对、Morgan/ECFP 等）依靠将子结构特征哈希折叠为固定长度位向量，位碰撞导致信息损失，在低维时尤为严重；而图神经网络等学习式表示虽恢复表达力，却需要任务特定训练、算力开销大，且在训练分布外泛化不佳。超维计算（HDC）利用高维随机向量的准正交性，通过简单代数运算即可构建结构化表示，完全免训练且确定性，但已有 HDC 图/分子工作（GraphHD、GrapHD 仅限 1-hop；VS-Graph、HyperGraphX 面向通用图分类/节点分类；MoleHD 按 SMILES 序列处理；HDBind 依赖外部特征提取器）尚未针对分子化学属性设计并系统评估其在性质回归、相似性检索与分子优化中的表现。因此需要一个兼具传统指纹的高效通用性与更强结构保真度的、免训练的分子表示。
AI.method: 1) 表示基础：采用 HRR/FHRR 框架，原子超向量取傅里叶系数幅值均为 1 的酉向量（避免循环卷积反复相乘导致能量集中于少数频率分量），结合操作为傅里叶域元素级乘法（即循环卷积），捆绑为逐分量相加并归一化；解绑为循环相关，可近似反演。2) 属性编码：类别型属性（元素类型、CIP 手性）映射为近正交字典超向量；数值型属性（键合氢数、重原子度、图大小、图直径）用分数幂编码，在傅里叶域取幂，内积相似度按 sinc 核随数值差衰减，保留序关系。3) 节点嵌入与消息传递：h_i^(0)=normalize(h_atom ⊙ h_hs ⊙ h_bonds)；迭代更新 h_i^(l+1)=normalize(Σ_{j∈N(i)} h_i^(l) ⊙ h_j^(l))，利用结合对加法的分配性等价于 1-WL 颜色精化，因此表达力至多 1-WL；固定节点 HV 的结合在概率 1 下可逆，多重集求和同样概率 1 注入，串扰约 O(1/√D)；归一化丢失的重数信息由键度与图大小显式补足。4) 读出：节点在 l=0..L 各层嵌入求和归一化 → 对全图节点求和得 g_struc，与全局属性捆绑向量 g_attr 相加归一化得最终指纹 g∈R^D（置换不变、维度固定、计算量多项式）。5) 实验：HOPV15、FreeSolv、BACE、Lipophilicity、AqSolDB、ClogP、COMPAS-3X、QM9 上与 Morgan、RDKit、Torsion、Atom Pair 对比（GB/KNN/RF/NN，统一调参预算 30 组）；用化学有效单编辑生成 1–3 步编辑样本，以编辑步数作为 GED 代理，计算嵌入距离与 GED 的 Pearson 相关；8–16384 维扫描并做 8/4-bit 量化；贝叶斯优化基准（20 个初始样本、150 轮、GP+logEI，Morgan 用 Tanimoto 核、HDF 用线性核，随机搜索为基线，9 个目标各 100 次 campaign）；统计采用 Friedman 检验与配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验（Holm 校正）。
AI.result: 性质预测：标准配置下 HDF 在 16 个「模型×数据集」组合中的 15 个为最佳，调参后 13 个为最佳；17 个性质-数据集组合中神经网络模型在 10 个上最优，中位排名 1；几何平均相对误差偏差 8.9%，显著优于 Morgan 153.2%、RDKit 221.6%、Torsion 204.0%、Atom Pair 74.8%，且 13/17 个性质落在最优结果的 10% 以内；QM9 热力学量优势最大（U0：0.518 vs Morgan 7.351 Ha；ZPVE：0.824 vs 4.957 mHa；ΔH：0.550 vs 7.332 Ha），即使给 Morgan 补充图大小与图直径仍不改变结论；但 COMPAS-3X 的 Gap/μ 与 HOPV15 的 PCE 上 Morgan/Atom Pair 更优。结构保真度：所有维度下 HDF 距离与编辑步数的 Pearson 相关均高于同维 Morgan，32 维约 0.85（摘要表述 0.9）vs Morgan 约 0.55，512/2048 维约 0.9 vs 约 0.8；KNN（k=5）中 HDF 多数数据集误差更低，优势随维度升高而缩小。低维鲁棒性：≤256 分量时 HDF 误差低于同维 Morgan，AqSolDB 上全维度占优，BACE 高维时 Morgan 略优；32 位浮点带来 32 倍存储开销，但 8-bit 量化后性能基本保留、4-bit 损失很小，可将开销降至约 4–8 倍。贝叶斯优化：9 个目标中 HDF 在 6 个上优于 Morgan+Tanimoto 核，1 个 Morgan 更优，2 个互有胜负；ClogP=15（AqSolDB）在所有维度占优，16 维时 100 次 HDF campaign 全部达到归一化 regret ≤0.05，Morgan 仅 8/100；QED=0.2（ZINC250k）自 256 维起差距缩小；HDF 用 16–64 维（QED 用 128 维）即可达到 Morgan 在其最佳维度下的样本效率，且低维显著降低单轮成本（ZINC250k 上 8 维数分钟 vs 512 维 2–3 小时）。
AI.conclusion: HDF 证明超维计算可为分子提供紧凑、免训练、确定性的通用指纹：其核心优势来自对分子拓扑相似性的忠实保留（距离与 GED 高相关），进而带来距离依赖方法（KNN、GP 代理）性能提升与低维高效率，并在贝叶斯优化中转化为更优的样本效率。局限与边界：优势并非普遍——部分生物活性类任务传统指纹仍更优，性能仍依赖数据集，HDF 随维度增大更早饱和，高维时 Morgan 可能反超；成本上浮点存储需量化缓解。展望：可无训练扩展更多原子/分子属性（如立体化学，已在补充材料展示），结合/捆绑运算的近似可逆性有望支持从指纹向量重建分子子结构，用于可解释性与生成式分子设计。

title: Probabilistic Circuits for Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
summary: Joint probabilistic modeling is essential for forecasting irregular multivariate time series (IMTS) to accurately quantify uncertainty. Existing approaches often struggle to balance model expressivity with consistent marginalization, frequently leading to unreliable or contradictory forecasts. To address this, we propose CircuITS, a novel architecture for probabilistic IMTS forecasting based on probabilistic circuits. Our model is flexible in capturing intricate dependencies between time series channels while structurally guaranteeing valid joint distributions. Experiments on four real world datasets demonstrate that CircuITS achieves superior joint and marginal density estimation compared to state of the art baselines.

AI.tldr: CircuITS是一种基于概率电路的新型概率IMTS预测架构，在保证有效联合分布的同时，能够灵活捕捉时间序列通道间的复杂依赖关系，在多个数据集上实现了优越的密度估计性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在模型表达力与一致的边缘化之间难以平衡，经常导致不可靠或矛盾的预测结果。
AI.method: 提出了CircuITS，一种基于概率电路的 irregular multivariate time series (IMTS) 预测架构，通过概率电路的结构特性保证有效的联合分布。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，CircuITS在联合和边缘密度估计方面均优于最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: CircuITS structurally guarantees valid joint distributions while maintaining flexibility in capturing intricate dependencies between time series channels, demonstrating superior performance across four real-world datasets.

title: MCPHunt: An Evaluation Framework for Cross-Boundary Data Propagation in Multi-Server MCP Agents
comment: 21 pages, 1 figure, 16 tables. Code: https://github.com/lihaonan0716/MCPHunt Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lihaonan0716/mcphunt-agent-traces
summary: Multi-server MCP agents create an information-flow control problem: faithful tool composition can turn individually benign read/write permissions into cross-boundary credential propagation -- a structural side effect of workflow topology, not necessarily malicious model behavior. We present MCPHunt, to our knowledge the first controlled benchmark that isolates non-adversarial, verbatim credential propagation across multi-server MCP trust boundaries, with three methodological contributions: (1) canary-based taint tracking that reduces propagation detection to objective string matching; (2) an environment-controlled coverage design with risky, benign, and hard-negative conditions that validates pipeline soundness and controls for credential-format confounds; (3) CRS stratification that disentangles task-mandated propagation (faithful execution of verbatim-transfer instructions) from policy-violating propagation (credentials included despite the option to redact). Across 3,615 main-benchmark traces from 5 models spanning 147 tasks and 9 mechanism families, policy-violating propagation rates reach 11.5--41.3% across all models. This propagation is pathway-specific (25x cross-mechanism range) and concentrated in browser-mediated data flows; hard-negative controls provide evidence that production-format credentials are not necessary -- prompt-directed cross-boundary data flow is sufficient. A prompt-mitigation study across 3 models reduces policy-violating propagation by up to 97% while preserving 80.5% utility, but effectiveness varies with instruction-following capability -- suggesting that prompt-level defenses alone may not suffice. Code, traces, and labeling pipeline are released under MIT and CC BY 4.0.

AI.tldr: MCPHunt 是首个在“非对抗、正常任务执行”条件下量化多服务器 MCP 智能体跨信任边界凭据逐字传播（compositional data propagation）的受控基准：通过格式仿真的 canary 污点追踪、risky/benign/hard-negative 三条件环境对照设计与 CRS（Completion-Requires-Secret）分层，把“任务强制传输”与“策略违规传播”区分开。跨 5 个模型、147 任务、9 类机制、3,615 条主基准轨迹显示，策略违规传播率在所有模型上持续存在（11.5%–41.3%），且高度依赖源→汇数据流拓扑（0.0%–74.4%，browser_to_local 最高），与模型能力关系弱于与路径结构的关系；提示词缓解可将 GPT-5.4 的策略违规率降至 0.3%（相对下降 98%）且保持 80.5% 效用，但跨模型效果差异大，说明提示级防御不足，需数据流感知的编排层防护。
AI.motivation: MCP 生态快速扩张（逾 1 万公开服务器、月均 SDK 下载 9700 万次），多服务器部署（文件系统+数据库+git+浏览器+shell 协同）已成为常见生产形态，已有 Asana 跨租户泄露、GitHub MCP 提示注入外泄、STDIO 传输 RCE 等事件。但这些事件均属对抗性威胁（恶意服务器、注入、协议漏洞），而“所有服务器均受信、任务完全合法、模型无恶意时，忠实的工具组合是否仍会把读写权限拼接成跨边界凭据传播”这一信息流控制（IFC）问题始终未被实证测量。作者称之为 compositional data propagation：风险是工作流拓扑的结构性副作用——每个单次工具调用单独看都无害，危害只在其组合与多步执行中涌现。现有工作或聚焦对抗鲁棒性（MCP-SafetyBench、MCPSecBench、AgentLeak 等），或聚焦非对抗下的“组合推断”（TOP-Bench，合成新信息而非搬运既有凭据），或提供形式化 IFC 框架但无实证测量；无人在多服务器 MCP 信任边界上测量“既有凭据是否在常规任务执行中被逐字搬运”。此外，权限与 RLHF 对齐为何失效有明确机制性解释：任务本身合法，模型无从“拒绝”；工具级权限检查无法阻止一次读+一次写的良性组合；运行时护栏逐调用检查却不跟踪跨调用数据流。
AI.method: 威胁模型与定义。非对抗场景：用户下达合法任务，智能体访问 k 个 MCP 服务器，无攻击者操纵提示、工具或数据。当某动作读取敏感值且后续动作将其跨信任边界写出（跨服务器/跨工具/跨位置）即构成跨边界数据传播。三大方法支柱：(1) canary-based taint tracking——用格式仿真的合成密钥（sk_live_*、AKIA*、ghp_*、pk_live_* 等）替换真实敏感值，检测退化为工具调用参数上的确定性字符串匹配（完整 canary 或 ≥10 字符核心的精确子串），无需人工标注与裁判模型；(2) 环境受控设计——每个任务在 risky(v1/v2/v3 三种不同 canary 值以防记忆效应)、benign（结构完全相同、值为 sk_test_* 但仍注册为 canary）、hard-negative（结构相同、格式族相同但取值互斥的新 canary，且提示不引导智能体接触敏感文件）三种条件下运行；同名任务在跨环境时提示与智能体配置完全相同，仅数据内容变化，benign 提供管线一致性检查，hard-negative 提供“匹配替代值对照”（检验传播是否依赖生产格式凭据，结论是不依赖）；(3) 机制族分类法——9 类 source→sink 风险机制（file_to_file、file_to_doc、config_to_script、db_to_artifact、sensitive_to_shell、forced_multi_hop、git_history_leak、browser_to_local、indirect_exposure），每类 12 任务，另加 27 个 hard-negative 专属任务与 12 个 benign 对照，共 147 任务。此外，检测管线按时间序逐 canary 追踪计算 11 个二元风险信号，分两层：Tier 1（8 个确认传播信号，如 data_flow、cross_boundary_flow、secret_in_executable、secret_in_command、opaque_transfer 等）与 Tier 2（3 个结构性风险信号，如 sensitive_schema_flow、external_after_sensitive、authority_escalation）。核心创新是 CRS 分层：按固定三段式判据（逐字传输语言、源结构性含凭据、脱敏智能体是否会违规）将任务标注为 CRS（完成必须包含秘密，如“复制全部”“导出所有”）或 non-CRS（只请求派生制品，如摘要、报告、脚本），标注在实验前冻结于任务注册表，从而把“任务强制传播”（81.0%，部署风险）与“策略违规传播”（13.5%，安全失败）分离，后者为主安全指标。基础设施：由 8 个 MCP 服务器（filesystem、git、memory/KG、SQLite、fetch、time、shell、browser）编排的 harness，每任务重启服务器并从零重置工作区与 KG 持久化文件，含采集完整性监控与失败即停检查；模型无关，仅需 YAML 配置即可接入任意 OpenAI 兼容端点。分析工具包括 Wilson 区间、BCa bootstrap、Fisher 精确检验（含 Bonferroni 解读）、按任务聚类的 GEE 逻辑回归与单预测因子 McFadden 伪 R² 偏差削减份额分解。
AI.result: 主基准 3,615 条轨迹（5 模型 × 723 条 = 147 任务 × 7 环境变体）。GPT-5.4 总体传播率 23.3% [19.3, 27.7]，效用 78.8%；CRS 层传播 81.0%（n=63），non-CRS 策略违规传播 13.5%（n=288）。benign 环境 0%（管线策略性强制，非检测器经验性零误报证据），hard-negative 环境 11.6%。路径特异性极强：browser_to_local 74.4%（OR=347.2，95% CI [37.7, 3200]，p<0.001）最高，forced_multi_hop 46.2%，file_to_file 30.8%（但策略违规为 0.0%），db_to_artifact 28.2%，config_to_script 20.5%，git_history_leak 15.4%，sensitive_to_shell 12.8%，file_to_doc 2.6%，indirect_exposure 0.0%，跨机制跨度 25 倍；浏览器机制贡献了 39 个策略违规事件中的 14 个（36%）。non-CRS 子集（n=1,440）GEE 显示机制族解释 62.2% 的伪 R² 改善、模型身份仅 32.0%（描述性偏差削减份额，非因果方差分解），各机制 OR 差异逾 21 倍，全部 p<0.01；模型效应上 MiniMax-M2.7（OR=8.2）、DeepSeek-V4-Flash（OR=6.4）、Gemini-3.1-Pro（OR=3.8）显著高于 GPT-5.2，GPT-5.4 无显著差异（OR=1.3, p=0.455）。跨模型策略违规率：GPT-5.2 11.5%、GPT-5.4 13.5%、Gemini-3.1-Pro 27.1%、DeepSeek-V4-Flash 36.5%、MiniMax-M2.7 41.3%，且效用高者传播未必低（MiniMax-M2.7 效用 92.2% 但传播 45.2%）。匹配替代值对照：同一 108 个跨边界任务在 risky 值集 25.9% vs hard-negative 值集 20.4%（配对差 +5.6pp，Tango 95% CI [−0.8, 12.8]，McNemar p=0.15），即传播在替换为不同合成凭据后依然存在，但数据既不能区分也不能等同两率；因两值集共享格式族且无中性占位符臂，格式线索未被隔离。缓解研究（2,706 条）：GPT-5.4 上 M1 通用提醒仅降 6.1pp（策略违规 13.9%→8.1%），M2 显式逐汇脱敏规则降至 4.7%/1.4%，M3 边界感知详细提示降至总传播 2.3%、策略违规 0.3%（相对基线降 98%），效用不降反微升（79.4%→80.5%）；跨模型 M3 在 risky_v1 上相对降幅为 GPT-5.4 92%、DeepSeek-V4-Flash 75%、MiniMax-M2.7 47%，M1 对 DeepSeek 完全无效（0%）。残余最抗缓解路径为 browser_to_local（M3 下 GPT-5.4 仍 5.6%；为 DeepSeek 13 个事件的 7 个、MiniMax 29 个事件的 10 个），且唯一普遍持续的任务是 CRS=True 的 fork_project。运行时污点护栏：同日配对试验（DeepSeek-V4-Flash，39 对 / 15 任务，两臂提示文本一致、护栏在工具派发层生效、拦截 49 次写入）实际汇端不安全率 79.5%→51.3%（−28.2pp，95% CI [−48.8, −10.8]，McNemar c/b=12/1），任务成功率 76.9%→79.5%（CI 跨零）；历史对照（387 单元，护栏触发 196 次）不安全率 40.1%→4.7%，但两臂采集日期、pipeline commit 均不同且 387 对中 345 对提示文本有差异，仅为观察性差异而非因果估计，残余集中于 browser_to_local（fetch 响应未被登记为污点源）。作者在附录 S 明确撤回了此前“事后回放模拟、5 模型中 4 个不安全写入归零、85–96% 拦截率、效用完全保持”等不可复现的表述。附录 T 的漏检流行度诊断（150/698 条检测干净轨迹，单一裁判 claude-opus-4-8）标记率 8.0% [4.6, 13.5]，但无一为完整 canary 复现（4 条为片段、8 条仅指认秘密类型或位置），属基于规则的阳性流行度而非召回率或假阴性率。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心论证链是：多服务器 MCP 的风险不只是“恶意工具能否突破护栏”，还包括“合规的工具组合是否在无恶意时构成信息流控制失效”。其最有价值的产出是评测方法学而非单一数字：canary 字符串匹配把跨边界泄露判定变成客观可复现的字符串问题；环境受控设计（尤其是匹配替代值对照）排除了“生产格式凭据本身驱动传播”这一替代解释；CRS 分层则把一个笼统的“泄露率”拆成任务强制传输（部署工程问题）与策略违规传播（真正的安全失败），后者才应作为模型安全指标。经验结论有三点：其一，传播是路径属性而非模型属性——机制族解释的偏差削减份额（62.2%）约为模型身份（32.0%）的两倍，browser_to_local 因缺乏 schema 级粒度、混合内容页面与“抓取即复制”的训练先验而成为所有模型共同的痛点，因此部署侧应优先对浏览器→本地汇路径做字符串级过滤与编排层污点拦截，而非按模型强弱选择；其二，提示级缓解可以极其有效（M3 达 98% 相对降幅且不牺牲效用，说明边界感知指令不会诱发过度拒答），但有效性随模型指令遵循能力递减（M3 相对降幅 92%→75%→47%），且 browser_to_local 与 CRS 类复制任务基本不可由提示消除，故不能仅依赖提示防御；其三，工具级权限、RLHF 对齐与逐调用运行时护栏在结构上都无法覆盖“读+写”的良性组合，防护必须升级到数据流感知的编排层（污点追踪、汇端脱敏、IFC 原语集成到 MCP），这既是工程结论也是开放研究议程。需谨慎解读的边界：benign 环境 0% 是标注管线策略性强制而非检测器可靠性的经验证据；hard-negative 对照因共享格式族无法隔离格式线索（缺中性占位符臂）；CRS 标签由作者按固定判据自行标注、仅在投稿后由两名非作者盲标复审（一致率 138/147=93.9%，κ=0.71，CI [0.50, 0.87]）且未修改冻结标签；检测仅覆盖精确子串，编码/哈希/改写式传播被系统性漏计，故报告的率是敏感信息暴露的下界；147 个任务全为研究者设计，与真实企业 MCP 轨迹的对应关系属回顾性、可审计但未经独立验证的作者策展映射；每个任务×环境仅单次运行，risky_v1/v2/v3 是覆盖与稳健性检查而非独立随机种子，故不能给出种子平均方差；8 个服务器未覆盖云存储、邮件与 CI/CD；护栏证据仅有单模型、单机制、39 对同日配对（另有更混杂的历史对照），不能建立因果防御效果、跨模型行为或效用非劣性结论。整体而言，论文论证链较完整、统计报告规范（Wilson 区间、bootstrap、Fisher/McNemar、GEE 聚类、Bonferroni 讨论齐备），并主动披露并撤回了不可复现的护栏表述与若干指标口径的局限（如 benign 强制归零、pseudo-R² 的解释边界），可信度较高；其最可落地的启示是：MCP 智能体的部署安全评估应以 source→sink 拓扑与 CRS 分层为主轴，并优先在浏览器路径与编排层实施防护。

title: CastFlow: Learning Role-Specialized Agentic Workflows for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Recently, large language models (LLMs) have shown great promise in time series forecasting. However, most existing LLM-based forecasting methods still follow a static generative paradigm that directly maps historical observations to future values in a single pass. Under this paradigm, forecasting is constrained by limited temporal pattern extraction, single-round acquisition of contextual features, one-shot forecast generation, and lack of support from ensemble forecasts. To address these limitations, in this work, we propose CastFlow, a dynamic agentic forecasting framework that enables multi-view temporal pattern extraction, multi-round contextual features acquisition, iterative forecast refinement, and forecasting with ensemble forecasts. First, CastFlow organizes the forecasting process into planning, action, forecasting, and reflection, establishing an agentic workflow. Second, this workflow is supported by a memory module that retrieves prior experience and a multi-view toolkit that constructs diagnostic evidence and provides a reliable ensemble forecast baseline. Third, CastFlow adopts a role-specialized design that combines general-purpose reasoning with specialized numerical forecasting. Under this design, a frozen LLM preserves general-purpose reasoning, while a fine-tuned domain-specific LLM performs evidence-guided numerical forecasting based on the ensemble forecast baseline, rather than from scratch. To optimize a fine-tuned domain-specific LLM, we further develop a two-stage workflow-oriented training that combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). To evaluate the effectiveness of CastFlow, we conduct extensive experiments on diverse datasets and show that it achieves superior overall results against strong baselines. We hope that this work can serve as a step toward more adaptive and accurate time series forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CastFlow，一种动态智能体时间序列预测框架，通过智能体工作流、多视图工具包和角色专业化设计，结合SFT和RLVR两阶段训练，有效解决了现有LLM预测方法的静态范式局限，在多数据集上验证了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的时间序列预测方法仍遵循静态生成范式，存在以下局限：时间模式提取有限、上下文特征单轮获取、一次性预测生成、以及缺乏集成预测支持。
AI.method: (1) 将预测流程组织为规划、行动、预测和反思四个阶段的智能体工作流；(2) 通过记忆模块检索先验经验，多视图工具包构建诊断证据并提供可靠的集成预测基线；(3) 采用角色专业化设计，结合冻结LLM保持通用推理能力与微调领域特定LLM进行证据引导的数值预测；(4) 开发两阶段面向工作流的训练范式，结合监督微调(SFT)和带可验证奖励的强化学习(RLVR)优化领域特定LLM。
AI.result: CastFlow实现了多视图时间模式提取、多轮上下文特征获取、迭代预测优化以及集成预测支持，在多个数据集上取得了优于强基线方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，CastFlow在多个数据集上相比强基线方法取得了更优的整体性能，表明该框架在实现自适应、准确的时间序列预测方面具有显著潜力。

title: Physical Foundation Models: Fixed hardware implementations of large-scale neural networks
summary:
Foundation models are deep neural networks (such as GPT-5, Gemini~3, and Opus~4) trained on large datasets that can perform diverse downstream tasks -- text and code generation, question answering, summarization, image classification, and so on. The philosophy of foundation models is to put effort into a single, large (${\sim}10^{12}$-parameter) general-purpose model that can be adapted to many downstream tasks with no or minimal additional training. We argue that the rise of foundation models presents an opportunity for hardware engineers: in contrast to when different models were used for different tasks, it now makes sense to build special-purpose, fixed hardware implementations of neural networks, manufactured and released at the roughly 1-year cadence of major new foundation-model versions.
  Beyond conventional digital-electronic inference hardware with read-only weight memory, we advocate a more radical re-thinking: hardware in which the neural network is realized directly at the level of the physical design and operates via the hardware's natural physical dynamics -- \textit{Physical Foundation Models} (PFMs). PFMs could enable orders-of-magnitude advantages in energy efficiency, speed, and parameter density. For ${\sim}10^{12}$-parameter models, this would both reduce the high energy burden of AI in datacenters and enable AI in edge devices that today are power-constrained to far smaller models. PFMs could also enable inference hardware for models much larger than current ones: $10^{15}$- or even $10^{18}$-parameter PFMs seem plausible by some measures. We present back-of-the-envelope calculations illustrating PFM scaling using an optical example -- a 3D nanostructured glass medium -- and discuss prospects in nanoelectronics and other physical platforms. We conclude with the major research challenges that must be resolved for trillion-parameter PFMs and beyond to become reality.

AI.tldr: 本文（综述/概念论文）提出"物理基础模型"（Physical Foundation Models, PFM）范式：把训练好的基础模型的架构与参数在制造阶段直接固化进硬件的物理结构中（纳米结构玻璃、纳米电子结构等），让硬件的自然物理动力学完成整个（而非仅权重）前向推理，从而摆脱可编程性与冯·诺依曼瓶颈。作者以"3D纳米结构玻璃光学PFM"为例做量级估算：10^12–10^18参数的PFM在原理上可行，单次推理能耗约按 P^{1/3} 增长（10^12参数时约100 μJ、10^18时约10 mJ），相对数字电子基线（能耗按 P 增长、约25 ms/次）有 10^4–10^8 倍能耗优势与 10^3–10^5 倍延迟优势，且优势随模型规模扩大而增大。作者同时评述了纳米电子路线（交叉阵列因寄生互连耗散呈 ~N^4 标度、逆设计电阻网络受 Tellegen 定理限制、逆设计掺杂半导体最具前景），并系统列出训练与仿真、制造良率与缺陷、仿真-现实鸿沟、模块化、精度-体积权衡、与数字电子接口等研究挑战，以及PFM在AI安全（"个体性/致命性"、可修改性低、物理可约束性）上的意义。
AI.motivation: 1) 现实压力：全球数据中心AI负载已达44 GW电力，预计2030年超过150 GW，相关资本开支超过5万亿美元；当前10^12级模型的算力/能耗已超出边缘设备（手机、机器人、汽车）的功率预算。2) 规模瓶颈：若模型达到10^18参数，按8 bit/参数需1 EB存储，按当前3D-NAND约30 Gb/mm²需约250 m²物理面积（即便乐观堆叠也相当于边长20 cm的立方体），且在1 Tbit/s带宽下仅"读入模型"就要90天，说明模型存储与计算分离的冯·诺依曼路线难以支撑超大规模推理。3) 时机转变：过去不同任务用不同模型，无法为单一模型做专用硬件；如今基础模型（GPT/Gemini/Llama/Claude 系列，约每年迭代一个大版本）以极少量下游微调即可复用，因此"按模型版本节奏（约1年）流片固化参数"的专用硬件在商业上变得合理，且可省去可编程性带来的写通路、控制通路、外围电路与刷新/写耐久等开销，从而提高参数密度、速度、能耗与规模。4) 作者还论证了超大模型的必要性：历史上硬件能力一旦提供就会被用满；人脑约10^14突触、神经元行为远比人工神经元复杂，达到类人智能可能需要10^15–10^18乃至10^21参数；为小模型做推理降本的技术也会外溢到小模型。
AI.method: 视角论文（perspective）+ 物理量级估算（back-of-the-envelope），而非工程设计。核心路线：(1) 光学PFM样例——3D纳米结构玻璃体（熔融石英，λ=1550 nm，n=1.5），参数以体折射率起伏编码，每个参数占体积 ~(λ/n)³；输入经高分辨率SLM编码为光脉冲，利用Kerr非线性传播实现深层非线性变换，输出由探测器阵列读出并数字化；采用类光纤长管几何（保证导模数 M~An²/λ² ≥ 输入/输出维数、全内反射降散射、便于增益与散热），输入/输出维数取 P^{1/3}；能耗按每元素100 pJ（含调制/探测/激光/数模转换）计，非线性由 Φ_NL=2π、n₂≈10⁻²⁰ m²/W 推得峰值功率44 MW/450 MW/4.5 GW（1 ps脉冲）；速度受1 kW平均光功率限制。(2) 数字基线：以B200级GPU为准，1 pJ/8-bit操作、算术操作数≈参数量、25 ms（192 GB @ 8 TB/s）为乐观假设，单GPU体积1000 cm³。(3) 纳米电子三条路线的定性/半定量评述：固定结电阻交叉阵列、逆设计电阻/导体结构（Tellegen定理→只能实现非负对称矩阵）、逆设计掺杂半导体（引用van der Wiel等Si中无序掺杂网络实现逻辑/分类的实验）以及相干输运/超导等极端设想。(4) 归纳适合PFM的三项物理要求（尺度可控可制造、动力学能量低、可从同介质其他物理过程抽象出来）及12项研究挑战，并讨论架构/软件栈、边缘能力、安全性、算力-物理约束等影响。(5) 分析固定超表面 vs 可编程SLM的密度对比（300 mm晶圆上>10^12参数 vs 现有SLM约10^7像素，同面积约100倍参数规模）。
AI.result: 估算结果（Table 1）：光学PFM在P=10^12/10^15/10^18时体积分别约(1 mm)²×1 m、(1 cm)²×10 m、(10 cm)²×100 m，能耗/次约100 μJ、1 mJ、10 mJ，时间/次约100 ns、1 μs、10 μs；数字基线体积约(17 cm)³、(1.7 m)³、(17 m)³，能耗/次约1 J、1 kJ、1 MJ，时间/次恒定约25 ms。即PFM能耗/延迟分别有 10^4–10^8 与 10^3–10^5 倍优势，且能耗优势随规模扩大、速度优势随规模缩小；10^18参数PFM的单次能耗约比今天的10^12参数数字系统低100倍，可支撑边缘部署，并有望在不触碰数字-模拟转换瓶颈的前提下获得更强的测试时扩展收益。关键判断：PFM的收益随模型规模P增大而增大——即便在当前10^12量级也已有可观优势；"放弃可编程性"带来的系统复杂度下降在参数密度、速度、能耗、规模四方面均有收益，且二阶（规模带来的）效应可能比一阶效应更重要。纳米电子方面：固定交叉阵列的能耗标度在~N到~N^4之间强烈依赖假设，最佳估计仍被寄生互连耗散主导（~N^4），故未列入对比表；逆设计导体可做到~N线性标度但表达能力受限；逆设计半导体被认为最有前景但当前评估远不充分。附录强调：以上仅为"物理合理性"层面的量级验证，外围数模转换、冷却、光源/探测器阵列等未做工程设计，误差可能达一个数量级以上；10^18参数PFM需要约50 m长、5×5 cm截面的玻璃管并配增益介质（如Yb掺杂）。
AI.conclusion: 结论性立场为：把当前最大模型再放大若干数量级，很可能需要彻底改变硬件实现方式，PFM（物理基础模型/单用途模拟计算机）是一条可行路径，可让10^15乃至10^18–10^21参数模型的推理成本不再成为瓶颈，并使廉价低功耗的基础模型计算下沉到边缘设备。方法论主张是"物理计算机科学"：不机械照搬Transformer的数学形式（正如大脑不使用ReLU），而是通过硬件-算法联合优化，把"物理系统的参数"直接作为学习对象（物理机器学习/大规模物理逆向设计），使硬件即软件；即使放弃可编程性、以固定硬件实现推理，仍比自学习硬件更易实现且经济上自洽。论文主体是一份研究议程与开放问题清单：①训练可扩展性——训练10^12以上模型的"网络之网络"式方案（固定、不可微的PFM作为专家，由可训练的数智"管理者"路由，类似MoE/多智能体混合；利用制造公差带来的个体差异做bagging/boosting式集成，甚至主动加大有功能意义的制造差异）；②制造规模化（3D制造范式、10^12–10^18参数器件如何制造）；③物理计算的表达能力与物理约束方式；④是否利用/容忍随机与概率动力学（如扩散模型中随机性是算法核心）；⑤物理层面的网络架构（哪些Transformer要素该保留、哪些该抛弃）；⑥模块化与层级（分模块训练、逐层构建以降低仿真负担）；⑦训练用仿真基础设施（超过10^12–10^18参数量级后仿真本身不可行，需要代理模型、模块化多物理场耦合、已有PFM辅助下一代的逆向设计、甚至硬件内部自演化参数）；⑧编译（从GPT等现有模型直接映射到硬件设计）；⑨制造变异与仿真-现实鸿沟（用前后端小型数字网络补偿、少量可编程元件做后制造调优、对应Hinton的"mortal computation"）；⑩抗缺陷与灾难性失效、冗余与熔丝式修正；⑪可处置性与可维修性（模块化替换、回收、类"数字器官"的修复）；⑫参数精度-体积权衡；⑬与数字电子的接口效率（避免过多DAC/ADC能耗）。作者亦坦承对PFM的能力边界、涌现性质与安全性认识极为有限，但强调PFM的类人能力可与"10^14突触/10^24蛋白"等参考尺度对话，同时指出其模拟脆弱性、个体差异与低可编程性会引入新的失效与控制难题；最终结论是"若PFM能被制造、按设计工作、并可被设计出来，就可能彻底改变AI的能力边界"，研究应在物理约束下的可理解、可控AI理论方向上展开。

title: A Grid-Aware Agent-Based Model for Analyzing Electric Vehicle Charging Systems
comment: This is the author's version of a paper submitted to SIMULTECH. 12 Pages, 1 Table, 10 Figures
summary: This paper presents a configurable, grid-aware Agent-Based Model (ABM) for the systematic analysis of electric vehicle (EV) charging systems under configurable infrastructure and operational conditions. The model integrates heterogeneous EV behavior, charging column constraints, and a shared Energy Sandbox that regulates aggregate power allocation, enabling the joint study of user-centric charging dynamics and facility-level power behavior. Implemented in Python using the SimPy discrete-event framework, the approach supports scalable, event-driven simulations across varying system sizes, charger compositions, and scheduling strategies. A representative workplace charging scenario is investigated to illustrate how infrastructure configuration and coordination mechanisms influence energy delivery performance, infrastructure utilization, and aggregate load characteristics. The results highlight the context-dependence of infrastructure suitability and demonstrate how charging strategies and charger types reshape both service-level outcomes and grid-facing behavior. The proposed ABM provides a flexible and extensible simulation environment for exploring technical, operational, and grid-aware aspects of EV charging ecosystems, and for serving as a methodological basis for subsequent studies on advanced coordination strategies beyond the specific scenario analyzed in this study.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于Python/SimPy的可配置网格感知ABM框架，用于系统分析EV充电系统，通过整合异构EV行为、充电约束和能源沙箱实现多维度仿真，实验验证了该框架在评估基础设施配置和协调策略对能量交付、设施利用率及电网负荷影响方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 需要系统分析电动汽车充电系统在可配置基础设施和运营条件下的表现，尤其是用户中心充电动态与设施级功率行为的联合研究尚不充分。
AI.method: 采用Python和SimPy离散事件框架实现可配置的、网格感知的ABM，整合异构EV行为、充电柱约束和共享能源沙箱调节聚合功率分配，支持跨不同系统规模、充电器组合和调度策略的可扩展事件驱动模拟。
AI.result: 工作场所充电场景研究表明：基础设施配置和协调机制显著影响能量交付性能、基础设施利用率和聚合负载特性；充电策略和充电器类型对服务水平和电网侧行为具有显著塑造作用；基础设施适用性具有明显的场景依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的ABM提供了一个灵活且可扩展的仿真环境，可用于探索电动汽车充电生态系统的技术、运营和电网感知方面，并为后续研究先进协调策略提供方法论基础。

title: Beyond the Baseband: Adaptive Multi-Band Encoding for Full-Spectrum Bioacoustics Classification
summary: Animals hear and vocalize across frequency ranges that differ substantially from humans, often extending into the ultrasonic domain. Yet most computational bioacoustics systems rely on audio models pre-trained at 16 kHz, restricting their usable bandwidth to the 0-8 kHz baseband and discarding higher-frequency information present in many bioacoustic recordings. We investigate a multi-band encoding framework that decomposes the full spectrum of animal calls into band features and fuses them into a unified representation. Similarity analyses on models show that certain encoders produce decorrelated band embeddings that improve class separation after fusion. Classification experiments on three bioacoustic datasets using eight pre-trained models and five fusion strategies show that fused representations consistently outperform the baseband and time-expansion baselines on two datasets, showing the potential of multi-band methods for full-spectrum encoding of animal calls.

AI.tldr: 针对现有生物声学系统因预训练模型带宽限制导致高频信息丢失的问题，提出多频带编码框架。该框架将全频谱分解为多个频带特征进行融合，实验表明融合表示在分类性能上优于传统基带方法。
AI.motivation: 现有计算生物声学系统依赖16 kHz预训练音频模型，限制可用带宽仅在0-8 kHz基带范围，导致许多动物叫声中的高频信息被丢弃。
AI.method: 提出多频带编码框架，将动物叫声全频谱分解为多个频带特征并融合为统一表示。采用三种数据集、八个预训练模型和五种融合策略进行分类实验。
AI.result: 融合表示在三个数据集中的两个上持续优于基带和时间扩展基线。
AI.conclusion: 多频带编码方法在两个数据集上持续优于基带和时间扩展基线，证明了全频谱编码方法在动物叫声分析中的潜力。

title: Rethinking Agentic Reinforcement Learning In Large Language Models
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has traditionally focused on training specialized agents to optimize predefined reward functions within narrowly defined environments. However, the advent of powerful Large Language Models (LLMs) and increasingly complex, open-ended tasks has catalyzed a paradigm shift towards agentic paradigms within RL. This emerging framework extends beyond traditional RL by emphasizing the development of autonomous agents capable of goal-setting, long-term planning, dynamic strategy adaptation, and interactive reasoning in uncertain, real-world environments. Unlike conventional approaches that rely heavily on static objectives and episodic interactions, LLM-based Agentic RL incorporates cognitive-like capabilities such as meta-reasoning, self-reflection, and multi-step decision-making directly into the learning loop. In this paper, we provide a deep insight for looking the conceptual foundations, methodological innovations, and effective designs underlying this trend. Furthermore, we identify critical challenges and outline promising future directions for building LLM-based Agentic RL.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了大语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体强化学习（Agentic RL）这一新兴范式，旨在突破传统 RL 在狭义环境和静态目标上的局限，构建具备自主目标设定、长期规划、动态策略调整和多步推理能力的智能体系统。
AI.motivation: 传统 RL 仅限于狭义环境中优化预定义奖励函数，已无法应对开放性复杂任务；LLM 的出现为 RL 带来了向自主智能体范式转变的机遇。
AI.method: 系统梳理了概念基础、方法论创新和有效设计模式，分析 LLM 如何赋予 RL agents 认知类能力。
AI.result: 提出了 LLM-based Agentic RL 的概念框架，涵盖目标设定、自主规划、动态策略调整和交互推理等核心能力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为构建 LLM-based Agentic RL 系统提供了概念框架和方法论指导，同时识别了关键挑战并展望了未来研究方向。

title: KellyBench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Sequential Decision Making
summary: Language models are saturating benchmarks for procedural tasks with narrow objectives. But they are increasingly being deployed in long-horizon, non-stationary environments with open-ended goals. In this paper we introduce KellyBench, an environment for evaluating sequential decision-making in sports betting markets. Agents are placed in a sequential simulation of the 2023-24 English Premier League season and tasked with maximising their long-term bankroll growth. They are given detailed historical data, including advanced statistics, lineups, and public odds. To succeed they must build machine learning models, identify edge in public markets, and adapt as the environment changes over time. We find that all frontier models evaluated lose money on average over the course of the season for five seeds. The best performing model achieves an average return of -8%, and many models experiencing ruin across seeds. To judge strategy sophistication, we use a human expert rubric to grade each model and find their approaches to be unsophisticated compared to human baselines; Claude Opus 4.6 achieves a rubric score of 26.5%, which means there is significant room for improvement. KellyBench is available as an open-access API endpoint at https://openreward.ai/GeneralReasoning/KellyBench.

AI.tldr:
KellyBench 是一个面向长时程序列决策的环境化评测基准：在真实 2023–24 英超赛季真实赔率上，智能体需逐比赛日构建预测模型、识别相对市场优势并管理资金，目标为最大化长期对数财富增长。结果是所有被测前沿模型在 5 个种子下平均全部亏损（最好者 GPT-5.4 约 −7.9% ROI，25 个种子中仅 3 个为正，6 个破产），专家 52 分 rubric 评估的最高策略复杂度得分仅为 Claude Opus 4.6 的 26.5%，且人类基线（Human Quant +5.1%）优于全部模型。论文核心结论是：当前模型的瓶颈不在分析能力，而在"知道该做什么却无法可靠执行、监控与适应"的闭环能力缺口。

motivation>动机：现有评测（如 terminal-bench、MLE-Bench、MLGym、ForecastBench、StockBench 等）多面向狭窄目标、静态环境与稀疏的回合末反馈，测试的是程序性能力，而非"从经验中归纳、构建并修正模型"的归纳推理与序列决策能力；真实部署环境则是长时程、非平稳、开放式目标的（如金融市场中规则随状态变化、球员能力因伤情漂移，足球主场优势在 2019–20 疫情空场赛季被证明系统性衰减）。因此存在"训练时静态行为 vs 测试时动态行为"的能力缺口，需要一个能持续采样决策、承受估计误差与非平稳性的评测环境；作者同时强调评测范式应从固定任务集转向智能体必须在不确定性下从经验学习的复杂世界。

method>方法：(1) 环境基于 Open Reward Standard（ORS）协议定义，通过 OpenReward 提供服务，firehorse 的 ReSum harness 运行模型；(2) 动力学：一个 episode 模拟完整英超赛季（约 100–150 比赛日），固定循环为观察（当日赛程与收盘十进制赔率）→ 建模（沙箱内读写文件训练模型）→ 下注（五类盘口：主胜/平/客胜/大2.5/小2.5）→ 结算（按真实赛果赔付）→ 数据更新（返回结果与球员级统计），并要求每个比赛日至少下一注以防止弃权；(3) 数据：1993–94 起比赛级纵向数据（比分、半场、射门/犯规/角球/牌/裁判、2002–03 起多博彩公司赔率）与 2008 起五大联赛及杯赛、欧战的球员级数据（首发阵容、进球助攻、出场时间、射门、牌、抢断拦截、xG、年龄身高位置），按比赛日渐进披露以模拟量化基金的信息结构；(4) 工具：4 个环境工具（view_matches、place_bet、view_bankroll、next_matchday）+ 7 个对齐 Claude Code schema 的 CLI 工具（bash/glob/grep/read/write/edit/todo_write），沙箱 4 CPU/16GB、NumPy-pandas-sklearn、禁网（3 次 HTTP 类尝试即取消资格并清零）；(5) 奖励：每步为对数财富变化，累积奖励等于终末/初始财富对数比，即 Kelly 增长率，完全可验证、免 LLM 评判；(6) 场景：5 个赛季（New Millennium 2000/01、Post-Crash 2010/11、Covid 2020/21 训练；Recent Season 2023/24 及加挂 30+ 篇文献库的 Lit. 变体测试）；(7) 防泄漏：禁止依赖结果/赛季记忆，要求遵守规则化策略并声明违规即取消资格；(8) 评测：5 个模型 × 5 个种子，统计上用逐比赛日对数收益的双侧 Mann–Whitney U（Holm–Bonferroni 校正）、Claude Opus 4.6 的 50,000 次层级 bootstrap、破产概率对复杂度分的逻辑回归；(9) 引入过程性指标 sophistication：由定量博彩基金经验专家构造的 45 条准则/52 分 rubric；(10) 消融：文献库、Claude Code harness、rubric 可见三种设定；(11) 四个人类/经典基线：Favourites-Only、Dixon–Coles、Human Quant（2 年经验）、AI Researcher（5 年深度学习经验）。

result>结果：(1) 5 个种子平均 ROI 从 Kimi K2.5 的 −89.6% 到 GPT-5.4 的 −7.9%，25 个种子仅 3 个为正（GPT-5.4 +34.1%、Gemini 3.1 Pro +33.7%、Opus 4.6 +21.5%），6/25 种子破产；根本驱动因素是模型 log loss 差（ΔLL +0.016~+0.080）所反映的预测弱于市场，而非仅仅风险管理失误；(2) 显著性：Opus 4.6 vs Gemini/Kimi 极显著（p<0.001），Opus 4.6 与 GPT-5.4 差异不显著（p=0.209），但单赛季共享赛程会高估显著性；(3) 失败模式统计（25 种子）：系统性的平局/冷门校准偏差 22/25、新升班马处理缺失 22/25、下注工具调用错误 13/25、无 Kelly/无原则下注 9/25、写了 Kelly 代码但下注时从不调用 7/25、赛季内不重训 7/25、回测标签泄漏 7/25、过早宣告任务完成 8/25；(4) 适应性：完全自适应种子 −11.1% vs 部分自适应 −49.6% vs 完全静态 −70.0%；Opus 4.6 与 GPT-5.4 是仅有的两个零破产模型，前者稳定使用校准 GBM + 分数 Kelly（0.15–0.25），后者在确认无法超越收盘线后转为 0.01 便士下注以保全本金；(5) 复杂度：Opus 4.6 26.5% > GPT-5.4 22.3% > GLM-5 17.3% > Kimi 12.7% > Gemini 8.8%；复杂度与 ROI 呈中度正相关，11–18 分手腕破产率约 8%，0–5 分约 55%，逻辑回归 LR 检验 p<0.001；(6) 消融：给予文献库或换用 Claude Code harness 均未改善（复杂度 29.5% vs 29.5%），而直接暴露 rubric 后复杂度升至 55.0%、平均 ROI −0.7%（3 种子）；层级 bootstrap 显示 Opus 4.6 约 33% 概率为正；(7) 人类基线：Human Quant ROI +5.1%、39 注、复杂度 73.1%，AI Researcher −4.3%，Dixon–Coles −15.4% 但优于 3/5 模型；作者指出 5.3% 的 overround 与公开数据边小是核心难点，量化交易员设计了约 260 个特征最终保留不足 10 个。

conclusion>结论与局限：KellyBench 揭示了当前模型在长时程序列决策上的系统性缺陷——能写出复杂代码、做出正确自我诊断、给出正确策略，却不执行、不监控、不随失败调整策略，且普遍低估对新增球员级特征与非平稳性（升班马）的投入；因此"分析能力—操作能力"缺口才是真实部署中的关键瓶颈，作者主张评测从固定任务集转向需在不确定性下持续学习的复杂世界。局限包括：英超市场信息效率高且缺追踪/定位球/滚球数据与临场伤停信息；仅单一赛季回测（且共享赛程影响显著性）；5.3% overround 的中间价而非 sharp odds；仅测试单智能体 harness（AlphaEvolve 式、多智能体分工未测，单个 GPT-5.4 级种子成本约 2,000 美元，学术不可负担）；以及知识污染（2023–24 赛季早于所有模型知识截止，权重记忆泄漏风险，通过禁网 + 规则化指令 + 轨迹审计缓解）。未来工作包括换用交易所 sharp odds、引入追踪/定位球数据、检测到奖励 hacking 后转上线实时基准，以及多智能体与迭代式脚手架评估。

title: Differentiable latent structure discovery for interpretable forecasting in clinical time series
comment: This manuscript is under review at BioData Mining
summary: Background: Timely, uncertainty-aware forecasting from irregular electronic health records (EHR) can support critical-care decisions, yet most approaches either impute to a grid or sacrifice interpretability. We introduce StructGP, a continuous-time multi-task Gaussian process that couples process convolutions with differentiable structure learning to uncover a sparse, ordered directed acyclic graph (DAG) of inter-variable dependencies while preserving principled uncertainty. We further propose LP-StructGP, which augments StructGP with latent pathways-shared, temporally shifted trajectories inferred via subject-specific coupling filters and a softmax gating mechanism-to capture cross-patient progression patterns. Both models are trained under sparsity and acyclicity constraints (augmented Lagrangian, Adam) using scalable low-rank updates. Results: In simulations, the approach reliably recovers ground-truth graphs (Structural Hamming Distance approaching 0 as cohorts grow) and pathway assignments (high Adjusted Rand Index). On a MIMIC-IV septic shock cohort (n=1,008; norepinephrine, creatinine, mean arterial pressure), StructGP improves short-horizon (6 h) forecasting over independent-task baselines (average RMSE 0.68 [95%CI: 0.63--0.74] vs. 0.88 [0.83-0.94]) and, with 15 additional inputs, markedly outperforms unstructured kernels (0.63 [0.58-0.69] vs. 3.02 [2.85-3.18]) with superior calibration (coverage 0.96 vs. 0.84). On the PhysioNet Challenge (12k patients, 41 variables), StructGP attains competitive accuracy (MAE 3.72e-2) relative to a state-of-the-art graph neural model while maintaining calibrated uncertainty. Conclusion: These results show that structured process convolutions with latent pathways deliver interpretable, scalable, and well-calibrated forecasting for irregular clinical time series.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 StructGP 及 LP-StructGP，利用结构化过程卷积和潜在路径机制，实现不规则临床时间序列的可解释、规模化、良好校准的预测，同时学习变量间因果依赖 DAG。
AI.motivation: ICU 中的不规则 EHR 数据需要及时且能量化不确定性的预测，但现有方法存在两方面问题：要么将数据插值到固定时间网格（丢失时序连续性），要么牺牲模型可解释性（无法揭示变量间因果关系）。因此需要一种既能处理不规则采样、又能保持不确定性量化、还能学习结构化因果依赖的模型。
AI.method: 提出 StructGP（连续时间多任务高斯过程），结合过程卷积与可微结构学习，推断变量间稀疏有序的 DAG 依赖关系；扩展为 LP-StructGP，通过subject-specific coupling filters和 softmax gating 机制引入潜在共享路径；使用增广拉格朗日 + Adam 优化器在稀疏性和无环约束下训练，采用可扩展低秩更新策略。
AI.result: 仿真中成功恢复真实图结构（SHD→0）和路径分配（高 ARI）；MIMIC-IV 脓毒性休克队列中，StructGP 6小时预测 RMSE 0.68 vs 基线 0.88；15变量输入时 0.63 vs 非结构化核 3.02，Coverage 0.96 vs 0.84；PhysioNet 12k患者/41变量挑战中 MAE 3.72e-2，媲美 GNN 且保持校准的不确定性。
AI.conclusion: StructGP 和 LP-StructGP 通过结构化过程卷积与潜在路径机制，为不规则临床时间序列提供了可解释、可扩展且校准良好的预测能力，同时保持了不确定性量化能力，在多个真实数据集上验证了有效性。

title: Modeling Clinical Concern Trajectories in Language Model Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents deployed in clinical settings often exhibit abrupt, threshold-driven behavior, offering little visibility into accumulating risk prior to escalation. In real-world care, however, clinicians act on gradually rising concern rather than instantaneous triggers. We study whether explicit state dynamics can expose such pre-escalation signals without delegating clinical authority to the agent. We introduce a lightweight agent architecture in which a memoryless clinical risk encoder is integrated over time using first- and second-order dynamics to produce a continuous escalation pressure signal. Across synthetic ward scenarios, stateless agents exhibit sharp escalation cliffs, while second-order dynamics produce smooth, anticipatory concern trajectories despite similar escalation timing. These trajectories surface sustained unease prior to escalation, enabling human-in-the-loop monitoring and more informed intervention. Our results suggest that explicit state dynamics can make LLM agents more clinically legible by revealing how long concern has been rising, not just when thresholds are crossed.

AI.tldr: 研究通过引入二阶动力学显式状态建模，使临床LLM智能体能够生成连续、可见的升级压力轨迹，从而在阈值触发前暴露累积关切信号，提升临床可解释性和人机协同监控能力。
AI.motivation: 临床LLM智能体存在阈值驱动的 abrupt 行为，缺乏风险累积可见性；而真实临床中医护人员依据逐渐上升的关切采取行动。
AI.method: 轻量级智能体架构：无记忆临床风险编码器 + 时间积分 + 一阶/二阶动力学 → 连续升级压力信号
AI.result: 二阶动力学生成平滑、可预期的关切轨迹 vs 无状态智能体的急剧升级悬崖；升级时机相似但过程可见性不同。
AI.conclusion: 显式状态动力学可提升LLM智能体的临床可解释性，揭示关切上升的持续时间而非仅关注阈值跨越时刻，支持人机协同监控。

title: ITS-Mina: A Harris Hawks Optimization-Based All-MLP Framework with Iterative Refinement and External Attention for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
summary: Multivariate time series forecasting plays a pivotal role in numerous real-world applications, including financial analysis, energy management, and traffic planning. While Transformer-based architectures have gained popularity for this task, recent studies reveal that simpler MLP-based models can achieve competitive or superior performance with significantly reduced computational cost. In this paper, we propose ITS-Mina, a novel all-MLP framework for multivariate time series forecasting that integrates three key innovations: (1) an iterative refinement mechanism that progressively enhances temporal representations by repeatedly applying a shared-parameter residual mixer stack, effectively deepening the model's computational capacity without multiplying the number of distinct parameters; (2) an external attention module that replaces traditional self-attention with learnable memory units, capturing cross-sample global dependencies at linear computational complexity; and (3) a Harris Hawks Optimization (HHO) algorithm for automatic dropout rate tuning, enabling adaptive regularization tailored to each dataset. Extensive experiments on six widely-used benchmark datasets demonstrate that ITS-Mina achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance compared to eleven baseline models across multiple forecasting horizons.

AI.tldr: ITS-Mina is an all-MLP multivariate time series forecasting framework that combines iterative refinement, linear-complexity external attention, and HHO-based dropout tuning to achieve SOTA performance with reduced computational cost compared to Transformer-based approaches.
AI.motivation: While Transformer-based architectures dominate multivariate time series forecasting, they incur substantial computational costs. Recent research shows that simpler MLP-based models can achieve competitive or better performance at significantly lower computational expense, motivating the exploration of all-MLP architectures.
AI.method: ITS-Mina introduces three innovations: (1) iterative refinement via shared-parameter residual mixer stack for deepening computational capacity without parameter multiplication; (2) external attention module replacing self-attention with learnable memory units, achieving linear computational complexity; (3) Harris Hawks Optimization (HHO) algorithm for automatic dropout rate tuning to enable dataset-adaptive regularization.
AI.result: Extensive experiments on six widely-used benchmark datasets demonstrate that ITS-Mina achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance compared to eleven baseline models across multiple forecasting horizons.
AI.conclusion: ITS-Mina presents a practical solution for multivariate time series forecasting by eliminating the computational overhead of attention mechanisms while maintaining or exceeding the accuracy of Transformer-based approaches. The combination of iterative refinement, linear-complexity external attention, and automated regularization makes it a scalable and adaptive framework for real-world applications.

title: Building Persona-Based Agents On Demand: Tailoring Multi-Agent Workflows to User Needs
summary: Recent advances in agentic AI are shifting automation from discrete tools to proactive multi-agent systems that coordinate multi-specialized capabilities behind unified interfaces. However, today's agent systems typically rely on hard-coded agent architectures with fixed roles, coordination patterns, and interaction flows that limit end-user personalization and make adaptation to individual needs and contexts difficult. Given this limitation, we argue that on-demand persona-based agent generation offers a promising path towards more efficient and contextually appropriate interaction within agentic workflows. By dynamically crafting agents and personas at run-time to match user characteristics, task demands, and workflow context, agentic platforms can move beyond one-size-fits-all configurations. We present a pipeline for on-demand persona generation in agentic platforms, detailing how real-time crafting of AI personas can be systematically integrated within agent systems, aiming to open new possibilities in agentic platform design paradigms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出按需人格生成作为突破现有硬编码智能体架构限制的解决方案，通过运行时动态创建匹配用户特征和任务需求的AI人格，实现智能体平台从"一刀切"向个性化自适应的范式转变。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体系统依赖硬编码的架构设计，具有固定的角色定义、协调模式和交互流程，导致终端用户个性化程度有限，难以适应个体差异和动态变化的使用场景。
AI.method: 提出了一个面向智能体平台的按需人格生成pipeline，通过实时分析用户特征、任务需求和工作流上下文，动态构建和调整AI智能体的人格配置与协作模式。
AI.result: 展示了如何在智能体系统内部系统性集成实时AI人格定制能力，为智能体平台的设计范式演进提供了可行路径。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为智能体平台设计开辟了新思路，通过运行时动态生成AI人格的系统化方法，突破了传统固定架构的限制，为实现真正的个性化自适应智能体系统奠定了基础。

title: Dynamic Scaled Gradient Descent for Stable Fine-Tuning for Classifications
summary: Fine-tuning pretrained models has become a standard approach to adapting pretrained knowledge to improve the accuracy on new sparse, imbalance datasets. However, issues arise when optimization falls into a collapsed state, where the model gets stuck, leading to degraded performance and unstable training. One possible reason for this is the cancellation of gradients across training examples. To address this problem, we propose a novel algorithm, dynamic scaled gradient descent (\mName), that directly modifies the gradients returned by training examples, specifically, scaling down the gradients of correctly classified examples using a dynamic scaler. This strategy offers both theoretical and empirical advantages in improving training stability. Experiments on a variety of benchmark datasets, spanning multiple tasks and large pretrained models, demonstrate that our method consistently reduces performance variance and surpasses the accuracy of existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动态缩放梯度下降法(DSGD)，通过动态缩小正确分类样本的梯度来解决预训练模型微调中的梯度崩溃问题，实验证明该方法能有效提升训练稳定性和模型性能。
AI.motivation: 在预训练模型微调过程中，当优化陷入崩溃状态时会导致性能下降和训练不稳定，可能原因是训练样本间梯度的相互抵消。
AI.method: DSGD算法直接修改训练样本返回的梯度，对正确分类的样本使用动态缩放器进行梯度缩小处理。
AI.result: 在多种基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法能够一致性地降低性能方差并超越现有方法的准确率。
AI.conclusion: DSGD通过动态缩小正确分类样本的梯度，在保持理论优势的同时显著提升了训练稳定性，在多种任务和大规模预训练模型上均表现出更低的性能方差和更高的准确率。

title: In-Context Prompting Obsoletes Agent Orchestration for Procedural Tasks
summary: Agent orchestration frameworks -- LangGraph, CrewAI, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, and others -- place an external orchestrator above the LLM, tracking state and injecting routing instructions at every turn. We present a controlled comparison showing that for procedural tasks, this architecture is dominated by a simpler alternative: putting the entire procedure in the system prompt and letting the model self-orchestrate. Across three domains -- travel booking (14 nodes), Zoom technical support (14 nodes), and insurance claims processing (55 nodes) -- we evaluate 200 conversations per condition using LLM-as-judge scoring on five quality criteria. The in-context approach scores 4.53--5.00 on a 5-point scale while a LangGraph orchestrator using the same model scores 4.17--4.84. The orchestrated system fails on 24% of travel, 9% of Zoom, and 17% of insurance conversations, compared to 11.5%, 0.5%, and 5% for the in-context baseline. While external orchestration may have been necessary for earlier models, advances in frontier model capabilities have made it unnecessary for multi-turn conversations following a defined procedure.

AI.tldr: 该研究证明，对于程序性任务，将完整程序置于系统提示中让模型自我编排的方法，优于使用外部编排框架（如LangGraph）。在旅行预订、技术支持和保险理赔三个领域进行评估，上下文内方法获得更高评分且失败率更低。
AI.motivation: 当前的Agent编排框架（LangGraph、CrewAI、Google ADK、OpenAI Agents SDK等）依赖外部编排器置于LLM之上进行状态跟踪和路由指令注入。研究假设这种架构对于程序性任务可能已被更简单的替代方案所主导。
AI.method: 采用受控对比实验，在三个领域（旅行预订14节点、Zoom技术支持14节点、保险理赔55节点）每个条件评估200段对话，使用LLM-as-judge在五个质量标准上进行评分。比较了LangGraph编排器与将完整程序置于系统提示的上下文内方法。
AI.result: 上下文内方法在5分制上得分4.53-5.00，而使用相同模型的LangGraph编排器得分4.17-4.84。编排系统在旅行预订中失败24%、Zoom中9%、保险理赔中17%，而上下文基线分别为11.5%、0.5%、5%。
AI.conclusion: 外部编排框架可能对早期模型有必要，但在当前前沿模型能力下，对于遵循定义程序的多轮对话不再必要。

title: Latent-GRPO: Group Relative Policy Optimization for Latent Reasoning
comment: This is an actively developing work, and we will continue to update the arXiv version
summary: Latent reasoning offers a more efficient alternative to explicit reasoning by compressing intermediate reasoning into continuous representations and substantially shortening reasoning chains. However, existing latent reasoning methods mainly focus on supervised learning, and reinforcement learning in latent space remains highly unstable. We study this problem through the lens of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), and show that directly adapting GRPO to latent reasoning is fundamentally non-trivial: latent reasoning changes both the probability density and the sampling mechanism, causing three coupled bottlenecks: absence of intrinsic latent manifolds, where unconstrained exploration pushes rollouts off the valid latent manifold; exploration-optimization misalignment, where trajectory-level rewards can induce incorrect token-level updates; and latent mixture non-closure, where jointly reinforcing multiple correct latent paths can produce an invalid averaged state. To address them, we propose \textbf{Latent-GRPO}, which combines invalid-sample advantage masking, one-sided noise sampling, and optimal correct-path first-token selection. Across four low-difficulty benchmarks (e.g., GSM8K-Aug) and four high-difficulty benchmarks (e.g., AIME), Latent-GRPO improves over its latent initialization by 7.86 Pass@1 points on low-difficulty tasks and surpasses explicit GRPO by 4.27 points on high-difficulty tasks while using 3--4$\times$ shorter reasoning chains. It also achieves stronger pass@$k$ performance under Gumbel sampling. These results establish Latent-GRPO as an effective approach for stable and efficient latent reasoning.

AI.tldr: Latent-GRPO 是一篇把 GRPO 强化学习后训练迁移到“隐式（连续）推理”范式的系统性工作。作者指出直接照搬 GRPO/Soft-GRPO 到隐式推理在概率密度与采样机制上存在三个耦合瓶颈（缺乏内在隐式流形、探索—优化方向错配、隐式混合非闭合），并据此提出三组件方案：无效样本优势掩码（只保留在长度上限前正常终止的轨迹参与组统计）、单边噪声采样（Gumbel 噪声裁剪平移为严格正值，并用条件 STE 在多轮 PPO 更新越界时翻转梯度以保持方向一致）、最优正确路径首 token 选择（在多条正确轨迹中按平均 surrogate log-prob 选一条，仅屏蔽其 t=1 的首 token 更新）。实验上，低难度任务（GSM8K-Aug 等，LLaMA-3.2-1B）较隐式初始化提升 7.86 Pass@1，高难度任务（Math500/AIME24/AIME25/GPQA，Qwen2.5-Math-7B）提升 14.77 点并反超显式 GRPO 4.27 点，同时推理链缩短 3–4 倍；Gumbel 采样下 pass@k（AIME24/25 pass@64 达 46.7/53.3）显著优于显式 GRPO。
AI.motivation: 显式 CoT 推理链随测试时扩展不断变长，带来严重的计算冗余与延迟。隐式推理把中间推理压缩为连续表示（latent token，通常取 top-K 词表嵌入的概率加权组合），可大幅缩短推理链。但已有隐式推理工作（如 Coconut、CODI、CoLaR、Latent-SFT）主要依赖监督微调，隐式空间中的强化学习仍极不稳定：Soft-GRPO 用 Gumbel 重参数估计隐式 token 概率密度后仍难以超过显式 token RL，增大 Gumbel 温度以鼓励探索则直接导致模型崩溃。作者因此研究：能否用 LLM RL 中最主流的 GRPO 框架，在隐式推理上获得稳定且高效的性能提升。作者强调，隐式推理同时改变了概率密度与采样机制，这使得 GRPO 的直接适配在原理上就非平凡，需要先做机理诊断再设计针对性方法。
AI.method:
方法建立在 Latent-SFT 初始化与 Soft-GRPO 的混合轨迹（连续隐式段 + 离散显式答案段）数学框架之上，核心是三项针对性设计：

(1) 无效样本优势掩码（Invalid Sample Advantage Masking）：以是否在最大响应长度 L_max 之前正常发出终止符判定轨迹有效性 G_valid={j | L_j < L_max}；组内均值与标准差仅在有效子集上计算，无效轨迹优势显式置 0（若有效集为空或方差为 0 则全部置 0）。作用是防止越界/不终止的离流形 rollout 污染组统计。

(2) 单边噪声采样（One-sided Noise Sampling）：对 i.i.d. Gumbel(0,1) 噪声做逐维裁剪平移 ξ_i^+ = clip(ξ_i, -a, b) + a + δ（a=1.5, b=3.0, δ>0），保证目标 g_i* = log p_i(θ_old)+ξ_i^+ 严格大于原预测；由于 softmax 平移不变，统一平移不改变归一化混合权重，仅把扰动 margin 推入正值区。进一步针对 PPO 多轮更新会越过固定目标导致 margin 变负的问题，在 margin 上引入条件直通估计器 FlipGrad（前向恒等、反向取负），得到单边 surrogate log-likelihood log π_θ^+。附录给出梯度推导：在 log p_i(θ) 坐标下 ∂ℓ^+/∂log p_i ≥ 0 且非零时严格为正，从而让更新方向与轨迹优势符号对齐；同时诚实说明在 softmax 竞争下并非每个被选 token 的 logit 都必然上升，非 top-K token 获得聚合向下信号。

(3) 最优正确路径首 token 选择（Optimal Correct Path First Token Selection）：针对隐式混合非闭合（同一 prefix 下同时强化多条正确路径会产生无效的平均隐状态，类似连续控制中的多模态动作平均问题，且在 t=1 最严重）。在正确轨迹集 G_correct 中按 rollout 目标下的平均每 token surrogate log-prob 选出最优路径 j*，并施加时间-轨迹依赖的掩码 M_{j,t}：仅对未被选中的其他正确路径屏蔽 t=1 的更新，后续 token 更新全部保留，避免把优化坍缩为单一轨迹。
